51type PredicateInput = (u32, String, Vec<(String, u8, String)>, Vec<usize>);
52type RecordInput = (u32, Vec<(u8, Py<PyAny>)>, Vec<u32>);

54type TaskContentRead = (Py<PyBytes>, Py<PyBytes>, Py<PyBytes>, (u8, u8, u8));

56fn task_content_read(
57    py: Python<'_>,
58    (identity, truth): (SemanticTaskContentIdentity, [SemanticTruth; 3]),
59) -> TaskContentRead {
60    let [first, second, third] = truth.map(|truth| match truth {
61        SemanticTruth::Neither => 0,
62        SemanticTruth::True => 1,
63        SemanticTruth::False => 2,
64        SemanticTruth::Both => 3,
65    });
66    (
67        PyBytes::new(py, identity.query.as_bytes()).unbind(),
68        PyBytes::new(py, identity.theory_program.as_bytes()).unbind(),
69        PyBytes::new(py, identity.result.as_bytes()).unbind(),
70        (first, second, third),
71    )
72}

74/// Own one admitted native semantic session and its acquired policy codebooks.
75///
76/// All constructor arguments are required and keyword-only. ``predicates`` rows
77/// are ``(predicate_id, role, columns, key_columns)``. Each column is
78/// ``(name, scalar_type_code, sort_label)``. Roles are ``statement``, ``qualifier``,
79/// ``provenance``, ``source``, ``context``, and ``scope``.
80///
81/// ``records`` rows are ``(predicate_id, arguments, qualifier_indices)``; each
82/// argument is ``(scalar_type_code, value)``. Canonical XLOG scalar codes are
83/// 0=u32, 1=u64, 2=i32, 3=i64, 4=f32 bits, 5=f64 bits, 6=bool, 7=symbol ID.
84/// Float arguments require unsigned integer IEEE bit patterns. Symbol IDs come
85/// from ``intern_symbols``; canonical admission retains the accepted symbol bytes.
86///
87/// ``supports`` rows are ``(statement_index, polarity, provenance_index,
88/// source_index, context_index, scope_index)`` with polarity ``pro`` or ``contra``.
89/// All record indices address ``records``. ``capacities`` is
90/// ``(roots, statements, supports, versions)``. ``admission_limits`` is
91/// ``(max_records, max_terms, max_references, max_utf8_bytes)``. ``device_ordinal``
92/// selects the CUDA device and ``memory_bytes`` bounds its allocation budget.
93///
94/// Construction allocates the native CUDA owner and admits the supplied typed
95/// descriptors against its empty base. It does not insert supplied supports into
96/// that base or grant task execution, publication, inference, or training authority.
97/// Public orchestration and reads belong to the constructing Python thread.
98/// The trusted Runtime must retain every issued witness and policy invocation,
99/// their original producers, callbacks and saved autograd payloads through the
100/// original backward call, then perform one guaranteed creator-thread cleanup.
101/// External aliases require their owning Runtime to remain alive until release.
102/// Transferable native ownership does not make arbitrary Python finalizers safe
103/// on workers. Only a retained content witness may verify from a worker thread.
104#[pyclass(name = "SemanticTransitionSession", module = "pyxlog._native", frozen)]
105pub(crate) struct PySemanticTransitionSession {
106    inner: Mutex<Option<SemanticTransitionSession>>,
107    editable_program: Option<Arc<SemanticProgramAdmission>>,
108    editable_observer_source: Option<String>,
109    importing: Arc<AtomicBool>,
110    recording: AtomicBool,
111    retiring: AtomicBool,
112    prepared_segment: Mutex<Option<PreparedPythonSegment>>,
113    learning_preparing: AtomicBool,
114    learning_transition: Mutex<Option<Py<learning_phase::PySemanticLearningPhaseTransition>>>,
115    issuance: Arc<AtomicU64>,
116    owner_thread: ThreadId,
117    device_ordinal: usize,
118    capacities: (u32, u32, u32, u32),
119    admission_limits: (u32, u32, u32, usize),
120    memory_bytes: u64,
121}
122
123struct SemanticSessionGuard<'a>(MutexGuard<'a, Option<SemanticTransitionSession>>);
124
125impl std::ops::Deref for SemanticSessionGuard<'_> {
126    type Target = SemanticTransitionSession;
127
128    fn deref(&self) -> &Self::Target {
129        self.0.as_ref().expect("checked live semantic session")
130    }
131}
132
133impl std::ops::DerefMut for SemanticSessionGuard<'_> {
134    fn deref_mut(&mut self) -> &mut Self::Target {
135        self.0.as_mut().expect("checked live semantic session")
136    }
137}

139impl PySemanticTransitionSession {
140    fn require_creator(&self) -> PyResult<()> {
141        require_creator_thread(self.owner_thread)
142    }
143
144    fn owner(&self) -> PyResult<SemanticSessionGuard<'_>> {
145        self.require_creator()?;
146        if !self.recording.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
147            drain_export_owners();
148        }
149        self.witness_owner()
150    }
151
152    // Only content verification enters this lock from an autograd worker.
153    // Do not drain creator-owned Python references or run callbacks here.
154    fn witness_owner(&self) -> PyResult<SemanticSessionGuard<'_>> {
155        let owner = self.inner.lock().map_err(|_| {
156            PyRuntimeError::new_err("native semantic session owner mutex is poisoned")
157        })?;
158        if owner.is_none() {
159            return Err(invalid("native semantic session was terminally released"));
160        }
161        Ok(SemanticSessionGuard(owner))
162    }
163
164    fn release_observed_cold(&self) -> PyResult<()> {
165        self.require_creator()?;
166        if self.importing.load(Ordering::Acquire)
167            || self.recording.load(Ordering::Acquire)
168            || self.retiring.load(Ordering::Acquire)
169            || self.issuance.load(Ordering::Acquire) != 0
170        {
171            return Err(invalid("fresh cold release requires an unused Session"));
172        }
173        let owner = {
174            let mut guard = self
175                .inner
176                .lock()
177                .map_err(|_| invalid("native semantic session owner mutex is poisoned"))?;
178            let live = guard
179                .as_mut()
180                .ok_or_else(|| invalid("fresh cold Session was already released"))?;
181            live.join_observed_cold_release().map_err(xlog_err)?;
182            guard.take().expect("checked live fresh cold Session")
183        };
184        owner.finish_observed_cold_release().map_err(xlog_err)?;
185        drain_export_owners();
186        Ok(())
187    }
188
189    fn from_admission(
190        records: SemanticAdmissionRecords,
191        capacities: (u32, u32, u32, u32),
192        admission_limits: (u32, u32, u32, usize),
193        device_ordinal: usize,
194        memory_bytes: u64,
195    ) -> PyResult<Self> {
196        let editable_source = cold_task::editable_source_from_admission(&records)?;
197        let native_capacities = SemanticHypergraphCapacities::try_new(
198            capacities.0,
199            capacities.1,
200            capacities.2,
201            capacities.3,
202        )
203        .map_err(val_err)?;
204        let limits = SemanticAdmissionLimits {
205            max_records: admission_limits.0,
206            max_terms: admission_limits.1,
207            max_references: admission_limits.2,
208            max_utf8_bytes: admission_limits.3,
209        };
210        let mut config = GpuConfig::default();
211        config.device_ordinal = device_ordinal;
212        config.memory_bytes = memory_bytes;
213        let provider = Arc::new(crate::provider_from_config(config).map_err(xlog_err)?);
214        let runtime = provider.memory().runtime().cloned().ok_or_else(|| {
215            PyRuntimeError::new_err("native semantic session requires a CUDA runtime")
216        })?;
217        let stream_id = runtime.stream_pool().acquire().map_err(xlog_err)?;
218        let stream = runtime.stream_pool().resolve(stream_id).ok_or_else(|| {
219            PyRuntimeError::new_err("native semantic session stream is unavailable")
220        })?;
221        let domain = provider
222            .bind_resident_execution_domain(runtime, stream_id, stream)
223            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
224        let mut graph = provider
225            .allocate_semantic_hypergraph(&domain, native_capacities)
226            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
227        graph
228            .admit_records(graph.empty_root(), records, limits)
229            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
230        let session = SemanticTransitionSession::from_hypergraph_with_program(
231            graph,
232            editable_source
233                .as_ref()
234                .map(|source| source.program.as_ref()),
235        )
236        .map_err(xlog_err)?;
237        Ok(Self {
238            inner: Mutex::new(Some(session)),
239            editable_program: editable_source
240                .as_ref()
241                .map(|source| Arc::clone(&source.program)),
242            editable_observer_source: editable_source.map(|source| source.observer_source),
243            importing: Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),
244            recording: AtomicBool::new(false),
245            retiring: AtomicBool::new(false),
246            prepared_segment: Mutex::new(None),
247            learning_preparing: AtomicBool::new(false),
248            learning_transition: Mutex::new(None),
249            issuance: Arc::new(AtomicU64::new(0)),
250            owner_thread: std::thread::current().id(),
251            device_ordinal,
252            capacities,
253            admission_limits,
254            memory_bytes,
255        })
256    }
257}

267#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
268struct TaskCheckpointBinding {
269    identity: [u8; 32],
270    epoch: u64,
271    content: [[u8; 32]; 3],
272    goal: [u8; 32],
273    scoring_law: [u8; 32],
274}
275
276impl TaskCheckpointBinding {
277    const BYTES: usize = 32 + 8 + 3 * 32 + 32 + 32;
278
279    fn content_identity(self) -> SemanticTaskContentIdentity {
280        SemanticTaskContentIdentity {
281            query: Identity256::from_bytes(self.content[0]),
282            theory_program: Identity256::from_bytes(self.content[1]),
283            result: Identity256::from_bytes(self.content[2]),
284        }
285    }
286
287    fn from_owner(owner: &SemanticTransitionSession) -> PyResult<Self> {
288        let identity = *owner
289            .task_evaluation_identity()
290            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("checkpoint has no native task binding"))?
291            .as_bytes();
292        let epoch = owner.task_evaluation_epoch();
293        if epoch == 0 {
294            return Err(invalid("checkpoint has no native task epoch"));
295        }
296        let (content, _) = owner
297            .task_content()
298            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("checkpoint has no native task content"))?;
299        let goal = *owner
300            .task_semantic_goal_root()
301            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("checkpoint has no semantic task goal"))?
302            .as_bytes();
303        let scoring_law = *owner
304            .task_scoring_law_identity()
305            .map_err(xlog_err)?
306            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("checkpoint has no native scoring law"))?
307            .as_bytes();
308        Ok(Self {
309            identity,
310            epoch,
311            content: [
312                *content.query.as_bytes(),
313                *content.theory_program.as_bytes(),
314                *content.result.as_bytes(),
315            ],
316            goal,
317            scoring_law,
318        })
319    }
320
321    fn same_task_content(self, other: Self) -> bool {
322        self.identity == other.identity
323            && self.content == other.content
324            && self.goal == other.goal
325            && self.scoring_law == other.scoring_law
326    }
327
328    fn same_cold_arena_content(self, other: Self) -> bool {
329        self.identity != other.identity
330            && self.epoch.checked_add(1) == Some(other.epoch)
331            && self.content == other.content
332            && self.goal == other.goal
333            && self.scoring_law == other.scoring_law
334    }
335
336    fn encode(self) -> [u8; Self::BYTES] {
337        let mut bytes = [0u8; Self::BYTES];
338        bytes[..32].copy_from_slice(&self.identity);
339        bytes[32..40].copy_from_slice(&self.epoch.to_le_bytes());
340        let mut offset = 40;
341        for digest in self
342            .content
343            .into_iter()
344            .chain([self.goal, self.scoring_law])
345        {
346            bytes[offset..offset + 32].copy_from_slice(&digest);
347            offset += 32;
348        }
349        bytes
350    }
351
352    fn decode(bytes: &[u8]) -> PyResult<Self> {
353        if bytes.len() != Self::BYTES {
354            return Err(invalid("checkpoint native task binding has another extent"));
355        }
356        let identity = bytes[..32].try_into().unwrap();
357        let epoch = u64::from_le_bytes(bytes[32..40].try_into().unwrap());
358        let mut offset = 40;
359        let mut next = || {
360            let digest = bytes[offset..offset + 32].try_into().unwrap();
361            offset += 32;
362            digest
363        };
364        if epoch == 0 {
365            return Err(invalid("checkpoint native task epoch is absent"));
366        }
367        Ok(Self {
368            identity,
369            epoch,
370            content: [next(), next(), next()],
371            goal: next(),
372            scoring_law: next(),
373        })
374    }
375}

377#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
378struct CheckpointReferent {
379    checkpoint_digest: [u8; 32],
380    checkpoint_bytes: u64,
381    publication: [u8; 104],
382    semantic_root: [u8; 32],
383    model_generation: u64,
384    model_digest: [u8; 32],
385    task: TaskCheckpointBinding,
386    scope_digest: [u8; 32],
387    authority_root: [u8; 32],
388    snapshot_digest: [u8; 32],
389    phase: CheckpointTaskPhase,
390}
391
392impl CheckpointReferent {
393    const MAGIC: &'static [u8] = b"XLOG-CHECKPOINT-REFERENT\0";
394    const VERSION: u32 = 2;
395    const BYTES: usize =
396        Self::MAGIC.len() + 4 + 32 + 8 + 104 + 32 + 8 + 32 + 32 + 8 + 3 * 32 + 5 * 32 + 1;
397
398    fn encode(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
399        let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(Self::BYTES);
400        bytes.extend_from_slice(Self::MAGIC);
401        bytes.extend_from_slice(&Self::VERSION.to_le_bytes());
402        bytes.extend_from_slice(&self.checkpoint_digest);
403        bytes.extend_from_slice(&self.checkpoint_bytes.to_le_bytes());
404        bytes.extend_from_slice(&self.publication);
405        bytes.extend_from_slice(&self.semantic_root);
406        bytes.extend_from_slice(&self.model_generation.to_le_bytes());
407        bytes.extend_from_slice(&self.model_digest);
408        bytes.extend_from_slice(&self.task.identity);
409        bytes.extend_from_slice(&self.task.epoch.to_le_bytes());
410        for digest in &self.task.content {
411            bytes.extend_from_slice(digest);
412        }
413        for digest in [
414            self.task.goal,
415            self.task.scoring_law,
416            self.scope_digest,
417            self.authority_root,
418            self.snapshot_digest,
419        ] {
420            bytes.extend_from_slice(&digest);
421        }
422        bytes.push(match self.phase {
423            CheckpointTaskPhase::Imported => 1,
424            CheckpointTaskPhase::InitialPrefillBound => 2,
425            CheckpointTaskPhase::Segment(_) => unreachable!("referents require a pre-action phase"),
426        });
427        debug_assert_eq!(bytes.len(), Self::BYTES);
428        bytes
429    }
430
431    fn decode(bytes: &[u8]) -> PyResult<Self> {
432        if bytes.len() != Self::BYTES || !bytes.starts_with(Self::MAGIC) {
433            return Err(invalid("checkpoint referent has another extent or domain"));
434        }
435        let mut cursor = Self::MAGIC.len();
436        let take = |cursor: &mut usize, count: usize| {
437            let start = *cursor;
438            *cursor += count;
439            &bytes[start..*cursor]
440        };
441        if take(&mut cursor, 4) != Self::VERSION.to_le_bytes() {
442            return Err(invalid("checkpoint referent has another version"));
443        }
444        let digest = |cursor: &mut usize| -> [u8; 32] {
445            take(cursor, 32).try_into().expect("fixed referent extent")
446        };
447        let checkpoint_digest = digest(&mut cursor);
448        let checkpoint_bytes = u64::from_le_bytes(
449            take(&mut cursor, 8)
450                .try_into()
451                .expect("fixed referent extent"),
452        );
453        if checkpoint_bytes == 0 {
454            return Err(invalid("checkpoint referent has an empty source"));
455        }
456        let publication = take(&mut cursor, 104)
457            .try_into()
458            .expect("fixed referent extent");
459        let semantic_root = digest(&mut cursor);
460        let model_generation = u64::from_le_bytes(
461            take(&mut cursor, 8)
462                .try_into()
463                .expect("fixed referent extent"),
464        );
465        let model_digest = digest(&mut cursor);
466        let identity = digest(&mut cursor);
467        let epoch = u64::from_le_bytes(
468            take(&mut cursor, 8)
469                .try_into()
470                .expect("fixed referent extent"),
471        );
472        let content = std::array::from_fn(|_| digest(&mut cursor));
473        let goal = digest(&mut cursor);
474        let scoring_law = digest(&mut cursor);
475        let scope_digest = digest(&mut cursor);
476        let authority_root = digest(&mut cursor);
477        let snapshot_digest = digest(&mut cursor);
478        let phase = match take(&mut cursor, 1)[0] {
479            1 => CheckpointTaskPhase::Imported,
480            2 => CheckpointTaskPhase::InitialPrefillBound,
481            _ => return Err(invalid("checkpoint referent phase is invalid")),
482        };
483        Ok(Self {
484            checkpoint_digest,
485            checkpoint_bytes,
486            publication,
487            semantic_root,
488            model_generation,
489            model_digest,
490            task: TaskCheckpointBinding {
491                identity,
492                epoch,
493                content,
494                goal,
495                scoring_law,
496            },
497            scope_digest,
498            authority_root,
499            snapshot_digest,
500            phase,
501        })
502    }
503
504    fn from_checkpoint(bytes: &[u8]) -> PyResult<Self> {
505        let manifest = SemanticCheckpointManifest::decode(bytes)?;
506        let (seed, snapshot, phase, task) = TaskCheckpointSeed::decode(&manifest.task)?;
507        if phase != CheckpointTaskPhase::InitialPrefillBound {
508            return Err(invalid(
509                "checkpoint referent requires an original initial-prefill-bound task phase",
510            ));
511        }
512        let authority = TaskAuthority::parse(&seed.authority)?;
513        let native = SemanticTransitionSession::state_material_projection(&manifest.native)
514            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
515        if !SemanticTransitionSession::verify_checkpoint_initial_prefill_source(
516            &manifest.initial_prefill,
517            &manifest.native,
518            Identity256::from_bytes(task.identity),
519            task.epoch,
520            task.content_identity(),
521            true,
522        )
523        .map_err(xlog_err)?
524        {
525            return Err(invalid(
526                "checkpoint referent has no original initial prefill",
527            ));
528        }
529        Ok(Self {
530            checkpoint_digest: Sha256::digest(bytes).into(),
531            checkpoint_bytes: u64::try_from(bytes.len())
532                .map_err(|_| invalid("checkpoint source exceeds u64"))?,
533            publication: checkpoint_publication_bytes(native.publication),
534            semantic_root: *native.semantic_root.as_bytes(),
535            model_generation: native.model_generation,
536            model_digest: Sha256::digest(&manifest.model).into(),
537            task,
538            scope_digest: checkpoint_scope_digest(&authority.scope),
539            authority_root: *authority.authority_root().as_bytes(),
540            snapshot_digest: Sha256::digest(&snapshot.canonical).into(),
541            phase,
542        })
543    }
544
545    fn verify_source(&self, bytes: &[u8]) -> PyResult<()> {
546        if u64::try_from(bytes.len()).ok() != Some(self.checkpoint_bytes)
547            || Sha256::digest(bytes).as_slice() != self.checkpoint_digest
548            || Self::from_checkpoint(bytes)? != *self
549        {
550            return Err(invalid(
551                "checkpoint referent differs from its retained complete source",
552            ));
553        }
554        Ok(())
555    }
556}
557
558fn checkpoint_scope_digest(scope: &[String]) -> [u8; 32] {
559    let mut digest = Sha256::new();
560    digest.update(b"xlog.semantic.checkpoint.scope.v1\0");
561    digest.update((scope.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
562    for item in scope {
563        digest.update((item.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
564        digest.update(item.as_bytes());
565    }
566    digest.finalize().into()
567}
568
569fn checkpoint_publication_bytes(identity: xlog_cuda::SemanticPublishedIdentity) -> [u8; 104] {
570    let mut bytes = [0u8; 104];
571    bytes[..32].copy_from_slice(identity.instance.as_bytes());
572    bytes[32..40].copy_from_slice(&identity.word.to_le_bytes());
573    bytes[40..72].copy_from_slice(identity.logical_digest.as_bytes());
574    bytes[72..].copy_from_slice(identity.state_digest.as_bytes());
575    bytes
576}
577
578fn check_checkpoint_referent_limits(
579    referents: &[CheckpointReferent],
580    max_checkpoint_bytes: usize,
581    max_total_checkpoint_bytes: usize,
582) -> PyResult<()> {
583    let mut unique = BTreeMap::new();
584    let mut total = 0usize;
585    for referent in referents {
586        let length = usize::try_from(referent.checkpoint_bytes)
587            .map_err(|_| invalid("checkpoint source exceeds host address space"))?;
588        if length == 0 || length > max_checkpoint_bytes {
589            return Err(invalid("checkpoint source exceeds its item limit"));
590        }
591        if let Some(previous) = unique.insert(referent.checkpoint_digest, referent) {
592            if previous != referent {
593                return Err(invalid("one checkpoint digest names different referents"));
594            }
595        } else {
596            total = total
597                .checked_add(length)
598                .ok_or_else(|| invalid("checkpoint source aggregate overflows this host"))?;
599            if total > max_total_checkpoint_bytes {
600                return Err(invalid("checkpoint sources exceed their aggregate limit"));
601            }
602        }
603    }
604    Ok(())
605}

607fn refresh_checkpoint_authority(
608    authority: &TaskAuthority,
609    snapshot: &mut AuthoritySnapshot,
610    refresh_snapshot: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
611    operation: &str,
612    actor_row: bool,
613) -> PyResult<()> {
614    let refreshed = refresh_snapshot.call0()?;
615    let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
616    let refreshed = AuthoritySnapshot::parse(&ColdValue::read(&refreshed, &mut budget, 0)?)?;
617    refreshed.newer_than(snapshot)?;
618    if actor_row {
619        authority.check_use("training", &refreshed, true)?;
620    }
621    authority.check_use(operation, &refreshed, true)?;
622    *snapshot = refreshed;
623    Ok(())
624}
625
626fn resolve_replay_checkpoint_referents(
627    py: Python<'_>,
628    authority: &TaskAuthority,
629    snapshot: &mut AuthoritySnapshot,
630    resolve_checkpoint: Option<&Bound<'_, PyAny>>,
631    refresh_snapshot: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
632    max_checkpoint_bytes: Option<&Bound<'_, PyAny>>,
633    max_total_checkpoint_bytes: Option<&Bound<'_, PyAny>>,
634) -> PyResult<Vec<CheckpointReferent>> {
635    let mut uses = Vec::new();
636    for (ordinal, row) in authority.replay.iter().enumerate() {
637        if let Some(referent) = row.checkpoint_referent()? {
638            uses.push((ordinal, false, referent));
639        }
640        if let Some(referent) = row.recovered_prefill_referent()? {
641            uses.push((ordinal, true, referent));
642        }
643    }
644    let referents = uses
645        .iter()
646        .map(|(_, _, referent)| referent.clone())
647        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
648    if referents.is_empty() {
649        if resolve_checkpoint.is_some()
650            || max_checkpoint_bytes.is_some()
651            || max_total_checkpoint_bytes.is_some()
652        {
653            return Err(invalid(
654                "replay without checkpoint referents must not supply a source resolver",
655            ));
656        }
657        return Ok(referents);
658    }
659    let resolver = resolve_checkpoint
660        .filter(|callback| callback.is_callable())
661        .ok_or_else(|| invalid("replay requires one checkpoint source resolver"))?;
662    if !refresh_snapshot.is_callable() {
663        return Err(invalid(
664            "replay requires the original current-authority refresh callback",
665        ));
666    }
667    let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
668    let limit = |value: Option<&Bound<'_, PyAny>>, name: &str, budget: &mut usize| {
669        usize::try_from(
670            ColdValue::read(
671                value.ok_or_else(|| invalid(&format!("replay requires {name}")))?,
672                budget,
673                0,
674            )?
675            .unsigned()?,
676        )
677        .map_err(|_| invalid(&format!("{name} exceeds host address space")))
678    };
679    let item_limit = limit(max_checkpoint_bytes, "max_checkpoint_bytes", &mut budget)?;
680    let total_limit = limit(
681        max_total_checkpoint_bytes,
682        "max_total_checkpoint_bytes",
683        &mut budget,
684    )?;
685    check_checkpoint_referent_limits(&referents, item_limit, total_limit)?;
686    let mut verified = BTreeMap::<[u8; 32], Vec<u8>>::new();
687    for (ordinal, recovered_prefill, referent) in &uses {
688        let row = &authority.replay[*ordinal];
689        let native = row.native_replay()?;
690        let operation = if *recovered_prefill {
691            if native.material.transition_kind() == SemanticTransitionKind::Update {
692                "training"
693            } else {
694                "inference"
695            }
696        } else {
697            "training"
698        };
699        let actor_row = row.checkpoint_referent()?.is_some();
700        if actor_row {
701            authority.check_use("training", snapshot, true)?;
702        }
703        authority.check_use(operation, snapshot, true)?;
704        if referent.scope_digest != checkpoint_scope_digest(&authority.scope) {
705            return Err(invalid("replay checkpoint refers to another task scope"));
706        }
707        let predecessor = native.material.predecessor_identity();
708        if !*recovered_prefill
709            && referent.publication != checkpoint_publication_bytes(predecessor)
710            && row.recovered_prefill_referent()?.as_ref() != Some(referent)
711        {
712            return Err(invalid(
713                "actor checkpoint publication differs from the verified episode predecessor",
714            ));
715        }
716        match verified.entry(referent.checkpoint_digest) {
717            Entry::Vacant(entry) => {
718                let source =
719                    resolver.call1((PyBytes::new(py, &referent.checkpoint_digest), item_limit))?;
720                if !source.is_exact_instance_of::<PyBytes>() {
721                    return Err(invalid(
722                        "checkpoint source resolver must return exact builtin bytes",
723                    ));
724                }
725                let source = source.cast::<PyBytes>()?.as_bytes();
726                if source.len() > item_limit {
727                    return Err(invalid("resolved checkpoint exceeds its item limit"));
728                }
729                referent.verify_source(source)?;
730                entry.insert(source.to_vec());
731                refresh_checkpoint_authority(
732                    authority,
733                    snapshot,
734                    refresh_snapshot,
735                    operation,
736                    actor_row,
737                )?;
738            }
739            Entry::Occupied(entry) => referent.verify_source(entry.get())?,
740        }
741        if *recovered_prefill {
742            let source = verified
743                .get(&referent.checkpoint_digest)
744                .expect("resolved source remains owned");
745            let manifest = SemanticCheckpointManifest::decode(source)?;
746            let (_, _, phase, binding) = TaskCheckpointSeed::decode(&manifest.task)?;
747            if phase != CheckpointTaskPhase::InitialPrefillBound {
748                return Err(invalid(
749                    "recovered prefill source is not an original pre-action checkpoint",
750                ));
751            }
752            let child = row
753                .materials
754                .iter()
755                .find(|item| item.kind == "initial-prefill")
756                .expect("recovered prefill has its original child");
757            native
758                .material
759                .verify_initial_prefill_checkpoint_source(
760                    (
761                        child
762                            .bytes
763                            .as_deref()
764                            .expect("recovered prefill has original bytes"),
765                        replay_digest_identity(&child.identity)?,
766                    ),
767                    row.action_identity()?,
768                    (&manifest.native, &manifest.initial_prefill),
769                    Identity256::from_bytes(binding.identity),
770                    binding.epoch,
771                    binding.content_identity(),
772                )
773                .map_err(xlog_err)?;
774        }
775    }
776    Ok(referents)
777}

779impl SemanticCheckpointManifest {
780    const MAGIC: &'static [u8] = b"XLOG-SEMANTIC-CHECKPOINT\0";
781    const SECTION_COUNT: usize = 5;
782    const VERSION: u32 = 3;
783
784    fn encode(self) -> PyResult<Vec<u8>> {
785        let sections = [
786            self.native,
787            self.model,
788            self.task,
789            self.session,
790            self.initial_prefill,
791        ];
792        let mut bytes = Self::MAGIC.to_vec();
793        bytes.extend_from_slice(&Self::VERSION.to_le_bytes());
794        for section in &sections {
795            bytes
796                .len()
797                .checked_add(section.len())
798                .ok_or_else(|| invalid("checkpoint extent exceeds this host"))?;
799            bytes.extend_from_slice(section);
800        }
801        let mut root = Sha256::new();
802        root.update(b"xlog.semantic.checkpoint.root.v1\0");
803        root.update((Self::SECTION_COUNT as u32).to_le_bytes());
804        bytes.extend_from_slice(&(Self::SECTION_COUNT as u32).to_le_bytes());
805        for section in &sections {
806            let length = u64::try_from(section.len())
807                .map_err(|_| invalid("checkpoint section exceeds u64"))?;
808            let digest = Sha256::digest(section);
809            bytes.extend_from_slice(&length.to_le_bytes());
810            bytes.extend_from_slice(&digest);
811            root.update(length.to_le_bytes());
812            root.update(digest);
813        }
814        bytes.extend_from_slice(&root.finalize());
815        Ok(bytes)
816    }
817
818    fn decode(bytes: &[u8]) -> PyResult<Self> {
819        let header = Self::MAGIC.len() + 4;
820        let footer = 4 + Self::SECTION_COUNT * (8 + 32) + 32;
821        if bytes.len() < header + footer
822            || &bytes[..Self::MAGIC.len()] != Self::MAGIC
823            || u32::from_le_bytes(
824                bytes[Self::MAGIC.len()..header]
825                    .try_into()
826                    .expect("checkpoint version extent"),
827            ) != Self::VERSION
828        {
829            return Err(invalid("checkpoint has another domain or version"));
830        }
831        let footer_begin = bytes.len() - footer;
832        let footer_bytes = &bytes[footer_begin..];
833        if u32::from_le_bytes(footer_bytes[..4].try_into().unwrap()) as usize != Self::SECTION_COUNT
834        {
835            return Err(invalid("checkpoint has another section count"));
836        }
837        let mut cursor = 4;
838        let mut lengths = [0usize; Self::SECTION_COUNT];
839        let mut digests = [[0u8; 32]; Self::SECTION_COUNT];
840        let mut root = Sha256::new();
841        root.update(b"xlog.semantic.checkpoint.root.v1\0");
842        root.update((Self::SECTION_COUNT as u32).to_le_bytes());
843        for index in 0..Self::SECTION_COUNT {
844            let length = u64::from_le_bytes(
845                footer_bytes[cursor..cursor + 8]
846                    .try_into()
847                    .expect("checkpoint length extent"),
848            );
849            cursor += 8;
850            lengths[index] = usize::try_from(length)
851                .map_err(|_| invalid("checkpoint section length exceeds this host"))?;
852            digests[index].copy_from_slice(&footer_bytes[cursor..cursor + 32]);
853            cursor += 32;
854            root.update(length.to_le_bytes());
855            root.update(digests[index]);
856        }
857        let encoded_root: [u8; 32] = footer_bytes[cursor..cursor + 32]
858            .try_into()
859            .expect("checkpoint root extent");
860        let computed_root: [u8; 32] = root.finalize().into();
861        if computed_root != encoded_root {
862            return Err(invalid("checkpoint root seal is invalid"));
863        }
864        let payload_bytes = lengths.iter().try_fold(0usize, |total, &length| {
865            total
866                .checked_add(length)
867                .ok_or_else(|| invalid("checkpoint payload extent exceeds this host"))
868        })?;
869        if payload_bytes != footer_begin - header {
870            return Err(invalid(
871                "checkpoint section lengths do not cover its payload",
872            ));
873        }
874        let mut payload = &bytes[header..footer_begin];
875        let mut sections: [Vec<u8>; Self::SECTION_COUNT] = std::array::from_fn(|_| Vec::new());
876        for index in 0..Self::SECTION_COUNT {
877            let (section, rest) = payload.split_at(lengths[index]);
878            let computed_digest: [u8; 32] = Sha256::digest(section).into();
879            if computed_digest != digests[index] {
880                return Err(invalid("checkpoint section seal is invalid"));
881            }
882            sections[index] = section.to_vec();
883            payload = rest;
884        }
885        let [native, model, task, session, initial_prefill] = sections;
886        Ok(Self {
887            native,
888            model,
889            task,
890            session,
891            initial_prefill,
892        })
893    }
894}
895
896#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
897struct SemanticCheckpointSessionConfig {
898    capacities: (u32, u32, u32, u32),
899    admission_limits: (u32, u32, u32, usize),
900    memory_bytes: u64,
901}
902
903impl SemanticCheckpointSessionConfig {
904    fn encode(self) -> PyResult<Vec<u8>> {
905        let mut bytes = b"XLOG-CHECKPOINT-SESSION\0".to_vec();
906        bytes.extend_from_slice(&1u32.to_le_bytes());
907        for value in [
908            self.capacities.0,
909            self.capacities.1,
910            self.capacities.2,
911            self.capacities.3,
912            self.admission_limits.0,
913            self.admission_limits.1,
914            self.admission_limits.2,
915        ] {
916            bytes.extend_from_slice(&value.to_le_bytes());
917        }
918        bytes.extend_from_slice(
919            &u64::try_from(self.admission_limits.3)
920                .map_err(|_| invalid("checkpoint UTF-8 budget exceeds u64"))?
921                .to_le_bytes(),
922        );
923        bytes.extend_from_slice(&self.memory_bytes.to_le_bytes());
924        Ok(bytes)
925    }
926
927    fn decode(bytes: &[u8]) -> PyResult<Self> {
928        const MAGIC: &[u8] = b"XLOG-CHECKPOINT-SESSION\0";
929        if bytes.len() != MAGIC.len() + 4 + 7 * 4 + 2 * 8
930            || &bytes[..MAGIC.len()] != MAGIC
931            || u32::from_le_bytes(bytes[MAGIC.len()..MAGIC.len() + 4].try_into().unwrap()) != 1
932        {
933            return Err(invalid(
934                "checkpoint session config has another domain or extent",
935            ));
936        }
937        let mut cursor = MAGIC.len() + 4;
938        let mut next_u32 = || {
939            let value = u32::from_le_bytes(bytes[cursor..cursor + 4].try_into().unwrap());
940            cursor += 4;
941            value
942        };
943        let capacities = (next_u32(), next_u32(), next_u32(), next_u32());
944        let admission_limits = (next_u32(), next_u32(), next_u32());
945        let utf8 = u64::from_le_bytes(bytes[cursor..cursor + 8].try_into().unwrap());
946        cursor += 8;
947        let memory_bytes = u64::from_le_bytes(bytes[cursor..cursor + 8].try_into().unwrap());
948        Ok(Self {
949            capacities,
950            admission_limits: (
951                admission_limits.0,
952                admission_limits.1,
953                admission_limits.2,
954                usize::try_from(utf8)
955                    .map_err(|_| invalid("checkpoint UTF-8 budget exceeds this host"))?,
956            ),
957            memory_bytes,
958        })
959    }
960}

962#[pymethods]
963impl PySemanticTransitionSession {
964    #[new]
965    #[pyo3(signature = (*, predicates, records, supports, capacities, admission_limits, device_ordinal, memory_bytes))]
966    #[expect(
967        clippy::too_many_arguments,
968        reason = "session construction receives independent admission and device budgets"
969    )]
970    fn new(
971        py: Python<'_>,
972        predicates: Vec<PredicateInput>,
973        records: Vec<RecordInput>,
974        supports: Vec<SupportInput>,
975        capacities: (u32, u32, u32, u32),
976        admission_limits: (u32, u32, u32, usize),
977        device_ordinal: usize,
978        memory_bytes: u64,
979    ) -> PyResult<Self> {
980        let records = parse_admission(py, predicates, records, supports)?;
981        Self::from_admission(
982            records,
983            capacities,
984            admission_limits,
985            device_ordinal,
986            memory_bytes,
987        )
988    }
989
990    /// Return this retained session's ``(generation, digest_bytes)`` binding.
991    fn binding(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<(u64, Py<PyBytes>)> {
992        self.require_creator()?;
993        let binding = self.owner()?.binding();
994        Ok((
995            binding.generation,
996            PyBytes::new(py, binding.digest.as_bytes()).unbind(),
997        ))
998    }
999
1000    /// Return one immutable snapshot of the acquired binding and parameter layout.
1001    ///
1002    /// The result is ``(binding, z_range, recurrence_range, positions_range,
1003    /// fields, parameter_cells)``. ``binding`` is ``(generation, digest_bytes)``.
1004    /// The eighteen ordered ``fields`` are ``(cardinality, null_category,
1005    /// embeddings_range, biases_range)``. Every range is a half-open ``(start,
1006    /// end)`` tuple measured in FP32 elements. NULL is ``None`` when absent.
1007    /// All values come from this owner's admitted codebooks under one lock.
1008    fn policy_layout(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
1009        self.require_creator()?;
1010        let owner = self.owner()?;
1011        let layout = owner.policy_layout().map_err(xlog_err)?;
1012        let binding = owner.binding();
1013        let fields = PyTuple::new(
1014            py,
1015            layout.fields.iter().map(|field| {
1016                (
1017                    field.cardinality,
1018                    field.null_category,
1019                    (field.embeddings.start, field.embeddings.end),
1020                    (field.biases.start, field.biases.end),
1021                )
1022            }),
1023        )?;
1024        Ok((
1025            (
1026                binding.generation,
1027                PyBytes::new(py, binding.digest.as_bytes()),
1028            ),
1029            (layout.z.start, layout.z.end),
1030            (layout.recurrence.start, layout.recurrence.end),
1031            (layout.positions.start, layout.positions.end),
1032            fields,
1033            layout.parameter_cells,
1034        )
1035            .into_pyobject(py)?
1036            .unbind())
1037    }
1038
1039    /// Restore one self-contained checkpoint into a fresh never-reused native
1040    /// owner. The trusted model factory is called exactly once with the exact
1041    /// controller, task use, acquired parent and model bytes retained by the
1042    /// returned carrier. The checkpoint itself grants no current authority.
1043    /// Project the compact replay material from one complete original checkpoint.
1044    #[staticmethod]
1045    fn checkpoint_referent<'py>(
1046        py: Python<'py>,
1047        checkpoint: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
1048    ) -> PyResult<Bound<'py, PyBytes>> {
1049        if !checkpoint.is_exact_instance_of::<PyBytes>() {
1050            return Err(invalid(
1051                "checkpoint referent requires exact builtin checkpoint bytes",
1052            ));
1053        }
1054        let record = CheckpointReferent::from_checkpoint(checkpoint.cast::<PyBytes>()?.as_bytes())?;
1055        Ok(PyBytes::new(py, &record.encode()))
1056    }
1057
1058    /// Decode the one native record for data-kit assembly without a second parser.
1059    #[staticmethod]
1060    fn inspect_checkpoint_referent<'py>(
1061        py: Python<'py>,
1062        referent: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
1063    ) -> PyResult<Bound<'py, PyDict>> {
1064        if !referent.is_exact_instance_of::<PyBytes>() {
1065            return Err(invalid(
1066                "checkpoint referent inspection requires exact builtin bytes",
1067            ));
1068        }
1069        let record = CheckpointReferent::decode(referent.cast::<PyBytes>()?.as_bytes())?;
1070        let fields = PyDict::new(py);
1071        fields.set_item(
1072            "checkpoint_sha256",
1073            PyBytes::new(py, &record.checkpoint_digest),
1074        )?;
1075        fields.set_item("checkpoint_bytes", record.checkpoint_bytes)?;
1076        fields.set_item(
1077            "publication_identity",
1078            PyBytes::new(py, &record.publication),
1079        )?;
1080        fields.set_item("semantic_root", PyBytes::new(py, &record.semantic_root))?;
1081        fields.set_item("model_generation", record.model_generation)?;
1082        fields.set_item("model_state_sha256", PyBytes::new(py, &record.model_digest))?;
1083        fields.set_item("task_identity", PyBytes::new(py, &record.task.identity))?;
1084        fields.set_item("task_epoch", record.task.epoch)?;
1085        fields.set_item(
1086            "query_content_identity",
1087            PyBytes::new(py, &record.task.content[0]),
1088        )?;
1089        fields.set_item(
1090            "theory_program_content_identity",
1091            PyBytes::new(py, &record.task.content[1]),
1092        )?;
1093        fields.set_item(
1094            "result_content_identity",
1095            PyBytes::new(py, &record.task.content[2]),
1096        )?;
1097        fields.set_item("semantic_goal_root", PyBytes::new(py, &record.task.goal))?;
1098        fields.set_item(
1099            "scoring_law_identity",
1100            PyBytes::new(py, &record.task.scoring_law),
1101        )?;
1102        fields.set_item("scope_sha256", PyBytes::new(py, &record.scope_digest))?;
1103        fields.set_item("authority_root", PyBytes::new(py, &record.authority_root))?;
1104        fields.set_item(
1105            "saved_snapshot_sha256",
1106            PyBytes::new(py, &record.snapshot_digest),
1107        )?;
1108        fields.set_item(
1109            "phase",
1110            match record.phase {
1111                CheckpointTaskPhase::Imported => "imported",
1112                CheckpointTaskPhase::InitialPrefillBound => "initial-prefill-bound",
1113                CheckpointTaskPhase::Segment(_) => unreachable!("decoded referent is pre-action"),
1114            },
1115        )?;
1116        Ok(fields)
1117    }
1118
1119    /// Validate a retained full checkpoint against every field of its compact record.
1120    #[staticmethod]
1121    fn verify_checkpoint_referent(
1122        referent: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
1123        checkpoint: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
1124    ) -> PyResult<()> {
1125        if !referent.is_exact_instance_of::<PyBytes>()
1126            || !checkpoint.is_exact_instance_of::<PyBytes>()
1127        {
1128            return Err(invalid(
1129                "checkpoint verification requires exact builtin source and referent bytes",
1130            ));
1131        }
1132        CheckpointReferent::decode(referent.cast::<PyBytes>()?.as_bytes())?
1133            .verify_source(checkpoint.cast::<PyBytes>()?.as_bytes())
1134    }

1136    #[staticmethod]
1137    #[pyo3(signature = (checkpoint, *, device_ordinal, snapshot, restore_model, training_domain, referent=None))]
1138    fn restore_checkpoint(
1139        py: Python<'_>,
1140        checkpoint: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
1141        device_ordinal: usize,
1142        snapshot: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
1143        restore_model: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
1144        training_domain: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
1145        referent: Option<&Bound<'_, PyAny>>,
1146    ) -> PyResult<Py<PySemanticTransitionRestoredCheckpoint>> {
1147        Self::restore_checkpoint_impl(
1148            py,
1149            checkpoint,
1150            device_ordinal,
1151            snapshot,
1152            restore_model,
1153            training_domain,
1154            referent,
1155            None,
1156        )
1157    }
1158}
1159
1160impl PySemanticTransitionSession {
1161    #[expect(
1162        clippy::too_many_arguments,
1163        reason = "canonical restore keeps the original checkpoint, authority, domain and optional cold phase recipe explicit"
1164    )]
1165    fn restore_checkpoint_impl(
1166        py: Python<'_>,
1167        checkpoint: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
1168        device_ordinal: usize,
1169        snapshot: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
1170        restore_model: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
1171        training_domain: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
1172        referent: Option<&Bound<'_, PyAny>>,
1173        learning_transition: Option<&xlog_cuda::SemanticLearningPhaseTransition>,
1174    ) -> PyResult<Py<PySemanticTransitionRestoredCheckpoint>> {
1175        if !checkpoint.is_exact_instance_of::<PyBytes>() {
1176            return Err(invalid("checkpoint restore requires exact builtin bytes"));
1177        }
1178        if !restore_model.is_callable() {
1179            return Err(invalid(
1180                "checkpoint restore requires one trusted model factory",
1181            ));
1182        }
1183        let checkpoint = checkpoint.cast::<PyBytes>()?.as_bytes();
1184        if let Some(referent) = referent {
1185            if !referent.is_exact_instance_of::<PyBytes>() {
1186                return Err(invalid(
1187                    "checkpoint restore referent requires exact builtin bytes",
1188                ));
1189            }
1190            CheckpointReferent::decode(referent.cast::<PyBytes>()?.as_bytes())?
1191                .verify_source(checkpoint)?;
1192        }
1193        let manifest = SemanticCheckpointManifest::decode(checkpoint)?;
1194        let config = SemanticCheckpointSessionConfig::decode(&manifest.session)?;
1195        let (seed, saved_snapshot, phase, saved_binding) =
1196            TaskCheckpointSeed::decode(&manifest.task)?;
1197        let mut domain_budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
1198        if ColdValue::read(training_domain, &mut domain_budget, 0)? != seed.training_domain {
1199            return Err(invalid(
1200                "checkpoint restore changed the original training input domain",
1201            ));
1202        }
1203        let has_initial_prefill =
1204            SemanticTransitionSession::verify_checkpoint_initial_prefill_source(
1205                &manifest.initial_prefill,
1206                &manifest.native,
1207                Identity256::from_bytes(saved_binding.identity),
1208                saved_binding.epoch,
1209                saved_binding.content_identity(),
1210                phase == CheckpointTaskPhase::InitialPrefillBound,
1211            )
1212            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
1213        if has_initial_prefill != (phase == CheckpointTaskPhase::InitialPrefillBound)
1214            && !matches!(phase, CheckpointTaskPhase::Segment(_))
1215        {
1216            return Err(invalid(
1217                "checkpoint initial prefill differs from its task phase",
1218            ));
1219        }
1220        let original_referent = if phase == CheckpointTaskPhase::InitialPrefillBound {
1221            Some(CheckpointReferent::from_checkpoint(checkpoint)?.encode())
1222        } else {
1223            None
1224        };
1225        let mut authority = TaskAuthority::parse(&seed.authority)?;
1226        authority.bind_initial_sources(&seed.initial_sources, &seed.source_mapping)?;
1227        let admission = SemanticTransitionSession::state_material_admission(&manifest.native)
1228            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
1229        let editable_source = cold_task::editable_source_from_admission(&admission)?;
1230        if let Some(source) = &editable_source {
1231            if seed
1232                .evaluation
1233                .get(2)
1234                .ok_or_else(|| invalid("checkpoint task evaluation is incomplete"))?
1235                .text()?
1236                != source.observer_source
1237            {
1238                return Err(invalid(
1239                    "checkpoint observer source differs from its admission",
1240                ));
1241            }
1242        }
1243        let editable_program = editable_source.map(|source| source.program);
1244        let spec = task_evaluation_spec(
1245            &seed.evaluation,
1246            authority.priority_levels.clone(),
1247            editable_program.clone(),
1248            &seed.training_domain,
1249        )?;
1250        let (_, selected_material) =
1251            decode_selected_replay(&authority.replay, &seed.replay_selection)?;
1252        let training_views = authority
1253            .replay
1254            .iter()
1255            .map(ReplayRow::training_view_row)
1256            .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
1257        let training_objective = read_training_objective(&seed.training_objective)?;
1258        if training_views.is_empty() != training_objective.is_none() {
1259            return Err(invalid(
1260                "checkpoint training objective differs from its retained replay rows",
1261            ));
1262        }
1263        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
1264        let current_snapshot =
1265            AuthoritySnapshot::parse(&ColdValue::read(snapshot, &mut budget, 0)?)?;
1266        current_snapshot.newer_than(&saved_snapshot)?;
1267        let validate_authority = |snapshot: &AuthoritySnapshot| match &phase {
1268            CheckpointTaskPhase::Imported | CheckpointTaskPhase::InitialPrefillBound => {
1269                authority.check_snapshot(snapshot).map(drop)
1270            }
1271            CheckpointTaskPhase::Segment(operation) => {
1272                authority.check_use(operation, snapshot, false)
1273            }
1274        };
1275        validate_authority(&saved_snapshot)?;
1276        validate_authority(&current_snapshot)?;
1277        let restored_phase = match learning_transition {
1278            None => phase.clone(),
1279            Some(transition) => CheckpointTaskPhase::Segment(
1280                match transition.target {
1281                    xlog_cuda::SemanticLearningPhase::Fast => "inference",
1282                    xlog_cuda::SemanticLearningPhase::Consolidation => "training",
1283                    xlog_cuda::SemanticLearningPhase::Alignment => {
1284                        return Err(invalid("learning-phase restore cannot return to alignment"));
1285                    }
1286                }
1287                .to_owned(),
1288            ),
1289        };
1290        if let CheckpointTaskPhase::Segment(operation) = &restored_phase {
1291            authority.check_use(operation, &current_snapshot, false)?;
1292        }
1293        let restored_session = Self::from_admission(
1294            admission,
1295            config.capacities,
1296            config.admission_limits,
1297            device_ordinal,
1298            config.memory_bytes,
1299        )?;
1300        let session = Py::new(py, restored_session)?;
1301        session
1302            .borrow(py)
1303            .learning_preparing
1304            .store(learning_transition.is_some(), Ordering::Release);
1305        let native_binding = (|| -> PyResult<TaskCheckpointBinding> {
1306            let restored = session.borrow(py);
1307            let mut owner = restored.owner()?;
1308            let observations = owner
1309                .task_observation_roots(
1310                    &spec,
1311                    selected_material.as_ref().map(|binding| &binding.material),
1312                )
1313                .map_err(xlog_err)?;
1314            authority.bind_native_reads(&observations, &spec.allowed_support_records)?;
1315            let goal_witness = authority.goal_witness(&observations);
1316            owner.bind_task_evaluation(spec).map_err(xlog_err)?;
1317            owner
1318                .bind_task_goal_witness(goal_witness)
1319                .map_err(xlog_err)?;
1320            if let Some(objective) = training_objective {
1321                owner
1322                    .bind_training_view_arena(training_views, objective)
1323                    .map_err(xlog_err)?;
1324            }
1325            match learning_transition {
1326                Some(transition) => {
1327                    owner.restore_learning_phase_material(&manifest.native, transition)
1328                }
1329                None => owner.restore_state_material(&manifest.native),
1330            }
1331            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
1332            let native_binding = TaskCheckpointBinding::from_owner(&owner)?;
1333            if !saved_binding.same_task_content(native_binding) {
1334                return Err(invalid(
1335                    "checkpoint restore changed its original native task content or scoring law",
1336                ));
1337            }
1338            Ok(native_binding)
1339        })()?;
1340        let controller_identity = Arc::new(());
1341        let controller = Py::new(
1342            py,
1343            PySemanticTransitionController {
1344                session: session.clone_ref(py),
1345                identity: Arc::clone(&controller_identity),
1346            },
1347        )?;
1348        let issuance = {
1349            let restored = session.borrow(py);
1350            TaskIssuance::issue(Arc::clone(&restored.issuance))?
1351        };
1352        let task_phase = match &restored_phase {
1353            CheckpointTaskPhase::Imported => TaskUsePhase::Imported,
1354            CheckpointTaskPhase::InitialPrefillBound => TaskUsePhase::InitialPrefillBound,
1355            CheckpointTaskPhase::Segment(operation) => TaskUsePhase::Segment(operation.clone()),
1356        };
1357        let restored_snapshot = current_snapshot.canonical.clone();
1358        let task_use = Py::new(
1359            py,
1360            PySemanticTransitionTaskUse {
1361                session: session.clone_ref(py),
1362                controller: controller_identity,
1363                issuance,
1364                importing: Arc::clone(&session.borrow(py).importing),
1365                task_identity: native_binding.identity,
1366                task_epoch: native_binding.epoch,
1367                authority,
1368                checkpoint: seed,
1369                state: Mutex::new(TaskUseState {
1370                    phase: if learning_transition.is_some() {
1371                        TaskUsePhase::ArenaPreparing(Box::new(task_phase))
1372                    } else {
1373                        task_phase
1374                    },
1375                    snapshot: current_snapshot,
1376                }),
1377                delivery: Mutex::new(None),
1378            },
1379        )?;
1380        let parent = {
1381            let issued = task_use.borrow(py);
1382            let restored = session.borrow(py);
1383            let mut owner = restored.owner()?;
1384            issued.require_current(&owner)?;
1385            let lease = owner.acquire().map_err(xlog_err)?;
1386            Py::new(
1387                py,
1388                PySemanticPublishedParent {
1389                    session: session.clone_ref(py),
1390                    task_use: task_use.clone_ref(py),
1391                    inner: Mutex::new(lease),
1392                    continuation_producers: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
1393                },
1394            )?
1395        };
1396        let restored_native = if learning_transition.is_some() {
1397            let acquired = parent.borrow(py);
1398            let native = session
1399                .borrow(py)
1400                .owner()?
1401                .published_state_material(&*acquired.lease()?)
1402                .map_err(xlog_err)?;
1403            Some(native)
1404        } else {
1405            None
1406        };
1407        let model = restore_model
1408            .call1((
1409                controller.clone_ref(py),
1410                task_use.clone_ref(py),
1411                parent.clone_ref(py),
1412                if learning_transition.is_some() {
1413                    py.None()
1414                } else {
1415                    PyBytes::new(py, &manifest.model).into_any().unbind()
1416                },
1417            ))
1418            .map(|model| model.unbind());
1419        let model = match model {
1420            Ok(model) => model,
1421            Err(error) => {
1422                if let Ok(mut owner) = session.borrow(py).owner() {
1423                    owner.abort();
1424                }
1425                if let Ok(mut state) = task_use.borrow(py).state() {
1426                    state.phase = TaskUsePhase::Refused;
1427                }
1428                return Err(error);
1429            }
1430        };
1431        let verified = (|| -> PyResult<()> {
1432            let issued = task_use.borrow(py);
1433            let acquired = parent.borrow(py);
1434            acquired.require_task(py, &issued)?;
1435            let restored = session.borrow(py);
1436            let mut owner = restored.owner()?;
1437            issued.require_current(&owner)?;
1438            let state = issued.state()?;
1439            if checkpoint_task_phase(&state)? != restored_phase
1440                || state.snapshot.canonical != restored_snapshot
1441            {
1442                return Err(invalid(
1443                    "checkpoint task phase changed during model restore",
1444                ));
1445            }
1446            drop(state);
1447            if let Some(native) = &restored_native {
1448                if owner
1449                    .published_state_material(&*acquired.lease()?)
1450                    .map_err(xlog_err)?
1451                    != *native
1452                {
1453                    return Err(invalid(
1454                        "learning-phase candidate changed during model restoration",
1455                    ));
1456                }
1457            } else {
1458                owner
1459                    .verify_restored_state_material(&*acquired.lease()?, &manifest.native)
1460                    .map_err(xlog_err)?;
1461            }
1462            if let Some(referent) = &original_referent {
1463                owner
1464                    .bind_restored_checkpoint_initial_prefill(
1465                        &*acquired.lease()?,
1466                        &manifest.native,
1467                        &manifest.initial_prefill,
1468                        referent,
1469                    )
1470                    .map_err(xlog_err)?;
1471            }
1472            Ok(())
1473        })();
1474        if let Err(error) = verified {
1475            if let Ok(mut owner) = session.borrow(py).owner() {
1476                owner.abort();
1477            }
1478            if let Ok(mut state) = task_use.borrow(py).state() {
1479                state.phase = TaskUsePhase::Refused;
1480            }
1481            return Err(error);
1482        }
1483        Py::new(
1484            py,
1485            PySemanticTransitionRestoredCheckpoint {
1486                session,
1487                controller,
1488                task_use,
1489                parent,
1490                model,
1491            },
1492        )
1493    }
1494}
1495
1496/// Owned primitive transport. Integers remain decimal strings until a particular
1497/// native index requires a checked bound; training identity integers are lossless.
1498#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
1499enum ColdValue {
1500    None,
1501    Bool(bool),
1502    Integer(String),
1503    Text(String),
1504    Sequence(Vec<ColdValue>),
1505    // Only the dedicated replay reader constructs bytes; general metadata
1506    // transport still refuses bytes and arbitrary dictionaries.
1507    Bytes(Arc<[u8]>),
1508}
1509
1510fn invalid(message: &str) -> PyErr {
1511    PyValueError::new_err(message.to_owned())
1512}
1513
1514#[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
1515fn transition_refusal(
1516    outcome: &xlog_cuda::SemanticTransitionOutcome,
1517) -> Option<(&'static str, u64)> {
1518    use xlog_cuda::{SemanticTransitionOutcome, SemanticTransitionRefusal};
1519    match outcome {
1520        SemanticTransitionOutcome::Published(_) => None,
1521        SemanticTransitionOutcome::Refused(refusal) => Some(match refusal {
1522            SemanticTransitionRefusal::InvalidFinalSupport { completed_draws } => {
1523                ("invalid_final_support", *completed_draws)
1524            }
1525            SemanticTransitionRefusal::NonFinitePolicyInput { completed_draws } => {
1526                ("non_finite_policy_input", *completed_draws)
1527            }
1528            SemanticTransitionRefusal::WorkCounterOverflow { completed_draws } => {
1529                ("work_counter_overflow", *completed_draws)
1530            }
1531            SemanticTransitionRefusal::InvalidTrainingView { status } => {
1532                ("invalid_training_view", *status)
1533            }
1534            SemanticTransitionRefusal::RejectedModelUpdate { evidence } => {
1535                let reason = match evidence.reason() {
1536                    Some(xlog_cuda::SemanticTrainingCanaryRefusalReason::NonFiniteMeasurement) => {
1537                        "canary_non_finite_measurement"
1538                    }
1539                    Some(xlog_cuda::SemanticTrainingCanaryRefusalReason::OutsideBounds) => {
1540                        "canary_outside_bounds"
1541                    }
1542                    Some(xlog_cuda::SemanticTrainingCanaryRefusalReason::MemoryLimitExceeded) => {
1543                        "canary_memory_limit_exceeded"
1544                    }
1545                    Some(xlog_cuda::SemanticTrainingCanaryRefusalReason::WorkLimitExceeded) => {
1546                        "canary_work_limit_exceeded"
1547                    }
1548                    Some(xlog_cuda::SemanticTrainingCanaryRefusalReason::IncompleteOperands) => {
1549                        "canary_incomplete_operands"
1550                    }
1551                    Some(
1552                        xlog_cuda::SemanticTrainingCanaryRefusalReason::ProtectedRetentionLost,
1553                    ) => "canary_protected_retention_lost",
1554                    Some(xlog_cuda::SemanticTrainingCanaryRefusalReason::GoalWitnessInvalid) => {
1555                        "canary_goal_witness_invalid"
1556                    }
1557                    Some(xlog_cuda::SemanticTrainingCanaryRefusalReason::WorkOverflow) => {
1558                        "canary_work_overflow"
1559                    }
1560                    Some(xlog_cuda::SemanticTrainingCanaryRefusalReason::GenerationMismatch) => {
1561                        "canary_generation_mismatch"
1562                    }
1563                    None => "invalid_canary_refusal",
1564                };
1565                (reason, evidence.row_ordinal)
1566            }
1567        }),
1568    }
1569}
1570
1571#[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
1572fn transition_refusal_report(
1573    py: Python<'_>,
1574    outcome: &xlog_cuda::SemanticTransitionOutcome,
1575) -> PyResult<Option<Py<PyDict>>> {
1576    use xlog_cuda::{SemanticTransitionOutcome, SemanticTransitionRefusal};
1577    let SemanticTransitionOutcome::Refused(refusal) = outcome else {
1578        return Ok(None);
1579    };
1580    let report = PyDict::new(py);
1581    let (reason, detail) = transition_refusal(outcome)
1582        .ok_or_else(|| invalid("native refusal has no public reason"))?;
1583    report.set_item("reason", reason)?;
1584    match refusal {
1585        SemanticTransitionRefusal::InvalidFinalSupport { .. }
1586        | SemanticTransitionRefusal::NonFinitePolicyInput { .. }
1587        | SemanticTransitionRefusal::WorkCounterOverflow { .. } => {
1588            report.set_item("completed_draws", detail)?;
1589        }
1590        SemanticTransitionRefusal::InvalidTrainingView { .. } => {
1591            report.set_item("training_view_status", detail)?;
1592        }
1593        SemanticTransitionRefusal::RejectedModelUpdate { evidence } => {
1594            report.set_item("canary_kind", evidence.kind)?;
1595            report.set_item("row_ordinal", evidence.row_ordinal)?;
1596            report.set_item("measurement_bits", evidence.measurement_bits)?;
1597            report.set_item("lower_bound_bits", evidence.lower_bound_bits)?;
1598            report.set_item("upper_bound_bits", evidence.upper_bound_bits)?;
1599            report.set_item("memory_used", evidence.memory_used)?;
1600            report.set_item("memory_limit", evidence.memory_limit)?;
1601            report.set_item("work_used", evidence.work_used)?;
1602            report.set_item("work_limit", evidence.work_limit)?;
1603            report.set_item("canary_identity", evidence.identity)?;
1604            report.set_item("selection_identity", evidence.selection_identity)?;
1605        }
1606    }
1607    Ok(Some(report.unbind()))
1608}
1609
1610#[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
1611fn update_measurements_report(
1612    py: Python<'_>,
1613    observation: xlog_cuda::SemanticUpdateMeasurements,
1614) -> PyResult<Py<PyDict>> {
1615    let availability = |value| match value {
1616        0 => "not_executed",
1617        1 => "incomplete",
1618        2 => "obtained",
1619        _ => unreachable!("native observation validated availability"),
1620    };
1621    let identity = |value: xlog_cuda::SemanticPublishedIdentity| {
1622        (
1623            PyBytes::new(py, value.instance.as_bytes()),
1624            value.word,
1625            PyBytes::new(py, value.logical_digest.as_bytes()),
1626            PyBytes::new(py, value.state_digest.as_bytes()),
1627        )
1628    };
1629    let report = PyDict::new(py);
1630    report.set_item("schema", 1)?;
1631    report.set_item("predecessor", identity(observation.predecessor))?;
1632    report.set_item("successor", observation.successor.map(identity))?;
1633    report.set_item("bank", observation.bank)?;
1634    report.set_item("model_generation", observation.model_generation)?;
1635    report.set_item(
1636        "model_geometry_digest",
1637        PyBytes::new(py, observation.model_geometry_digest.as_bytes()),
1638    )?;
1639    report.set_item(
1640        "model_numerical_digest",
1641        PyBytes::new(py, observation.model_numerical_digest.as_bytes()),
1642    )?;
1643    report.set_item("transition_status", observation.transition_status)?;
1644    let selected = &observation.selection;
1645    let selection = PyDict::new(py);
1646    for (name, value) in [
1647        ("status", selected.status),
1648        ("row_count", selected.row_count),
1649        ("capacity", selected.capacity),
1650        ("ordinal", selected.ordinal),
1651        ("basis", selected.basis),
1652        ("window", selected.window),
1653        ("source_length", selected.source_length),
1654        ("block_size", selected.block_size),
1655        ("prefix_extent", selected.prefix_extent),
1656        ("answer_start", selected.answer_start),
1657        ("origin_candidate", selected.origin_candidate),
1658    ] {
1659        selection.set_item(name, value)?;
1660    }
1661    selection.set_item("identity", PyTuple::new(py, selected.identity)?)?;
1662    selection.set_item(
1663        "source_identity",
1664        PyTuple::new(py, selected.source_identity)?,
1665    )?;
1666    selection.set_item(
1667        "content_identity",
1668        PyTuple::new(py, selected.content_identity)?,
1669    )?;
1670    selection.set_item("training_rng", PyTuple::new(py, selected.training_rng)?)?;
1671    let origin = &selected.origin;
1672    let source = PyDict::new(py);
1673    for (name, value) in [
1674        ("present", origin.present),
1675        ("transition", origin.transition),
1676        ("predecessor_word", origin.predecessor_word),
1677        ("successor_word", origin.successor_word),
1678        ("model_generation", origin.model_generation),
1679        ("stream_serial", origin.stream_serial),
1680        ("family_id", origin.family_id),
1681        ("proposal", origin.proposal),
1682    ] {
1683        source.set_item(name, value)?;
1684    }
1685    for (name, value) in [
1686        ("lineage_instance", origin.lineage_instance),
1687        ("predecessor_instance", origin.predecessor_instance),
1688        ("predecessor_logical", origin.predecessor_logical),
1689        ("predecessor_state", origin.predecessor_state),
1690        ("successor_instance", origin.successor_instance),
1691        ("successor_logical", origin.successor_logical),
1692        ("successor_state", origin.successor_state),
1693        ("model_geometry_digest", origin.model_geometry_digest),
1694        ("model_numerical_digest", origin.model_numerical_digest),
1695    ] {
1696        source.set_item(name, PyTuple::new(py, value)?)?;
1697    }
1698    selection.set_item("origin", source)?;
1699    report.set_item("selection", selection)?;
1700    let refusal_measurement = observation.canary_refusal.map(|refusal| {
1701        let measured = observation
1702            .canaries
1703            .iter()
1704            .find(|measured| measured.frozen.kind == refusal.kind)
1705            .expect("native observation validated the refusal's original check");
1706        (measured.availability, measured.measurement_bits)
1707    });
1708    let mut canaries = Vec::with_capacity(5);
1709    for measured in observation.canaries {
1710        let frozen = measured.frozen;
1711        let check = PyDict::new(py);
1712        for (name, value) in [
1713            ("evaluator_abi", frozen.evaluator_abi),
1714            ("kind", frozen.kind),
1715            ("row_ordinal", frozen.row_ordinal),
1716            ("lower_bound_bits", frozen.lower_bound_bits),
1717            ("upper_bound_bits", frozen.upper_bound_bits),
1718            ("memory_limit", frozen.memory_limit),
1719            ("work_limit", frozen.work_limit),
1720            ("protected_member_offset", frozen.protected_member_offset),
1721            ("protected_member_count", frozen.protected_member_count),
1722            ("reason", measured.reason),
1723            ("memory_used", measured.memory_used),
1724            ("work_used", measured.work_used),
1725        ] {
1726            check.set_item(name, value)?;
1727        }
1728        check.set_item("availability", availability(measured.availability))?;
1729        check.set_item("measurement_bits", measured.measurement_bits)?;
1730        check.set_item(
1731            "obligation_positions",
1732            PyTuple::new(py, frozen.obligation_positions)?,
1733        )?;
1734        check.set_item(
1735            "protected_positions",
1736            PyTuple::new(py, measured.protected_positions)?,
1737        )?;
1738        check.set_item("row_identity", PyTuple::new(py, frozen.row_identity)?)?;
1739        check.set_item(
1740            "row_content_identity",
1741            PyTuple::new(py, frozen.row_content_identity)?,
1742        )?;
1743        check.set_item("task_identity", PyTuple::new(py, frozen.task_identity)?)?;
1744        check.set_item("identity", PyTuple::new(py, frozen.identity)?)?;
1745        canaries.push(check);
1746    }
1747    report.set_item("canaries", PyTuple::new(py, canaries)?)?;
1748    let mut forwards = Vec::with_capacity(2);
1749    for (role, receipt) in observation.forward_receipts.into_iter().enumerate() {
1750        let forward = PyDict::new(py);
1751        forward.set_item("role", role)?;
1752        forward.set_item("availability", availability(receipt.availability))?;
1753        let material = receipt
1754            .material
1755            .map(|receipt| -> PyResult<_> {
1756                let payload = PyDict::new(py);
1757                payload.set_item("role", receipt.role)?;
1758                payload.set_item("generation", receipt.generation)?;
1759                payload.set_item("work_sequence", receipt.work_sequence)?;
1760                payload.set_item("scalar_type", receipt.scalar_type)?;
1761                payload.set_item("dimensions", PyTuple::new(py, receipt.dimensions)?)?;
1762                payload.set_item("strides_bytes", PyTuple::new(py, receipt.strides_bytes)?)?;
1763                payload.set_item(
1764                    "model_geometry_digest",
1765                    PyBytes::new(py, receipt.model_geometry_digest.as_bytes()),
1766                )?;
1767                payload.set_item(
1768                    "model_numerical_digest",
1769                    PyBytes::new(py, receipt.model_numerical_digest.as_bytes()),
1770                )?;
1771                payload.set_item(
1772                    "logits_digest",
1773                    PyBytes::new(py, receipt.logits_digest.as_bytes()),
1774                )?;
1775                payload.set_item("identity", PyBytes::new(py, receipt.identity.as_bytes()))?;
1776                payload.set_item(
1777                    "canonical_bytes",
1778                    PyBytes::new(py, &receipt.canonical_bytes),
1779                )?;
1780                Ok(payload)
1781            })
1782            .transpose()?;
1783        forward.set_item("material", material)?;
1784        forwards.push(forward);
1785    }
1786    report.set_item("forward_receipts", PyTuple::new(py, forwards)?)?;
1787    let refusal = observation
1788        .canary_refusal
1789        .map(|evidence| {
1790            transition_refusal_report(
1791                py,
1792                &xlog_cuda::SemanticTransitionOutcome::Refused(
1793                    xlog_cuda::SemanticTransitionRefusal::RejectedModelUpdate { evidence },
1794                ),
1795            )
1796        })
1797        .transpose()?
1798        .flatten();
1799    if let Some(ref refusal) = refusal {
1800        let (status, bits) =
1801            refusal_measurement.expect("native refusal retains its original measurement status");
1802        refusal
1803            .bind(py)
1804            .set_item("availability", availability(status))?;
1805        refusal.bind(py).set_item("measurement_bits", bits)?;
1806    }
1807    report.set_item("canary_refusal", refusal)?;
1808    Ok(report.unbind())
1809}

1811fn require_creator_thread(creator: ThreadId) -> PyResult<()> {
1812    if std::thread::current().id() != creator {
1813        return Err(PyRuntimeError::new_err(
1814            "native semantic orchestration and reads require the creating thread",
1815        ));

1820fn parse_witness_consumer_stream(value: &Bound<'_, PyAny>, budget: &mut usize) -> PyResult<u64> {
1821    let stream = ColdValue::read(value, budget, 0)?.unsigned()?;
1822    if stream == 0 || stream == 2 {
1823        return Err(invalid("tensor content requires an explicit consumer stream or legacy default stream 1; stream 0 and per-thread default stream 2 are invalid"));
1824    }
1825    Ok(stream)
1826}

1828fn parse_model_work(
1829    kind: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
1830    dimensions: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
1831) -> PyResult<(xlog_cuda::ModelWorkKind, [u64; 8], usize)> {
1832    let kind = ColdValue::read(kind, &mut 128, 0)?.unsigned()?;
1833    let kind = xlog_cuda::ModelWorkKind::from_code(kind)
1834        .ok_or_else(|| invalid("unknown model work unit category"))?;
1835    let geometry = ColdValue::read(dimensions, &mut 1024, 0)?;
1836    let dimensions = geometry.sequence()?;
1837    if dimensions.len() > 8 {
1838        return Err(invalid("model work geometry exceeds eight dimensions"));
1839    }
1840    let mut values = [0u64; 8];
1841    for (index, dimension) in dimensions.iter().enumerate() {
1842        values[index] = dimension.unsigned()?;
1843    }
1844    Ok((kind, values, dimensions.len()))
1845}
