3865impl ReplayBasis {
3866    fn name(&self) -> &'static str {
3867        match self {
3868            Self::Episode { .. } => "episode",
3869            Self::CorpusAnchor { .. } => "anchor",
3870        }
3871    }
3872}
3873
3874const NATIVE_REPLAY_OPERATION: &str = "xlog.semantic-transition.replay.v1";
3875
3876struct NativeReplayBinding {
3877    material: xlog_cuda::SemanticReplayMaterial,
3878    original_decisions: Arc<[u8]>,
3879}
3880
3881impl ReplayRow {
3882    fn action_identity(&self) -> PyResult<Identity256> {
3883        let mut actions = self.materials.iter().filter(|item| item.kind == "action");
3884        let action = actions
3885            .next()
3886            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("replay episode has no action owner"))?;
3887        if actions.next().is_some() {
3888            return Err(invalid("replay episode has more than one action owner"));
3889        }
3890        replay_digest_identity(&action.identity)
3891    }
3892
3893    fn recovered_prefill_referent(&self) -> PyResult<Option<CheckpointReferent>> {
3894        if !matches!(self.basis, ReplayBasis::Episode { .. }) {
3895            return Ok(None);
3896        }
3897        let mut children = self
3898            .materials
3899            .iter()
3900            .filter(|item| item.kind == "initial-prefill");
3901        let Some(child) = children.next() else {
3902            return Ok(None);
3903        };
3904        if children.next().is_some() {
3905            return Err(invalid(
3906                "replay episode has more than one initial prefill child",
3907            ));
3908        }
3909        let bytes = child
3910            .bytes
3911            .as_deref()
3912            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("initial prefill child has no original bytes"))?;
3913        let identity = replay_digest_identity(&child.identity)?;
3914        self.native_replay()?
3915            .material
3916            .initial_prefill_recovery_referent(bytes, identity, self.action_identity()?)
3917            .map_err(xlog_err)?
3918            .as_deref()
3919            .map(CheckpointReferent::decode)
3920            .transpose()
3921    }
3922
3923    fn checkpoint_referent(&self) -> PyResult<Option<CheckpointReferent>> {
3924        if !matches!(self.basis, ReplayBasis::Episode { .. }) {
3925            return Ok(None);
3926        }
3927        let envelope = replay_json_object(replay_json_field(&self.record, "envelope")?)?;
3928        let actor = replay_json_value(replay_json_field(&envelope, "actor_eligible")?)?
3929            .as_bool()
3930            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("replay actor eligibility is not a boolean"))?;
3931        let snapshot = replay_json_value(replay_json_field(
3932            &envelope,
3933            "downstream_snapshot_identity",
3934        )?)?;
3935        let snapshots = self
3936            .materials
3937            .iter()
3938            .filter(|material| material.kind == "downstream-snapshot")
3939            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
3940        if !actor {
3941            if !snapshot.is_null() || !snapshots.is_empty() {
3942                return Err(invalid(
3943                    "non-actor replay must not contain a checkpoint referent",
3944                ));
3945            }
3946            return Ok(None);
3947        }
3948        let identity = snapshot
3949            .as_str()
3950            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("actor replay has no checkpoint referent identity"))?;
3951        if snapshots.len() != 1 || snapshots[0].identity != identity {
3952            return Err(invalid(
3953                "actor replay checkpoint referent differs from its original material",
3954            ));
3955        }
3956        let bytes = snapshots[0]
3957            .bytes
3958            .as_deref()
3959            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("actor replay checkpoint referent bytes are absent"))?;
3960        CheckpointReferent::decode(bytes).map(Some)
3961    }
3962
3963    fn training_view_row(&self) -> PyResult<SemanticTrainingViewRow> {
3964        let mut materials = self
3965            .materials
3966            .iter()
3967            .filter(|material| material.kind == "training-view");
3968        let material = materials
3969            .next()
3970            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("replay row has no admitted training view"))?;
3971        if materials.next().is_some() {
3972            return Err(invalid(
3973                "replay row has more than one admitted training view",
3974            ));
3975        }
3976        let bytes = material
3977            .bytes
3978            .as_deref()
3979            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("training view has no original bytes"))?;
3980        let identity = self.identity.fields(6)?;
3981        let view = identity[0].fields(9)?;
3982        let ColdValue::Integer(training_seed) = &view[6] else {
3983            return Err(invalid("training view seed is not its original integer"));
3984        };
3985        let origin = match &self.basis {
3986            ReplayBasis::Episode { .. } => Some(
3987                self.native_replay()?
3988                    .material
3989                    .training_view_origin()
3990                    .map_err(xlog_err)?,
3991            ),
3992            ReplayBasis::CorpusAnchor { .. } => None,
3993        };
3994        let (basis, task_content) = match &self.basis {
3995            ReplayBasis::Episode { .. } => (SemanticTrainingViewBasis::Episode, None),
3996            ReplayBasis::CorpusAnchor {
3997                group: ReplayAnchorGroup::Language,
3998                ..
3999            } => (SemanticTrainingViewBasis::CorpusLanguageAnchor, None),
4000            ReplayBasis::CorpusAnchor {
4001                group: ReplayAnchorGroup::Symbolic,
4002                task_content,
4003            } => (
4004                SemanticTrainingViewBasis::CorpusSymbolicAnchor,
4005                *task_content,
4006            ),
4007        };
4008        Ok(SemanticTrainingViewRow {
4009            basis,
4010            identity: replay_digest_identity(identity[1].text()?)?,
4011            bytes_identity: replay_digest_identity(
4012                material
4013                    .bytes_sha256
4014                    .as_deref()
4015                    .ok_or_else(|| invalid("training view has no original byte identity"))?,
4016            )?,
4017            content_identity: replay_digest_identity(identity[2].text()?)?,
4018            data_manifest: replay_digest_identity(view[0].text()?)?,
4019            mask_policy: replay_digest_identity(view[5].text()?)?,
4020            training_seed: training_seed.clone(),
4021            task_content,
4022            origin,
4023            bytes: bytes.to_vec(),
4024        })
4025    }
4026
4027    fn native_replay(&self) -> PyResult<NativeReplayBinding> {
4028        let ReplayBasis::Episode { execution } = &self.basis else {
4029            return Err(invalid(
4030                "a corpus anchor has admission evidence, not a native execution to replay",
4031            ));
4032        };
4033        let digest = |name: &str| {
4034            execution
4035                .get(name)
4036                .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str)
4037                .ok_or_else(|| invalid("native replay material root is absent"))
4038        };
4039        let predecessor = digest("action_base_h_logical")?;
4040        let successor = digest("action_successor_h_logical")?;
4041        let envelope = replay_json_object(replay_json_field(&self.record, "envelope")?)?;
4042        let provenance = replay_json_value(replay_json_field(&envelope, "provenance_identity")?)?;
4043        let provenance = provenance
4044            .as_str()
4045            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("native replay provenance root is absent"))?;
4046        let resolve = |identity: &str, kind: &str| {
4047            self.materials
4048                .iter()
4049                .find(|material| material.identity == identity && material.kind == kind)
4050                .ok_or_else(|| {
4051                    invalid("native replay input does not resolve to its exact material")
4052                })
4053        };
4054        let original = resolve(predecessor, "logical-state")?;
4055        let result = resolve(successor, "logical-state")?;
4056        let provenance = resolve(provenance, "provenance")?;
4057        let reconstruction = result.reconstruction.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
4058            invalid("successor must be reconstructed, not loaded from its own full snapshot")
4059        })?;
4060        if reconstruction.operation != NATIVE_REPLAY_OPERATION {
4061            return Err(invalid(
4062                "successor reconstruction must use the pinned native transition operation",
4063            ));
4064        }
4065        let invocation = execution
4066            .get("invocation")
4067            .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_object)
4068            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("native replay invocation is absent"))?;
4069        for input in [predecessor, provenance.identity.as_str()]
4070            .into_iter()
4071            .chain(invocation.values().filter_map(serde_json::Value::as_str))
4072        {
4073            if !reconstruction.inputs.iter().any(|item| item == input) {
4074                return Err(invalid("native successor reconstruction omits an original invocation input or provenance root"));
4075            }
4076        }
4077        fn bytes(material: &ReplayMaterial) -> PyResult<&[u8]> {
4078            material.bytes.as_deref().ok_or_else(|| {
4079                invalid("native predecessor and provenance require their complete original bytes")
4080            })
4081        }
4082        let material = xlog_cuda::SemanticReplayMaterial::decode(
4083            bytes(original)?,
4084            &self.evidence,
4085            replay_digest_identity(predecessor)?,
4086            replay_digest_identity(successor)?,
4087        )
4088        .map_err(xlog_err)?;
4089        ColdValue::from_canonical_bytes(material.model_numerical_mode().map_err(xlog_err)?)?;
4090        let original_decisions = material
4091            .verify_provenance(bytes(provenance)?)
4092            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
4093        // Historical metadata is reproducible input only. Never install this
4094        // snapshot as the current TaskUse authority or derive a present grant.
4095        AuthoritySnapshot::parse(&ColdValue::from_canonical_bytes(&original_decisions)?)?;
4096        Ok(NativeReplayBinding {
4097            material,
4098            original_decisions: original_decisions.into(),
4099        })
4100    }
4101
4102    fn python_view(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
4103        let mut blobs: BTreeMap<&str, Py<PyAny>> = BTreeMap::new();
4104        let mut materials = Vec::with_capacity(self.materials.len());
4105        for material in &self.materials {
4106            let reference = PyDict::new(py);
4107            reference.set_item("identity", &material.identity)?;
4108            reference.set_item("kind", &material.kind)?;
4109            reference.set_item("bytes_sha256", &material.bytes_sha256)?;
4110            if let Some(reconstruction) = &material.reconstruction {
4111                let item = PyDict::new(py);
4112                item.set_item("operation", &reconstruction.operation)?;
4113                item.set_item("inputs", PyList::new(py, &reconstruction.inputs)?)?;
4114                reference.set_item("reconstruction", item)?;
4115            } else {
4116                reference.set_item("reconstruction", py.None())?;
4117            }
4118            let payload =
4119                if let (Some(digest), Some(bytes)) = (&material.bytes_sha256, &material.bytes) {
4120                    blobs
4121                        .entry(digest)
4122                        .or_insert_with(|| PyBytes::new(py, bytes).into_any().unbind())
4123                        .clone_ref(py)
4124                } else {
4125                    py.None()
4126                };
4127            materials.push((reference, payload));
4128        }
4129        Ok((
4130            self.basis.name(),
4131            self.identity.python_value(py)?,
4132            &self.record_line,
4133            PyTuple::new(py, materials)?,
4134            PyBytes::new(py, &self.evidence),
4135        )
4136            .into_pyobject(py)?
4137            .unbind())
4138    }
4139
4140    #[cfg(test)]
4141    fn parse(value: &ColdValue) -> PyResult<Self> {
4142        Self::parse_with_live(value, &[])
4143    }
4144
4145    fn parse_with_live(value: &ColdValue, live: &[LiveAuthority]) -> PyResult<Self> {
4146        let fields = value.fields(5)?;
4147        let basis = fields[0].text()?;
4148        if !matches!(basis, "episode" | "anchor") {
4149            return Err(invalid("unknown replay row basis"));
4150        }
4151        let identity = fields[1].fields(6)?;
4152        checked_digest(&identity[1])?;
4153        checked_digest(&identity[2])?;
4154        let record_line = fields[2].text()?.to_owned();
4155        validate_replay_json_structure(&record_line, 0)?;
4156        let record = replay_json_object(&record_line)?;
4157        let payload = replay_json_join(&record, Some("content_sha256"));
4158        // These are the external producer's wire-domain tags, not native
4159        // semantic laws or an additional native identity projection.
4160        let content = if basis == "anchor" {
4161            format!("[\"dlm-new/corpus-anchor/v1\",{payload}]")
4162        } else {
4163            payload
4164        };
4165        if replay_json_value(replay_json_field(&record, "content_sha256")?)?
4166            != identity[2].text()?
4167            || replay_hash(content.as_bytes()) != identity[2].text()?
4168        {
4169            return Err(invalid(
4170                "replay record content digest differs from its identity",
4171            ));
4172        }
4173        validate_replay_training_identity(identity, &record)?;
4174        let ColdValue::Bytes(evidence) = &fields[4] else {
4175            return Err(invalid("replay evidence bytes are absent"));
4176        };
4177        if evidence.is_empty() {
4178            return Err(invalid("replay evidence bytes are empty"));
4179        }
4180        if basis == "anchor" {
4181            let (source, group, task_content) =
4182                validate_anchor_admission(identity, &record, evidence, live)?;
4183            let transported = fields[3].fields(1)?;
4184            let material = ReplayMaterial::parse(&transported[0], &BTreeSet::new())?;
4185            if material.kind != "training-view"
4186                || replay_json_value(replay_json_field(&record, "training_view_identity")?)?
4187                    != material.identity
4188            {
4189                return Err(invalid(
4190                    "corpus anchor requires its one original training-view material",
4191                ));
4192            }
4193            validate_replay_training_payload(&material, identity, &source, true)?;
4194            return Ok(Self {
4195                basis: ReplayBasis::CorpusAnchor {
4196                    group,
4197                    task_content,
4198                },
4199                identity: fields[1].clone(),
4200                record_line,
4201                record,
4202                materials: vec![material],
4203                evidence: Arc::clone(evidence),
4204            });
4205        }
4206        let envelope = replay_json_object(replay_json_field(&record, "envelope")?)?;
4207        let execution = replay_json_object(replay_json_field(&envelope, "execution_materials")?)?;
4208        let expected = [
4209            "action_base_h_logical",
4210            "action_successor_h_logical",
4211            "invocation",
4212            "training_view_identity",
4213            "baseline",
4214            "materials",
4215        ];
4216        if execution.len() != expected.len()
4217            || !expected.iter().all(|key| execution.contains_key(*key))
4218        {
4219            return Err(invalid("replay execution materials field set differs"));
4220        }
4221        let declared: Vec<Box<serde_json::value::RawValue>> =
4222            serde_json::from_str(replay_json_field(&execution, "materials")?)
4223                .map_err(|_| invalid("replay material roster is not an array"))?;
4224        let transported = fields[3].sequence()?;
4225        if declared.len() != transported.len() || declared.is_empty() {
4226            return Err(invalid(
4227                "replay material roster is missing or detached from the episode",
4228            ));
4229        }
4230        let mut earlier = BTreeSet::new();
4231        let mut materials = Vec::new();
4232        for (declared, transported) in declared.iter().zip(transported) {
4233            let material = ReplayMaterial::parse(transported, &earlier)?;
4234            let reference = replay_json_object(declared.get())?;
4235            let reconstruction = replay_json_field(&reference, "reconstruction")?;
4236            if reconstruction != "null" {
4237                replay_json_object(reconstruction)?;
4238            }
4239            if replay_json_value(declared.get())? != material.reference_json() {
4240                return Err(invalid(
4241                    "replay material order or reference differs from the episode",
4242                ));
4243            }
4244            earlier.insert(material.identity.clone());
4245            materials.push(material);
4246        }
4247        let require_kind = |raw: &str, kind: &str| -> PyResult<()> {
4248            let value = replay_json_value(raw)?;
4249            let identity = value
4250                .as_str()
4251                .ok_or_else(|| invalid("replay material binding requires a digest"))?;
4252            if !materials
4253                .iter()
4254                .any(|material| material.identity == identity && material.kind == kind)
4255            {
4256                return Err(invalid(
4257                    "replay execution binding does not resolve to its material kind",
4258                ));
4259            }
4260            Ok(())
4261        };
4262        require_kind(
4263            replay_json_field(&execution, "action_base_h_logical")?,
4264            "logical-state",
4265        )?;
4266        require_kind(
4267            replay_json_field(&execution, "action_successor_h_logical")?,
4268            "logical-state",
4269        )?;
4270        let invocation = replay_json_object(replay_json_field(&execution, "invocation")?)?;
4271        let invocation_kinds = [
4272            ("entry_boundary_identity", "entry-boundary"),
4273            ("source_tokens_identity", "source-tokens"),
4274            ("topology_identity", "topology"),
4275            ("cache_identity", "cache"),
4276            ("feedback_identity", "feedback"),
4277            ("model_generation", "neural-generation"),
4278            ("parameters_identity", "parameters"),
4279            ("physical_partition_identity", "physical-partition"),
4280            ("numerical_realization_identity", "numerical-realization"),
4281            ("logits_identity", "logits"),
4282            ("random_state_identity", "random-state"),
4283        ];
4284        if invocation.len() != invocation_kinds.len() {
4285            return Err(invalid("replay invocation field set differs"));
4286        }
4287        for (name, kind) in invocation_kinds {
4288            require_kind(replay_json_field(&invocation, name)?, kind)?;
4289        }
4290        if replay_json_field(&invocation, "model_generation")?
4291            != replay_json_field(&envelope, "neural_generation")?
4292        {
4293            return Err(invalid(
4294                "replay invocation generation differs from its envelope",
4295            ));
4296        }
4297        let training = materials
4298            .iter()
4299            .filter(|material| material.kind == "training-view")
4300            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
4301        if training.len() != 1 {
4302            return Err(invalid(
4303                "replay episode requires one original training-view material",
4304            ));
4305        }
4306        if replay_json_value(replay_json_field(&execution, "training_view_identity")?)?
4307            != training[0].identity
4308        {
4309            return Err(invalid(
4310                "replay episode training-view identity differs from its original material",
4311            ));
4312        }
4313        let source = replay_json_value(replay_json_field(&invocation, "source_tokens_identity")?)?;
4314        validate_replay_training_payload(
4315            training[0],
4316            identity,
4317            source
4318                .as_str()
4319                .ok_or_else(|| invalid("replay source identity is not a digest"))?,
4320            false,
4321        )?;
4322        let row = Self {
4323            basis: ReplayBasis::Episode {
4324                execution: replay_json_value(replay_json_field(&envelope, "execution_materials")?)?,
4325            },
4326            identity: fields[1].clone(),
4327            record_line,
4328            record,
4329            materials,
4330            evidence: Arc::clone(evidence),
4331        };
4332        row.checkpoint_referent()?;
4333        Ok(row)
4334    }
4335}
4336
4337fn validate_replay_training_identity(
4338    identity: &[ColdValue],
4339    record: &ReplayJsonObject,
4340) -> PyResult<()> {
4341    const NAMES: [&str; 9] = [
4342        "data_manifest_hash",
4343        "example_id",
4344        "final_split",
4345        "tokenizer_hash",
4346        "tokenizer_revision",
4347        "mask_policy_hash",
4348        "training_seed",
4349        "epoch_index",
4350        "variant_index",
4351    ];
4352    let view = identity[0].fields(NAMES.len())?;
4353    let original = replay_json_object(replay_json_field(record, "training_view")?)?;
4354    if original.len() != NAMES.len() {
4355        return Err(invalid("training view requires its original nine fields"));
4356    }
4357    for (index, name) in NAMES.iter().enumerate() {
4358        if index < 6 {
4359            view[index].text()?;
4360        } else if !matches!(&view[index], ColdValue::Integer(value) if !value.starts_with('-')) {
4361            return Err(invalid(
4362                "training view seed, epoch and variant require nonnegative integers",
4363            ));
4364        }
4365        if replay_json_field(&original, name)? != replay_identity_json(&view[index])? {
4366            return Err(invalid(
4367                "training identity differs from its original record projection",
4368            ));
4369        }
4370    }
4371    for index in [0, 3, 5] {
4372        checked_digest(&view[index])?;
4373    }
4374    if replay_json_field(record, "example_id")? != replay_identity_json(&view[1])?
4375        || !matches!(view[2].text()?, "train" | "dev" | "request-local-replay")
4376    {
4377        return Err(invalid(
4378            "replay training identity names another example or a sealed partition",
4379        ));
4380    }
4381    if let Some(split) = record.get("final_split") {
4382        if split.get() != replay_identity_json(&view[2])? {
4383            return Err(invalid("replay training partition differs from its record"));
4384        }
4385    }
4386    let canonical = replay_identity_json(&identity[0])?;
4387    if replay_hash(format!("[\"dlm-new/training-view-identity/v1\",{canonical}]").as_bytes())
4388        != identity[1].text()?
4389    {
4390        return Err(invalid("training-view identity digest differs"));
4391    }
4392    Ok(())
4393}
4394
4395fn validate_anchor_admission(
4396    identity: &[ColdValue],
4397    record: &ReplayJsonObject,
4398    evidence: &[u8],
4399    live: &[LiveAuthority],
4400) -> PyResult<(
4401    String,
4402    ReplayAnchorGroup,
4403    Option<SemanticTaskContentIdentity>,
4404)> {
4405    let base_keys = [
4406        "content_sha256",
4407        "example_id",
4408        "group",
4409        "training_view",
4410        "training_view_identity",
4411    ];
4412    let view = identity[0].fields(9)?;
4413    let group = match replay_json_value(replay_json_field(record, "group")?)?.as_str() {
4414        Some("language") => ReplayAnchorGroup::Language,
4415        Some("symbolic") => ReplayAnchorGroup::Symbolic,
4416        _ => {
4417            return Err(invalid(
4418                "anchor requires the exact language or symbolic retention group",
4419            ));
4420        }
4421    };
4422    let has_task_content = matches!(group, ReplayAnchorGroup::Symbolic);
4423    let task_content_fields = if has_task_content { 1 } else { 0 };
4424    if record.len() != base_keys.len() + task_content_fields
4425        || base_keys.iter().any(|key| !record.contains_key(*key))
4426        || record.contains_key("semantic_task") != has_task_content
4427    {
4428        return Err(invalid("anchor record field set differs"));
4429    }
4430    let task_content = if has_task_content {
4431        let binding = replay_json_object(replay_json_field(record, "semantic_task")?)?;
4432        let keys = [
4433            "query_identity",
4434            "result_identity",
4435            "theory_program_identity",
4436        ];
4437        if binding.len() != keys.len() || keys.iter().any(|key| !binding.contains_key(*key)) {
4438            return Err(invalid(
4439                "symbolic anchor requires exact query, theory/program and result identities",
4440            ));
4441        }
4442        let digest = |name: &str| {
4443            let value = replay_json_value(replay_json_field(&binding, name)?)?;
4444            let text = value
4445                .as_str()
4446                .ok_or_else(|| invalid("symbolic task content identity is not a digest"))?;
4447            replay_digest_identity(text)
4448        };
4449        Some(SemanticTaskContentIdentity {
4450            query: digest("query_identity")?,
4451            theory_program: digest("theory_program_identity")?,
4452            result: digest("result_identity")?,
4453        })
4454    } else {
4455        None
4456    };
4457    if view[2].text()? != "train" {
4458        return Err(invalid(
4459            "anchor requires its admitted train partition and original retention group",
4460        ));
4461    }
4462    let text = std::str::from_utf8(evidence)
4463        .map_err(|_| invalid("anchor admission evidence is not UTF-8"))?;
4464    validate_replay_json_structure(text, 0)?;
4465    let parts: Vec<Box<serde_json::value::RawValue>> = serde_json::from_str(text)
4466        .map_err(|_| invalid("anchor admission evidence requires its canonical record"))?;
4467    let expected_evidence_fields = if has_task_content { 6 } else { 3 };
4468    if parts.len() != expected_evidence_fields
4469        || replay_json_value(parts[0].get())? != "dlm-new/corpus-anchor-admission/v1"
4470        || parts[1].get() != replay_identity_json(&view[0])?
4471    {
4472        return Err(invalid(
4473            "anchor admission differs from the original manifest",
4474        ));
4475    }
4476    let entry = replay_json_value(parts[2].get())?;
4477    let entry = entry
4478        .as_array()
4479        .filter(|entry| entry.len() == 10)
4480        .ok_or_else(|| invalid("anchor admission requires the complete manifest entry"))?;
4481    if entry[0] != view[1].text()? || entry[1] != "train" {
4482        return Err(invalid(
4483            "anchor admission names another example or partition",
4484        ));
4485    }
4486    for index in [2, 3, 4] {
4487        replay_digest_identity(
4488            entry[index]
4489                .as_str()
4490                .ok_or_else(|| invalid("manifest entry content digest is absent"))?,
4491        )?;
4492    }
4493    let provenance = entry[7]
4494        .as_array()
4495        .ok_or_else(|| invalid("anchor requires its complete original provenance"))?;
4496    let admission = entry[8]
4497        .as_array()
4498        .filter(|parts| parts.len() == 3)
4499        .ok_or_else(|| invalid("anchor requires its original admission decision"))?;
4500    let admits_train = admission[1]
4501        .as_array()
4502        .is_some_and(|splits| splits.iter().any(|split| split == "train"));
4503    match provenance.first().and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str) {
4504        Some("corpus") => {
4505            if provenance.len() != 11
4506                || admission[0] != "corpus"
4507                || admission[2] != "corpus"
4508                || !admits_train
4509                || !provenance[8]
4510                    .as_array()
4511                    .is_some_and(|uses| uses.iter().any(|use_| use_ == "training"))
4512            {
4513                return Err(invalid("corpus anchor has no train-only corpus admission"));
4514            }
4515        }
4516        Some("live") => {
4517            if provenance.len() != 16
4518                || admission[0] != "live"
4519                || admission[2] != "cross-request"
4520                || !admits_train
4521                || !provenance[8].as_array().is_some_and(|uses| {
4522                    uses.iter().any(|use_| use_ == "durable-slow-consolidation")
4523                })
4524                || provenance[13] != true
4525                || provenance[14] != true
4526            {
4527                return Err(invalid("live anchor lacks durable train admission"));
4528            }
4529            let mut matched = false;
4530            for authority in live {
4531                if replay_json_value(&replay_identity_json(&authority.canonical)?)? == entry[7] {
4532                    matched = true;
4533                    break;
4534                }
4535            }
4536            if !matched {
4537                return Err(invalid(
4538                    "live anchor provenance differs from every bound live authority",
4539                ));
4540            }
4541        }
4542        _ => {
4543            return Err(invalid(
4544                "anchor provenance has no admitted corpus or live branch",
4545            ))
4546        }
4547    }
4548    if let Some(binding) = task_content {
4549        for (part, expected) in
4550            parts[3..]
4551                .iter()
4552                .zip([binding.query, binding.theory_program, binding.result])
4553        {
4554            let actual = replay_json_value(part.get())?;
4555            let actual = actual
4556                .as_str()
4557                .ok_or_else(|| invalid("symbolic admission task binding is not a digest"))?;
4558            if replay_digest_identity(actual)? != expected {
4559                return Err(invalid(
4560                    "symbolic admission differs from its query, theory/program or result binding",
4561                ));
4562            }
4563        }
4564    }
4565    // This checks the transported producer record, not a signature or a grant.
4566    // TaskAuthority still requires the trusted application's full dependency
4567    // closure and fresh permission for every use of these retained bytes.
4568    Ok((
4569        entry[4]
4570            .as_str()
4571            .expect("checked original normalized record digest")
4572            .to_owned(),
4573        group,
4574        task_content,
4575    ))
4576}
4577
4578fn validate_replay_training_payload(
4579    material: &ReplayMaterial,
4580    identity: &[ColdValue],
4581    source: &str,
4582    require_retention: bool,
4583) -> PyResult<()> {
4584    if material.bytes_sha256.as_deref() != Some(material.identity.as_str()) {
4585        return Err(invalid(
4586            "training-view material identity differs from its original byte identity",
4587        ));
4588    }
4589    let bytes = material
4590        .bytes
4591        .as_deref()
4592        .ok_or_else(|| invalid("training view requires its original bytes"))?;
4593    let layout = xlog_cuda::validate_training_view_layout(bytes).map_err(xlog_err)?;
4594    if bytes[32..64] != *replay_digest_identity(identity[1].text()?)?.as_bytes()
4595        || bytes[64..96] != *replay_digest_identity(source)?.as_bytes()
4596    {
4597        return Err(invalid(
4598            "training-view header differs from its original identity or source",
4599        ));
4600    }
4601    let window = layout.window;
4602    let length = identity[3].unsigned()?;
4603    let block = identity[4].unsigned()?;
4604    let answer_start = layout.answer_start;
4605    if layout.source_length != length
4606        || layout.block_size != block
4607        || (require_retention && answer_start == length)
4608        || length
4609            .checked_mul(2)
4610            .is_none_or(|extent| extent > window as u64)
4611    {
4612        return Err(invalid(
4613            "training-view byte extent or dimensions differ from its original row",
4614        ));
4615    }
4616    let token_ids = 264;
4617    let mask_labels = token_ids + window * 8;
4618    let mask_weights = mask_labels + window * 8;
4619    let ar_labels = mask_weights + window * 4 + (window % 2) * 4;
4620    let retention = ar_labels + window * 8;
4621    let branch_labels = retention + window * 8;
4622    let branch_ids = branch_labels + window * 8;
4623    let source_slots = branch_ids + window * 8;
4624    let positions = source_slots + window * 8;
4625    let kinds = positions + window * 8;
4626    let parents = kinds + window * 8;
4627    let signed = |offset: usize| {
4628        i64::from_le_bytes(
4629            bytes[offset..offset + 8]
4630                .try_into()
4631                .expect("bounded training-view element"),
4632        )
4633    };
4634    let mut targets = BTreeSet::new();
4635    let mut previous = None;
4636    for target in identity[5].sequence()? {
4637        let target = target.fields(3)?;
4638        let position = target[0].unsigned()?;
4639        if position >= length
4640            || previous.is_some_and(|last| position <= last)
4641            || target[1].unsigned()? != position
4642            || Some(target[2].unsigned()?) != length.checked_add(position)
4643        {
4644            return Err(invalid(
4645                "training-view targets must retain ordered (p, p, L+p) coordinates",
4646            ));
4647        }
4648        previous = Some(position);
4649        targets.insert(target[2].unsigned()? as usize);
4650    }
4651    for slot in 0..window {
4652        let label = signed(mask_labels + slot * 8);
4653        let offset = mask_weights + slot * 4;
4654        let weight = f32::from_le_bytes(
4655            bytes[offset..offset + 4]
4656                .try_into()
4657                .expect("bounded training-view weight"),
4658        );
4659        if targets.contains(&slot) {
4660            if label < 0 || !weight.is_finite() || weight <= 0.0 {
4661                return Err(invalid(
4662                    "training-view target is absent from its original MASK supervision",
4663                ));
4664            }
4665        } else if label != -100 || weight != 0.0 {
4666            return Err(invalid(
4667                "training-view MASK supervision contains an undeclared target",
4668            ));
4669        }
4670        let autoregressive = signed(ar_labels + slot * 8);
4671        if autoregressive < 0 && autoregressive != -100 {
4672            return Err(invalid("training-view autoregressive label is not a token"));
4673        }
4674        // Retention reads the original causal memory predictor, not the
4675        // permuted prediction stream or a newly drawn subset of MASK rows.
4676        let next = slot as u64 + 1;
4677        let expected_label = if next >= answer_start && next < length {
4678            let token = signed(token_ids + (slot + 1) * 8);
4679            if token < 0 {
4680                return Err(invalid("training-view retention target is not a token"));
4681            }
4682            token
4683        } else {
4684            -100
4685        };
4686        if signed(retention + slot * 8) != expected_label {
4687            return Err(invalid(
4688                "training-view retention labels differ from the original answer projection",
4689            ));
4690        }
4691    }
4692    let mut nodes_by_source_slot = vec![None; window];
4693    for node in 0..window {
4694        let source_slot = usize::try_from(signed(source_slots + node * 8))
4695            .map_err(|_| invalid("training-view topology has a negative source slot"))?;
4696        if source_slot >= window || nodes_by_source_slot[source_slot].replace(node).is_some() {
4697            return Err(invalid(
4698                "training-view topology source slots are not a permutation",
4699            ));
4700        }
4701        let kind = signed(kinds + node * 8);
4702        let position = signed(positions + node * 8);
4703        let parent = signed(parents + node * 8);
4704        if kind == 0 {
4705            if position != 0 || parent != -2 {
4706                return Err(invalid(
4707                    "training-view inactive topology node is not canonical",
4708                ));
4709            }
4710        } else if !matches!(kind, 2 | 4 | 5)
4711            || position < 0
4712            || position as u64 >= window as u64
4713            || parent < -1
4714            || parent >= window as i64
4715            || parent == node as i64
4716        {
4717            return Err(invalid("training-view active topology node is invalid"));
4718        }
4719    }
4720    let source_length = length as usize;
4721    for node in 0..source_length {
4722        let expected_parent = if node == 0 { -1 } else { node as i64 - 1 };
4723        if signed(source_slots + node * 8) != node as i64
4724            || signed(positions + node * 8) != node as i64
4725            || signed(kinds + node * 8) != 4
4726            || signed(parents + node * 8) != expected_parent
4727        {
4728            return Err(invalid(
4729                "training-view memory topology differs from its source",
4730            ));
4731        }
4732    }
4733    let block_size = usize::try_from(block)
4734        .map_err(|_| invalid("training-view block size exceeds host address space"))?;
4735    let mut physical = source_length;
4736    for block_start in (0..source_length).step_by(block_size) {
4737        let block_end = block_start.saturating_add(block_size).min(source_length);
4738        let first_in_block = physical;
4739        for masked in [false, true] {
4740            for position in block_start..block_end {
4741                let source_slot = source_length + position;
4742                if targets.contains(&source_slot) != masked {
4743                    continue;
4744                }
4745                let expected_parent = if physical == first_in_block {
4746                    if block_start == 0 {
4747                        -1
4748                    } else {
4749                        block_start as i64 - 1
4750                    }
4751                } else {
4752                    physical as i64 - 1
4753                };
4754                if signed(source_slots + physical * 8) != source_slot as i64
4755                    || signed(positions + physical * 8) != position as i64
4756                    || signed(kinds + physical * 8) != if masked { 2 } else { 5 }
4757                    || signed(parents + physical * 8) != expected_parent
4758                {
4759                    return Err(invalid(
4760                        "training-view prediction topology differs from its source",
4761                    ));
4762                }
4763                physical += 1;
4764            }
4765        }
4766    }
4767    if physical != source_length * 2 {
4768        return Err(invalid("training-view prediction topology is incomplete"));
4769    }
4770    if layout.branch_words[0] != 0 {
4771        let shared_context_end = layout.branch_words[0] as usize;
4772        for branch in 0..3 {
4773            let offset = 1 + branch * 5;
4774            let tail_begin = layout.branch_words[offset] as usize;
4775            let answer_end = layout.branch_words[offset + 3] as usize;
4776            for source_slot in tail_begin..answer_end {
4777                let expected_parent = if source_slot == tail_begin {
4778                    shared_context_end as i64 - 1
4779                } else {
4780                    physical as i64 - 1
4781                };
4782                let expected_position = shared_context_end + source_slot - tail_begin;
4783                if signed(source_slots + physical * 8) != source_slot as i64
4784                    || signed(positions + physical * 8) != expected_position as i64
4785                    || signed(kinds + physical * 8) != 5
4786                    || signed(parents + physical * 8) != expected_parent
4787                {
4788                    return Err(invalid(
4789                        "training-view branch topology differs from its source",
4790                    ));
4791                }
4792                physical += 1;
4793            }
4794        }
4795    }
4796    for node in physical..window {
4797        if signed(source_slots + node * 8) != node as i64
4798            || signed(positions + node * 8) != 0
4799            || signed(kinds + node * 8) != 0
4800            || signed(parents + node * 8) != -2
4801        {
4802            return Err(invalid(
4803                "training-view inactive topology node is not canonical",
4804            ));
4805        }
4806    }
4807    let mut expected_branches = vec![None; window];
4808    if layout.branch_words[0] != 0 {
4809        for branch in 0..3 {
4810            let offset = 1 + branch * 5;
4811            let answer_begin = layout.branch_words[offset + 2];
4812            let answer_end = layout.branch_words[offset + 3];
4813            let logical_start = layout.branch_words[offset + 4];
4814            for index in 0..(answer_end - answer_begin) {
4815                let source_slot = (answer_begin + index) as usize;
4816                let node =
4817                    nodes_by_source_slot[source_slot].expect("validated source-slot permutation");
4818                let parent = signed(parents + node * 8);
4819                let answer_position = logical_start + index;
4820                if signed(kinds + node * 8) != 5
4821                    || signed(positions + node * 8) != answer_position as i64
4822                    || parent < 0
4823                    || signed(positions + parent as usize * 8) != answer_position as i64 - 1
4824                {
4825                    return Err(invalid(
4826                        "training-view branch answer lacks its original causal parent",
4827                    ));
4828                }
4829                let predictor = signed(source_slots + parent as usize * 8) as usize;
4830                let token = signed(token_ids + source_slot * 8);
4831                if token < 0
4832                    || expected_branches[predictor]
4833                        .replace((token, branch as i64))
4834                        .is_some()
4835                {
4836                    return Err(invalid(
4837                        "training-view branch target is absent or duplicated",
4838                    ));
4839                }
4840            }
4841        }
4842    }
4843    for (slot, expected) in expected_branches.into_iter().enumerate() {
4844        let actual = (
4845            signed(branch_labels + slot * 8),
4846            signed(branch_ids + slot * 8),
4847        );
4848        if actual != expected.unwrap_or((-100, -1)) {
4849            return Err(invalid(
4850                "training-view branch supervision differs from its declared topology",
4851            ));
4852        }
4853    }
4854    Ok(())
4855}
4856
4857fn replay_digest_identity(text: &str) -> PyResult<Identity256> {
4858    checked_digest(&ColdValue::Text(text.to_owned()))?;
4859    let mut bytes = [0u8; 32];
4860    for (index, byte) in bytes.iter_mut().enumerate() {
4861        *byte = u8::from_str_radix(&text[index * 2..index * 2 + 2], 16)
4862            .map_err(|_| invalid("native replay identity is not an exact SHA256 digest"))?;
4863    }
4864    Ok(Identity256::from_bytes(bytes))
4865}
4866
4867fn select_replay_row(rows: &[ReplayRow], selection: &ColdValue) -> PyResult<Option<usize>> {
4868    if selection == &ColdValue::None {
4869        return Ok(None);
4870    }
4871    let fields = selection.fields(2)?;
4872    let ordinal = usize::try_from(fields[0].unsigned()?)
4873        .map_err(|_| invalid("selected replay ordinal exceeds host address space"))?;
4874    let row = rows
4875        .get(ordinal)
4876        .ok_or_else(|| invalid("selected replay ordinal is absent"))?;
4877    if row.identity != fields[1] {
4878        return Err(invalid(
4879            "selected replay identity differs from the exact original row",
4880        ));
4881    }
4882    Ok(Some(ordinal))
4883}
4884
4885fn decode_selected_replay(
4886    rows: &[ReplayRow],
4887    selection: &ColdValue,
4888) -> PyResult<(Option<usize>, Option<NativeReplayBinding>)> {
4889    let selection = select_replay_row(rows, selection)?;
4890    let mut selected = None;
4891    for (ordinal, row) in rows.iter().enumerate() {
4892        if matches!(row.basis, ReplayBasis::CorpusAnchor { .. }) {
4893            if selection == Some(ordinal) {
4894                return Err(invalid(
4895                    "native execution replay cannot select a corpus anchor",
4896                ));
4897            }
4898            continue;
4899        }
4900        let material = row.native_replay()?;
4901        if selection == Some(ordinal) {
4902            selected = Some(material);
4903        }
4904    }
4905    Ok((selection, selected))
4906}

4908#[expect(
4909    clippy::too_many_arguments,
4910    reason = "the native task evaluator has seven independent admitted inputs"
4911)]
4912fn read_task_evaluation_spec(
4913    statements: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
4914    supports: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
4915    source: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
4916    queries: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
4917    scoring: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
4918    truth_masks: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
4919    actor_eligible: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
4920    budget: &mut usize,
4921) -> PyResult<xlog_cuda::SemanticTaskEvaluationSpec> {
4922    let values = read_task_evaluation_values(
4923        statements,
4924        supports,
4925        source,
4926        queries,
4927        scoring,
4928        truth_masks,
4929        actor_eligible,
4930        budget,
4931    )?;
4932    // Observation coverage precedes task authority; priorities do not affect
4933    // its queried root set and are bound by import_task instead.
4934    task_evaluation_spec(&values, Vec::new(), None, &ColdValue::None)
4935}
4936
4937#[expect(
4938    clippy::too_many_arguments,
4939    reason = "the native task evaluator has seven independent admitted inputs"
4940)]
4941fn read_task_evaluation_values(
4942    statements: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
4943    supports: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
4944    source: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
4945    queries: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
4946    scoring: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
4947    truth_masks: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
4948    actor_eligible: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
4949    budget: &mut usize,
4950) -> PyResult<Vec<ColdValue>> {
4951    [
4952        statements,
4953        supports,
4954        source,
4955        queries,
4956        scoring,
4957        truth_masks,
4958        actor_eligible,
4959    ]
4960    .into_iter()
4961    .map(|value| ColdValue::read(value, budget, 0))
4962    .collect()
4963}
4964
4965fn task_evaluation_spec(
4966    values: &[ColdValue],
4967    priority_levels: Vec<xlog_cuda::SemanticTaskPriorityLevel>,
4968    editable_program: Option<Arc<SemanticProgramAdmission>>,
4969    training_domain: &ColdValue,
4970) -> PyResult<xlog_cuda::SemanticTaskEvaluationSpec> {
4971    if values.len() != 7 {
4972        return Err(invalid("incorrect task evaluation input count"));
4973    }
4974    let statements = &values[0];
4975    let statements = statements.fields(3)?;
4976    let record_index = |value: &ColdValue| {
4977        u32::try_from(value.unsigned()?)
4978            .map_err(|_| invalid("native admitted record index exceeds u32"))
4979    };
4980    let statement_records = [
4981        record_index(&statements[0])?,
4982        record_index(&statements[1])?,
4983        record_index(&statements[2])?,
4984    ];
4985    let allowed_support_records = values[1]
4986        .sequence()?
4987        .iter()
4988        .map(record_index)
4989        .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
4990    let source = values[2].text()?.to_owned();
4991    let queries = &values[3];
4992    let queries = queries.fields(3)?;
4993    let query_ordinal = |value: &ColdValue| {
4994        usize::try_from(value.unsigned()?)
4995            .map_err(|_| invalid("native task query ordinal exceeds host address space"))
4996    };
4997    let query_ordinals = [
4998        query_ordinal(&queries[0])?,
4999        query_ordinal(&queries[1])?,
5000        query_ordinal(&queries[2])?,
5001    ];
5002    if editable_program.is_some() && (statement_records != [0, 1, 2] || query_ordinals != [0, 1, 2])
5003    {
5004        return Err(invalid(
5005            "editable task requires the original statement and observer query order",
5006        ));
5007    }
5008    let scoring = &values[4];
5009    let scoring = scoring.fields(6)?;
5010    let weight = |value: &ColdValue| {
5011        u32::try_from(value.unsigned()?)
5012            .map_err(|_| invalid("native task scoring weight exceeds u32"))
5013    };
5014    let scoring = xlog_cuda::SemanticTaskScoring {
5015        correct_weight: weight(&scoring[0])?,
5016        all_correct_weight: weight(&scoring[1])?,
5017        work_weight: weight(&scoring[2])?,
5018        improvement_weight: weight(&scoring[3])?,
5019        refusal_weight: weight(&scoring[4])?,
5020        spent_weight: weight(&scoring[5])?,
5021    };
5022    let masks = &values[5];
5023    let masks = masks.fields(3)?;
5024    let mask = |value: &ColdValue| {
5025        u8::try_from(value.unsigned()?).map_err(|_| invalid("native task truth mask exceeds u8"))
5026    };
5027    let admissible_truth_masks = [mask(&masks[0])?, mask(&masks[1])?, mask(&masks[2])?];
5028    let actor_eligible = values[6].boolean()?;
5029    let mut program = xlog_gpu::logic::SemanticLogicTaskProgram::compile(source, query_ordinals)
5030        .map_err(xlog_err)?;
5031    if let Some(editable) = editable_program {
5032        program = program.with_editable_program(editable);
5033    }
5034    let program = Arc::new(program);
5035    Ok(xlog_cuda::SemanticTaskEvaluationSpec {
5036        statement_records,
5037        allowed_support_records,
5038        program,
5039        scoring,
5040        priority_levels,
5041        admissible_truth_masks,
5042        actor_eligible,
5043        training_domain: read_training_domain(training_domain)?,
5044    })
5045}
5046
5047fn task_priority_levels(value: &ColdValue) -> PyResult<Vec<xlog_cuda::SemanticTaskPriorityLevel>> {
5048    value
5049        .sequence()?
5050        .iter()
5051        .map(|level| {
5052            let goals = level
5053                .sequence()?
5054                .iter()
5055                .map(|goal| {
5056                    let fields = goal.fields(3)?;
5057                    Ok(xlog_cuda::SemanticTaskPriorityGoal {
5058                        query: u8::try_from(fields[0].unsigned()?)
5059                            .map_err(|_| invalid("task priority query exceeds u8"))?,
5060                        target_truth: u8::try_from(fields[1].unsigned()?)
5061                            .map_err(|_| invalid("task priority truth exceeds u8"))?,
5062                        weight: u32::try_from(fields[2].unsigned()?)
5063                            .map_err(|_| invalid("task priority weight exceeds u32"))?,
5064                    })
5065                })
5066                .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
5067            Ok(xlog_cuda::SemanticTaskPriorityLevel { goals })
5068        })
5069        .collect()
5070}
5071
5072fn task_priority_levels_tuple(
5073    py: Python<'_>,
5074    levels: &[xlog_cuda::SemanticTaskPriorityLevel],
5075) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
5076    let mut rows = Vec::with_capacity(levels.len());
5077    for level in levels {
5078        rows.push(
5079            PyTuple::new(
5080                py,
5081                level
5082                    .goals
5083                    .iter()
5084                    .map(|goal| (goal.query, goal.target_truth, goal.weight)),
5085            )?
5086            .unbind(),
5087        );
5088    }
5089    Ok(PyTuple::new(py, rows)?.unbind())
5090}
5091
5092fn read_task_replay_limits(
5093    material: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
5094    total: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
5095    evidence: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
5096    budget: &mut usize,
5097) -> PyResult<[usize; 3]> {
5098    let mut limits = [0; 3];
5099    for (index, (value, name)) in [
5100        (material, "max_material_bytes"),
5101        (total, "max_total_material_bytes"),
5102        (evidence, "max_evidence_bytes"),
5103    ]
5104    .into_iter()
5105    .enumerate()
5106    {
5107        limits[index] = usize::try_from(ColdValue::read(value, budget, 0)?.unsigned()?)
5108            .map_err(|_| invalid(&format!("{name} exceeds host address space")))?;
5109    }
5110    Ok(limits)
5111}
