5113/// The immutable retained source values and complete trusted dependency graph.
5114/// These are resolved decisions from privileged application code, not signatures
5115/// authenticated by this extension and not rights inferred from provenance refs.
5116#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
5117struct TaskAuthority {
5118    canonical: Vec<u8>,
5119    task_ref: String,
5120    priority_levels: Vec<xlog_cuda::SemanticTaskPriorityLevel>,
5121    scope: Vec<String>,
5122    live: Vec<LiveAuthority>,
5123    replay: Vec<ReplayRow>,
5124    dependencies: Vec<Dependency>,
5125    feedback_roots: Vec<String>,
5126    publication: Vec<ResolvedGrant>,
5127    inference: Vec<ResolvedGrant>,
5128    training: Vec<ResolvedGrant>,
5129    initial_sources: Vec<SemanticObservedSource>,
5130    source_mapping: Vec<SemanticSourceMapping>,
5131    sources_allow_learning: bool,
5132    source_partitions: Vec<(Option<String>, String)>,
5133    corpus_sources: BTreeSet<String>,
5134}
5135
5136fn parse_live_authorities(value: &ColdValue, scope: &[String]) -> PyResult<Vec<LiveAuthority>> {
5137    value
5138        .sequence()?
5139        .iter()
5140        .map(|value| {
5141            let fields = value.fields(2)?;
5142            validate_live(&fields[0], scope)?;
5143            Ok(LiveAuthority {
5144                canonical: fields[0].clone(),
5145                retention_micros: fields[1].signed()?,
5146            })
5147        })
5148        .collect()
5149}
5150
5151fn parse_replay_rows_with_live(
5152    value: &ColdValue,
5153    live: &[LiveAuthority],
5154) -> PyResult<Vec<ReplayRow>> {
5155    value
5156        .sequence()?
5157        .iter()
5158        .map(|value| ReplayRow::parse_with_live(value, live))
5159        .collect()
5160}
5161
5162impl TaskAuthority {
5163    fn parse(values: &[ColdValue]) -> PyResult<Self> {
5164        if values.len() != 10 {
5165            return Err(invalid("incorrect task authority input count"));
5166        }
5167        let scope = values[1].strings()?;
5168        if scope.len() != 5 {
5169            return Err(invalid("task_scope must contain five explicit fields"));
5170        }
5171        let live = parse_live_authorities(&values[2], &scope)?;
5172        let mut dependencies = Vec::new();
5173        for value in values[4].sequence()? {
5174            let fields = value.fields(7)?;
5175            let target = if fields[5] == ColdValue::None {
5176                None
5177            } else {
5178                let target = fields[5].fields(2)?;
5179                Some((
5180                    usize::try_from(target[0].unsigned()?)
5181                        .map_err(|_| invalid("target row index overflow"))?,
5182                    target[1].unsigned()?,
5183                ))
5184            };
5185            let native_record = if fields[6] == ColdValue::None {
5186                None
5187            } else {
5188                let record = fields[6].fields(2)?;
5189                let kind = record[0].text()?;
5190                if !matches!(kind, "statement" | "support" | "observer") {
5191                    return Err(invalid("invalid native task read-root kind"));
5192                }
5193                let index = u32::try_from(record[1].unsigned()?)
5194                    .map_err(|_| invalid("native record index exceeds u32"))?;
5195                if kind == "observer" && index != 0 {
5196                    return Err(invalid("only the bound native observer zero exists"));
5197                }
5198                Some((kind.to_owned(), index))
5199            };
5200            dependencies.push(Dependency {
5201                identity: fields[0].text()?.to_owned(),
5202                kind: fields[1].text()?.to_owned(),
5203                data_parents: fields[2].strings()?,
5204                control_parents: fields[3].strings()?,
5205                live_envelopes: fields[4].strings()?,
5206                target,
5207                native_record,
5208            });
5209        }
5210        let grants = |value: &ColdValue, training| {
5211            value
5212                .sequence()?
5213                .iter()
5214                .map(|value| ResolvedGrant::parse(value, training))
5215                .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()
5216        };
5217        let replay = parse_replay_rows_with_live(&values[3], &live)?;
5218        let result = Self {
5219            canonical: ColdValue::Sequence(values.to_vec()).canonical_bytes(),
5220            task_ref: values[0].text()?.to_owned(),
5221            priority_levels: task_priority_levels(&values[9])?,
5222            scope,
5223            live,
5224            replay,
5225            dependencies,
5226            feedback_roots: values[5].strings()?,
5227            publication: grants(&values[6], false)?,
5228            inference: grants(&values[7], false)?,
5229            training: grants(&values[8], true)?,
5230            initial_sources: Vec::new(),
5231            source_mapping: Vec::new(),
5232            sources_allow_learning: true,
5233            source_partitions: Vec::new(),
5234            corpus_sources: BTreeSet::new(),
5235        };
5236        result.validate_lineage()?;
5237        Ok(result)
5238    }
5239
5240    fn bind_initial_sources(&mut self, values: &ColdValue, mapping: &ColdValue) -> PyResult<()> {
5241        let mut sources = Vec::new();
5242        let mut learning = true;
5243        let mut identities = BTreeSet::new();
5244        let mut partitions = Vec::new();
5245        let mut corpus_sources = BTreeSet::new();
5246        for value in values.sequence()? {
5247            // Exact projection of the data owner's sealed manifest entry and
5248            // separately observed token payload, supplied by trusted Runtime.
5249            let fields = value.fields(6)?;
5250            let identity = fields[0].text()?;
5251            if !identities.insert(identity.to_owned()) {
5252                return Err(invalid("duplicate initial source identity"));
5253            }
5254            checked_digest(&fields[1])?;
5255            let tokenizer = fields[2].text()?;
5256            let revision = fields[3].text()?;
5257            let entry = fields[4].fields(10)?;
5258            entry[0].text()?;
5259            for digest in &entry[2..5] {
5260                checked_digest(digest)?;
5261            }
5262            entry[6].strings()?;
5263            let observation = entry[9].fields(4)?;
5264            let field = observation[0].text()?;
5265            checked_digest(&observation[1])?;
5266            checked_digest(&observation[2])?;
5267            let tokens = fields[5]
5268                .sequence()?
5269                .iter()
5270                .map(ColdValue::unsigned)
5271                .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
5272            if tokens.is_empty() || observation[3].unsigned()? != tokens.len() as u64 {
5273                return Err(invalid(
5274                    "observed source token payload or bound count is invalid",
5275                ));
5276            }
5277            let payload = format!(
5278                "[{}]",
5279                tokens
5280                    .iter()
5281                    .map(u64::to_string)
5282                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
5283                    .join(",")
5284            );
5285            let transform = format!("{{\"field\":{},\"template\":\"observed-source-field:v1\",\"tokenizer_hash\":{},\"tokenizer_revision\":{}}}",
5286                observation_json_string(field), observation_json_string(tokenizer), observation_json_string(revision));
5287            let hash = |bytes: &[u8]| {
5288                Sha256::digest(bytes)
5289                    .iter()
5290                    .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
5291                    .collect::<String>()
5292            };
5293            if hash(payload.as_bytes()) != observation[1].text()?
5294                || hash(transform.as_bytes()) != observation[2].text()?
5295            {
5296                return Err(invalid("observed payload or tokenizer transformation differs from the admitted binding"));
5297            }
5298            let origin = entry[7].sequence()?;
5299            let branch = origin
5300                .first()
5301                .ok_or_else(|| invalid("source origin is absent"))?
5302                .text()?;
5303            if branch == "corpus" || entry[5] != ColdValue::None {
5304                checked_digest(&entry[5])?;
5305            }
5306            let source_envelopes = self.source_lineage_envelopes(identity)?;
5307            match branch {
5308                "live" => {
5309                    validate_live(&entry[7], &self.scope)?;
5310                    if !self.live.iter().any(|live| live.canonical == entry[7]) {
5311                        return Err(invalid(
5312                            "initial source live origin differs from this task's admitted envelope",
5313                        ));
5314                    }
5315                    if !source_envelopes.contains(origin[1].text()?) {
5316                        return Err(invalid(
5317                            "initial source lineage omits its actual live origin envelope",
5318                        ));
5319                    }
5320                }
5321                "corpus" => {
5322                    corpus_sources.insert(identity.to_owned());
5323                    let origin = entry[7].fields(11)?;
5324                    for index in [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 10] {
5325                        origin[index].text()?;
5326                    }
5327                    for index in [7, 8] {
5328                        let capabilities = origin[index].strings()?;
5329                        unique(&capabilities)?;
5330                        if capabilities.is_empty() {
5331                            return Err(invalid("corpus origin has an empty capability set"));
5332                        }
5333                    }
5334                }
5335                _ => {
5336                    return Err(invalid(
5337                        "observed source requires complete corpus or live origin",
5338                    ))
5339                }
5340            }
5341            let admission = entry[8].fields(3)?;
5342            let permitted = admission[1].strings()?;
5343            unique(&permitted)?;
5344            if admission[0].text()? != branch
5345                || permitted.iter().any(|split| {
5346                    !matches!(
5347                        split.as_str(),
5348                        "train" | "dev" | "eval" | "request-local-replay"
5349                    )
5350                })
5351                || (branch == "corpus" && admission[2].text()? != "corpus")
5352                || (branch == "live"
5353                    && !matches!(admission[2].text()?, "cross-request" | "request-local"))
5354            {
5355                return Err(invalid(
5356                    "observed source admission does not match its full origin",
5357                ));
5358            }
5359            if entry[1] == ColdValue::None {
5360                if branch != "live"
5361                    || !origin[8].sequence()?.is_empty()
5362                    || !permitted.is_empty()
5363                    || admission[2].text()? != "request-local"
5364                {
5365                    return Err(invalid(
5366                        "observation-only source cannot carry learning or replay admission",
5367                    ));
5368                }
5369                learning = false;
5370            } else {
5371                let split = entry[1].text()?;
5372                if !permitted.iter().any(|allowed| allowed == split) {
5373                    return Err(invalid(
5374                        "source split is absent from its admitted partitions",
5375                    ));
5376                }
5377                learning &= split != "eval";
5378                if branch == "live" && origin[8].sequence()?.is_empty() {
5379                    return Err(invalid(
5380                        "live source without learning rights cannot enter a replay partition",
5381                    ));
5382                }
5383            }
5384            sources.push(SemanticObservedSource {
5385                identity: identity.to_owned(),
5386                tokens,
5387                origin: value.canonical_bytes(),
5388            });
5389            partitions.push((
5390                if entry[1] == ColdValue::None {
5391                    None
5392                } else {
5393                    Some(entry[1].text()?.to_owned())
5394                },
5395                admission[2].text()?.to_owned(),
5396            ));
5397        }
5398        let mapping = mapping
5399            .sequence()?
5400            .iter()
5401            .map(|entry| {
5402                let fields = entry.fields(3)?;
5403                let source = fields[0].text()?;
5404                let offset = fields[1].unsigned()?;
5405                let logical_position = fields[2].unsigned()?;
5406                if sources
5407                    .iter()
5408                    .find(|entry| entry.identity == source)
5409                    .is_none_or(|entry| offset >= entry.tokens.len() as u64)
5410                {
5411                    return Err(invalid(
5412                        "initial source mapping has an unknown source or out-of-range token offset",
5413                    ));
5414                }
5415                Ok(SemanticSourceMapping {
5416                    source: source.to_owned(),
5417                    offset,
5418                    logical_position,
5419                })
5420            })
5421            .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
5422        if mapping
5423            .iter()
5424            .map(|entry| entry.logical_position)
5425            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>()
5426            .len()
5427            != mapping.len()
5428        {
5429            return Err(invalid("initial source mapping repeats a logical position"));
5430        }
5431        self.initial_sources = sources;
5432        self.source_mapping = mapping;
5433        self.sources_allow_learning = learning;
5434        self.source_partitions = partitions;
5435        self.corpus_sources = corpus_sources;
5436        self.validate_lineage()?;
5437        self.require_source_origins()?;
5438        // Preserve the original canonical task payload and extend that same
5439        // retained authority record with the complete admitted source values.
5440        let source_bytes = values.canonical_bytes();
5441        let mut binding = b"xlog.task.observed-sources.v1\0".to_vec();
5442        for bytes in [&self.canonical, &source_bytes] {
5443            binding.extend_from_slice(&(bytes.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
5444            binding.extend_from_slice(bytes);
5445        }
5446        for entry in &self.source_mapping {
5447            binding.extend_from_slice(&(entry.source.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
5448            binding.extend_from_slice(entry.source.as_bytes());
5449            binding.extend_from_slice(&entry.offset.to_le_bytes());
5450            binding.extend_from_slice(&entry.logical_position.to_le_bytes());
5451        }
5452        self.canonical = binding;
5453        Ok(())
5454    }
5455
5456    fn source_lineage_envelopes(&self, identity: &str) -> PyResult<BTreeSet<String>> {
5457        let index = self
5458            .dependencies
5459            .iter()
5460            .map(|node| (node.identity.as_str(), node))
5461            .collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>();
5462        let mut pending = vec![identity];
5463        let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
5464        let mut envelopes = BTreeSet::new();
5465        let mut observed = false;
5466        while let Some(reference) = pending.pop() {
5467            if !seen.insert(reference) {
5468                continue;
5469            }
5470            let node = index.get(reference).ok_or_else(|| {
5471                invalid("initial source is absent from the complete task dependency graph")
5472            })?;
5473            if node.kind == "target_value" {
5474                return Err(invalid(
5475                    "initial source depends on a target value through data or control lineage",
5476                ));
5477            }
5478            observed |= node.kind == "source";
5479            envelopes.extend(node.live_envelopes.iter().cloned());
5480            pending.extend(
5481                node.data_parents
5482                    .iter()
5483                    .chain(&node.control_parents)
5484                    .map(String::as_str),
5485            );
5486        }
5487        if !observed {
5488            return Err(invalid("initial source lacks observed data ancestry"));
5489        }
5490        Ok(envelopes)
5491    }
5492
5493    fn require_source_origins(&self) -> PyResult<()> {
5494        for node in &self.dependencies {
5495            if node.kind == "source"
5496                && node.live_envelopes.is_empty()
5497                && !self.corpus_sources.contains(&node.identity)
5498            {
5499                return Err(invalid(
5500                    "source root without a live envelope requires its admitted corpus observation",
5501                ));
5502            }
5503        }
5504        Ok(())
5505    }
5506
5507    fn validate_lineage(&self) -> PyResult<()> {
5508        let mut targets = BTreeSet::new();
5509        for (row, replay) in self.replay.iter().enumerate() {
5510            let fields = replay.identity.fields(6)?;
5511            let context = fields[0].fields(9)?;
5512            if !matches!(context[2].text()?, "train" | "dev" | "request-local-replay") {
5513                return Err(invalid("replay task cannot contain sealed evaluation rows"));
5514            }
5515            checked_digest(&fields[1])?;
5516            checked_digest(&fields[2])?;
5517            let length = fields[3].unsigned()?;
5518            if length == 0 || fields[4].unsigned()? == 0 {
5519                return Err(invalid("replay dimensions must be positive"));
5520            }
5521            let mut previous = None;
5522            for value in fields[5].sequence()? {
5523                let target = value.fields(3)?;
5524                let position = target[0].unsigned()?;
5525                if position >= length
5526                    || previous.is_some_and(|last| position <= last)
5527                    || target[1].unsigned()? != position
5528                    || Some(target[2].unsigned()?) != length.checked_add(position)
5529                {
5530                    return Err(invalid(
5531                        "replay target must preserve ordered (p, p, L+p) identity",
5532                    ));
5533                }
5534                previous = Some(position);
5535                targets.insert((row, position));
5536            }
5537        }
5538        if self.dependencies.is_empty() {
5539            return Err(invalid("task dependency closure cannot be empty"));
5540        }
5541        let index = self
5542            .dependencies
5543            .iter()
5544            .enumerate()
5545            .map(|(i, node)| (node.identity.as_str(), i))
5546            .collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>();
5547        if index.len() != self.dependencies.len() {
5548            return Err(invalid("duplicate dependency identity"));
5549        }
5550        let envelopes = self
5551            .live
5552            .iter()
5553            .map(|live| live.canonical.fields(16)?[1].text())
5554            .collect::<PyResult<BTreeSet<_>>>()?;
5555        if envelopes.len() != self.live.len() {
5556            return Err(invalid("duplicate live envelope identity"));
5557        }
5558        let mut masks = BTreeSet::new();
5559        let mut indegree = vec![0usize; self.dependencies.len()];
5560        let mut children = vec![Vec::new(); self.dependencies.len()];
5561        for (child, node) in self.dependencies.iter().enumerate() {
5562            unique(&node.data_parents)?;
5563            unique(&node.control_parents)?;
5564            unique(&node.live_envelopes)?;
5565            if node
5566                .live_envelopes
5567                .iter()
5568                .any(|reference| !envelopes.contains(reference.as_str()))
5569            {
5570                return Err(invalid("dependency names an unbound data-use envelope"));
5571            }
5572            match node.kind.as_str() {
5573                "constant"
5574                    if node.data_parents.is_empty()
5575                        && node.control_parents.is_empty()
5576                        && node.live_envelopes.is_empty()
5577                        && node.target.is_none() => {}
5578                "source"
5579                    if node.data_parents.is_empty()
5580                        && node.control_parents.is_empty()
5581                        && node.target.is_none() => {}
5582                "mask" | "target_value"
5583                    if node.target.is_some() && !node.data_parents.is_empty() =>
5584                {
5585                    let target = node.target.unwrap();
5586                    if !targets.contains(&target) {
5587                        return Err(invalid(
5588                            "dependency target is not in the verified replay projection",
5589                        ));
5590                    }
5591                    if node.kind == "mask" && !masks.insert(target) {
5592                        return Err(invalid("duplicate acquired MASK identity"));
5593                    }
5594                }
5595                "derived"
5596                    if node.target.is_none()
5597                        && (!node.data_parents.is_empty() || !node.control_parents.is_empty()) => {}
5598                _ => {
5599                    return Err(invalid(
5600                        "dependency kind does not match its source and target fields",
5601                    ))
5602                }
5603            }
5604            for parent in node.data_parents.iter().chain(&node.control_parents) {
5605                let parent = *index
5606                    .get(parent.as_str())
5607                    .ok_or_else(|| invalid("dependency closure omits a data or control parent"))?;
5608                indegree[child] += 1;
5609                children[parent].push(child);
5610            }
5611        }
5612        if masks != targets {
5613            return Err(invalid(
5614                "replay target lacks its exact acquired MASK provenance join",
5615            ));
5616        }
5617        let mut ready = indegree
5618            .iter()
5619            .enumerate()
5620            .filter_map(|(i, count)| (*count == 0).then_some(i))
5621            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
5622        let mut visited = 0;
5623        while let Some(parent) = ready.pop() {
5624            visited += 1;
5625            for &child in &children[parent] {
5626                indegree[child] -= 1;
5627                if indegree[child] == 0 {
5628                    ready.push(child);
5629                }
5630            }
5631        }
5632        if visited != self.dependencies.len() {
5633            return Err(invalid("task dependency closure contains a cycle"));
5634        }
5635        unique(&self.feedback_roots)?;
5636        let mut pending =
5637            self.feedback_roots
5638                .iter()
5639                .map(|reference| {
5640                    index.get(reference.as_str()).copied().ok_or_else(|| {
5641                        invalid("feedback root is absent from the dependency closure")
5642                    })
5643                })
5644                .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
5645        // These roots cannot be omitted by selecting a smaller feedback_roots
5646        // tuple. bind_native_reads below requires their exact native read set.
5647        pending.extend(
5648            self.dependencies
5649                .iter()
5650                .enumerate()
5651                .filter_map(|(i, node)| node.native_record.as_ref().map(|_| i)),
5652        );
5653        for source in &self.initial_sources {
5654            let i = *index.get(source.identity.as_str()).ok_or_else(|| {
5655                invalid("initial source is absent from the task dependency closure")
5656            })?;
5657            if !matches!(self.dependencies[i].kind.as_str(), "source" | "derived") {
5658                return Err(invalid(
5659                    "initial observation must resolve to a source data/control lineage",
5660                ));
5661            }
5662            pending.push(i);
5663        }
5664        let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
5665        while let Some(i) = pending.pop() {
5666            if !seen.insert(i) {
5667                continue;
5668            }
5669            let node = &self.dependencies[i];
5670            if node.kind == "target_value" {
5671                return Err(invalid(
5672                    "feedback or initial source depends on a target value through data or control lineage",
5673                ));
5674            }
5675            pending.extend(
5676                node.data_parents
5677                    .iter()
5678                    .chain(&node.control_parents)
5679                    .map(|parent| index[parent.as_str()]),
5680            );
5681        }
5682        for family in [&self.publication, &self.inference, &self.training] {
5683            unique(
5684                &family
5685                    .iter()
5686                    .map(|grant| grant.reference.clone())
5687                    .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
5688            )?;
5689            for grant in family {
5690                if grant.task_ref != self.task_ref
5691                    || grant.issuer_provenance.is_empty()
5692                    || grant
5693                        .dependencies
5694                        .iter()
5695                        .any(|reference| !index.contains_key(reference.as_str()))
5696                {
5697                    return Err(invalid(
5698                        "resolved grant does not match the exact task dependency scope",
5699                    ));
5700                }
5701            }
5702        }
5703        Ok(())
5704    }
5705
5706    fn bind_native_reads(
5707        &self,
5708        observations: &xlog_cuda::SemanticTaskObservationRoots,
5709        supports: &[u32],
5710    ) -> PyResult<()> {
5711        let mut expected = observations
5712            .query_records
5713            .iter()
5714            .map(|&index| ("statement".to_owned(), index))
5715            .chain(supports.iter().map(|&index| ("support".to_owned(), index)))
5716            .chain(std::iter::once(("observer".to_owned(), 0)))
5717            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
5718        for &(query, statement, support) in &observations.contributors {
5719            if query >= observations.query_records.len() as u32 {
5720                return Err(invalid(
5721                    "native observation contributor names an absent task query",
5722                ));
5723            }
5724            let statement = statement.ok_or_else(|| invalid(
5725                "native feedback contributor has a derived target without an original admitted statement"))?;
5726            expected.insert(("statement".to_owned(), statement));
5727            expected.insert(("support".to_owned(), support));
5728        }
5729        let actual = self
5730            .dependencies
5731            .iter()
5732            .filter_map(|node| node.native_record.clone())
5733            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
5734        let distinct = actual.iter().cloned().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
5735        if actual.len() != distinct.len() || distinct != expected {
5736            return Err(invalid("dependency closure must bind each actual native observer, statement and support read root exactly once"));
5737        }
5738        Ok(())
5739    }
5740
5741    fn authority_root(&self) -> Identity256 {
5742        let mut authority = Sha256::new();
5743        authority.update(b"xlog.task-authority.canonical.v1\0");
5744        authority.update((self.canonical.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
5745        authority.update(&self.canonical);
5746        Identity256::from_bytes(authority.finalize().into())
5747    }
5748
5749    fn goal_witness(
5750        &self,
5751        observations: &xlog_cuda::SemanticTaskObservationRoots,
5752    ) -> SemanticTaskGoalWitness {
5753        fn text(hash: &mut Sha256, value: &str) {
5754            hash.update((value.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
5755            hash.update(value.as_bytes());
5756        }
5757        let mut links = Sha256::new();
5758        links.update(b"xlog.task-authority.mandatory-links.v1\0");
5759        for node in &self.dependencies {
5760            text(&mut links, &node.identity);
5761            text(&mut links, &node.kind);
5762            for family in [
5763                &node.data_parents,
5764                &node.control_parents,
5765                &node.live_envelopes,
5766            ] {
5767                links.update((family.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
5768                for value in family {
5769                    text(&mut links, value);
5770                }
5771            }
5772            match node.target {
5773                Some((row, position)) => {
5774                    links.update([1]);
5775                    links.update((row as u64).to_le_bytes());
5776                    links.update(position.to_le_bytes());
5777                }
5778                None => links.update([0]),
5779            }
5780            match &node.native_record {
5781                Some((kind, record)) => {
5782                    links.update([1]);
5783                    text(&mut links, kind);
5784                    links.update(record.to_le_bytes());
5785                }
5786                None => links.update([0]),
5787            }
5788        }
5789
5790        let mut constraints = Sha256::new();
5791        constraints.update(b"xlog.task-authority.constraints.v1\0");
5792        constraints.update((self.canonical.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
5793        constraints.update(&self.canonical);
5794        text(&mut constraints, &self.task_ref);
5795        for value in &self.scope {
5796            text(&mut constraints, value);
5797        }
5798        for value in &self.feedback_roots {
5799            text(&mut constraints, value);
5800        }
5801        for (family_name, family) in [
5802            ("publication", &self.publication),
5803            ("inference", &self.inference),
5804            ("training", &self.training),
5805        ] {
5806            text(&mut constraints, family_name);
5807            constraints.update((family.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
5808            for grant in family {
5809                text(&mut constraints, &grant.reference);
5810                text(&mut constraints, &grant.issuer_provenance);
5811                constraints.update([u8::from(grant.allowed)]);
5812                text(&mut constraints, &grant.task_ref);
5813                constraints.update((grant.dependencies.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
5814                for dependency in &grant.dependencies {
5815                    text(&mut constraints, dependency);
5816                }
5817                text(&mut constraints, &grant.expiry.spelling);
5818                constraints.update(grant.expiry.micros.to_le_bytes());
5819                text(&mut constraints, &grant.revocation_ref);
5820                match &grant.learning_purpose {
5821                    Some(purpose) => {
5822                        constraints.update([1]);
5823                        text(&mut constraints, purpose);
5824                    }
5825                    None => constraints.update([0]),
5826                }
5827            }
5828        }
5829        SemanticTaskGoalWitness {
5830            semantic_root: observations.root_digest,
5831            authority_root: self.authority_root(),
5832            mandatory_links_root: Identity256::from_bytes(links.finalize().into()),
5833            constraints_root: Identity256::from_bytes(constraints.finalize().into()),
5834            mandatory_link_count: self.dependencies.len() as u64,
5835            constraint_count: (self.scope.len()
5836                + self.feedback_roots.len()
5837                + self.publication.len()
5838                + self.inference.len()
5839                + self.training.len()) as u64,
5840        }
5841    }
5842
5843    fn check_snapshot(&self, snapshot: &AuthoritySnapshot) -> PyResult<i64> {
5844        self.require_source_origins()?;
5845        if snapshot.live.len() != self.live.len() {
5846            return Err(invalid(
5847                "authority snapshot does not cover every live envelope",
5848            ));
5849        }
5850        for (live, (canonical, segment_end, revoked)) in self.live.iter().zip(&snapshot.live) {
5851            validate_live(canonical, &self.scope)?;
5852            if canonical != &live.canonical {
5853                return Err(invalid(
5854                    "snapshot envelope differs from the imported live provenance",
5855                ));
5856            }
5857            if live.retention_micros <= segment_end.micros
5858                || live.retention_micros <= snapshot.observed_at.micros
5859            {
5860                return Err(invalid(
5861                    "live data authority expires before the required boundary",
5862                ));
5863            }
5864            let revocation_ref = canonical.fields(16)?[15].text()?;
5865            if revoked.iter().any(|reference| reference == revocation_ref) {
5866                return Err(invalid("live data authority has been revoked"));
5867            }
5868            if segment_end != &snapshot.segment_end {
5869                return Err(invalid(
5870                    "live snapshot differs from the task's preregistered segment end",
5871                ));
5872            }
5873        }
5874        Ok(snapshot.segment_end.micros)
5875    }
5876
5877    fn check_grants(
5878        &self,
5879        grants: &[ResolvedGrant],
5880        snapshot: &AuthoritySnapshot,
5881        horizon: i64,
5882    ) -> PyResult<()> {
5883        let mut covered = BTreeSet::new();
5884        for grant in grants {
5885            if !grant.allowed
5886                || grant.expiry.micros <= horizon
5887                || snapshot.revoked_grants.contains(&grant.revocation_ref)
5888            {
5889                return Err(invalid(
5890                    "required independent grant is denied, expired, or revoked",
5891                ));
5892            }
5893            covered.extend(grant.dependencies.iter().map(String::as_str));
5894            if let Some(purpose) = &grant.learning_purpose {
5895                for (split, scope) in &self.source_partitions {
5896                    if (purpose == "current-request-fast-adaptation"
5897                        && (split.as_deref() != Some("request-local-replay")
5898                            || scope != "request-local"))
5899                        || (purpose == "durable-slow-consolidation"
5900                            && (!matches!(split.as_deref(), Some("train" | "dev"))
5901                                || scope == "request-local"))
5902                    {
5903                        return Err(invalid("training grant is incompatible with an observed source's immutable split or replay scope"));
5904                    }
5905                }
5906                for live in &self.live {
5907                    let fields = live.canonical.fields(16)?;
5908                    if !fields[8].strings()?.contains(purpose)
5909                        || (purpose == "durable-slow-consolidation"
5910                            && (!fields[13].boolean()? || !fields[14].boolean()?))
5911                    {
5912                        return Err(invalid(
5913                            "training grant exceeds the live data-use learning purpose",
5914                        ));
5915                    }
5916                }
5917                for row in &self.replay {
5918                    let split = row.identity.fields(6)?[0].fields(9)?[2].text()?;
5919                    if (purpose == "current-request-fast-adaptation"
5920                        && split != "request-local-replay")
5921                        || (purpose == "durable-slow-consolidation"
5922                            && !matches!(split, "train" | "dev"))
5923                    {
5924                        return Err(invalid(
5925                            "training grant is incompatible with the immutable replay split",
5926                        ));
5927                    }
5928                }
5929            }
5930        }
5931        if self
5932            .dependencies
5933            .iter()
5934            .any(|node| !covered.contains(node.identity.as_str()))
5935        {
5936            return Err(invalid(
5937                "required independent grant does not cover the full dependency closure",
5938            ));
5939        }
5940        Ok(())
5941    }
5942
5943    fn check_use(
5944        &self,
5945        operation: &str,
5946        snapshot: &AuthoritySnapshot,
5947        before_segment: bool,
5948    ) -> PyResult<()> {
5949        let end = self.check_snapshot(snapshot)?;
5950        if before_segment && snapshot.observed_at.micros >= end {
5951            return Err(invalid("preregistered segment end is not in the future"));
5952        }
5953        let horizon = if before_segment {
5954            end
5955        } else {
5956            snapshot.observed_at.micros
5957        };
5958        self.check_grants(&self.publication, snapshot, horizon)?;
5959        match operation {
5960            "inference" => self.check_grants(&self.inference, snapshot, horizon),
5961            // Fresh observations need both admitted material and its validated
5962            // position mapping. Neither alternative issues learning rights.
5963            "training" if !self.replay.is_empty()
5964                || (!self.initial_sources.is_empty() && !self.source_mapping.is_empty()) => {
5965                if !self.sources_allow_learning {
5966                    return Err(invalid("observed source admission excludes learning or replay"));
5967                }
5968                self.check_grants(&self.training, snapshot, horizon)
5969            }
5970            _ => Err(invalid(
5971                "operation must be inference or training with verified replay rows or admitted initial sources and mapping",
5972            )),
5973        }
5974    }
5975}
5976
5977/// Privileged, constructing-thread controller for one real native Session.
5978///
5979/// The application, not generated code, must construct all primitive arguments
5980/// from already resolved authority and verified replay values. This boundary is
5981/// not a sandbox or cryptographic issuer verifier. Trusted application-supplied
5982/// replay callbacks restore and retire the original invocation; they cannot
5983/// issue rights. Cold metadata accepts closed primitive values, not custom
5984/// conversion handlers. The Session exposes no rights-issuing API.
5985#[pyclass(
5986    name = "SemanticTransitionController",
5987    module = "pyxlog._native",
5988    frozen
5989)]
5990pub(crate) struct PySemanticTransitionController {
5991    session: Py<PySemanticTransitionSession>,
5992    identity: Arc<()>,
5993}
5994
5995#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
5996enum TaskUsePhase {
5997    Importing {
5998        operation: String,
5999        reads: bool,
6000    },
6001    Imported,
6002    InitialPrefill {
6003        scope: Arc<()>,
6004    },
6005    InitialPrefillReady {
6006        scope: Arc<()>,
6007    },
6008    InitialPrefillBound,
6009    Recording {
6010        scope: Arc<()>,
6011        operation: Option<String>,
6012    },
6013    Prepared {
6014        scope: Arc<()>,
6015        operation: Option<String>,
6016    },
6017    Segment(String),
6018    ArenaPreparing(Box<TaskUsePhase>),
6019    Refused,
6020}
6021
6022struct TaskUseState {
6023    phase: TaskUsePhase,
6024    snapshot: AuthoritySnapshot,
6025}
6026
6027#[derive(Clone)]
6028struct TaskCheckpointSeed {
6029    authority: Vec<ColdValue>,
6030    evaluation: Vec<ColdValue>,
6031    training_objective: ColdValue,
6032    training_domain: ColdValue,
6033    initial_sources: ColdValue,
6034    source_mapping: ColdValue,
6035    replay_selection: ColdValue,
6036}
6037
6038/// An arena admission may append sources and replay history, never reinterpret
6039/// the selected task, its data scope, or a previously admitted record.
6040fn require_retained_arena_authority(
6041    selected: &[ColdValue],
6042    candidate: &[ColdValue],
6043) -> PyResult<()> {
6044    if selected.len() != 10 || candidate.len() != 10 {
6045        return Err(invalid("arena admission requires complete task authority"));
6046    }
6047    for index in [0, 1, 2, 5, 9] {
6048        if selected[index] != candidate[index] {
6049            return Err(invalid(
6050                "arena admission changed the selected task or original data scope",
6051            ));
6052        }
6053    }
6054    for index in [3, 4] {
6055        let original = selected[index].sequence()?;
6056        let extended = candidate[index].sequence()?;
6057        if !extended.starts_with(original) {
6058            return Err(invalid(
6059                "arena admission changed an original source, replay row or dependency",
6060            ));
6061        }
6062    }
6063    Ok(())
6064}
6065
6066#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
6067enum CheckpointTaskPhase {
6068    Imported,
6069    InitialPrefillBound,
6070    Segment(String),
6071}
6072
6073fn checkpoint_task_phase(state: &TaskUseState) -> PyResult<CheckpointTaskPhase> {
6074    let phase = match &state.phase {
6075        TaskUsePhase::ArenaPreparing(original) => original.as_ref(),
6076        phase => phase,
6077    };
6078    match phase {
6079        TaskUsePhase::Imported => Ok(CheckpointTaskPhase::Imported),
6080        TaskUsePhase::InitialPrefillBound => Ok(CheckpointTaskPhase::InitialPrefillBound),
6081        TaskUsePhase::Segment(operation) => Ok(CheckpointTaskPhase::Segment(operation.clone())),
6082        _ => Err(invalid(
6083            "checkpoint requires an imported or admitted stable task phase",
6084        )),
6085    }
6086}

6088impl TaskCheckpointSeed {
6089    fn encode(
6090        &self,
6091        snapshot: &AuthoritySnapshot,
6092        phase: &CheckpointTaskPhase,
6093        binding: &TaskCheckpointBinding,
6094    ) -> PyResult<Vec<u8>> {
6095        let snapshot = ColdValue::from_canonical_bytes(&snapshot.canonical)?;
6096        let (phase, operation) = match phase {
6097            CheckpointTaskPhase::Imported => ("imported", ColdValue::None),
6098            CheckpointTaskPhase::InitialPrefillBound => ("initial-prefill-bound", ColdValue::None),
6099            CheckpointTaskPhase::Segment(operation) => {
6100                ("segment", ColdValue::Text(operation.clone()))
6101            }
6102        };
6103        Ok(checkpoint_cold_value_bytes(&ColdValue::Sequence(vec![
6104            ColdValue::Sequence(self.authority.clone()),
6105            ColdValue::Sequence(self.evaluation.clone()),
6106            self.training_objective.clone(),
6107            self.initial_sources.clone(),
6108            self.source_mapping.clone(),
6109            self.replay_selection.clone(),
6110            snapshot,
6111            ColdValue::Text(phase.to_owned()),
6112            operation,
6113            ColdValue::Bytes(Arc::from(binding.encode())),
6114            self.training_domain.clone(),
6115        ])))
6116    }
6117
6118    fn decode(
6119        bytes: &[u8],
6120    ) -> PyResult<(
6121        Self,
6122        AuthoritySnapshot,
6123        CheckpointTaskPhase,
6124        TaskCheckpointBinding,
6125    )> {
6126        let value = checkpoint_cold_value(bytes)?;
6127        let fields = value.fields(11)?;
6128        let phase = match fields[7].text()? {
6129            "imported" if fields[8] == ColdValue::None => CheckpointTaskPhase::Imported,
6130            "initial-prefill-bound" if fields[8] == ColdValue::None => {
6131                CheckpointTaskPhase::InitialPrefillBound
6132            }
6133            "segment" => CheckpointTaskPhase::Segment(fields[8].text()?.to_owned()),
6134            _ => return Err(invalid("checkpoint task phase is invalid")),
6135        };
6136        let ColdValue::Bytes(binding) = &fields[9] else {
6137            return Err(invalid("checkpoint native task binding is absent"));
6138        };
6139        Ok((
6140            Self {
6141                authority: fields[0].sequence()?.to_vec(),
6142                evaluation: fields[1].sequence()?.to_vec(),
6143                training_objective: fields[2].clone(),
6144                training_domain: fields[10].clone(),
6145                initial_sources: fields[3].clone(),
6146                source_mapping: fields[4].clone(),
6147                replay_selection: fields[5].clone(),
6148            },
6149            AuthoritySnapshot::parse(&fields[6])?,
6150            phase,
6151            TaskCheckpointBinding::decode(binding)?,
6152        ))
6153    }
6154}
6155
6156fn checkpoint_cold_value_bytes(value: &ColdValue) -> Vec<u8> {
6157    fn append(value: &ColdValue, bytes: &mut Vec<u8>) {
6158        match value {
6159            ColdValue::None => bytes.push(0),
6160            ColdValue::Bool(value) => bytes.extend_from_slice(&[1, u8::from(*value)]),
6161            ColdValue::Integer(value) => {
6162                bytes.push(2);
6163                bytes.extend_from_slice(&(value.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
6164                bytes.extend_from_slice(value.as_bytes());
6165            }
6166            ColdValue::Text(value) => {
6167                bytes.push(3);
6168                bytes.extend_from_slice(&(value.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
6169                bytes.extend_from_slice(value.as_bytes());
6170            }
6171            ColdValue::Sequence(values) => {
6172                bytes.push(4);
6173                bytes.extend_from_slice(&(values.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
6174                for value in values {
6175                    append(value, bytes);
6176                }
6177            }
6178            ColdValue::Bytes(value) => {
6179                bytes.push(5);
6180                bytes.extend_from_slice(&(value.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
6181                bytes.extend_from_slice(value);
6182            }
6183        }
6184    }
6185    let mut bytes = b"XLOG-CHECKPOINT-TASK\0".to_vec();
6186    bytes.extend_from_slice(&3u32.to_le_bytes());
6187    append(value, &mut bytes);
6188    bytes
6189}
6190
6191fn checkpoint_cold_value(bytes: &[u8]) -> PyResult<ColdValue> {
6192    fn take<'a>(remaining: &mut &'a [u8], count: usize) -> PyResult<&'a [u8]> {
6193        if count > remaining.len() {
6194            return Err(invalid("checkpoint task capsule is truncated"));
6195        }
6196        let (value, rest) = remaining.split_at(count);
6197        *remaining = rest;
6198        Ok(value)
6199    }
6200
6201    fn length(remaining: &mut &[u8]) -> PyResult<usize> {
6202        let encoded: [u8; 8] = take(remaining, 8)?.try_into().unwrap();
6203        usize::try_from(u64::from_le_bytes(encoded))
6204            .map_err(|_| invalid("checkpoint task capsule length exceeds this host"))
6205    }
6206
6207    fn decode(remaining: &mut &[u8], budget: &mut usize, depth: usize) -> PyResult<ColdValue> {
6208        if depth > 32 || *budget == 0 {
6209            return Err(invalid(
6210                "checkpoint task capsule exceeds its structural bound",
6211            ));
6212        }
6213        *budget -= 1;
6214        let tag = *take(remaining, 1)?.first().unwrap();
6215        match tag {
6216            0 => Ok(ColdValue::None),
6217            1 => match *take(remaining, 1)?.first().unwrap() {
6218                0 => Ok(ColdValue::Bool(false)),
6219                1 => Ok(ColdValue::Bool(true)),
6220                _ => Err(invalid(
6221                    "checkpoint task capsule contains an invalid boolean",
6222                )),
6223            },
6224            2 | 3 => {
6225                let length = length(remaining)?;
6226                if length > *budget {
6227                    return Err(invalid("checkpoint task capsule exceeds its byte bound"));
6228                }
6229                *budget -= length;
6230                let value = std::str::from_utf8(take(remaining, length)?)
6231                    .map_err(|_| invalid("checkpoint task capsule contains invalid UTF-8"))?
6232                    .to_owned();
6233                if tag == 2 {
6234                    Ok(ColdValue::Integer(value))
6235                } else {
6236                    Ok(ColdValue::Text(value))
6237                }
6238            }
6239            4 => {
6240                let count = length(remaining)?;
6241                if count > *budget {
6242                    return Err(invalid(
6243                        "checkpoint task capsule sequence exceeds its bound",
6244                    ));
6245                }
6246                (0..count)
6247                    .map(|_| decode(remaining, budget, depth + 1))
6248                    .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()
6249                    .map(ColdValue::Sequence)
6250            }
6251            5 => {
6252                let length = length(remaining)?;
6253                if length > *budget {
6254                    return Err(invalid("checkpoint task payload exceeds its byte bound"));
6255                }
6256                *budget -= length;
6257                Ok(ColdValue::Bytes(Arc::from(take(remaining, length)?)))
6258            }
6259            _ => Err(invalid("checkpoint task capsule contains an unknown tag")),
6260        }
6261    }
6262
6263    let mut remaining = bytes;
6264    if take(&mut remaining, 21)? != b"XLOG-CHECKPOINT-TASK\0"
6265        || u32::from_le_bytes(take(&mut remaining, 4)?.try_into().unwrap()) != 3
6266    {
6267        return Err(invalid(
6268            "checkpoint task capsule has another domain or version",
6269        ));
6270    }
6271    let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
6272    let value = decode(&mut remaining, &mut budget, 0)?;
6273    if !remaining.is_empty() {
6274        return Err(invalid("checkpoint task capsule has trailing bytes"));
6275    }
6276    Ok(value)
6277}
6278
6279/// Process-local resource authority, independent of restored native epochs.
6280/// Every import reserves one new generation before parsing or rebinding state.
6281#[derive(Clone)]
6282struct TaskIssuance {
6283    counter: Arc<AtomicU64>,
6284    generation: u64,
6285}
6286
6287impl TaskIssuance {
6288    fn issue(counter: Arc<AtomicU64>) -> PyResult<Self> {
6289        let previous = counter
6290            .try_update(Ordering::AcqRel, Ordering::Acquire, |generation| {
6291                generation.checked_add(1)
6292            })
6293            .map_err(|_| invalid("native task issuance generation is exhausted"))?;
6294        Ok(Self {
6295            counter,
6296            generation: previous + 1,
6297        })
6298    }
6299
6300    fn require_current(&self) -> PyResult<()> {
6301        if self.counter.load(Ordering::Acquire) != self.generation {
6302            return Err(invalid("task use was invalidated by a later import"));
6303        }
6304        Ok(())
6305    }
6306
6307    fn same_as(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
6308        Arc::ptr_eq(&self.counter, &other.counter) && self.generation == other.generation
6309    }
6310}
6311
6312impl TaskUseState {
6313    fn begin_arena_preparation(&mut self) -> PyResult<()> {
6314        checkpoint_task_phase(self)?;
6315        self.phase = TaskUsePhase::ArenaPreparing(Box::new(self.phase.clone()));
6316        Ok(())
6317    }
6318
6319    fn finish_arena_preparation(&mut self) -> PyResult<()> {
6320        let phase = std::mem::replace(&mut self.phase, TaskUsePhase::Refused);
6321        match phase {
6322            TaskUsePhase::ArenaPreparing(original) => {
6323                self.phase = *original;
6324                Ok(())
6325            }
6326            other => {
6327                self.phase = other;
6328                Err(invalid("task use has no cold arena preparation"))
6329            }
6330        }
6331    }
6332
6333    fn begin_initial_prefill(&mut self) -> PyResult<Arc<()>> {
6334        if !matches!(self.phase, TaskUsePhase::Imported) {
6335            return Err(invalid(
6336                "initial prefill requires one imported task before parent binding",
6337            ));
6338        }
6339        let scope = Arc::new(());
6340        self.phase = TaskUsePhase::InitialPrefill {
6341            scope: Arc::clone(&scope),
6342        };
6343        Ok(scope)
6344    }
6345
6346    fn require_initial_prefill(&self, scope: &Arc<()>) -> PyResult<()> {
6347        if !matches!(&self.phase, TaskUsePhase::InitialPrefill { scope: current } if Arc::ptr_eq(current, scope))
6348        {
6349            return Err(invalid("initial prefill belongs to another task scope"));
6350        }
6351        Ok(())
6352    }
6353
6354    fn finish_initial_prefill(&mut self, scope: &Arc<()>) -> PyResult<()> {
6355        self.require_initial_prefill(scope)?;
6356        self.phase = TaskUsePhase::InitialPrefillReady {
6357            scope: Arc::clone(scope),
6358        };
6359        Ok(())
6360    }
6361
6362    fn require_initial_prefill_ready(&self, scope: &Arc<()>) -> PyResult<()> {
6363        if !matches!(&self.phase, TaskUsePhase::InitialPrefillReady { scope: current } if Arc::ptr_eq(current, scope))
6364        {
6365            return Err(invalid(
6366                "initial prefill receipt belongs to another task scope",
6367            ));
6368        }
6369        Ok(())
6370    }
6371
6372    fn commit_initial_prefill(&mut self, scope: &Arc<()>) -> PyResult<()> {
6373        self.require_initial_prefill_ready(scope)?;
6374        self.phase = TaskUsePhase::InitialPrefillBound;
6375        Ok(())
6376    }
6377
6378    fn begin_build(&mut self) -> PyResult<Arc<()>> {
6379        let operation = match &self.phase {
6380            TaskUsePhase::Imported | TaskUsePhase::InitialPrefillBound => None,
6381            TaskUsePhase::Segment(operation) => Some(operation.clone()),
6382            _ => {
6383                return Err(invalid(
6384                    "segment recording cannot be nested or resume a refused use",
6385                ))
6386            }
6387        };
6388        let scope = Arc::new(());
6389        self.phase = TaskUsePhase::Recording {
6390            scope: Arc::clone(&scope),
6391            operation,
6392        };
6393        Ok(scope)
6394    }
6395
6396    fn prepared_content_binding(&self, scope: &Arc<()>) -> PyResult<(Option<String>, Vec<u8>)> {
6397        let operation = match &self.phase {
6398            TaskUsePhase::Recording { scope: current, .. }
6399            | TaskUsePhase::Prepared { scope: current, .. }
6400                if Arc::ptr_eq(current, scope) =>
6401            {
6402                None
6403            }
6404            // Native retained-step custody is additionally required by every
6405            // caller; a completed step's witnesses outlive its recording scope.
6406            TaskUsePhase::Segment(operation) => Some(operation.clone()),
6407            _ => {
6408                return Err(invalid(
6409                    "prepared content belongs to no active or completed recording",
6410                ))
6411            }
6412        };
6413        Ok((operation, self.snapshot.canonical.clone()))
6414    }
6415
6416    fn finish_build(&mut self, scope: &Arc<()>) -> PyResult<()> {
6417        let TaskUsePhase::Recording {
6418            scope: current,
6419            operation,
6420        } = &self.phase
6421        else {
6422            return Err(invalid("only the original recording may finish"));
6423        };
6424        if !Arc::ptr_eq(current, scope) {
6425            return Err(invalid("segment recording scope changed"));
6426        }
6427        self.phase = TaskUsePhase::Prepared {
6428            scope: Arc::clone(scope),
6429            operation: operation.clone(),
6430        };
6431        Ok(())
6432    }
6433
6434    fn admit_built_segment(
6435        &mut self,
6436        scope: &Arc<()>,
6437        authority: &TaskAuthority,
6438        operation: String,
6439        snapshot: AuthoritySnapshot,
6440    ) -> PyResult<()> {
6441        let TaskUsePhase::Prepared {
6442            scope: current,
6443            operation: original,
6444        } = &self.phase
6445        else {
6446            return Err(invalid(
6447                "built segment may be submitted exactly once after recording",
6448            ));
6449        };
6450        if !Arc::ptr_eq(current, scope)
6451            || original.as_ref().is_some_and(|value| value != &operation)
6452        {
6453            return Err(invalid(
6454                "built segment changed its scope or original operation",
6455            ));
6456        }
6457        // Reuse the ordinary authoritative snapshot check. No callback or native
6458        // operation may intervene before the caller's one actual submission.
6459        self.phase = original.as_ref().map_or(TaskUsePhase::Imported, |value| {
6460            TaskUsePhase::Segment(value.clone())
6461        });
6462        self.admit_segment(authority, operation, snapshot)
6463    }
6464
6465    fn finish_import(
6466        &mut self,
6467        authority: &TaskAuthority,
6468        snapshot: AuthoritySnapshot,
6469    ) -> PyResult<()> {
6470        let result = match &self.phase {
6471            TaskUsePhase::Importing {
6472                operation,
6473                reads: false,
6474            } => snapshot
6475                .newer_than(&self.snapshot)
6476                .and_then(|()| authority.check_use(operation, &snapshot, false)),
6477            _ => Err(invalid("only the closed original import may finish")),
6478        };
6479        match result {
6480            Ok(()) => {
6481                self.snapshot = snapshot;
6482                self.phase = TaskUsePhase::Imported;
6483                Ok(())
6484            }
6485            Err(error) => {
6486                self.phase = TaskUsePhase::Refused;
6487                Err(error)
6488            }
6489        }
6490    }
6491
6492    fn require_read(&self) -> PyResult<()> {
6493        match &self.phase {
6494            TaskUsePhase::Imported
6495            | TaskUsePhase::InitialPrefillReady { .. }
6496            | TaskUsePhase::InitialPrefillBound
6497            | TaskUsePhase::Segment(_)
6498            | TaskUsePhase::ArenaPreparing(_)
6499            | TaskUsePhase::Importing { reads: true, .. } => Ok(()),
6500            _ => Err(invalid(
6501                "task use is not available outside its controlled import",
6502            )),
6503        }
6504    }
6505
6506    fn require_read_during_import(&self, importing: bool) -> PyResult<()> {
6507        if importing != matches!(&self.phase, TaskUsePhase::Importing { .. }) {
6508            return Err(invalid(
6509                "task reader does not belong to the active import state",
6510            ));
6511        }
6512        self.require_read()
6513    }
6514
6515    fn require_public_use(&self) -> PyResult<()> {
6516        match &self.phase {
6517            TaskUsePhase::Imported
6518            | TaskUsePhase::InitialPrefillBound
6519            | TaskUsePhase::Segment(_) => Ok(()),
6520            _ => Err(invalid(
6521                "unfinished or refused import grants no public operation",
6522            )),
6523        }
6524    }
6525
6526    fn set_import_reads(&mut self, enabled: bool) -> PyResult<()> {
6527        let TaskUsePhase::Importing { reads, .. } = &mut self.phase else {
6528            return Err(invalid("task use is not in the original unfinished import"));
6529        };
6530        if *reads == enabled {
6531            return Err(invalid("import read scope cannot be nested or reused"));
6532        }
6533        *reads = enabled;
6534        Ok(())
6535    }
6536
6537    fn content_handoff_binding(&self) -> PyResult<(String, Vec<u8>)> {
6538        let operation = match &self.phase {
6539            TaskUsePhase::Segment(operation)
6540            | TaskUsePhase::Importing {
6541                operation,
6542                reads: true,
6543            } => operation,
6544            TaskUsePhase::ArenaPreparing(original) => match original.as_ref() {
6545                TaskUsePhase::Segment(operation) => operation,
6546                _ => {
6547                    return Err(invalid(
6548                        "tensor content requires an admitted segment or controlled import",
6549                    ))
6550                }
6551            },
6552            _ => {
6553                return Err(invalid(
6554                    "tensor content requires an admitted segment or controlled import",
6555                ))
6556            }
6557        };
6558        Ok((operation.clone(), self.snapshot.canonical.clone()))
6559    }
6560
6561    fn admit_segment(
6562        &mut self,
6563        authority: &TaskAuthority,
6564        operation: String,
6565        snapshot: AuthoritySnapshot,
6566    ) -> PyResult<()> {
6567        if !matches!(&self.phase, TaskUsePhase::Imported)
6568            && !matches!(&self.phase, TaskUsePhase::Segment(previous) if previous == &operation)
6569        {
6570            return Err(invalid(
6571                "task use cannot change its original operation or resume a refused use",
6572            ));
6573        }
6574        let result = snapshot
6575            .newer_than(&self.snapshot)
6576            .and_then(|()| authority.check_use(&operation, &snapshot, true));
6577        match result {
6578            Ok(()) => {
6579                self.phase = TaskUsePhase::Segment(operation);
6580                self.snapshot = snapshot;
6581                Ok(())
6582            }
6583            Err(error) => {
6584                self.phase = TaskUsePhase::Refused;
6585                Err(error)
6586            }
6587        }
6588    }
6589
6590    fn revalidate_activation(
6591        &mut self,
6592        authority: &TaskAuthority,
6593        snapshot: AuthoritySnapshot,
6594    ) -> PyResult<()> {
6595        let TaskUsePhase::Segment(operation) = &self.phase else {
6596            return Err(invalid("task use has no admitted segment"));
6597        };
6598        let result = snapshot
6599            .newer_than(&self.snapshot)
6600            .and_then(|()| authority.check_use(operation, &snapshot, false));
6601        match result {
6602            Ok(()) => {
6603                self.snapshot = snapshot;
6604                Ok(())
6605            }
6606            Err(error) => {
6607                self.phase = TaskUsePhase::Refused;
6608                Err(error)
6609            }
6610        }
6611    }
6612}

6614use xlog_cuda::SemanticFeedbackSchema as FeedbackSchema;
6615
6616fn feedback_schema_object(py: Python<'_>, schema: &FeedbackSchema) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
6617    let mut adapter = Sha256::new();
6618    adapter.update(b"xlog.python.typed-feedback-adapter.v1\0");
6619    adapter.update(SemanticTransitionSession::feedback_adapter_identity().as_bytes());
6620    adapter.update(include_bytes!("semantic_transition.rs"));
6621    let adapter: [u8; 32] = adapter.finalize().into();
6622    let fields = PyTuple::new(
6623        py,
6624        (0..schema.statement_bytes)
6625            .map(|offset| ("statement", offset, 8u8, false))
6626            .chain([("record", 32, 1, true), ("record", 40, 1, true)])
6627            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
6628    )?;
6629    Ok((
6630        1u64,
6631        PyBytes::new(py, &schema.identity),
6632        PyBytes::new(py, &adapter),
6633        schema.statement_bytes,
6634        schema.feature_width,
6635        2u64,
6636        fields,
6637    )
6638        .into_pyobject(py)?
6639        .unbind())
6640}

6642/// A controller-issued, task-bound use. It cannot issue or refresh grants.
6643/// It retains its real Session, nonreused issuance and exact native task epoch.
6644/// Transferable ownership does not permit off-thread orchestration or reads.
6645#[pyclass(name = "SemanticTransitionTaskUse", module = "pyxlog._native", frozen)]
6646pub(crate) struct PySemanticTransitionTaskUse {
6647    session: Py<PySemanticTransitionSession>,
6648    controller: Arc<()>,
6649    issuance: TaskIssuance,
6650    importing: Arc<AtomicBool>,
6651    task_identity: [u8; 32],
6652    task_epoch: u64,
6653    authority: TaskAuthority,
6654    checkpoint: TaskCheckpointSeed,
6655    state: Mutex<TaskUseState>,
6656    delivery: Mutex<Option<DeliveryReceiverBinding>>,
6657}
6658
6659#[derive(Clone)]
6660struct DeliveryReceiverBinding {
6661    recipient_id: Identity256,
6662    verification_key: [u8; 32],
6663    expected_effect: Vec<u8>,
6664}
6665
6666impl PySemanticTransitionTaskUse {
6667    fn require_learning_operation(
6668        &self,
6669        owner: &SemanticTransitionSession,
6670        operation: &str,
6671    ) -> PyResult<()> {
6672        if operation != "training" {
6673            return Ok(());
6674        }
6675        if let Some(record) = owner.learning_phase_history().last() {
6676            let purpose = match record.target {
6677                xlog_cuda::SemanticLearningPhase::Fast => "current-request-fast-adaptation",
6678                xlog_cuda::SemanticLearningPhase::Alignment
6679                | xlog_cuda::SemanticLearningPhase::Consolidation => "durable-slow-consolidation",
6680            };
6681            if self.authority.training.is_empty()
6682                || self
6683                    .authority
6684                    .training
6685                    .iter()
6686                    .any(|grant| grant.learning_purpose.as_deref() != Some(purpose))
6687            {
6688                return Err(invalid(
6689                    "training grant purpose differs from the actual native learning phase",
6690                ));
6691            }
6692        }
6693        Ok(())
6694    }
6695
6696    fn delivery_binding(&self) -> PyResult<DeliveryReceiverBinding> {
6697        self.delivery
6698            .lock()
6699            .map_err(|_| PyRuntimeError::new_err("delivery receiver binding mutex is poisoned"))?
6700            .clone()
6701            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("task use has no trusted delivery receiver binding"))
6702    }
6703    fn state(&self) -> PyResult<MutexGuard<'_, TaskUseState>> {
6704        self.state
6705            .lock()
6706            .map_err(|_| PyRuntimeError::new_err("task-use state mutex is poisoned"))
6707    }
6708
6709    fn require_current(&self, owner: &SemanticTransitionSession) -> PyResult<()> {
6710        self.require_identity(owner)?;
6711        self.state()?
6712            .require_read_during_import(self.importing.load(Ordering::Acquire))
6713    }
6714
6715    fn require_identity(&self, owner: &SemanticTransitionSession) -> PyResult<()> {
6716        self.issuance.require_current()?;
6717        if owner.is_poisoned() {
6718            return Err(invalid("native semantic session is poisoned"));
6719        }
6720        if owner.task_evaluation_epoch() != self.task_epoch
6721            || owner
6722                .task_evaluation_identity()
6723                .is_none_or(|identity| identity.as_bytes() != &self.task_identity)
6724        {
6725            return Err(invalid("task use is stale after native task rebinding"));
6726        }
6727        Ok(())
6728    }
6729
6730    fn checked_initial_source_layout(
6731        &self,
6732        py: Python<'_>,
6733        prefix_capacity: u64,
6734        feedback_capacity: u64,
6735        max_position: u64,
6736        pad_token: u64,
6737        provenance_capacity_records: u64,
6738    ) -> PyResult<SemanticInitialSourceLayout> {
6739        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
6740        session.require_creator()?;
6741        let owner = session.owner()?;
6742        self.require_current(&owner)?;
6743        drop(owner);
6744        if !matches!(self.state()?.phase, TaskUsePhase::Imported) {
6745            return Err(invalid(
6746                "initial source layout requires an imported task before parent binding",
6747            ));
6748        }
6749        xlog_cuda::initial_source_layout(
6750            &self.authority.initial_sources,
6751            &self.authority.source_mapping,
6752            &self.authority.canonical,
6753            self.task_epoch,
6754            provenance_capacity_records,
6755            prefix_capacity,
6756            feedback_capacity,
6757            max_position,
6758            pad_token,
6759        )
6760        .map_err(xlog_err)
6761    }
6762}

6800    frozen

6802pub(crate) struct PySemanticInitialPrefillContentWitness {
6803    inner: SemanticInitialPrefillContentWitness,
6804    _inputs: Py<PyAny>,
6805    _producers: Vec<Py<PyAny>>,
6806    stage: Py<PySemanticInitialPrefillStage>,
6807}

6809#[pymethods]
6810impl PySemanticInitialPrefillContentWitness {
6811    /// Enqueue a check against the same pre-forward or original transient seal.
6812    /// No new baseline is created, including after the parent consumes the stage.
6813    #[pyo3(signature = (*, tensors, consumer_stream))]
6814    fn verify(
6815        &self,
6816        py: Python<'_>,
6817        tensors: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
6818        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
6819    ) -> PyResult<()> {
6820        let stage = self.stage.borrow(py);
6821        let session = stage.session.borrow(py);
6822        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
6823        let stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(consumer_stream, &mut budget)?;
6824        let check = || -> PyResult<()> {
6825            let owner = session.witness_owner()?;
6826            stage.task_use.borrow(py).require_identity(&owner)
6827        };
6828        check()?;
6829        let parsed = parse_tensor_inputs_guarded(
6830            tensors,
6831            &mut budget,
6832            session.device_ordinal,
6833            stream,
6834            &check,
6835        )?;
6836        let mut owner = session.witness_owner()?;
6837        stage.task_use.borrow(py).require_identity(&owner)?;
6838        owner
6839            .verify_initial_prefill_tensor_content(
6840                &stage.lease,
6841                &self.inner,
6842                parsed.handoff.into_native(),
6843                stream,
6844            )
6845            .map_err(xlog_err)
6846    }
6847}

6849impl PySemanticInitialPrefillStage {
6850    fn require_active(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<()> {
6851        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
6852        session.require_creator()?;
6853        let issued = self.task_use.borrow(py);
6854        let owner = session.owner()?;
6855        issued.require_identity(&owner)?;
6856        drop(owner);
6857        let result = issued.state()?.require_initial_prefill(&self.scope);
6858        result
6859    }
6860}
