6862#[pymethods]
6863impl PySemanticInitialPrefillStage {
6864    /// The original `(source, prefix, prefill_tokens, ring_head)` issued by
6865    /// this same TaskUse. It contains no caller-supplied cache or authority.
6866    fn source_layout(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
6867        self.require_active(py)?;
6868        Ok(self.layout.clone_ref(py))
6869    }
6870
6871    /// Seal the original complete model tensor and backing allocation rosters
6872    /// before the model's prefill forward. Both use bind_parent's typed rows.
6873    #[pyo3(signature = (*, tensors, model_allocations, consumer_stream))]
6874    fn bind_model_content(
6875        slf: Py<Self>,
6876        py: Python<'_>,
6877        tensors: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
6878        model_allocations: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
6879        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
6880    ) -> PyResult<Py<PySemanticInitialPrefillContentWitness>> {
6881        let stage = slf.borrow(py);
6882        let this = &*stage;
6883        this.require_active(py)?;
6884        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
6885        let stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(consumer_stream, &mut budget)?;
6886        let check = || this.require_active(py);
6887        let device = this.session.borrow(py).device_ordinal;
6888        let model = parse_tensor_inputs_guarded(tensors, &mut budget, device, stream, &check)?;
6889        let allocations =
6890            parse_tensor_inputs_guarded(model_allocations, &mut budget, device, stream, &check)?;
6891        let mut inputs = model.handoff.into_native();
6892        inputs.extend(allocations.handoff.into_native());
6893        {
6894            let mut retained = this.model_producers.lock().map_err(|_| {
6895                PyRuntimeError::new_err("initial prefill model custody is poisoned")
6896            })?;
6897            retained.extend(model.producers);
6898            retained.extend(allocations.producers);
6899        }
6900        this.require_active(py)?;
6901        let inner = this
6902            .session
6903            .borrow(py)
6904            .owner()?
6905            .bind_initial_prefill_model_content(&this.lease, inputs, stream)
6906            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
6907        drop(stage);
6908        Py::new(
6909            py,
6910            PySemanticInitialPrefillContentWitness {
6911                inner,
6912                _inputs: tensors.clone().unbind(),
6913                _producers: Vec::new(),
6914                stage: slf,
6915            },
6916        )
6917    }
6918
6919    /// Capture original pre-call, transient or autograd-saved tensors after
6920    /// model binding. Capture closes when record_outputs issues the receipt.
6921    #[pyo3(signature = (*, tensors, consumer_stream))]
6922    fn capture_tensor_content(
6923        slf: Py<Self>,
6924        py: Python<'_>,
6925        tensors: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
6926        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
6927    ) -> PyResult<Py<PySemanticInitialPrefillContentWitness>> {
6928        let stage = slf.borrow(py);
6929        let this = &*stage;
6930        this.require_active(py)?;
6931        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
6932        let stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(consumer_stream, &mut budget)?;
6933        let check = || this.require_active(py);
6934        let device = this.session.borrow(py).device_ordinal;
6935        let parsed = parse_tensor_inputs_guarded(tensors, &mut budget, device, stream, &check)?;
6936        this.require_active(py)?;
6937        let inner = this
6938            .session
6939            .borrow(py)
6940            .owner()?
6941            .capture_initial_prefill_tensor_content(
6942                &this.lease,
6943                parsed.handoff.into_native(),
6944                stream,
6945            )
6946            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
6947        let producers = parsed.producers;
6948        drop(stage);
6949        Py::new(
6950            py,
6951            PySemanticInitialPrefillContentWitness {
6952                inner,
6953                _inputs: tensors.clone().unbind(),
6954                _producers: producers,
6955                stage: slf,
6956            },
6957        )
6958    }
6959
6960    /// Authenticate the actual contiguous I64 token tensor at the model's
6961    /// pre-hook; a device mismatch traps before the forward continues.
6962    #[pyo3(signature = (*, token_tensor, consumer_stream))]
6963    fn record_input(
6964        &self,
6965        py: Python<'_>,
6966        token_tensor: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
6967        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
6968    ) -> PyResult<()> {
6969        self.require_active(py)?;
6970        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
6971        let stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(consumer_stream, &mut budget)?;
6972        let check = || self.require_active(py);
6973        validate_producer_device_guarded(
6974            token_tensor,
6975            self.session.borrow(py).device_ordinal,
6976            &check,
6977        )?;
6978        let count = u64::try_from(self.prefix_len)
6979            .map_err(|_| invalid("initial prefill token count exceeds native domain"))?;
6980        let row_bytes = count
6981            .checked_mul(8)
6982            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("initial prefill token tensor size overflows"))?;
6983        let input = SemanticTensorInput {
6984            layout: SemanticTensorLayout {
6985                role: 0,
6986                index: 0,
6987                element_bytes: 8,
6988                scalar_type: 7,
6989                rank: 2,
6990                logical_axis: 1,
6991                dimensions: [1, count, 0, 0],
6992                strides_bytes: [row_bytes, 8, 0, 0],
6993            },
6994            logical_begin: 0,
6995            logical_end: count,
6996            tensor: crate::dlpack_from_py_for_stream_guarded(
6997                token_tensor,
6998                i64::try_from(stream)
6999                    .map_err(|_| invalid("consumer stream exceeds DLPack address space"))?,
7000                &check,
7001            )?,
7002            native_allocation: None,
7003        };
7004        *self
7005            .input_producer
7006            .lock()
7007            .map_err(|_| PyRuntimeError::new_err("initial prefill input custody is poisoned"))? =
7008            Some(token_tensor.clone().unbind());
7009        self.require_active(py)?;
7010        self.session
7011            .borrow(py)
7012            .owner()?
7013            .record_initial_prefill_input(&self.lease, input, stream)
7014            .map_err(xlog_err)
7015    }
7016
7017    /// Seal all original key/value, recurrent and accumulator outputs at the
7018    /// final post-detach wrapper hook, then close this one-use stage for bind.
7019    #[pyo3(signature = (*, tensors, consumer_stream))]
7020    fn record_outputs(
7021        slf: Py<Self>,
7022        py: Python<'_>,
7023        tensors: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
7024        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
7025    ) -> PyResult<Py<PySemanticInitialPrefillReceipt>> {
7026        let stage = slf.borrow(py);
7027        let this = &*stage;
7028        this.require_active(py)?;
7029        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
7030        let stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(consumer_stream, &mut budget)?;
7031        let check = || this.require_active(py);
7032        let device = this.session.borrow(py).device_ordinal;
7033        let parsed = parse_tensor_inputs_guarded(tensors, &mut budget, device, stream, &check)?;
7034        {
7035            let mut retained = this.output_producers.lock().map_err(|_| {
7036                PyRuntimeError::new_err("initial prefill output custody is poisoned")
7037            })?;
7038            retained.extend(parsed.producers);
7039        }
7040        this.require_active(py)?;
7041        this.session
7042            .borrow(py)
7043            .owner()?
7044            .record_initial_prefill_outputs(&this.lease, parsed.handoff.into_native(), stream)
7045            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
7046        this.task_use
7047            .borrow(py)
7048            .state()?
7049            .finish_initial_prefill(&this.scope)?;
7050        drop(stage);
7051        Py::new(
7052            py,
7053            PySemanticInitialPrefillReceipt {
7054                stage: slf,
7055                consumed: AtomicBool::new(false),
7056            },
7057        )
7058    }
7059}

7061/// The shared Session rejects reentrant imports from any controller. Only a
7062/// fully verified result commits this guard; all other exits poison the owner.
7063struct ColdImportGuard<'a> {
7064    session: &'a PySemanticTransitionSession,
7065    issuance: TaskIssuance,
7066    original_decisions: Option<Arc<[u8]>>,
7067    committed: bool,
7068    deferred: bool,
7069}
7070
7071impl<'a> ColdImportGuard<'a> {
7072    fn begin(
7073        session: &'a PySemanticTransitionSession,
7074        original_decisions: Option<Arc<[u8]>>,
7075    ) -> PyResult<Self> {
7076        if session.learning_preparing.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
7077            return Err(invalid(
7078                "learning-phase preparation retains the original Session until durable resolution",
7079            ));
7080        }
7081        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
7082        if session.importing.load(Ordering::Acquire)
7083            || session.recording.load(Ordering::Acquire)
7084            || session.retiring.load(Ordering::Acquire)
7085            || owner.is_poisoned()
7086        {
7087            owner.abort();
7088            return Err(invalid(
7089                "native session cannot enter a nested or aborted import",
7090            ));
7091        }
7092        let issuance = match TaskIssuance::issue(Arc::clone(&session.issuance)) {
7093            Ok(issuance) => issuance,
7094            Err(error) => {
7095                owner.abort();
7096                return Err(error);
7097            }
7098        };
7099        session.importing.store(true, Ordering::Release);
7100        Ok(Self {
7101            session,
7102            issuance,
7103            original_decisions,
7104            committed: false,
7105            deferred: false,
7106        })
7107    }
7108}
7109
7110impl Drop for ColdImportGuard<'_> {
7111    fn drop(&mut self) {
7112        let mut owner = self
7113            .session
7114            .inner
7115            .lock()
7116            .unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner);
7117        if !self.committed {
7118            if let Some(owner) = owner.as_mut() {
7119                owner.abort();
7120            }
7121        }
7122        if !self.deferred {
7123            self.session.importing.store(false, Ordering::Release);
7124        }
7125    }
7126}
7127
7128/// Dynamic access to genuine restored readers, never controller execution.
7129/// No state lock survives into Python. Saved references lose this access on
7130/// every normal/error/unwind exit; a refused phase cannot be resurrected.
7131struct ImportReadScope<'a> {
7132    task_use: &'a PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
7133}
7134
7135impl<'a> ImportReadScope<'a> {
7136    fn enter(task_use: &'a PySemanticTransitionTaskUse) -> PyResult<Self> {
7137        task_use.issuance.require_current()?;
7138        if !task_use.importing.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
7139            return Err(invalid("controlled import reads require an active import"));
7140        }
7141        task_use.state()?.set_import_reads(true)?;
7142        Ok(Self { task_use })
7143    }
7144}
7145
7146impl Drop for ImportReadScope<'_> {
7147    fn drop(&mut self) {
7148        if let Ok(mut state) = self.task_use.state() {
7149            if let TaskUsePhase::Importing { reads, .. } = &mut state.phase {
7150                *reads = false;
7151            }
7152        }
7153    }
7154}

7324#[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
7325fn completed_u192(py: Python<'_>, limbs: [u64; 3]) -> PyResult<Py<PyAny>> {
7326    let mut bytes = [0u8; 24];
7327    for (chunk, limb) in bytes.chunks_exact_mut(8).zip(limbs) {
7328        chunk.copy_from_slice(&limb.to_le_bytes());
7329    }
7330    Ok(py
7331        .get_type::<PyInt>()
7332        .call_method1("from_bytes", (PyBytes::new(py, &bytes), "little"))?
7333        .unbind())
7334}

7336#[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
7337fn completed_truth_kind(code: u64) -> &'static str {
7338    match code {
7339        0 => "NEITHER",
7340        1 => "TRUE",
7341        2 => "FALSE",
7342        3 => "BOTH",
7343        _ => unreachable!("native completed task truth was validated"),
7344    }
7345}

7347#[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
7348fn completed_truth_codes(truth: [xlog_cuda::SemanticTruth; 3]) -> [u64; 3] {
7349    truth.map(|value| value as u64)
7350}
7351
7352#[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
7353fn completed_truth_kinds(truth: [xlog_cuda::SemanticTruth; 3]) -> [&'static str; 3] {

8285/// Native-owned delivery from one real AccumulateGrad node into the canonical
8286/// resident gradient and presence slots. This is a node hook, not a Parameter
8287/// hook; the original leaf remains the GraphTask's accumulation owner.
8288#[pyclass(module = "pyxlog._native")]
8289struct PySemanticGradientDeliveryHook {
8290    effective: Py<PyAny>,
8291    gradient: Py<PyAny>,
8292    presence: Py<PyAny>,
8293}
8294
8295#[pymethods]
8296impl PySemanticGradientDeliveryHook {
8297    fn __call__(
8298        &self,
8299        py: Python<'_>,
8300        _gradient_inputs: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8301        _gradient_outputs: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8302    ) -> PyResult<()> {
8303        let effective = self.effective.bind(py);
8304        let current = effective.getattr("grad")?;
8305        if !current.is(self.gradient.bind(py)) {
8306            return Err(invalid(
8307                "AccumulateGrad replaced the canonical native gradient slot",
8308            ));
8309        }
8310        self.presence.bind(py).call_method1("fill_", (true,))?;
8311        Ok(())
8312    }
8313}

8315/// Cold registration owner for one prepared bank's complete gradient roster.
8316/// Registration attaches canonical role-24 storage to the real leaf, installs
8317/// only AccumulateGrad-node hooks, and retains every handle through recording.
8318#[pyclass(name = "SemanticGradientDelivery", module = "pyxlog._native")]
8319pub(crate) struct PySemanticGradientDelivery {
8320    accumulation: Py<PyAny>,
8321    gradients: Vec<Py<PyAny>>,
8322    presences: Vec<Py<PyAny>>,
8323    _binding: SemanticGradientDeliveryBinding,
8324    _producers: Vec<Py<PyAny>>,
8325    _edges: Vec<Py<PyAny>>,
8326    _callbacks: Vec<Py<PySemanticGradientDeliveryHook>>,
8327    handles: Mutex<Option<Vec<Py<PyAny>>>>,
8328    deferred_hooks: Mutex<Option<Vec<GradientHookEntry>>>,
8329    activated_once: AtomicBool,
8330    restore_on_finish: bool,
8331    restores: Mutex<Vec<GradientSlotRestore>>,
8332}
8333
8334struct GradientSlotRestore {
8335    effective: Py<PyAny>,
8336    gradient: Py<PyAny>,
8337    original_grad: Py<PyAny>,
8338}
8339
8340struct GradientHookEntry {
8341    node: Py<PyAny>,
8342    effective: Py<PyAny>,
8343    gradient: Py<PyAny>,
8344    original_grad: Py<PyAny>,
8345    callback: Py<PySemanticGradientDeliveryHook>,
8346}
8347
8348fn swap_group_leaf_gradient(
8349    effective: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8350    expected: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8351    replacement: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8352) -> PyResult<()> {
8353    if !effective.getattr("grad")?.is(expected) {
8354        return Err(invalid(
8355            "original leaf gradient changed outside group capture",
8356        ));
8357    }
8358    effective.setattr("grad", replacement)
8359}
8360
8361#[pymethods]
8362impl PySemanticGradientDelivery {
8363    /// Record device reset-or-accumulate before the one combined GraphTask.
8364    /// A zero accumulation counter clears role 24/25; a nonzero counter keeps
8365    /// the existing slots so subsequent node deliveries add in place.
8366    fn record_reset(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<()> {
8367        if self.restore_on_finish {
8368            return Err(invalid(
8369                "group delivery shares the target bank's single gradient reset",
8370            ));
8371        }
8372        if self
8373            .handles
8374            .lock()
8375            .map_err(|_| PyRuntimeError::new_err("gradient-delivery owner is poisoned"))?
8376            .is_none()
8377        {
8378            return Err(invalid("gradient delivery has already finished recording"));
8379        }
8380        let zero = self.accumulation.bind(py).call_method1("eq", (0,))?;
8381        let keep = zero.call_method0("logical_not")?;
8382        for (gradient, presence) in self.gradients.iter().zip(&self.presences) {
8383            gradient.bind(py).call_method1("mul_", (&keep,))?;
8384            presence.bind(py).call_method1("logical_and_", (&keep,))?;
8385        }
8386        Ok(())
8387    }
8388
8389    /// Remove cold node hooks after their operations have been captured. The
8390    /// captured device graph retains the recorded reset/add/presence work.
8391    fn activate(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<()> {
8392        self.activate_group(py)
8393    }
8394
8395    fn finish_recording(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<()> {
8396        self.remove_hooks(py, false)
8397    }
8398}
8399
8400impl PySemanticGradientDelivery {
8401    /// Attach a cold-verified historical model's nodes only for this bank's
8402    /// capture. Another bank may already be staged, but cannot be active.
8403    fn activate_group(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<()> {
8404        if !self.restore_on_finish {
8405            return Err(invalid("ordinary gradient delivery is already active"));
8406        }
8407        let entries = self
8408            .deferred_hooks
8409            .lock()
8410            .map_err(|_| PyRuntimeError::new_err("group gradient hooks are poisoned"))?
8411            .take()
8412            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("group gradient delivery was already activated"))?;
8413        let mut handles = Vec::with_capacity(entries.len());
8414        let mut attached = Vec::with_capacity(entries.len());
8415        let installed = (|| -> PyResult<()> {
8416            for entry in &entries {
8417                let effective = entry.effective.bind(py);
8418                let node = entry.node.bind(py);
8419                if node.get_type().name()? != "AccumulateGrad"
8420                    || !node.getattr("variable")?.is(effective)
8421                {
8422                    return Err(invalid(
8423                        "original physical AccumulateGrad edge changed before capture",
8424                    ));
8425                }
8426                swap_group_leaf_gradient(
8427                    effective,
8428                    entry.original_grad.bind(py),
8429                    entry.gradient.bind(py),
8430                )?;
8431                attached.push(GradientSlotRestore {
8432                    effective: entry.effective.clone_ref(py),
8433                    gradient: entry.gradient.clone_ref(py),
8434                    original_grad: entry.original_grad.clone_ref(py),
8435                });
8436                handles.push(
8437                    node.call_method1("register_hook", (entry.callback.clone_ref(py),))?
8438                        .unbind(),
8439                );
8440            }
8441            Ok(())
8442        })();
8443        if let Err(error) = installed {
8444            for handle in handles.drain(..).rev() {
8445                let _ = handle.bind(py).call_method0("remove");
8446            }
8447            for restore in attached.into_iter().rev() {
8448                let _ = swap_group_leaf_gradient(
8449                    restore.effective.bind(py),
8450                    restore.gradient.bind(py),
8451                    restore.original_grad.bind(py),
8452                );
8453            }
8454            return Err(error);
8455        }
8456        *self
8457            .restores
8458            .lock()
8459            .map_err(|_| PyRuntimeError::new_err("group gradient restoration is poisoned"))? =
8460            attached;
8461        *self
8462            .handles
8463            .lock()
8464            .map_err(|_| PyRuntimeError::new_err("gradient-delivery owner is poisoned"))? =
8465            Some(handles);
8466        self.activated_once.store(true, Ordering::Release);
8467        Ok(())
8468    }
8469
8470    fn remove_hooks(&self, py: Python<'_>, already_removed_ok: bool) -> PyResult<()> {
8471        if self.restore_on_finish && !self.activated_once.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
8472            return Err(invalid(
8473                "historical gradient delivery was never activated in its Update bank",
8474            ));
8475        }
8476        let handles = self
8477            .handles
8478            .lock()
8479            .map_err(|_| PyRuntimeError::new_err("gradient-delivery owner is poisoned"))?
8480            .take();
8481        let Some(handles) = handles else {
8482            return if already_removed_ok {
8483                Ok(())
8484            } else {
8485                Err(invalid("gradient delivery has already finished recording"))
8486            };
8487        };
8488        let mut failure = None;
8489        for handle in handles {
8490            if let Err(error) = handle.bind(py).call_method0("remove") {
8491                if failure.is_none() {
8492                    failure = Some(error);
8493                }
8494            }
8495        }
8496        if self.restore_on_finish {
8497            let mut restores = self
8498                .restores
8499                .lock()
8500                .map_err(|_| PyRuntimeError::new_err("group gradient restoration is poisoned"))?;
8501            for restore in restores.drain(..) {
8502                if let Err(error) = swap_group_leaf_gradient(
8503                    restore.effective.bind(py),
8504                    restore.gradient.bind(py),
8505                    restore.original_grad.bind(py),
8506                ) {
8507                    if failure.is_none() {
8508                        failure = Some(error);
8509                    }
8510                }
8511            }
8512        }
8513        if let Some(error) = failure {
8514            return Err(error);
8515        }
8516        Ok(())
8517    }
8518}
8519
8520impl PySemanticPreparedStep {
8521    fn finish_gradient_delivery_recording(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<()> {
8522        let deliveries = self
8523            .gradient_deliveries
8524            .lock()
8525            .map_err(|_| PyRuntimeError::new_err("gradient-delivery roster is poisoned"))?
8526            .iter()
8527            .filter_map(|delivery| delivery.as_ref().map(|item| item.clone_ref(py)))
8528            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
8529        #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
8530        let deliveries = {
8531            let mut deliveries = deliveries;
8532            let groups = self.group_gradient_deliveries.lock().map_err(|_| {
8533                PyRuntimeError::new_err("group gradient-delivery roster is poisoned")
8534            })?;
8535            deliveries.extend(
8536                groups
8537                    .iter()
8538                    .flat_map(|bank| bank.iter().map(|item| item.clone_ref(py))),
8539            );
8540            deliveries
8541        };
8542        let mut failure = None;
8543        for delivery in deliveries {
8544            if let Err(error) = delivery.borrow(py).remove_hooks(py, true) {
8545                if failure.is_none() {
8546                    failure = Some(error);
8547                }
8548            }
8549        }
8550        if let Some(error) = failure {
8551            return Err(error);
8552        }
8553        Ok(())
8554    }
8555}

8557#[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
8558struct PreparedPolicyInputs {
8559    model_output: Py<PyAny>,
8560    inputs: [Py<PyAny>; 9],
8561    invocation_issued: bool,
8562}
8563
8564#[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
8565impl PreparedPolicyInputs {
8566    fn issue_originals(&mut self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<(Py<PyAny>, [Py<PyAny>; 9])> {
8567        if self.invocation_issued {
8568            return Err(invalid("prepared policy invocation was already issued"));
8569        }
8570        // Keep the full original graph on the step for late exported adjoints.
8571        // No getter, tensor copy, new leaf or second numerical invocation runs.
8572        let output = self.model_output.clone_ref(py);
8573        let inputs = std::array::from_fn(|index| self.inputs[index].clone_ref(py));
8574        self.invocation_issued = true;
8575        Ok((output, inputs))
8576    }
8577}

8581        &self,
8582        owner: &SemanticTransitionSession,
8583        stream: u64,
8584    ) -> PyResult<()> {
8585        let native = owner
8586            .prepared_stream(&self.inner)
8587            .map_err(xlog_err)?
8588            .cu_stream() as u64;
8589        let declared = if stream == 1 { 0 } else { stream };
8590        if declared != native {
8591            return Err(invalid(
8592                "recorded producer handoff requires the original native capture stream",
8593            ));
8594        }
8595        Ok(())
8596    }
8597
8598    fn content_binding_with_owner(
8599        &self,
8600        py: Python<'_>,
8601        owner: &SemanticTransitionSession,
8602    ) -> PyResult<(Option<String>, Vec<u8>)> {
8603        let task_use = self.task_use.borrow(py);
8604        task_use.require_identity(owner)?;
8605        owner.prepared_stream(&self.inner).map_err(xlog_err)?;
8606        let binding = task_use.state()?.prepared_content_binding(&self.scope)?;
8607        Ok(binding)
8608    }
8609
8610    fn completed_observation_streams(
8611        &self,
8612        py: Python<'_>,
8613        consumer_streams: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8614    ) -> PyResult<Vec<u64>> {
8615        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
8616        session.require_creator()?;
8617        if session.importing.load(Ordering::Acquire)
8618            || session.recording.load(Ordering::Acquire)
8619            || session.retiring.load(Ordering::Acquire)
8620        {
8621            return Err(invalid(
8622                "completed input observation cannot overlap recording, import or retirement",
8623            ));
8624        }
8625        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
8626        let streams = ColdValue::read(consumer_streams, &mut budget, 0)?;
8627        let streams = streams
8628            .sequence()?
8629            .iter()
8630            .map(ColdValue::unsigned)
8631            .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
8632        if streams.is_empty() {
8633            return Err(invalid(
8634                "completed input observation requires the original consumer streams",
8635            ));
8636        }
8637        let owner = session.owner()?;
8638        if self.content_binding_with_owner(py, &owner)?.0.is_none() {
8639            return Err(invalid(
8640                "completed input observation requires the admitted original operation",
8641            ));
8642        }
8643        Ok(streams)
8644    }
8645
8646    fn require_task(&self, py: Python<'_>, task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse) -> PyResult<()> {
8647        let issued = self.task_use.borrow(py);
8648        issued.issuance.require_current()?;
8649        if self.session.as_ptr() != task_use.session.as_ptr()
8650            || !Arc::ptr_eq(&issued.controller, &task_use.controller)
8651            || !issued.issuance.same_as(&task_use.issuance)
8652            || issued.task_epoch != task_use.task_epoch
8653            || issued.task_identity != task_use.task_identity
8654        {
8655            return Err(invalid("prepared step belongs to another task use"));
8656        }
8657        Ok(())
8658    }
8659
8660    fn export(
8661        &self,
8662        py: Python<'_>,
8663        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8664        export: impl FnOnce(
8665            &mut SemanticTransitionSession,
8666            &SemanticPreparedStep,
8667            u64,
8668        ) -> Result<DlpackManagedTensor, xlog_cuda::SemanticTransitionError>,
8669    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyAny>> {
8670        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
8671        let stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(consumer_stream, &mut 128)?;
8672        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
8673        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
8674        self.content_binding_with_owner(py, &owner)?;
8675        let tensor = export(&mut owner, &self.inner, stream).map_err(xlog_err)?;
8676        crate::dlpack_capsule_from_tensor(
8677            py,
8678            retain_export_owner(tensor, self.session.clone_ref(py), session.owner_thread)?,
8679        )
8680    }
8681}
8682
8683#[pymethods]
8684impl PySemanticPreparedStep {
8685    /// The Session's immutable nominal mode, readable during cold preparation
8686    /// and recording. This is not the device-acquired effective mode or a grant
8687    /// to execute; DRAIN_REQUIRED may override either mode after submission.
8688    #[getter]
8689    fn requested_transition(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<&'static str> {
8690        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
8691        session.require_creator()?;
8692        let owner = session.owner()?;
8693        self.content_binding_with_owner(py, &owner)?;
8694        match owner
8695            .prepared_transition_kind(&self.inner)
8696            .map_err(xlog_err)?
8697        {
8698            SemanticTransitionKind::Proposal => Ok("proposal"),
8699            SemanticTransitionKind::Recompute => Ok("recompute"),
8700            SemanticTransitionKind::Update => Ok("update"),
8701            SemanticTransitionKind::Drain => {
8702                Err(invalid("drain is not a cold scheduled transition"))
8703            }
8704        }
8705    }
8706
8707    /// Cold fixed-address Source U64[32,8]; populated by this step's device acquire.
8708    #[pyo3(signature = (*, consumer_stream))]
8709    fn source(&self, py: Python<'_>, consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>) -> PyResult<Py<PyAny>> {
8710        self.export(
8711            py,
8712            consumer_stream,
8713            SemanticTransitionSession::prepared_source,
8714        )
8715    }
8716
8717    /// Cold full-capacity prefix view for one capture-time bank branch. Only
8718    /// the device-selected branch and prefix extent are live during execution.
8719    #[pyo3(signature = (bank, *, consumer_stream))]
8720    fn prefix(
8721        &self,
8722        py: Python<'_>,
8723        bank: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8724        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8725    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyAny>> {
8726        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
8727        let bank = usize::try_from(ColdValue::read(bank, &mut 128, 0)?.unsigned()?)
8728            .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared tensor bank exceeds native address space"))?;
8729        self.export(py, consumer_stream, |owner, step, stream| {
8730            owner.prepared_prefix(step, bank, stream)
8731        })
8732    }
8733
8734    #[pyo3(signature = (*, consumer_stream))]
8735    fn prefix_extent(
8736        &self,
8737        py: Python<'_>,
8738        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8739    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyAny>> {
8740        self.export(
8741            py,
8742            consumer_stream,
8743            SemanticTransitionSession::prepared_prefix_extent,
8744        )
8745    }
8746
8747    #[pyo3(signature = (*, consumer_stream))]
8748    fn ring_head(&self, py: Python<'_>, consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>) -> PyResult<Py<PyAny>> {
8749        self.export(
8750            py,
8751            consumer_stream,
8752            SemanticTransitionSession::prepared_ring_head,
8753        )
8754    }
8755
8756    /// Original-sealed U64[1] terminal state of the actual device parent.
8757    /// This is a private input snapshot, never an alias of the authority lease.
8758    #[pyo3(signature = (*, consumer_stream))]
8759    fn terminal_state(
8760        &self,
8761        py: Python<'_>,
8762        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8763    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyAny>> {
8764        self.export(
8765            py,
8766            consumer_stream,
8767            SemanticTransitionSession::prepared_terminal,
8768        )

8770
8771    #[pyo3(signature = (role, index, bank, *, consumer_stream))]
8772    fn tensor(
8773        &self,
8774        py: Python<'_>,
8775        role: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8776        index: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8777        bank: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8778        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8779    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyAny>> {
8780        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
8781        let role = ColdValue::read(role, &mut 128, 0)?.unsigned()?;
8782        let role = SemanticStateRole::from_code(role)
8783            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("unknown native publication tensor role"))?;
8784        let index = ColdValue::read(index, &mut 128, 0)?.unsigned()?;
8785        let bank = usize::try_from(ColdValue::read(bank, &mut 128, 0)?.unsigned()?)
8786            .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared tensor bank exceeds native address space"))?;
8787        self.export(py, consumer_stream, |owner, step, stream| {
8788            owner.prepared_tensor(step, role, index, bank, stream)
8789        })
8790    }
8791
8792    /// Return (native provenance, full allocation U8 DLPack capsule) for the
8793    /// exact prepared tensor view. The capsule retains the original step grant;
8794    /// consume once and retain through every use, including original backward.
8795    /// Its full backing is read-only by contract, never an update destination.
8796    /// Capacity does not certify live input content. Version-counter origins
8797    /// belong to the model producer, independently of this physical owner.
8798    #[pyo3(signature = (role, index, bank, *, consumer_stream))]
8799    fn tensor_allocation(
8800        &self,
8801        py: Python<'_>,
8802        role: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8803        index: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8804        bank: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8805        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8806    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
8807        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
8808        let role = SemanticStateRole::from_code(ColdValue::read(role, &mut 128, 0)?.unsigned()?)
8809            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("unknown native publication tensor role"))?;
8810        let index = ColdValue::read(index, &mut 128, 0)?.unsigned()?;
8811        let bank = usize::try_from(ColdValue::read(bank, &mut 128, 0)?.unsigned()?)
8812            .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared tensor bank exceeds native address space"))?;
8813        let stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(consumer_stream, &mut 128)?;
8814        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
8815        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
8816        self.content_binding_with_owner(py, &owner)?;
8817        let (provenance, tensor) = owner
8818            .prepared_tensor_allocation(&self.inner, role, index, bank, stream)
8819            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
8820        let tensor = retain_export_owner(tensor, self.session.clone_ref(py), session.owner_thread)?;
8821        Ok((
8822            Py::new(py, PyNativeTensorAllocation { provenance })?,
8823            crate::dlpack_capsule_from_tensor(py, tensor)?,
8824        )
8825            .into_pyobject(py)?
8826            .unbind())
8827    }
8828
8829    /// Fixed device outputs of this Update step's native replay selection.
8830    /// The first U64 tensor is the selection/status record. It is followed by the
8831    /// complete roster metadata, frozen objective, reduction groups, group member
8832    /// ordinals and canaries. Remaining rank-two ports are token IDs, mask labels,
8833    /// mask weights, autoregressive labels, retention labels, branch labels,
8834    /// branch IDs, source slots, logical positions, kinds, and parents for every
8835    /// replay row.
8836    #[pyo3(signature = (*, consumer_stream))]
8837    fn training_view(
8838        &self,
8839        py: Python<'_>,
8840        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8841    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
8842        let ports = [
8843            SemanticTrainingViewPort::Selection,
8844            SemanticTrainingViewPort::RosterRows,
8845            SemanticTrainingViewPort::Objective,
8846            SemanticTrainingViewPort::ObjectiveGroups,
8847            SemanticTrainingViewPort::ObjectiveGroupMembers,
8848            SemanticTrainingViewPort::Canaries,
8849            SemanticTrainingViewPort::TokenIds,
8850            SemanticTrainingViewPort::MaskLabels,
8851            SemanticTrainingViewPort::MaskWeights,
8852            SemanticTrainingViewPort::AutoregressiveLabels,
8853            SemanticTrainingViewPort::RetentionLabels,
8854            SemanticTrainingViewPort::BranchLabels,
8855            SemanticTrainingViewPort::BranchIds,
8856            SemanticTrainingViewPort::SourceSlots,
8857            SemanticTrainingViewPort::LogicalPositions,
8858            SemanticTrainingViewPort::Kinds,
8859            SemanticTrainingViewPort::Parents,
8860        ];
8861        let mut values = Vec::with_capacity(ports.len());
8862        for port in ports {
8863            values.push(self.export(py, consumer_stream, |owner, step, stream| {
8864                owner.prepared_training_view_port(step, port, stream)
8865            })?);
8866        }
8867        Ok(PyTuple::new(py, values)?.unbind())
8868    }
8869
8870    /// Register one prepared bank's real AccumulateGrad roster before capture.
8871    /// ``phase`` and ``accumulation`` are original five-field tensor-input rows.
8872    /// ``leaves`` are ``(GradientEdge_or_None, effective_input,
8873    /// gradient_input_or_None, presence_input, phase_mask_input)`` in the
8874    /// original physical parameter order.
8875    #[pyo3(signature = (bank, phase, accumulation, leaves, *, consumer_stream, group_member=None))]
8876    fn register_gradient_delivery(
8877        &self,
8878        bank: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8879        phase: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8880        accumulation: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8881        leaves: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8882        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
8883        group_member: Option<Py<PySemanticRetainedReplayMember>>,
8884    ) -> PyResult<Py<PySemanticGradientDelivery>> {
8885        let py = bank.py();
8886        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
8887        session.require_creator()?;
8888        let bank = usize::try_from(ColdValue::read(bank, &mut 128, 0)?.unsigned()?)
8889            .map_err(|_| invalid("gradient-delivery bank exceeds native address space"))?;
8890        if bank > 1 {
8891            return Err(invalid("gradient delivery requires bank zero or one"));
8892        }
8893        #[cfg(not(feature = "semantic-policy"))]
8894        if group_member.is_some() {
8895            return Err(invalid(
8896                "group gradient delivery requires a semantic-policy build",
8897            ));
8898        }
8899        if group_member.is_none() {
8900            let owners = self
8901                .gradient_deliveries
8902                .lock()
8903                .map_err(|_| PyRuntimeError::new_err("gradient-delivery roster is poisoned"))?;
8904            if owners[bank].is_some() {
8905                return Err(invalid(
8906                    "gradient delivery was already registered for this bank",
8907                ));
8908            }
8909        }
8910        #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
8911        if let Some(member) = &group_member {
8912            let member = member.borrow(py);
8913            let source = member.session.borrow(py);
8914            source.require_creator()?;
8915            if member.completed.load(Ordering::Acquire)
8916                || !source.importing.load(Ordering::Acquire)
8917                || self.session.as_ptr() == member.session.as_ptr()
8918            {
8919                return Err(invalid(
8920                    "group gradient delivery requires an open distinct original replay",
8921                ));
8922            }
8923            let group = member
8924                .group_use
8925                .lock()
8926                .map_err(|_| PyRuntimeError::new_err("retained group use is poisoned"))?;
8927            if group.gradient_banks[bank]
8928                || group
8929                    .target
8930                    .as_ref()
8931                    .is_some_and(|owner| !owner.same_handle(&self.inner))
8932            {
8933                return Err(invalid(
8934                    "original replay already has gradient delivery for this bank or another Update",
8935                ));
8936            }
8937        }
8938        let consumer_stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(consumer_stream, &mut 128)?;
8939        let check = || {
8940            self.require_task(py, &self.task_use.borrow(py))?;
8941            #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
8942            if let Some(member) = &group_member {
8943                let member = member.borrow(py);
8944                if member.completed.load(Ordering::Acquire)
8945                    || !member.session.borrow(py).importing.load(Ordering::Acquire)
8946                {
8947                    return Err(invalid("original replay closed during gradient handoff"));
8948                }
8949            }
8950            Ok(())
8951        };
8952        let rows = object_sequence(leaves, &mut 8192)?;
8953        if rows.is_empty() {
8954            return Err(invalid(
8955                "gradient delivery requires the complete physical leaf roster",
8956            ));
8957        }
8958        struct LeafRows {
8959            edge: Option<Py<PyAny>>,
8960            effective: usize,
8961            gradient: Option<usize>,
8962            presence: usize,
8963            phase_mask: usize,
8964        }
8965        let mut tensor_rows = vec![phase.clone(), accumulation.clone()];
8966        let mut leaf_rows = Vec::with_capacity(rows.len());
8967        for row in rows {
8968            let fields = object_sequence(&row, &mut 8192)?;
8969            if fields.len() != 5 {
8970                return Err(invalid(
8971                    "gradient-delivery leaf needs edge, effective, gradient, presence and phase mask",
8972                ));
8973            }
8974            let effective = tensor_rows.len();
8975            tensor_rows.push(fields[1].clone());
8976            let gradient = if fields[2].is_none() {
8977                None
8978            } else {
8979                let index = tensor_rows.len();
8980                tensor_rows.push(fields[2].clone());
8981                Some(index)
8982            };
8983            let presence = tensor_rows.len();
8984            tensor_rows.push(fields[3].clone());
8985            let phase_mask = tensor_rows.len();
8986            tensor_rows.push(fields[4].clone());
8987            leaf_rows.push(LeafRows {
8988                edge: (!fields[0].is_none()).then(|| fields[0].clone().unbind()),
8989                effective,
8990                gradient,
8991                presence,
8992                phase_mask,
8993            });
8994        }
8995        let tensor_rows = PyList::new(py, &tensor_rows)?;
8996        let parsed = parse_tensor_inputs_guarded(
8997            tensor_rows.as_any(),
8998            &mut 32768,
8999            session.device_ordinal,
9000            consumer_stream,
9001            &check,
9002        )?;
9003        let tensors = &parsed.handoff.0;
9004        let is_scalar = |layout: &SemanticTensorLayout, role, element_bytes, scalar_type| {
9005            layout.role == role
9006                && layout.element_bytes == element_bytes
9007                && layout.scalar_type == scalar_type
9008                && layout.rank == 0
9009                && layout.logical_axis == u64::MAX
9010                && layout.dimensions == [0; 4]
9011                && layout.strides_bytes == [0; 4]
9012        };
9013        if !is_scalar(
9014            &tensors[0].layout,
9015            SemanticStateRole::TrainingSchedule as u64,
9016            8,
9017            7,
9018        ) || !is_scalar(
9019            &tensors[1].layout,
9020            SemanticStateRole::GradientAccumulation as u64,
9021            8,
9022            7,
9023        ) {
9024            return Err(invalid(
9025                "gradient delivery phase and accumulation require canonical scalar layouts",
9026            ));
9027        }
9028        let mut effective_coordinates = BTreeSet::new();
9029        let mut gradient_coordinates = BTreeSet::new();
9030        let mut presence_coordinates = BTreeSet::new();
9031        let mut phase_mask_coordinates = BTreeSet::new();
9032        for leaf in &leaf_rows {
9033            let effective = &tensors[leaf.effective].layout;
9034            let presence = &tensors[leaf.presence].layout;
9035            let phase_mask = &tensors[leaf.phase_mask].layout;
9036            let gradient_valid = leaf.gradient.is_none_or(|index| {
9037                let gradient = &tensors[index].layout;
9038                gradient.role == SemanticStateRole::Gradients as u64
9039                    && gradient.rank == effective.rank
9040                    && gradient.dimensions == effective.dimensions
9041                    && gradient_coordinates.insert((gradient.role, gradient.index))
9042            });
9043            if !(18..=20).contains(&effective.role)
9044                || !gradient_valid
9045                || !is_scalar(
9046                    presence,
9047                    SemanticStateRole::GradientAccumulation as u64,
9048                    1,
9049                    8,
9050                )
9051                || phase_mask.role != SemanticStateRole::TrainingSchedule as u64
9052                || phase_mask.element_bytes != 1
9053                || phase_mask.scalar_type != 8
9054                || phase_mask.rank != 1
9055                || phase_mask.logical_axis != u64::MAX
9056                || phase_mask.dimensions != [3, 0, 0, 0]
9057                || phase_mask.strides_bytes != [1, 0, 0, 0]
9058                || !effective_coordinates.insert((effective.role, effective.index))
9059                || !presence_coordinates.insert((presence.role, presence.index))
9060                || !phase_mask_coordinates.insert((phase_mask.role, phase_mask.index))
9061            {
9062                return Err(invalid(
9063                    "gradient-delivery leaf inputs require unique canonical model, gradient, presence and phase-mask layouts",
9064                ));
9065            }
9066        }
9067        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
9068        self.content_binding_with_owner(py, &owner)?;
9069        let inputs = parsed.handoff.into_native();
9070        #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
9071        let binding = if let Some(member) = &group_member {
9072            let member = member.borrow(py);
9073            let source = member.session.borrow(py);
9074            let source_owner = source.owner()?;
9075            let parent = member.parent.borrow(py);
9076            let lease = parent.lease()?;
9077            let invocation = member.invocation.borrow(py);
9078            owner.bind_imported_group_gradient_delivery(
9079                &self.inner,
9080                bank,
9081                &source_owner,
9082                &lease,
9083                invocation.rng,
9084                member.replay_ordinal,
9085                &member.replay_row,
9086                inputs,
9087                consumer_stream,
9088            )
9089        } else {
9090            owner.bind_prepared_gradient_delivery(&self.inner, bank, inputs, consumer_stream)
9091        }
9092        .map_err(xlog_err)?;
9093        #[cfg(not(feature = "semantic-policy"))]
9094        let binding = owner
9095            .bind_prepared_gradient_delivery(&self.inner, bank, inputs, consumer_stream)
9096            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
9097        drop(owner);
9098
9099        struct HookLeaf {
9100            node: Py<PyAny>,
9101            effective: Py<PyAny>,
9102            gradient: Py<PyAny>,
9103            presence: Py<PyAny>,
9104            restore_none: bool,
9105            original_grad: Py<PyAny>,
9106        }
9107        let mut hook_leaves = Vec::new();
9108        let mut gradients = Vec::new();
9109        let mut presences = Vec::new();
9110        let mut edges = Vec::new();
9111        for leaf in leaf_rows {
9112            let effective = parsed.producers[leaf.effective].bind(py);
9113            let gradient = leaf
9114                .gradient
9115                .map(|index| parsed.producers[index].clone_ref(py));
9116            let presence = parsed.producers[leaf.presence].clone_ref(py);
9117            if let Some(gradient) = &gradient {
9118                gradients.push(gradient.clone_ref(py));
9119            }
9120            presences.push(presence.clone_ref(py));
9121            let Some(edge) = leaf.edge else {
9122                if effective.getattr("requires_grad")?.is_truthy()? {
9123                    return Err(invalid(
9124                        "a trainable physical leaf requires its real AccumulateGrad edge",
9125                    ));
9126                }
9127                continue;
9128            };
9129            let Some(gradient) = gradient else {
9130                return Err(invalid(
9131                    "a retained AccumulateGrad edge requires native gradient capacity",
9132                ));
9133            };
9134            let edge_bound = edge.bind(py);
9135            let node = edge_bound.getattr("node")?;
9136            if edge_bound.getattr("output_nr")?.extract::<u64>()? != 0
9137                || node.get_type().name()? != "AccumulateGrad"
9138                || !node.getattr("variable")?.is(effective)
9139            {
9140                return Err(invalid(
9141                    "gradient delivery requires the leaf's real AccumulateGrad edge",
9142                ));
9143            }
9144            let current = effective.getattr("grad")?;
9145            if group_member.is_none() && !current.is_none() && !current.is(gradient.bind(py)) {
9146                return Err(invalid(
9147                    "the physical leaf already owns a different gradient allocation",
9148                ));
9149            }
9150            edges.push(edge.clone_ref(py));
9151            hook_leaves.push(HookLeaf {
9152                node: node.unbind(),
9153                effective: effective.clone().unbind(),
9154                gradient,
9155                presence,
9156                restore_none: current.is_none(),
9157                original_grad: current.unbind(),
9158            });
9159        }
9160
9161        let callbacks = hook_leaves
9162            .iter()
9163            .map(|leaf| {
9164                Py::new(
9165                    py,
9166                    PySemanticGradientDeliveryHook {
9167                        effective: leaf.effective.clone_ref(py),
9168                        gradient: leaf.gradient.clone_ref(py),
9169                        presence: leaf.presence.clone_ref(py),
9170                    },
9171                )
9172            })
9173            .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
9174        let deferred_hooks = group_member.as_ref().map(|_| {
9175            hook_leaves
9176                .iter()
9177                .zip(&callbacks)
9178                .map(|(leaf, callback)| GradientHookEntry {
9179                    node: leaf.node.clone_ref(py),
9180                    effective: leaf.effective.clone_ref(py),
9181                    gradient: leaf.gradient.clone_ref(py),
9182                    original_grad: leaf.original_grad.clone_ref(py),
9183                    callback: callback.clone_ref(py),
9184                })
9185                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
9186        });
9187        let delivery = Py::new(
9188            py,
9189            PySemanticGradientDelivery {
9190                accumulation: parsed.producers[1].clone_ref(py),
9191                gradients,
9192                presences,
9193                _binding: binding,
9194                _producers: parsed.producers,
9195                _edges: edges,
9196                _callbacks: callbacks.iter().map(|item| item.clone_ref(py)).collect(),
9197                handles: Mutex::new(group_member.is_none().then(Vec::new)),
9198                deferred_hooks: Mutex::new(deferred_hooks),
9199                activated_once: AtomicBool::new(group_member.is_none()),
9200                restore_on_finish: group_member.is_some(),
9201                restores: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
9202            },
9203        )?;
9204        let mut owners = self
9205            .gradient_deliveries
9206            .lock()
9207            .map_err(|_| PyRuntimeError::new_err("gradient-delivery roster is poisoned"))?;
9208        if group_member.is_none() && owners[bank].is_some() {
9209            return Err(invalid(
9210                "gradient delivery was already registered for this bank",
9211            ));
9212        }
9213        #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
9214        if let Some(member) = &group_member {
9215            let member = member.borrow(py);
9216            let mut group = member
9217                .group_use
9218                .lock()
9219                .map_err(|_| PyRuntimeError::new_err("retained group use is poisoned"))?;
9220            if group.gradient_banks[bank]
9221                || group
9222                    .target
9223                    .as_ref()
9224                    .is_some_and(|owner| !owner.same_handle(&self.inner))
9225            {
9226                return Err(invalid(
9227                    "original group gradient delivery changed before registration",
9228                ));
9229            }
9230            self.group_gradient_deliveries.lock().map_err(|_| {
9231                PyRuntimeError::new_err("group gradient-delivery roster is poisoned")
9232            })?[bank]
9233                .push(delivery.clone_ref(py));
9234            group.gradient_banks[bank] = true;
9235            group.deliveries[bank] = Some(delivery.clone_ref(py));
9236            if group.target.is_none() {
9237                group.target = Some(self.inner.clone());
9238            }
9239            return Ok(delivery);
9240        }
9241        let mut handles = Vec::new();
9242        let mut attached = Vec::new();
9243        let installed = (|| -> PyResult<()> {
9244            for (leaf, callback) in hook_leaves.iter().zip(&callbacks) {
9245                let effective = leaf.effective.bind(py);
9246                // Native registration, not the numerical producer, attaches
9247                // canonical role-24 storage to this real AccumulateGrad node.
9248                effective.setattr("grad", leaf.gradient.bind(py))?;
9249                attached.push((
9250                    leaf.effective.clone_ref(py),
9251                    leaf.gradient.clone_ref(py),
9252                    leaf.restore_none,
9253                ));
9254                let handle = leaf
9255                    .node
9256                    .bind(py)
9257                    .call_method1("register_hook", (callback.clone_ref(py),))?;
9258                handles.push(handle.unbind());
9259            }
9260            Ok(())
9261        })();
9262        if let Err(error) = installed {
9263            for handle in handles.drain(..).rev() {
9264                let _ = handle.bind(py).call_method0("remove");
9265            }
9266            for (effective, _, restore_none) in attached.into_iter().rev() {
9267                if restore_none {
9268                    let _ = effective.bind(py).setattr("grad", py.None());
9269                }
9270            }
9271            return Err(error);
9272        }
9273        *delivery
9274            .borrow(py)
9275            .handles
9276            .lock()
9277            .expect("unexposed gradient-delivery owner cannot be poisoned") = Some(handles);
9278        owners[bank] = Some(delivery.clone_ref(py));
9279        Ok(delivery)
9280    }

9282    /// Record this proposal tape's complete Update-policy VJP. Actor, critic
9283    /// and cost terms use the frozen selected episode; supervised edit uses
9284    /// the exact genuine demonstration origin. When both name this tape their
9285    /// selected-score cotangents are summed before one native VJP. Returned
9286    /// parameter, full MASK and baseline roots remain device-resident.
9287    #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
9288    #[pyo3(signature = (update_step, bank, *, consumer_stream))]
9289    fn temporal_update_vjp(
9290        &self,
9291        py: Python<'_>,
9292        update_step: Py<PySemanticPreparedStep>,
9293        bank: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
9294        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
9295    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
9296        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
9297        let bank = usize::try_from(ColdValue::read(bank, &mut 128, 0)?.unsigned()?)
9298            .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared policy bank exceeds native address space"))?;
9299        let consumer_stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(consumer_stream, &mut 128)?;
9300        {
9301            let update = update_step.borrow(py);
9302            if self.session.as_ptr() != update.session.as_ptr()
9303                || !Arc::ptr_eq(&self.scope, &update.scope)
9304            {
9305                return Err(invalid(
9306                    "temporal policy backward requires an Update from the same prepared segment",
9307                ));
9308            }
9309            let task_use = self.task_use.borrow(py);
9310            update.require_task(py, &task_use)?;
9311        }
9312        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
9313        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
9314        self.content_binding_with_owner(py, &owner)?;
9315        let gradients = owner
9316            .record_prepared_update_policy_vjp(
9317                &self.inner,
9318                bank,
9319                &update_step.borrow(py).inner,
9320                consumer_stream,
9321            )
9322            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
9323        let capsules = gradients
9324            .into_dlpack()
9325            .map_err(xlog_err)?
9326            .into_iter()
9327            .map(|tensor| {
9328                let tensor =
9329                    retain_export_owner(tensor, self.session.clone_ref(py), session.owner_thread)?;
9330                crate::dlpack_capsule_from_tensor(py, tensor)
9331            })
9332            .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
9333        Ok(PyTuple::new(py, capsules)?.unbind())
9334    }

9336    /// Return parameter, full MASK and baseline adjoints for this exact
9337    /// prepared Proposal's frozen actor or edit row in a recording Update bank.
9338    /// Native membership determines the numerical path; the caller cannot
9339    /// reclassify a row or omit the other required group members.
9340    /// Nine capsules are returned: the three FP32 adjoints, then their three
9341    /// FP64 ordinary/underflow envelopes, then their three FP64
9342    /// magnitude/ordinary/underflow bounds. These are selected late outputs,
9343    /// not the paired actor/full domains required before a draw.
9344    #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
9345    #[pyo3(signature = (update_step, bank, member_ordinal, *, consumer_stream))]
9346    fn group_update_vjp(
9347        &self,
9348        py: Python<'_>,
9349        update_step: Py<PySemanticPreparedStep>,
9350        bank: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
9351        member_ordinal: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
9352        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
9353    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
9354        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
9355        let bank = usize::try_from(ColdValue::read(bank, &mut 128, 0)?.unsigned()?)
9356            .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared policy bank exceeds native address space"))?;
9357        let ordinal = ColdValue::read(member_ordinal, &mut 128, 0)?.unsigned()?;
9358        let ordinal_index = usize::try_from(ordinal)
9359            .map_err(|_| invalid("frozen group ordinal exceeds native address space"))?;
9360        let consumer_stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(consumer_stream, &mut 128)?;
9361        {
9362            let update = update_step.borrow(py);
9363            if self.session.as_ptr() != update.session.as_ptr()
9364                || !Arc::ptr_eq(&self.scope, &update.scope)
9365            {
9366                return Err(invalid(
9367                    "group policy backward requires an Update from the same prepared segment",
9368                ));
9369            }
9370            update.require_task(py, &self.task_use.borrow(py))?;
9371        }
9372        let row = self
9373            .task_use
9374            .borrow(py)
9375            .authority
9376            .replay
9377            .get(ordinal_index)
9378            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("group policy row is absent from the admitted replay"))?
9379            .training_view_row()?;
9380        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
9381        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
9382        self.content_binding_with_owner(py, &owner)?;
9383        let gradients = owner
9384            .record_prepared_policy_group_vjp(
9385                &self.inner,
9386                bank,
9387                &update_step.borrow(py).inner,
9388                ordinal,
9389                &row,
9390                consumer_stream,
9391            )
9392            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
9393        let capsules = gradients
9394            .into_dlpack()
9395            .map_err(xlog_err)?
9396            .into_iter()
9397            .map(|tensor| {
9398                let tensor =
9399                    retain_export_owner(tensor, self.session.clone_ref(py), session.owner_thread)?;
9400                crate::dlpack_capsule_from_tensor(py, tensor)
9401            })
9402            .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
9403        Ok(PyTuple::new(py, capsules)?.unbind())
9404    }

9406    /// Record the native group reduction after all frozen actor and edit rows
9407    /// have contributed once in this Update bank. Returns one FP32[1] DLPack
9408    /// scalar: raw episode sums are normalized, summed in the admitted order,
9409    /// then multiplied by the original frozen critic coefficient once. Its
9410    /// numerical value is native, not a host reconstructed loss.
9411    #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
9412    #[pyo3(signature = (bank, *, consumer_stream))]
9413    fn group_critic_scalar(

9421            .map_err(|_| invalid("group critic bank exceeds native address space"))?;
9422        let stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(consumer_stream, &mut 128)?;
9423        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
9424        let mut owner = session.owner()?;

9506    /// Cold authenticated binding of this completed step's original model.
9507    /// Returns (predecessor_identity, successor_identity_or_None, model_generation,
9508    /// model_geometry_digest, model_numerical_digest, carrier_or_None). The
9509    /// immutable successful-Proposal carrier exposes numerical_realization, logits and random_state as
9510    /// (native_owner_identity, canonical_bytes). Identities have the same four
9511    /// fields as PublishedParent.identity(); they are not live readers.
9512    /// Join every original consumer stream. Read record 44 and complete model
9513    /// allocations through this step's existing exports, then call again after
9514    /// serialization to verify the same sealed inputs. Unknown completion and
9515    /// skipped steps cannot expose a binding. A refusal has no successor, and
9516    /// refusal/Recompute/Update/Drain observations return carrier None.
9517    #[pyo3(signature = (*, consumer_streams))]
9518    fn completed_model_binding(
9519        &self,
9520        py: Python<'_>,
9521        consumer_streams: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
9522    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
9523        let streams = self.completed_observation_streams(py, consumer_streams)?;
9524        #[cfg(not(feature = "semantic-policy"))]
9525        {
9526            let _ = streams;
9527            Err(invalid(
9528                "completed model material requires the semantic-policy feature",
9529            ))
9530        }
9531        #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
9532        {
9533            let session = self.session.borrow(py);
9534            let mut owner = session.owner()?;
9535            let binding = owner
9536                .prepared_model_binding(&self.inner, &streams)
9537                .map_err(xlog_err)?;
9538            let carrier = owner
9539                .prepared_completed_model_carrier(&self.inner, &streams)
9540                .map_err(xlog_err)?;
9541            if owner
9542                .prepared_model_binding(&self.inner, &streams)
9543                .map_err(xlog_err)?
9544                != binding
9545            {
9546                return Err(invalid(
9547                    "completed model binding changed while serializing its carrier",
9548                ));
9549            }
9550            let (predecessor, successor, generation, geometry, numerical) = binding;
9551            let identity = |value: xlog_cuda::SemanticPublishedIdentity| {
9552                (
9553                    PyBytes::new(py, value.instance.as_bytes()),
9554                    value.word,
9555                    PyBytes::new(py, value.logical_digest.as_bytes()),
9556                    PyBytes::new(py, value.state_digest.as_bytes()),
9557                )
9558            };
9559            Ok((
9560                identity(predecessor),
9561                successor.map(identity),
9562                generation,
9563                PyBytes::new(py, geometry.as_bytes()),
9564                PyBytes::new(py, numerical.as_bytes()),
9565                carrier
9566                    .map(|inner| Py::new(py, PySemanticCompletedModelCarrier { inner }))
9567                    .transpose()?,
9568            )
9569                .into_pyobject(py)?
9570                .unbind())
9571        }
9572    }

9574    /// Cold original Update observations, including known refusals. Availability
9575    /// is authored by the original CUDA execution; incomplete accumulators are
9576    /// never exported as measurement bits. The host-only snapshot grants no
9577    /// execution authority and must be obtained before original step retirement.
9578    #[getter]
9579    fn update_measurements(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<Option<Py<PyDict>>> {
9580        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
9581        session.require_creator()?;
9582        if session.importing.load(Ordering::Acquire)
9583            || session.recording.load(Ordering::Acquire)
9584            || session.retiring.load(Ordering::Acquire)
9585        {
9586            return Err(invalid(
9587                "Update observation cannot overlap recording, import or retirement",
9588            ));
9589        }
9590        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
9591        let binding = self.content_binding_with_owner(py, &owner)?;
9592        if binding.0.is_none() {
9593            return Err(invalid(
9594                "Update observation requires the admitted original operation",
9595            ));
9596        }
9597        #[cfg(not(feature = "semantic-policy"))]
9598        {
9599            let _ = &mut owner;
9600            Err(invalid(
9601                "Update observation requires the semantic-policy feature",
9602            ))
9603        }
9604        #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
9605        {
9606            let observation = owner
9607                .prepared_update_measurements(&self.inner)
9608                .map_err(xlog_err)?;
9609            let report = observation
9610                .map(|observation| update_measurements_report(py, observation))
9611                .transpose()?;
9612            if self.content_binding_with_owner(py, &owner)? != binding {
9613                return Err(invalid(
9614                    "original Update authority changed during observation",
9615                ));
9616            }
9617            Ok(report)
9618        }
9619    }

9644    /// Cold original records, not encoded features or current-bank substitutes.
9645    /// Returns (predecessor_identity, successor_identity_or_None, records), with
9646    /// records ordered by (role, index). Each record is (role, index, generation,

9648    /// Native identity is the original range seal; a carrier hashes raw_bytes
9649    /// separately for bytes_sha256. No new model or publication identity issues.
9650    #[pyo3(signature = (*, consumer_streams))]
9651    fn completed_feedback_records(
9652        &self,
9653        py: Python<'_>,

9660            .prepared_feedback_records(&self.inner, &streams)

9663            (
9664                PyBytes::new(py, value.instance.as_bytes()),
9665                value.word,

9667                PyBytes::new(py, value.state_digest.as_bytes()),
9668            )
9669        };
9670        let records = PyTuple::new(
9671            py,
9672            records.iter().map(|record| {
9673                (
9674                    record.role as u64,
9675                    record.index,
9676                    record.generation,
9677                    record.capacity_bytes,
9678                    record.logical_begin,
9679                    record.logical_end,
9680                    PyBytes::new(py, record.identity.as_bytes()),
9681                    PyBytes::new(py, &record.bytes),
9682                )
9683            }),

9719    /// Reserve event slots before capture; no additional model forward occurs.
9720    fn reserve_model_work(&self, py: Python<'_>, capacity: &Bound<'_, PyAny>) -> PyResult<()> {
9721        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
9722        let capacity = usize::try_from(ColdValue::read(capacity, &mut 128, 0)?.unsigned()?)
9723            .map_err(|_| invalid("model work capacity exceeds native address space"))?;
9724        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
9725        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
9726        self.content_binding_with_owner(py, &owner)?;
9727        owner
9728            .reserve_model_work(&self.inner, capacity)
9729            .map_err(xlog_err)
9730    }
9731
9732    /// Cold native-owned U64[capacity,3] work scratch, retained by this step.
9733    /// Rows are [actual_units, sticky_overflow, producer_writes]; the producer
9734    /// must count every reached category, including predicates and padding.
9735    #[pyo3(signature = (*, consumer_stream))]
9736    fn model_work_buffer(
9737        &self,
9738        py: Python<'_>,
9739        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
9740    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyAny>> {
9741        self.export(
9742            py,
9743            consumer_stream,
9744            SemanticTransitionSession::model_work_buffer,
9745        )
9746    }
9747
9748    /// Record a bounded device-produced category and reset its original slot.
9749    /// Returns the row index in model_work_buffer, not a device result. Call
9750    /// before the producer in the same active original recording stream. A
9751    /// closed forward recording cannot receive work from a later invocation.
9752    fn record_model_device_work(
9753        &self,
9754        py: Python<'_>,
9755        kind: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
9756        upper_dimensions: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
9757    ) -> PyResult<usize> {
9758        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
9759        let (kind, values, rank) = parse_model_work(kind, upper_dimensions)?;
9760        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
9761        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
9762        self.content_binding_with_owner(py, &owner)?;
9763        owner
9764            .record_model_device_work(&self.inner, kind, &values[..rank])
9765            .map_err(xlog_err)
9766    }
9767
9768    /// Record one original executed operation's unit category and geometry.
9769    /// The native transition freezes the roster when enqueue_step returns.
9770    fn record_model_work(
9771        &self,
9772        py: Python<'_>,
9773        kind: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
9774        dimensions: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
9775    ) -> PyResult<()> {
9776        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
9777        let (kind, values, rank) = parse_model_work(kind, dimensions)?;
9778        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
9779        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
9780        self.content_binding_with_owner(py, &owner)?;
9781        owner
9782            .record_model_work(&self.inner, kind, &values[..rank])
9783            .map_err(xlog_err)
9784    }
9785
9786    /// Charge original autograd save occurrences using retained native layouts,
9787    /// never a Python byte total or a later replacement tensor.
9788    fn record_saved_tensor_work(
9789        &self,
9790        py: Python<'_>,
9791        witness: PyRef<'_, PySemanticTensorContentWitness>,
9792    ) -> PyResult<()> {
9793        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
9794        if witness.session.as_ptr() != self.session.as_ptr() {
9795            return Err(invalid("saved work belongs to another Session"));
9796        }
9797        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
9798        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
9799        self.content_binding_with_owner(py, &owner)?;
9800        owner
9801            .record_saved_tensor_work(&self.inner, &witness.inner)
9802            .map_err(xlog_err)
9803    }
9804
9805    /// Original native feedback producer ports: schema and six DLPack capsules.
9806    #[pyo3(signature = (*, consumer_stream))]
9807    fn feedback(
9808        &self,
9809        py: Python<'_>,
9810        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
9811    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
9812        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
9813        let stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(consumer_stream, &mut 128)?;
9814        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
9815        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
9816        self.content_binding_with_owner(py, &owner)?;
9817        let (schema, tensors) = owner
9818            .prepared_feedback(&self.inner, stream)
9819            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
9820        let tensors = tensors
9821            .into_iter()
9822            .map(|tensor| {
9823                crate::dlpack_capsule_from_tensor(
9824                    py,
9825                    retain_export_owner(tensor, self.session.clone_ref(py), session.owner_thread)?,
9826                )
9827            })
9828            .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
9829        Ok((
9830            feedback_schema_object(py, &schema)?,
9831            PyTuple::new(py, tensors)?,
9832        )
9833            .into_pyobject(py)?
9834            .unbind())
9835    }
9836}

9838enum ContentStepOwner {
9839    Published(Py<PySemanticPublishedParent>),
9840    Prepared(Py<PySemanticPreparedStep>),
9841}
9842
9843#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
9844enum ContentStepRef<'a> {
9845    Published(&'a PySemanticPublishedParent),
9846    Prepared(&'a PySemanticPreparedStep),
9847}

9849enum TensorContentBinding {
9850    Capture,
9851    Model(Option<usize>),

9853
9854impl ContentStepOwner {
9855    fn check_producer_stream(
9856        &self,
9857        py: Python<'_>,
9858        owner: &SemanticTransitionSession,
9859        stream: u64,
9860    ) -> PyResult<()> {
9861        if let Self::Prepared(step) = self {
9862            let step = step.borrow(py);
9863            let issued = step.task_use.borrow(py);
9864            if matches!(
9865                &issued.state()?.phase,
9866                TaskUsePhase::Recording { .. } | TaskUsePhase::Prepared { .. }
9867            ) {
9868                step.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
9869                step.require_recording_stream(owner, stream)?;
9870            }
9871        }
9872        Ok(())
9873    }
9874
9875    fn from_python(value: &Bound<'_, PyAny>) -> PyResult<Self> {
9876        if let Ok(parent) = value.extract::<Py<PySemanticPublishedParent>>() {
9877            Ok(Self::Published(parent))
9878        } else if let Ok(step) = value.extract::<Py<PySemanticPreparedStep>>() {
9879            Ok(Self::Prepared(step))
9880        } else {
9881            Err(invalid(
9882                "content requires an authentic acquired parent or prepared step",
9883            ))
9884        }
9885    }
9886
9887    fn binding(
9888        &self,
9889        py: Python<'_>,
9890        owner: &SemanticTransitionSession,
9891        retained: bool,
9892    ) -> PyResult<(Option<String>, Vec<u8>)> {
9893        match self {
9894            Self::Published(parent) => {
9895                let parent = parent.borrow(py);
9896                let (operation, snapshot) = if retained {
9897                    parent.retained_content_binding_with_owner(py, owner)?
9898                } else {
9899                    parent.content_binding_with_owner(py, owner)?
9900                };
9901                Ok((Some(operation), snapshot))
9902            }
9903            Self::Prepared(step) => step.borrow(py).content_binding_with_owner(py, owner),
9904        }
9905    }
9906}

9908/// Private content witness for one acquired parent and its original producers.
9909/// Transient capture proves stability; model binding compares the original
9910/// publication baseline. Neither proves derivation, provenance, replay or
9911/// permission to execute. Only the privileged controller can issue one.
9912/// The issuing Runtime must retain this complete object until its guaranteed
9913/// creator-thread cleanup after the original backward, not just save its native
9914/// aliases. Arbitrary retained Python producers must not be last-dropped by a
9915/// worker; thread-safe native ownership is not a producer-finalizer guarantee.
9916#[pyclass(
9917    name = "SemanticTensorContentWitness",
9918    module = "pyxlog._native",
9919    frozen
9920)]
9921pub(crate) struct PySemanticTensorContentWitness {
9922    // Drop native ownership before the retained Python producers and Session.
9923    inner: SemanticTensorContentWitness,
9924    _inputs: Py<PyAny>,
9925    _producers: Vec<Py<PyAny>>,
9926    parent: ContentStepOwner,
9927    session: Py<PySemanticTransitionSession>,
9928}

9931    name = "SemanticModelForwardWitness",
