11640    /// Return (computed, rows) from this acquired bank's sealed active-cache
11641    /// record. Each row is (physical_row, source_slot, logical_position, kind).
11642    /// Computed empty rows are valid; an uncomputed initial cache is not.
11643    fn active_rows(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
11644        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
11645        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
11646        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
11647        self.task_use.borrow(py).require_current(&owner)?;
11648        let active = owner
11649            .published_active_rows(&*self.lease()?)
11650            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
11651        let rows = PyTuple::new(
11652            py,
11653            active.rows.into_iter().map(|row| {
11654                (
11655                    row.physical_row,
11656                    row.source_slot,
11657                    row.logical_position,
11658                    row.kind,
11659                )
11660            }),
11661        )?;
11662        Ok((active.computed, rows).into_pyobject(py)?.unbind())
11663    }
11664
11665    /// Return (parent_identity, rows) for this acquired parent's committed prefix.
11666    /// ``rows`` is a single-consumer CUDA DLPack capsule with dtype U64, shape
11667    /// (prefix_capacity, 8), and element strides (8, 1). Committed row i is logical position i;
11668    /// columns are (token, logical_position, kind, provenance, valid, committed,
11669    /// recomputed, provenance_record). Kind is FILLED=1; provenance preserves
11670    /// SOURCE=1 or GENERATED=2, and provenance_record is its retained native ledger
11671    /// index, not an authority bit. Flags remain u64 values, not a numeric cast.
11672    /// The identity is exactly the four-component tuple returned by identity().
11673    ///
11674    /// Only [0, prefix_extent) is committed; even an empty prefix retains its
11675    /// cold capacity shape. Unused rows must not enter model computation.
11676    /// There is no second Acquire, ring reconstruction, or host prefix copy.
11677    /// The read-only-by-contract view retains this reader and the Session until
11678    /// its final DLPack deleter. Do not modify it. ``consumer_stream`` follows
11679    /// tensor()'s protocol; release must name every stream after its final use.
11680    #[pyo3(signature = (*, consumer_stream))]
11681    fn prefix(&self, py: Python<'_>, consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
11682        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
11683        let mut budget = 128;
11684        let stream = ColdValue::read(consumer_stream, &mut budget, 0)?.unsigned()?;
11685        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
11686        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
11687        self.task_use.borrow(py).require_current(&owner)?;
11688        let (identity, tensor) = owner
11689            .published_prefix(&*self.lease()?, stream)
11690            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
11691        let parent_identity = (
11692            PyBytes::new(py, identity.instance.as_bytes()),
11693            identity.word,
11694            PyBytes::new(py, identity.logical_digest.as_bytes()),
11695            PyBytes::new(py, identity.state_digest.as_bytes()),
11696        );
11697        let tensor = retain_export_owner(tensor, self.session.clone_ref(py), session.owner_thread)?;
11698        Ok((
11699            parent_identity,
11700            crate::dlpack_capsule_from_tensor(py, tensor)?,
11701        )
11702            .into_pyobject(py)?
11703            .unbind())
11704    }
11705
11706    /// Export a real bank tensor with its cold physical-capacity shape as a
11707    /// single-consumer DLPack capsule. ``consumer_stream`` is legacy default 1
11708    /// or an explicit live CUDA stream; zero and per-thread default 2 refuse.
11709    /// It is not a publication identity. The native owner orders producer work
11710    /// onto it without a host wait. Role/index must exist and have computed
11711    /// content; capacity does not make unused rows valid model inputs.
11712    #[pyo3(signature = (*, role, index, consumer_stream))]
11713    fn tensor(
11714        &self,
11715        py: Python<'_>,
11716        role: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
11717        index: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
11718        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
11719    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyAny>> {
11720        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
11721        let mut budget = 128;
11722        let role = SemanticStateRole::from_code(ColdValue::read(role, &mut budget, 0)?.unsigned()?)
11723            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("unknown native publication tensor role"))?;
11724        let index = ColdValue::read(index, &mut budget, 0)?.unsigned()?;
11725        let stream = ColdValue::read(consumer_stream, &mut budget, 0)?.unsigned()?;
11726        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
11727        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
11728        self.task_use.borrow(py).require_current(&owner)?;
11729        let tensor = owner
11730            .published_tensor(&*self.lease()?, role, index, stream)
11731            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
11732        let tensor = retain_export_owner(tensor, self.session.clone_ref(py), session.owner_thread)?;
11733        crate::dlpack_capsule_from_tensor(py, tensor)
11734    }
11735
11736    /// Return (native provenance, full allocation U8 DLPack capsule) for
11737    /// tensor(role, index). Use during cold binding; consume the capsule once.
11738    /// Geometry is in bytes relative to the complete native allocation, and
11739    /// same_allocation compares retained owners, not addresses or consumer storage.
11740    /// The capsule keeps the original reader/step grant and stream ordering;
11741    /// its full backing is read-only by contract, never an update destination.
11742    /// capacity does not certify unused content. Retain the original owners
11743    /// through every use and backward. Model version-counter origins are separate.
11744    #[pyo3(signature = (*, role, index, consumer_stream))]
11745    fn tensor_allocation(
11746        &self,
11747        py: Python<'_>,
11748        role: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
11749        index: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
11750        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
11751    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
11752        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
11753        let mut budget = 128;
11754        let role = SemanticStateRole::from_code(ColdValue::read(role, &mut budget, 0)?.unsigned()?)
11755            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("unknown native publication tensor role"))?;
11756        let index = ColdValue::read(index, &mut budget, 0)?.unsigned()?;
11757        let stream = ColdValue::read(consumer_stream, &mut budget, 0)?.unsigned()?;
11758        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
11759        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
11760        self.task_use.borrow(py).require_current(&owner)?;
11761        let (provenance, tensor) = owner
11762            .published_tensor_allocation(&*self.lease()?, role, index, stream)
11763            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
11764        let tensor = retain_export_owner(tensor, self.session.clone_ref(py), session.owner_thread)?;
11765        Ok((
11766            Py::new(py, PyNativeTensorAllocation { provenance })?,
11767            crate::dlpack_capsule_from_tensor(py, tensor)?,
11768        )
11769            .into_pyobject(py)?
11770            .unbind())
11771    }
11772
11773    /// Export a sealed native record's actual device bytes, including raw
11774    /// feedback (role15) and its qualified typed-statement payload (role16).
11775    /// These are U8 bytes with the same reader lifetime as model tensors;
11776    /// neither an encoded model feature nor a caller-supplied feedback object.
11777    #[pyo3(signature = (*, role, index, consumer_stream))]
11778    fn record(
11779        &self,
11780        py: Python<'_>,
11781        role: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
11782        index: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
11783        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
11784    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyAny>> {
11785        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
11786        let mut budget = 128;
11787        let role = SemanticStateRole::from_code(ColdValue::read(role, &mut budget, 0)?.unsigned()?)
11788            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("unknown native publication record role"))?;
11789        let index = ColdValue::read(index, &mut budget, 0)?.unsigned()?;
11790        let stream = ColdValue::read(consumer_stream, &mut budget, 0)?.unsigned()?;
11791        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
11792        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
11793        self.task_use.borrow(py).require_current(&owner)?;
11794        let tensor = owner
11795            .published_record(&*self.lease()?, role, index, stream)
11796            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
11797        let tensor = retain_export_owner(tensor, self.session.clone_ref(py), session.owner_thread)?;
11798        crate::dlpack_capsule_from_tensor(py, tensor)
11799    }
11800
11801    /// Produce (parent_identity, schema, features, device_validity, lineage).
11802    /// The two device values are single-consumer DLPack capsules with exact
11803    /// FP32[capacity, 9*B+4] and Bool8[capacity] shapes. Validity remains on the
11804    /// device; provenance errors trap before the consumer readiness event.
11805    /// No slots are packed. Each byte contributes eight LSB-first bits followed
11806    /// by presence; the tail is (PRO, 1, CONTRA, 1) for valid records. Invalid
11807    /// rows are entirely zero, before any payload address or bit computation.
11808    ///
11809    /// Lineage is (task_epoch, support_fields, current_receipts,
11810    /// original_statements, support_offsets, support_rows). These four additional
11811    /// single-consumer capsules are U64[capacity,42], U64[capacity],
11812    /// U64[capacity+1], U64[support_capacity,12]. Receipts are opaque production
11813    /// query receipts from this acquired root, not archived runtime handles.
11814    /// A slot owns rows [offset[s],offset[s+1]); support_fields names their
11815    /// columns. Rows are actual newest-to-oldest contributions, not the allowed
11816    /// mutation roster. Invalid slots have index U64::MAX and no rows; valid
11817    /// Neither retains its original statement index and an empty row interval.
11818    /// Service values are not learned feature columns and do not replace the
11819    /// original dependency graph or current task epoch check.
11820    ///
11821    /// Requires before_segment for this parent. All exports retain its reader
11822    /// until their final deleters, including any original encoder backward.
11823    /// Release must name every consumer stream after the final use of all six.
11824    #[pyo3(signature = (*, consumer_stream))]
11825    fn feedback(
11826        &self,
11827        py: Python<'_>,
11828        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
11829    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
11830        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
11831        let mut budget = 128;
11832        let stream = ColdValue::read(consumer_stream, &mut budget, 0)?.unsigned()?;
11833        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
11834        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
11835        let task_use = self.task_use.borrow(py);
11836        task_use.require_current(&owner)?;
11837        task_use.state()?.content_handoff_binding()?;
11838        let feedback = owner
11839            .published_feedback(&*self.lease()?, stream)
11840            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
11841        let identity = feedback.parent;
11842        let parent_identity = (
11843            PyBytes::new(py, identity.instance.as_bytes()),
11844            identity.word,
11845            PyBytes::new(py, identity.logical_digest.as_bytes()),
11846            PyBytes::new(py, identity.state_digest.as_bytes()),
11847        );
11848        let schema = feedback_schema_object(py, &feedback.schema)?;
11849        let [features, device_validity, queries, originals, offsets, supports] =
11850            feedback.into_dlpack();
11851        let features =
11852            retain_export_owner(features, self.session.clone_ref(py), session.owner_thread)?;
11853        let device_validity = retain_export_owner(
11854            device_validity,
11855            self.session.clone_ref(py),
11856            session.owner_thread,
11857        )?;
11858        let export = |tensor| {
11859            let tensor =
11860                retain_export_owner(tensor, self.session.clone_ref(py), session.owner_thread)?;
11861            crate::dlpack_capsule_from_tensor(py, tensor)
11862        };
11863        let lineage = (
11864            task_use.task_epoch,
11865            PyTuple::new(py, xlog_cuda::SEMANTIC_FEEDBACK_SUPPORT_FIELDS)?,
11866            export(queries)?,
11867            export(originals)?,
11868            export(offsets)?,
11869            export(supports)?,
11870        );
11871        Ok((
11872            parent_identity,
11873            schema,
11874            crate::dlpack_capsule_from_tensor(py, features)?,
11875            crate::dlpack_capsule_from_tensor(py, device_validity)?,
11876            lineage,
11877        )
11878            .into_pyobject(py)?
11879            .unbind())
11880    }
11881
11882    /// Join the actual bank consumers and retire only this exact bank reader.
11883    /// Every bank alias must have returned its managed owner. Original private
11884    /// witnesses, model baselines, feedback outputs, continuation producers and
11885    /// the original autograd graph remain owned for late verification/backward.
11886    /// No further publication reads are allowed through this parent; original
11887    /// witnesses and policy final use still require current task authority.
11888    /// Finish with ``release`` after all late consumers and witnesses are gone.
11889    /// Failure preserves native and Python custody; never retry an uncertain use.
11890    #[pyo3(signature = (*, consumer_streams))]
11891    fn release_reader(&self, py: Python<'_>, consumer_streams: &Bound<'_, PyAny>) -> PyResult<()> {
11892        self.release_native_ownership(py, consumer_streams, true)
11893    }
11894
11895    /// Join all named consumer streams and finally release this original step.
11896    /// Accepts either a live bank reader or one retired by ``release_reader``.
11897    /// Outstanding content witnesses or externally held DLPack aliases refuse
11898    /// without destroying retained custody. A failed device release is quarantined by
11899    /// Session, never retried automatically.
11900    #[pyo3(signature = (*, consumer_streams))]
11901    fn release(&self, py: Python<'_>, consumer_streams: &Bound<'_, PyAny>) -> PyResult<()> {
11902        self.release_native_ownership(py, consumer_streams, false)
11903    }
11904}
11905
11906#[pymethods]
11907impl PySemanticTransitionTaskUse {
11908    /// Read the retained Session binding without exposing the controller.
11909    fn binding(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<(u64, Py<PyBytes>)> {
11910        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
11911        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
11912        self.require_current(&*session.owner()?)?;
11913        session.binding(py)
11914    }
11915
11916    /// Return ``(source, prefix, prefill_tokens, ring_head)`` for this task's
11917    /// admitted observed mapping. ``source`` is the original 32-row active
11918    /// ring and ``prefix`` is its ordered committed predecessor; each row has
11919    /// the eight fields accepted by ``bind_parent``. ``prefill_tokens`` are
11920    /// exactly the tokens whose model cache must be computed before that bind.
11921    /// This imported-phase layout is not a model-cache or publication witness.
11922    #[pyo3(signature = (*, prefix_capacity, feedback_capacity, max_position, pad_token, provenance_capacity_records))]
11923    fn initial_source_layout(
11924        &self,
11925        py: Python<'_>,
11926        prefix_capacity: u64,
11927        feedback_capacity: u64,
11928        max_position: u64,
11929        pad_token: u64,
11930        provenance_capacity_records: u64,
11931    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
11932        let layout = self.checked_initial_source_layout(
11933            py,
11934            prefix_capacity,
11935            feedback_capacity,
11936            max_position,
11937            pad_token,
11938            provenance_capacity_records,
11939        )?;
11940        initial_source_parts(py, layout)
11941    }
11942
11943    /// Issue one pre-parent stage for the exact admitted committed prefix and
11944    /// model generation. The returned stage accepts original model content,
11945    /// the actual wrapper input and its post-detach outputs in that order.
11946    /// Neither this call nor the layout is a completed model-forward receipt.
11947    #[pyo3(signature = (*, prefix_capacity, feedback_capacity, max_position, pad_token, provenance_capacity_records, model_generation))]
11948    #[expect(
11949        clippy::too_many_arguments,
11950        reason = "initial prefill binds the complete admitted source and model geometry"
11951    )]
11952    fn begin_initial_prefill(
11953        slf: Py<Self>,
11954        py: Python<'_>,
11955        prefix_capacity: u64,
11956        feedback_capacity: u64,
11957        max_position: u64,
11958        pad_token: u64,
11959        provenance_capacity_records: u64,
11960        model_generation: u64,
11961    ) -> PyResult<Py<PySemanticInitialPrefillStage>> {
11962        let issued = slf.borrow(py);
11963        let layout = issued.checked_initial_source_layout(
11964            py,
11965            prefix_capacity,
11966            feedback_capacity,
11967            max_position,
11968            pad_token,
11969            provenance_capacity_records,
11970        )?;
11971        let parts = initial_source_parts(py, layout.clone())?;
11972        let prefix_len = layout.prefill_tokens.len();
11973        let scope = issued.state()?.begin_initial_prefill()?;
11974        let session = issued.session.clone_ref(py);
11975        let lease = {
11976            let session_ref = session.borrow(py);
11977            let mut owner = session_ref.owner()?;
11978            match owner.begin_initial_prefill(layout, model_generation) {
11979                Ok(lease) => lease,
11980                Err(error) => {
11981                    owner.abort();
11982                    return Err(xlog_err(error));
11983                }
11984            }
11985        };
11986        drop(issued);
11987        Py::new(
11988            py,
11989            PySemanticInitialPrefillStage {
11990                session,
11991                task_use: slf,
11992                scope,
11993                lease,
11994                layout: parts,
11995                prefix_len,
11996                model_producers: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
11997                input_producer: Mutex::new(None),
11998                output_producers: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
11999            },
12000        )
12001    }
12002
12003    /// Return one immutable native projection of the exact ordered query,
12004    /// admitted theory plus executed observer program, observed four-valued
12005    /// result, and the three stored truths in query order. This does not
12006    /// re-execute the observer and carries no use authority. A symbolic corpus
12007    /// anchor stores the same three identities in its ``semantic_task`` record
12008    /// and admission evidence; cold import rejects any mismatch with the task it
12009    /// executes.
12010    ///
12011    /// Returns ``(query_identity, theory_program_identity, result_identity,
12012    /// truths)``. Identities are 32-byte values. ``truths`` contains the native
12013    /// objective indices ``0=Neither``, ``1=True``, ``2=False`` and ``3=Both``;
12014    /// each indexes the frozen ``truth_tokens`` array directly.
12015    fn task_content(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<TaskContentRead> {
12016        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
12017        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
12018        let owner = session.owner()?;
12019        self.require_current(&owner)?;
12020        let (identity, truth) = owner
12021            .task_content()
12022            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("native task content binding is absent"))?;
12023        Ok(task_content_read(py, (identity, truth)))
12024    }
12025
12026    /// Project the native law frozen at cold task binding, before any Proposal.
12027    /// Returns ``(scoring_identity, evaluator_f64_bits, coefficient_f32_bits,
12028    /// (cost_unit_identity, cost_cap))``. This does not create training groups,
12029    /// grant actor eligibility or establish a physical numerical certificate.
12030    fn task_objective_law(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
12031        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
12032        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
12033        let owner = session.owner()?;
12034        self.require_current(&owner)?;
12035        let law = owner
12036            .task_objective_law()
12037            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("native task objective law is absent"))?;
12038        let identity = owner
12039            .task_scoring_law_identity()
12040            .map_err(xlog_err)?
12041            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("native task scoring law is absent"))?;
12042        Ok((
12043            PyBytes::new(py, identity.as_bytes()),
12044            (law.evaluator_min.to_bits(), law.evaluator_max.to_bits()),
12045            PyTuple::new(py, law.coefficients.map(f32::to_bits))?,
12046            (
12047                PyBytes::new(py, law.structural_cost.unit.as_bytes()),
12048                law.structural_cost.cap,
12049            ),
12050        )
12051            .into_pyobject(py)?
12052            .unbind())
12053    }
12054
12055    /// Return ``(domain_identity_bytes, original_domain_projection)`` from the
12056    /// retained native owner. None means no prospective training was bound.
12057    /// This is metadata custody, not a roster, grant or numerical certificate.
12058    fn task_training_domain(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<Py<PyAny>> {
12059        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
12060        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
12061        let owner = session.owner()?;
12062        self.require_current(&owner)?;
12063        let Some(domain) = owner.task_training_domain() else {
12064            return Ok(py.None());
12065        };
12066        let projection = self.checkpoint.training_domain.python_value(py)?;
12067        Ok((PyBytes::new(py, domain.identity().as_bytes()), projection)
12068            .into_pyobject(py)?
12069            .into_any()
12070            .unbind())
12071    }
12072
12073    /// Return original pre-draw actor/full domains as three owner-bearing
12074    /// DLPack capsules: parameters [2,P,4], text [2,32,V,4], baselines
12075    /// [2,1,136,4], FP64 (M,O,U,I). These are not selected backward outputs
12076    /// and not a physical model certificate. Consume them in the same model
12077    /// numerical owner before freezing its original work/continuation.
12078    #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
12079    #[pyo3(signature = (parent, bank, consumer_stream))]
12080    fn policy_numerical_domains(
12081        &self,
12082        py: Python<'_>,
12083        parent: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12084        bank: Option<usize>,
12085        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12086    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
12087        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
12088        let stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(consumer_stream, &mut 128)?;
12089        let parent = ContentStepOwner::from_python(parent)?;
12090        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
12091        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
12092        self.require_identity(&owner)?;
12093        let tensors = match parent {
12094            ContentStepOwner::Prepared(step) => {
12095                let step = step.borrow(py);
12096                step.require_task(py, self)?;
12097                step.content_binding_with_owner(py, &owner)?;
12098                step.require_recording_stream(&owner, stream)?;
12099                owner.prepared_policy_numerical_domains(
12100                    &step.inner,
12101                    bank.ok_or_else(|| {
12102                        invalid("prepared policy domains require their original bank")
12103                    })?,
12104                    stream,
12105                )
12106            }
12107            ContentStepOwner::Published(parent) => {
12108                let parent = parent.borrow(py);
12109                parent.require_task(py, self)?;
12110                parent.content_binding_with_owner(py, &owner)?;
12111                if bank.is_some() {
12112                    return Err(invalid("acquired policy domains require bank=None"));
12113                }
12114                let lease = parent.lease()?;
12115                owner.policy_numerical_domains(&lease, stream)
12116            }
12117        }
12118        .map_err(xlog_err)?;
12119        drop(owner);
12120        let capsules = tensors
12121            .into_iter()
12122            .map(|tensor| {
12123                let tensor =
12124                    retain_export_owner(tensor, self.session.clone_ref(py), session.owner_thread)?;
12125                crate::dlpack_capsule_from_tensor(py, tensor)
12126            })
12127            .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
12128        Ok(PyTuple::new(py, capsules)?.unbind())
12129    }
12130
12131    /// Return the bound native semantic goal root before any Proposal. This
12132    /// 32-byte root is the same one retained in completed task ground; reading
12133    /// it neither recomputes the goal nor grants execution authority.
12134    fn semantic_goal_root(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<Py<PyBytes>> {
12135        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
12136        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
12137        let owner = session.owner()?;
12138        self.require_current(&owner)?;
12139        self.state()?.require_public_use()?;
12140        let root = owner
12141            .task_semantic_goal_root()
12142            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("native task goal witness is absent"))?;
12143        Ok(PyBytes::new(py, root.as_bytes()).unbind())
12144    }

12146    /// Ordered task-local levels from the same native bank used by selection.
12147    /// Each level is an ordered tuple of (query ordinal, truth code, weight)
12148    /// goals. The truth-match score is zero or one; progress subtracts the
12149    /// acquired base of the current step before comparing candidates.
12150    fn task_priority_levels(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
12151        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;

12154        self.require_current(&owner)?;

12161    /// Read the same native Session layout; this does not grant execution.
12162    fn policy_layout(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
12163        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
12164        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
12165        self.require_current(&*session.owner()?)?;
12166        session.policy_layout(py)
12167    }
12168
12169    /// Return the cold typed-feedback layout without granting execution or
12170    /// pretending that a result bank has been acquired.
12171    ///
12172    /// The tuple is ``(abi, schema_digest, adapter_digest, statement_capacity,
12173    /// feature_width, minimum_slots, fields)``. Each field is ``(source,
12174    /// byte_offset, bit_width, required)``. ``statement`` names the native
12175    /// qualified-value payload: u64 atom-length, exact predicate/arity/typed
12176    /// values, u32 qualifier-count, then each u64 qualifier-length and its exact
12177    /// typed values, in admitted order. Lengths and values are little-endian;
12178    /// symbols contain the originally admitted UTF-8, not registry IDs.
12179    /// Schema digests, addresses, observer answers, and receipt seals are not
12180    /// part of that learned payload. A statement byte is present exactly below
12181    /// the acquired record's statement length; every absent byte is canonical
12182    /// zero. ``record`` offsets 32 and 40 name the independent pro/contra u64
12183    /// values, each restricted to zero or one. Bits are least-significant-first.
12184    /// Invalid slots are masked before encoding, independently of payload bytes.
12185    /// The actual fixed slot capacity and validity come only from parent Acquire.
12186    /// Flat coordinates append each field's LSB-first bits and its presence:
12187    /// byte i occupies [9*i, 9*i+9); the final four are PRO, presence(PRO),
12188    /// CONTRA, presence(CONTRA). Required support presence is one only for valid
12189    /// records. Use parent.feedback for the authenticated device producer.
12190    fn feedback_schema(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
12191        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
12192        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
12193        let owner = session.owner()?;
12194        self.require_current(&owner)?;
12195        let schema = FeedbackSchema::new(owner.feedback_statement_bytes().map_err(xlog_err)?)
12196            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
12197        feedback_schema_object(py, &schema)
12198    }
12199
12200    /// Native support packing in fixed catalogue order.
12201    /// Returns (binding, 136 half-open byte spans, total Bool8 cells).
12202    /// Inactive TEXT keeps its reserved span, which the device does not read.
12203    fn policy_support_layout(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
12204        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
12205        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
12206        let owner = session.owner()?;
12207        self.require_current(&owner)?;
12208        let binding = owner.binding();
12209        let (spans, cells) = owner.policy_support_layout().map_err(xlog_err)?;
12210        let spans: Vec<_> = spans
12211            .into_iter()
12212            .map(|span| (span.start, span.end))
12213            .collect();
12214        Ok((
12215            (
12216                binding.generation,
12217                PyBytes::new(py, binding.digest.as_bytes()),
12218            ),
12219            spans,
12220            cells,
12221        )
12222            .into_pyobject(py)?
12223            .unbind())
12224    }
12225}
12226
12227#[pymethods]
12228impl PySemanticTransitionController {
12229    #[new]
12230    fn new(py: Python<'_>, session: Py<PySemanticTransitionSession>) -> PyResult<Self> {
12231        session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
12232        Ok(Self {
12233            session,
12234            identity: Arc::new(()),
12235        })
12236    }
12237
12238    /// Versioned (unit identity, maximum raw cost) of this Session's native
12239    /// program mode, available before import_task freezes its objective.
12240    #[getter]
12241    fn structural_cost_descriptor(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
12242        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
12243        session.require_creator()?;
12244        let descriptor =
12245            xlog_cuda::semantic_structural_cost_descriptor(session.editable_program.is_some());
12246        Ok(
12247            (PyBytes::new(py, descriptor.unit.as_bytes()), descriptor.cap)
12248                .into_pyobject(py)?
12249                .unbind(),
12250        )
12251    }
12252
12253    /// Record one fixed bounded segment without submitting it. The original
12254    /// producer prepares cold storage on consumer_stream and returns an owner
12255    /// with memory_scope, prepare_unpublished_successors(),
12256    /// enqueue_step(step, bank), and finish_segment() methods.
12257    /// memory_scope spans allocation/recording through EndCapture/instantiate;
12258    /// enqueue_step records both fixed bank branches per slot and returns None.
12259    /// Each bank binds its own original model witness, continuation, policy and
12260    /// update outputs through this controller. Device admission selects exactly
12261    /// one retained branch; no branch aliases the other's primal or tape owners.
12262    /// Python receives neither the graph nor authority to report its completion.
12263    /// transitions is a nonempty exact tuple of requested modes; its length fixes
12264    /// the bound. Native claims the frozen per-step content and work capacities,
12265    /// the producer slab, and every later external CUDA allocation upper bound
12266    /// before the first producer callback.
12267    /// Device DRAIN_REQUIRED overrides either nominal mode. Recompute binds the
12268    /// original model continuation without a policy or backward obligation.
12269    #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
12270    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, transitions, producer, tensor_content_capacity, model_work_capacity, segment_capacity_bytes, other_external_cuda_bytes))]
12271    #[expect(
12272        clippy::too_many_arguments,
12273        reason = "cold recording binds the original producer and four independent capacity obligations"
12274    )]
12275    fn build_segment(
12276        &self,
12277        py: Python<'_>,
12278        task_use: Py<PySemanticTransitionTaskUse>,
12279        transitions: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12280        producer: Py<PyAny>,
12281        tensor_content_capacity: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12282        model_work_capacity: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12283        segment_capacity_bytes: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12284        other_external_cuda_bytes: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12285    ) -> PyResult<()> {
12286        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
12287        session.require_creator()?;
12288        let issued = task_use.borrow(py);
12289        self.require_issued(&issued)?;
12290        if self.session.as_ptr() != issued.session.as_ptr() {
12291            return Err(invalid("segment task belongs to another Session"));
12292        }
12293        let transitions = prepared_transitions(transitions)?;
12294        let cold_capacity = SemanticSegmentColdCapacity {
12295            tensor_content_capacity: usize::try_from(
12296                ColdValue::read(tensor_content_capacity, &mut 128, 0)?.unsigned()?,
12297            )
12298            .map_err(|_| invalid("tensor content capacity exceeds native address space"))?,
12299            model_work_capacity: usize::try_from(
12300                ColdValue::read(model_work_capacity, &mut 128, 0)?.unsigned()?,
12301            )
12302            .map_err(|_| invalid("model work capacity exceeds native address space"))?,
12303            segment_capacity_bytes: ColdValue::read(segment_capacity_bytes, &mut 128, 0)?
12304                .unsigned()?,
12305            other_external_cuda_bytes: ColdValue::read(other_external_cuda_bytes, &mut 128, 0)?
12306                .unsigned()?,
12307        };
12308        if session.importing.load(Ordering::Acquire)
12309            || session.retiring.load(Ordering::Acquire)
12310            || session.recording.swap(true, Ordering::AcqRel)
12311        {
12312            return Err(invalid(
12313                "segment recording cannot overlap another recording or import",
12314            ));
12315        }
12316        let mut guard = PreparedBuildGuard {
12317            session: &session,
12318            task_use: &issued,
12319            committed: false,
12320        };
12321        let (scope, snapshot, handles, stream) = {
12322            let mut owner = session.owner()?;
12323            issued.require_identity(&owner)?;
12324            if session
12325                .prepared_segment
12326                .lock()
12327                .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared segment mutex is poisoned"))?
12328                .is_some()
12329            {
12330                return Err(invalid("previous prepared segment has not been retired"));
12331            }
12332            let mut state = issued.state()?;
12333            if let CheckpointTaskPhase::Segment(operation) = checkpoint_task_phase(&state)? {
12334                issued.require_learning_operation(&owner, &operation)?;
12335            }
12336            let scope = state.begin_build()?;
12337            let handles = owner
12338                .prepare_segment_steps(transitions, cold_capacity)
12339                .map_err(xlog_err)?;
12340            let stream = owner.prepared_stream(&handles[0]).map_err(xlog_err)?;
12341            (scope, state.snapshot.canonical.clone(), handles, stream)
12342        };
12343        let mut steps = Vec::with_capacity(handles.len());
12344        for inner in handles {
12345            steps.push(Py::new(
12346                py,
12347                PySemanticPreparedStep {
12348                    session: self.session.clone_ref(py),
12349                    task_use: task_use.clone_ref(py),
12350                    scope: Arc::clone(&scope),
12351                    inner,
12352                    continuation_producers: Mutex::new(std::array::from_fn(|_| Vec::new())),
12353                    policy_inputs: Mutex::new(std::array::from_fn(|_| None)),
12354                    gradient_deliveries: Mutex::new(std::array::from_fn(|_| None)),
12355                    #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
12356                    group_gradient_deliveries: Mutex::new(std::array::from_fn(|_| Vec::new())),
12357                },
12358            )?);
12359        }
12360        let resources = Arc::new(PreparedProducerResources {
12361            producers: Mutex::new(vec![producer.clone_ref(py)]),
12362            owner_thread: session.owner_thread,
12363        });
12364        *session
12365            .prepared_segment
12366            .lock()
12367            .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared segment mutex is poisoned"))? =
12368            Some(PreparedPythonSegment {
12369                scope: Arc::clone(&scope),
12370                task_use: task_use.clone_ref(py),
12371                steps: steps.iter().map(|step| step.clone_ref(py)).collect(),
12372                resources: Arc::clone(&resources),
12373                producers_retired: false,
12374            });
12375        let check = || self.check_recording(py, &issued, &scope, &snapshot);
12376        let kwargs = PyDict::new(py);
12377        kwargs.set_item(
12378            "steps",
12379            PyTuple::new(py, steps.iter().map(|step| step.clone_ref(py)))?,
12380        )?;
12381        kwargs.set_item("consumer_stream", stream.cu_stream() as u64)?;
12382        let prepare = recording_callback(check, || producer.bind(py).getattr("prepare_segment"))?;
12383        let prepared = recording_callback(check, || {
12384            prepare.call((task_use.clone_ref(py),), Some(&kwargs))
12385        })?;
12386        resources
12387            .producers
12388            .lock()
12389            .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared producer owner mutex is poisoned"))?
12390            .push(prepared.clone().unbind());
12391        let memory = recording_callback(check, || prepared.getattr("memory_scope"))?;
12392        resources
12393            .producers
12394            .lock()
12395            .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared producer owner mutex is poisoned"))?
12396            .push(memory.clone().unbind());
12397        let mut memory_owner = PreparedMemoryScope::new(py, &memory, &check)?;
12398        let enter = recording_callback(check, || memory.getattr("__enter__"))?;
12399        recording_callback(check, || {
12400            let entered = enter.call0()?;
12401            memory_owner.entered = true;
12402            Ok(entered)
12403        })?;
12404        let recorded = (|| -> PyResult<()> {
12405            let prepare_successors =
12406                recording_callback(check, || prepared.getattr("prepare_unpublished_successors"))?;
12407            recording_callback(check, || {
12408                let value = prepare_successors.call0()?;
12409                if !value.is_none() {
12410                    return Err(invalid(
12411                        "prepare_unpublished_successors must return None, not a host result",
12412                    ));
12413                }
12414                Ok(())
12415            })?;
12416            let external: Arc<dyn Send + Sync> = resources.clone();
12417            let (mut capture, capture_stream) = {
12418                let mut owner = session.owner()?;
12419                owner
12420                    .begin_prepared_segment(vec![external])
12421                    .map_err(xlog_err)?
12422            };
12423            if capture_stream.cu_stream() != stream.cu_stream() {
12424                return Err(invalid(
12425                    "native recording stream changed after cold preparation",
12426                ));
12427            }
12428            for step in &steps {
12429                check()?;
12430                let native = step.borrow(py).inner.clone();
12431                let admission_error = std::cell::RefCell::new(None);
12432                let admission = capture.add_conditional_if(
12433                    &stream,
12434                    |handle| -> PyResult<()> {
12435                        let result = session
12436                            .owner()?
12437                            .record_prepared_step_admission(&native, handle)
12438                            .map_err(xlog_err);
12439                        if let Err(value) = &result {
12440                            *admission_error.borrow_mut() = Some(value.clone_ref(py));
12441                        }
12442                        result
12443                    },
12444                    |body| {
12445                        body.capture_on_stream(&stream, || -> PyResult<()> {
12446                            let result = session
12447                                .owner()?
12448                                .record_prepared_step_inputs(&native)
12449                                .map_err(xlog_err);
12450                            if let Err(value) = &result {
12451                                *admission_error.borrow_mut() = Some(value.clone_ref(py));
12452                            }
12453                            result
12454                        })
12455                    },
12456                );
12457                if let Err(graph_error) = admission {
12458                    return Err(admission_error
12459                        .into_inner()
12460                        .unwrap_or_else(|| xlog_err(graph_error)));
12461                }
12462
12463                for bank in 0..2 {
12464                    let requested_error = std::cell::RefCell::new(None);
12465                    let requested = capture.add_conditional_if(
12466                        &stream,
12467                        |handle| -> PyResult<()> {
12468                            let result = session
12469                                .owner()?
12470                                .record_prepared_step_requested_bank_gate(&native, bank, handle)
12471                                .map_err(xlog_err);
12472                            if let Err(value) = &result {
12473                                *requested_error.borrow_mut() = Some(value.clone_ref(py));
12474                            }
12475                            result
12476                        },
12477                        |body| {
12478                            body.capture_on_stream(&stream, || -> PyResult<()> {
12479                                let result = (|| {
12480                                    session
12481                                        .owner()?
12482                                        .begin_prepared_step_bank_capture(&native, bank)
12483                                        .map_err(xlog_err)?;
12484                                    session
12485                                        .owner()?
12486                                        .record_prepared_bank_model_content(&native, bank)
12487                                        .map_err(xlog_err)?;
12488                                    let enqueue = recording_callback(check, || {
12489                                        prepared.getattr("enqueue_step")
12490                                    })?;
12491                                    recording_callback(check, || {
12492                                        let value = enqueue.call1((step.clone_ref(py), bank))?;
12493                                        if !value.is_none() {
12494                                            return Err(invalid(
12495                                                "enqueue_step must return None, not a host result",
12496                                            ));
12497                                        }
12498                                        Ok(())
12499                                    })?;
12500                                    session
12501                                        .owner()?
12502                                        .enqueue_prepared_transition(&native, bank)
12503                                        .map_err(xlog_err)
12504                                })();
12505                                if let Err(value) = &result {
12506                                    *requested_error.borrow_mut() = Some(value.clone_ref(py));
12507                                }
12508                                result
12509                            })
12510                        },
12511                    );
12512                    if let Err(graph_error) = requested {
12513                        return Err(requested_error
12514                            .into_inner()
12515                            .unwrap_or_else(|| xlog_err(graph_error)));
12516                    }
12517                }
12518
12519                let drain_error = std::cell::RefCell::new(None);
12520                let drain = capture.add_conditional_if(
12521                    &stream,
12522                    |handle| -> PyResult<()> {
12523                        let result = session
12524                            .owner()?
12525                            .record_prepared_step_drain_gate(&native, handle)
12526                            .map_err(xlog_err);
12527                        if let Err(value) = &result {
12528                            *drain_error.borrow_mut() = Some(value.clone_ref(py));
12529                        }
12530                        result
12531                    },
12532                    |body| {
12533                        body.capture_on_stream(&stream, || -> PyResult<()> {
12534                            let result = session
12535                                .owner()?
12536                                .enqueue_prepared_drain(&native)
12537                                .map_err(xlog_err);
12538                            if let Err(value) = &result {
12539                                *drain_error.borrow_mut() = Some(value.clone_ref(py));
12540                            }
12541                            result
12542                        })
12543                    },
12544                );
12545                if let Err(graph_error) = drain {
12546                    return Err(drain_error
12547                        .into_inner()
12548                        .unwrap_or_else(|| xlog_err(graph_error)));
12549                }
12550
12551                let release_error = std::cell::RefCell::new(None);
12552                let release = capture.add_conditional_if(
12553                    &stream,
12554                    |handle| -> PyResult<()> {
12555                        let result = session
12556                            .owner()?
12557                            .record_prepared_step_active_gate(&native, handle)
12558                            .map_err(xlog_err);
12559                        if let Err(value) = &result {
12560                            *release_error.borrow_mut() = Some(value.clone_ref(py));
12561                        }
12562                        result
12563                    },
12564                    |body| {
12565                        body.capture_on_stream(&stream, || -> PyResult<()> {
12566                            let result = session
12567                                .owner()?
12568                                .record_prepared_step_release(&native)
12569                                .map_err(xlog_err);
12570                            if let Err(value) = &result {
12571                                *release_error.borrow_mut() = Some(value.clone_ref(py));
12572                            }
12573                            result
12574                        })
12575                    },
12576                );
12577                if let Err(graph_error) = release {
12578                    return Err(release_error
12579                        .into_inner()
12580                        .unwrap_or_else(|| xlog_err(graph_error)));
12581                }
12582                check()?;
12583            }
12584            // Instantiation and any graph destructor run outside the owner lock.
12585            let mut executable = Some(capture.instantiate().map_err(xlog_err)?);
12586            check()?;
12587            let installed = session
12588                .owner()?
12589                .finish_prepared_segment(&mut executable)
12590                .map_err(xlog_err);
12591            drop(executable);
12592            installed
12593        })();
12594        // Cleanup is mandatory even when a callback invalidated the task. It
12595        // cannot hide that refusal, replace the graph, or suppress an exception.
12596        let mut delivery_cleanup = Ok(());
12597        for step in &steps {
12598            if let Err(error) = step.borrow(py).finish_gradient_delivery_recording(py) {
12599                if delivery_cleanup.is_ok() {
12600                    delivery_cleanup = Err(error);
12601                }
12602            }
12603        }
12604        let before_cleanup = finish_with_cleanup(py, check(), delivery_cleanup);
12605        let cleanup = memory_owner.finish(recorded.as_ref().err());
12606        let cleanup = finish_with_cleanup(py, before_cleanup, cleanup);
12607        let cleanup = finish_with_cleanup(py, cleanup, check());
12608        finish_with_cleanup(py, recorded, cleanup)?;
12609        issued.state()?.finish_build(&scope)?;
12610        guard.committed = true;
12611        Ok(())
12612    }
12613
12614    /// Submit the original built graph exactly once, await actual completion,
12615    /// and refresh original rights before exposing any result (including refusal
12616    /// and drain). No producer callback runs between submission and completion.
12617    /// Return (genuine final parent, ordered step rows). Each row is
12618    /// (prepared_step, transition_or_None, skipped_status, refusal_or_None,
12619    /// policy_invocation_or_None, selected_bank_or_None). Refusal is a typed native
12620    /// evidence dictionary. Every completed row carries the validated publication bank.
12621    /// A completed drain has no policy invocation or fabricated RNG draw.
12622    #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
12623    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, operation, snapshot, refresh_snapshot))]
12624    fn execute_segment(
12625        &self,
12626        py: Python<'_>,
12627        task_use: Py<PySemanticTransitionTaskUse>,
12628        operation: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12629        snapshot: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12630        refresh_snapshot: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12631    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
12632        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
12633        session.require_creator()?;
12634        let issued = task_use.borrow(py);
12635        self.require_read_issued(&issued)?;
12636        if session.recording.load(Ordering::Acquire) || session.retiring.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
12637            return Err(invalid(
12638                "segment submission cannot overlap a producer ownership scope",
12639            ));
12640        }
12641        if !refresh_snapshot.is_callable() {
12642            return Err(invalid(
12643                "completion requires the original current authority callback",
12644            ));
12645        }
12646        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
12647        let operation = ColdValue::read(operation, &mut budget, 0)?
12648            .text()?
12649            .to_owned();
12650        let snapshot = AuthoritySnapshot::parse(&ColdValue::read(snapshot, &mut budget, 0)?)?;
12651        let (scope, steps) = {
12652            let stored = session
12653                .prepared_segment
12654                .lock()
12655                .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared segment mutex is poisoned"))?;
12656            let stored = stored
12657                .as_ref()
12658                .ok_or_else(|| invalid("no original built segment"))?;
12659            if stored.task_use.as_ptr() != task_use.as_ptr() {
12660                return Err(invalid("built segment belongs to another task use"));
12661            }
12662            (
12663                Arc::clone(&stored.scope),
12664                stored
12665                    .steps
12666                    .iter()
12667                    .map(|step| step.clone_ref(py))
12668                    .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
12669            )
12670        };
12671        let mut guard = PreparedBuildGuard {
12672            session: &session,
12673            task_use: &issued,
12674            committed: false,
12675        };
12676        let expected = {
12677            let mut owner = session.owner()?;
12678            issued.require_identity(&owner)?;
12679            issued.require_learning_operation(&owner, &operation)?;
12680            let mut state = issued.state()?;
12681            state.admit_built_segment(&scope, &issued.authority, operation.clone(), snapshot)?;
12682            let expected = Self::execution_binding(&state, false)?;
12683            owner
12684                .launch_prepared_segment(state.snapshot.canonical.clone())
12685                .map_err(xlog_err)?;
12686            expected
12687        };
12688        let shared = &*session;
12689        let outcomes = py.detach(|| {
12690            let mut owner = shared.witness_owner()?;
12691            owner.complete_prepared_segment().map_err(xlog_err)
12692        })?;
12693        let check = || -> PyResult<()> {
12694            self.require_read_issued(&issued)?;
12695            let owner = session.owner()?;
12696            issued.require_identity(&owner)?;
12697            if !owner.prepared_segment_completion_known()
12698                || Self::execution_binding(&*issued.state()?, false)? != expected
12699            {
12700                return Err(invalid(
12701                    "completed segment authority changed during result handoff",
12702                ));
12703            }
12704            Ok(())
12705        };
12706        let fresh = recording_callback(check, || refresh_snapshot.call0())?;
12707        let fresh = AuthoritySnapshot::parse(&ColdValue::read(&fresh, &mut budget, 0)?)?;
12708        let lease = {
12709            let mut owner = session.owner()?;
12710            issued.require_identity(&owner)?;
12711            let mut state = issued.state()?;
12712            if Self::execution_binding(&state, false)? != expected {
12713                return Err(invalid(
12714                    "completion snapshot no longer belongs to this original operation",
12715                ));
12716            }
12717            state.revalidate_activation(&issued.authority, fresh)?;
12718            owner.acquire().map_err(xlog_err)?
12719        };
12720        let parent = Py::new(
12721            py,
12722            PySemanticPublishedParent {
12723                session: self.session.clone_ref(py),
12724                task_use: task_use.clone_ref(py),
12725                inner: Mutex::new(lease),
12726                continuation_producers: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
12727            },
12728        )?;
12729        if outcomes.len() != steps.len() {
12730            return Err(invalid("native completion changed the original step count"));
12731        }
12732        let mut rows = Vec::with_capacity(steps.len());
12733        for (step, completed) in steps.into_iter().zip(outcomes) {
12734            let (transition, status, refusal, invocation, bank) = match completed {
12735                xlog_cuda::SemanticPreparedStepOutcome::Skipped { status, .. } => {
12736                    (None, status, None, py.None(), None)
12737                }
12738                xlog_cuda::SemanticPreparedStepOutcome::Completed {
12739                    invocation,
12740                    bank,
12741                    transition,
12742                    outcome,
12743                    ..
12744                } => {
12745                    let label = match transition {
12746                        SemanticTransitionKind::Proposal => "proposal",
12747                        SemanticTransitionKind::Recompute => "recompute",
12748                        SemanticTransitionKind::Update => "update",
12749                        SemanticTransitionKind::Drain => "drain",
12750                    };
12751                    let refusal = transition_refusal_report(py, &outcome)?;
12752                    let invocation = if transition == SemanticTransitionKind::Proposal {
12753                        Py::new(
12754                            py,
12755                            self.issue_prepared_policy_invocation(
12756                                py,
12757                                task_use.clone_ref(py),
12758                                step.clone_ref(py),
12759                                invocation,
12760                                outcome,
12761                                operation == "training",
12762                            )?,
12763                        )?
12764                        .into_any()
12765                    } else {
12766                        py.None()
12767                    };
12768                    (Some(label), 0, refusal, invocation, Some(bank))
12769                }
12770            };
12771            rows.push(
12772                (step, transition, status, refusal, invocation, bank)
12773                    .into_pyobject(py)?
12774                    .unbind(),
12775            );
12776        }
12777        let result = (parent, PyTuple::new(py, rows)?)
12778            .into_pyobject(py)?
12779            .unbind();
12780        guard.committed = true;
12781        Ok(result)
12782    }
12783
12784    /// Creator-thread terminal cleanup after every original backward/final-use.
12785    /// Join exact consumer streams before releasing the graph or invoking the
12786    /// original producer's finish_segment(). External aliases/invocations must
12787    /// be retired by their owners; native custody refuses premature release.
12788    /// Unknown completion retains all original resources and cannot enter here.
12789    #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
12790    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, consumer_streams))]
12791    fn retire_segment(
12792        &self,
12793        py: Python<'_>,
12794        task_use: Py<PySemanticTransitionTaskUse>,
12795        consumer_streams: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12796    ) -> PyResult<()> {
12797        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
12798        session.require_creator()?;
12799        self.require_read_issued(&task_use.borrow(py))?;
12800        if session.importing.load(Ordering::Acquire)
12801            || session.recording.load(Ordering::Acquire)
12802            || session.retiring.swap(true, Ordering::AcqRel)
12803        {
12804            return Err(invalid(
12805                "segment retirement cannot be nested or overlap recording/import",
12806            ));
12807        }
12808        let _retirement = PreparedRetirementGuard(&session.retiring);
12809        let snapshot = task_use.borrow(py).state()?.snapshot.canonical.clone();
12810        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
12811        let streams = ColdValue::read(consumer_streams, &mut budget, 0)?;
12812        let streams = streams
12813            .sequence()?
12814            .iter()
12815            .map(ColdValue::unsigned)
12816            .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
12817        if streams.is_empty()
12818            || streams
12819                .iter()
12820                .any(|&stream| stream == 0 || stream == 2 || stream > i64::MAX as u64)
12821        {
12822            return Err(invalid(
12823                "final segment retirement requires exact supported consumer streams",
12824            ));
12825        }
12826        let (steps, resources, producers_retired) = {
12827            let stored = session
12828                .prepared_segment
12829                .lock()
12830                .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared segment mutex is poisoned"))?;
12831            let stored = stored
12832                .as_ref()
12833                .ok_or_else(|| invalid("no original prepared segment to retire"))?;
12834            if stored.task_use.as_ptr() != task_use.as_ptr() {
12835                return Err(invalid("segment retirement belongs to another task use"));
12836            }
12837            (
12838                stored
12839                    .steps
12840                    .iter()
12841                    .map(|step| step.clone_ref(py))
12842                    .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
12843                Arc::clone(&stored.resources),
12844                stored.producers_retired,
12845            )
12846        };
12847        let graph = {
12848            let mut owner = session.owner()?;
12849            for step in &steps {
12850                owner
12851                    .quiesce_prepared_step(&step.borrow(py).inner, &streams)
12852                    .map_err(xlog_err)?;
12853            }
12854            owner
12855                .take_prepared_executable_for_retirement()
12856                .map_err(xlog_err)?
12857        };
12858        drop(graph);
12859        let prepared = {
12860            let retained = resources
12861                .producers
12862                .lock()
12863                .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared producer owner mutex is poisoned"))?;
12864            retained
12865                .get(1)
12866                .ok_or_else(|| invalid("original prepared producer is absent"))?
12867                .clone_ref(py)
12868        };
12869        if !producers_retired {
12870            let check = || -> PyResult<()> {
12871                let issued = task_use.borrow(py);
12872                self.require_read_issued(&issued)?;
12873                if issued.state()?.snapshot.canonical != snapshot {
12874                    return Err(invalid(
12875                        "original task authority changed during producer retirement",
12876                    ));
12877                }
12878                Ok(())
12879            };
12880            let finish = recording_callback(check, || prepared.bind(py).getattr("finish_segment"))?;
12881            let finished = recording_callback(check, || finish.call0())?;
12882            if !finished.is_none() {
12883                return Err(invalid(
12884                    "finish_segment must return None after retiring original producers",
12885                ));
12886            }
12887            session
12888                .prepared_segment
12889                .lock()
12890                .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared segment mutex is poisoned"))?
12891                .as_mut()
12892                .ok_or_else(|| invalid("original segment was removed during producer retirement"))?
12893                .producers_retired = true;
12894        }
12895        for step in &steps {
12896            let step = step.borrow(py);
12897            let continuation = std::mem::take(
12898                &mut *step
12899                    .continuation_producers
12900                    .lock()
12901                    .map_err(|_| invalid("continuation producer ownership mutex is poisoned"))?,
12902            );
12903            let policy = std::mem::take(
12904                &mut *step
12905                    .policy_inputs
12906                    .lock()
12907                    .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared policy inputs mutex is poisoned"))?,
12908            );
12909            drop(policy);
12910            drop(continuation);
12911        }
12912        drain_export_owners();
12913        for step in &steps {
12914            session
12915                .owner()?
12916                .release_prepared_step(&step.borrow(py).inner, &streams)
12917                .map_err(xlog_err)?;
12918            // Preserve only unretired steps if another external alias delays a
12919            // later release. A retry never re-releases an already removed owner.
12920            let removed = {
12921                let mut stored = session
12922                    .prepared_segment
12923                    .lock()
12924                    .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared segment mutex is poisoned"))?;
12925                let stored = stored
12926                    .as_mut()
12927                    .ok_or_else(|| invalid("original segment disappeared during retirement"))?;
12928                let index = stored
12929                    .steps
12930                    .iter()
12931                    .position(|original| original.as_ptr() == step.as_ptr())
12932                    .ok_or_else(|| invalid("original retirement step changed"))?;
12933                stored.steps.remove(index)
12934            };
12935            drop(removed);
12936        }
12937        let native_resources = session
12938            .owner()?
12939            .take_prepared_resources_for_retirement()
12940            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
12941        drop(native_resources);
12942        let retained = session
12943            .prepared_segment
12944            .lock()
12945            .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared segment mutex is poisoned"))?
12946            .take();
12947        drop(retained);
12948        drop(resources);
12949        drop(prepared);
12950        drop(steps);
12951        drain_export_owners();
12952        Ok(())
12953    }
12954
12955    /// Permanently abort this shared native Session after trusted application
12956    /// validation fails, including verification after bind_parent has published.
12957    /// Saved task uses, parents and other controllers of this same Session can
12958    /// no longer continue execution. No current task use is required, and
12959    /// repeated abort calls are safe. Resources remain retained; abort performs
12960    /// no device synchronization, resource release or reset. A fatal CUDA error
12961    /// still requires terminating the task process.
12962    fn abort(&self, py: Python<'_>) -> PyResult<()> {
12963        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
12964        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
12965        if session.learning_preparing.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
12966            return Err(invalid("resolve or abandon the retained learning-phase transition before aborting its Session"));
12967        }
12968        session.owner()?.abort();
12969        Ok(())
12970    }
12971
12972    /// Inspect cold native observation coverage before constructing the task's
12973    /// authority graph. The scope and live authorities are the same original
12974    /// inputs later supplied to import_task; the replay transport, exact
12975    /// selection and byte limits are also identical. No replay is executed or
12976    /// restored here, and import_task independently checks current authority.
12977    /// Returns (root_digest, root_extents, query_records, contributors), where
12978    /// each contributor is (query_ordinal, original_target_or_None, original_support).
12979    /// These are original admission coordinates, not learned features, current
12980    /// device receipts or use grants. A derived target remains None even when
12981    /// its value equals an admitted query. import_task independently recomputes
12982    /// this coverage and requires original targets before issuing its TaskUse.
12983    #[pyo3(signature = (*, task_scope, live_authorities, statement_records, allowed_support_records, task_program_source, task_query_ordinals, task_scoring, admissible_truth_masks, actor_eligible, replay_rows, replay_selection, max_material_bytes, max_total_material_bytes, max_evidence_bytes))]
12984    #[expect(
12985        clippy::too_many_arguments,
12986        reason = "observation coverage retains every independent task and replay input"
12987    )]
12988    fn task_observation_roots(
12989        &self,
12990        py: Python<'_>,
12991        task_scope: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12992        live_authorities: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12993        statement_records: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12994        allowed_support_records: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12995        task_program_source: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12996        task_query_ordinals: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12997        task_scoring: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12998        admissible_truth_masks: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
12999        actor_eligible: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13000        replay_rows: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13001        replay_selection: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13002        max_material_bytes: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13003        max_total_material_bytes: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13004        max_evidence_bytes: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13005    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
13006        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
13007        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
13008        let scope = ColdValue::read(task_scope, &mut budget, 0)?.strings()?;
13009        if scope.len() != 5 {
13010            return Err(invalid("task_scope must contain five explicit fields"));
13011        }
13012        let live =
13013            parse_live_authorities(&ColdValue::read(live_authorities, &mut budget, 0)?, &scope)?;
13014        let [material_limit, total_material_limit, evidence_limit] = read_task_replay_limits(
13015            max_material_bytes,
13016            max_total_material_bytes,
13017            max_evidence_bytes,
13018            &mut budget,
13019        )?;
13020        let spec = read_task_evaluation_spec(
13021            statement_records,
13022            allowed_support_records,
13023            task_program_source,
13024            task_query_ordinals,
13025            task_scoring,
13026            admissible_truth_masks,
13027            actor_eligible,
13028            &mut budget,
13029        )?;
13030        let rows = read_replay_rows(
13031            replay_rows,
13032            &mut budget,
13033            material_limit,
13034            total_material_limit,
13035            evidence_limit,
13036        )?;
13037        let rows = parse_replay_rows_with_live(&rows, &live)?;
13038        let (_, selected) =
13039            decode_selected_replay(&rows, &ColdValue::read(replay_selection, &mut budget, 0)?)?;
13040        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
13041        let roots = session
13042            .owner()?
13043            .task_observation_roots(&spec, selected.as_ref().map(|binding| &binding.material))
13044            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
13045        Ok((
13046            PyBytes::new(py, roots.root_digest.as_bytes()),
13047            PyTuple::new(py, roots.root_extents)?,
13048            PyTuple::new(py, roots.query_records)?,
13049            PyTuple::new(py, roots.contributors)?,
13050        )
13051            .into_pyobject(py)?
13052            .unbind())
13053    }
13054
13055    /// Import resolved rights and lineage into this controller's real Session.
13056    ///
13057    /// All arguments are mandatory. ``task_scope`` is ``(controller, tenant,
13058    /// security_scope, request_scope, repository_scope)``. ``statement_records``
13059    /// contains the three admitted native observer statement indices;
13060    /// ``allowed_support_records`` contains admitted support indices.
13061    /// ``task_program_source`` is the complete authored XLOG observer program,
13062    /// including all concrete input facts. ``task_query_ordinals`` maps its three
13063    /// selected zero-arity query results to the ordered statement records.
13064    /// The native owner executes that program during every cold task binding.
13065    /// ``task_scoring`` supplies (correct, all_correct, work, improvement,
13066    /// refusal, spent) unsigned weights. ``admissible_truth_masks`` supplies three
13067    /// bit masks over (neither, true, false, both), in that bit order.
13068    ///
13069    /// ``training_domain`` is the original ``(manifests, loader)`` projection:
13070    /// manifests are sorted ``(sha256_hex, (entries, keys, records, bytes))``
13071    /// rows, and loader is ``((window, pad_id, mask_id, block_size), batch_size,
13072    /// mask_permille, training_seed, mask_policy_sha256_hex)``. The application
13073    /// must extract it from validated sealed inputs before the first action;
13074    /// native binding does not authenticate external manifest ownership. None
13075    /// explicitly means no prospective training arena and cannot be expanded
13076    /// into one during later admission. It grants no actor eligibility.
13077    ///
13078    /// ``training_objective`` is None only when replay_rows is empty. Otherwise it
13079    /// is ``(evaluator_f64_bits, coefficient_f32_bits, cost, truth_tokens, groups,
13080    /// canaries)``. The evaluator pair and nine coefficient words are exact IEEE
13081    /// bit patterns. Cost is the exact ``(unit_identity, positive_cap)`` from
13082    /// this controller's pre-import structural_cost_descriptor property; the
13083    /// native bound task checks both fields. Evaluator and coefficient bits must
13084    /// equal its pre-action ``task_objective_law()`` projection as well; a later
13085    /// arena cannot choose another interval or refit the coefficients. Each group is
13086    /// ``(kind, positive_denominator, strictly_increasing_row_ordinals)`` and the
13087    /// complete mandatory group roster must cover every row. ``truth_tokens`` maps
13088    /// neither, true, false and both to four distinct vocabulary ids. Each canary
13089    /// is ``(kind, row_ordinal, lower_f64_bits, upper_f64_bits, memory_limit,
13090    /// work_limit, obligation_positions_or_None, protected_positions_or_None)``.
13091    /// For symbolic-utility and goal-chain, the three obligation positions are
13092    /// model-logit positions in native query order: the token immediately after
13093    /// each position in the symbolic training view must equal the objective's
13094    /// canonical token for that task result's four-valued truth. They are not
13095    /// query ordinals, target-token positions, or physical model rows.
13096    /// Only retained behavior carries the nonempty, strictly increasing protected
13097    /// subset; retention labels outside that frozen set remain compensable. Native
13098    /// recomputes all identities and owns both rosters on device.
13099    ///
13100    /// ``live_authorities`` rows are ``(LiveProvenance.canonical(),
13101    /// retention_deadline_utc_us)``. ``replay_rows`` rows are
13102    /// ``(basis, identity, canonical_record_line, materials, evidence_bytes)``.
13103    /// ``basis`` is ``episode`` or ``anchor``. ``identity`` is the original
13104    /// ``(training_view, training_view_digest, content_sha256, source_length,
13105    /// block_size, target_triples)``; training_view retains the producer's nine
13106    /// canonical fields (manifest, example, split, tokenizer hash/revision,
13107    /// mask policy, seed, epoch, variant), including exact unbounded integers.
13108    /// No additional native identity or rewritten episode record is required.
13109    /// Targets retain ``(p, p, source_length+p)`` from the original projection,
13110    /// not a physical row permutation. The original training-view material
13111    /// retains its 136-byte header, answer boundary, supervision and geometry.
13112    /// An anchor retains its original admission evidence and retention group;
13113    /// that evidence cannot authorize native execution replay or actor credit.
13114    /// A language anchor has exactly the five original record fields and the
13115    /// three-field corpus admission evidence. A symbolic anchor additionally has
13116    /// ``semantic_task`` with exactly ``query_identity``,
13117    /// ``theory_program_identity`` and ``result_identity``. Its existing corpus
13118    /// admission evidence appends those three identities in that order. Native
13119    /// recomputes them from the ordered admitted statements and query selection,
13120    /// the admitted theory and complete executed observer source, and the exact
13121    /// observed result bytes plus three four-valued truths. The imported row must
13122    /// equal the task executed during this same cold binding.
13123    /// Materials are the complete ordered ``(MaterialReference.payload(),
13124    /// bytes_or_None)`` closure. Evidence is the original opaque bytes, not a
13125    /// caller-decoded receipt. Identity-only rows are not a replay carrier.
13126    /// The exact positive integers ``max_material_bytes``,
13127    /// ``max_total_material_bytes`` and ``max_evidence_bytes`` come from the
13128    /// trusted replay-kit caps. Material and evidence limits apply per item;
13129    /// the total counts each unique material SHA256 once across all rows.
13130    /// Equal material digests must name equal bytes and share retained storage.
13131    /// All limits are checked before copying payloads, and are not CUDA limits.
13132    ///
13133    /// ``dependencies`` rows are ``(identity, kind, data_parents, control_parents,
13134    /// live_envelope_refs, target_key_or_None, native_record_or_None)``. Kinds are ``constant``, ``source``,
13135    /// ``mask``, ``target_value`` and ``derived``. A target key is
13136    /// ``(replay_row_index, logical_position)``. The trusted caller supplies the
13137    /// complete graph and exact acquired MASK join; the importer rejects missing
13138    /// parents, cycles, missing MASK targets, and target-value ancestors through
13139    /// either edge kind. ``native_record`` is ``('statement', index)``,
13140    /// ``('support', index)`` or ``('observer', 0)``. The exact native observer,
13141    /// both queried statements, every allowed mutation support, and every actual
13142    /// queried-head contributor's original target/support must each have one
13143    /// distinct node. The cold task_observation_roots getter exposes that native
13144    /// coverage without granting mutation rights or claiming current causality.
13145    /// Their full closures are always joined with ``feedback_roots``, regardless
13146    /// of which feedback roots the caller explicitly lists. Observer zero names
13147    /// the retained program and the actual native execution bound to this task.
13148    ///
13149    /// ``initial_sources`` rows are ``(source_id, manifest_hash, tokenizer_hash,
13150    /// tokenizer_revision, manifest_entry, tokens)``. The trusted application
13151    /// obtains observed tokens from its data reader and the complete entry from
13152    /// the same sealed manifest. The ten-field entry retains example, split,
13153    /// acquired/transform/normalized digests, decontamination, leakage keys,
13154    /// full corpus/live origin, admission and the observed-field binding.
