13155    /// That final binding is ``(field, payload_sha256, transformation_sha256,
13156    /// token_count)``. The normalized mixed training-row digest is never used
13157    /// as the observation digest. Native verifies the actual observed payload
13158    /// and transformation; provenance references alone grant no operation.
13159    /// ``source_mapping`` rows are ``(source_id, token_offset, logical_position)``;
13160    /// no second token ID is accepted. Each source resolves through the same
13161    /// complete data/control graph; target-value ancestry is rejected even when
13162    /// the source is not explicitly listed as a feedback root.
13163    ///
13164    /// Each separate grant family contains ``(grant_ref, issuer_provenance,
13165    /// decision, task_ref, dependency_ids, expiry, revocation_ref)``. Decision is
13166    /// explicitly ``allow`` or ``deny``; training records additionally contain the
13167    /// canonical learning purpose as their eighth field. Grant references and
13168    /// issuer strings retain provenance, not cryptographic authentication. The
13169    /// resolved decision originates in the trusted controlling application.
13170    /// Empty explicit families grant no corresponding use; no rights are defaulted.
13171    /// A training use requires one compatible learning purpose across its whole
13172    /// dependency closure. Independently scoped grants are intersected for this
13173    /// shared use, not combined into a wider model-use permission.
13174    ///
13175    /// ``snapshot`` is ``(revision, observed_at, preregistered_segment_end, live_snapshots,
13176    /// revoked_grant_refs)``; each live snapshot is ``(bound_envelope.canonical(),
13177    /// segment_end, revoked_refs)``. Times are ``(original_ISO_string, utc_us)``;
13178    /// the application uses the canonical timezone-aware parser before import.
13179    /// The task-level end is mandatory even for corpus-only tasks; each live
13180    /// deadline must equal it exactly and refresh cannot change it.
13181    /// Snapshot revision is supplied by the trusted current authority source,
13182    /// not inferred from a hash or native Session creation. Revoked references
13183    /// must be sorted and unique. This bounded transport accepts admitted observed data,
13184    /// exact builtin primitive containers, at most 32 nesting levels and
13185    /// 16,777,216 primitive-input units: one per node plus scalar UTF-8 bytes.
13186    /// This is an input bound, not a native heap or CUDA allocation budget.
13187    /// ``replay_selection`` is None for a fresh task, otherwise the original
13188    /// (row_ordinal, complete_row_identity). All rows retain their original order;
13189    /// validating their material does not claim to have executed every row.
13190    /// Fresh import requires replay_operation and all callbacks to be None.
13191    /// Selected replay requires an explicit current inference/training operation
13192    /// and trusted application callbacks, not permissions inferred from archive.
13193    ///
13194    /// restore_invocation(task_use, restored_parent, full_row, transition) returns
13195    /// (original_model_output, finalize_continuation, consumer_stream). The second
13196    /// value is a callable retaining that original invocation, not an already
13197    /// captured continuation. finalize_continuation(task_use, restored_parent,
13198    /// original_model_output) runs once after proposal policy snapshots are bound,
13199    /// before capture/launch, and returns (text_rows, text_row_count, selected_text,
13200    /// active_rows, active_row_count, numerical_admissibility, tensors,
13201    /// producer_witness) for a non-drawing transition. A proposal inserts original numerical_blocks,
13202    /// model_schema_digest and model_identity before tensors. Its seventh CUDA
13203    /// service is FP64[N,2,3], covered by the same transient witness; the two
13204    /// identities are bytes from the original sealed model contract.
13205    /// For a proposal, pack_policy(task_use, restored_parent, original_model_output)
13206    /// returns (binding, text_logits, parameters, product_support,
13207    /// component_baselines, parameter_errors, baseline_errors, parameter_domains,
13208    /// text_domains, baseline_domains, producer_witness), computed by the same
13209    /// Runtime before the final continuation is captured. For
13210    /// recompute/drain pack_policy must be None; no policy draw is synthesized.
13211    /// These callbacks receive genuine task-bound readers only within a dynamic
13212    /// import read scope; ordinary controller execution/backward remains closed.
13213    ///
13214    /// After the first full native successor comparison, finish_invocation(task_use,
13215    /// restored_parent) destroys the Runtime's temporary graph/aliases/witnesses
13216    /// and returns its exact consumer-stream tuple. refresh_snapshot() then
13217    /// obtains a newer current authority snapshot. Native joins those streams,
13218    /// verifies full P/S again after all callbacks, and releases both readers.
13219    /// Only then does this same TaskUse become Imported. Any failed import
13220    /// permanently aborts the shared Session, including saved callback references.
13221    /// No Session, task-state or reader mutex is held across a Python callback.
13222    #[pyo3(signature = (*, task_ref, task_scope, statement_records, allowed_support_records, task_program_source, task_query_ordinals, task_scoring, task_priority_levels, admissible_truth_masks, actor_eligible, live_authorities, replay_rows, training_objective, training_domain, max_material_bytes, max_total_material_bytes, max_evidence_bytes, dependencies, feedback_roots, publication_grants, inference_grants, training_grants, initial_sources, source_mapping, snapshot, replay_selection, replay_operation, restore_invocation, pack_policy, finish_invocation, refresh_snapshot, resolve_checkpoint=None, max_checkpoint_bytes=None, max_total_checkpoint_bytes=None, retain_policy=false))]
13223    #[expect(
13224        clippy::too_many_arguments,
13225        reason = "task import binds the complete authority, replay, and callback contract"
13226    )]
13227    fn import_task(
13228        &self,
13229        py: Python<'_>,
13230        task_ref: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13231        task_scope: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13232        statement_records: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13233        allowed_support_records: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13234        task_program_source: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13235        task_query_ordinals: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13236        task_scoring: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13237        task_priority_levels: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13238        admissible_truth_masks: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13239        actor_eligible: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13240        live_authorities: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13241        replay_rows: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13242        training_objective: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13243        training_domain: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13244        max_material_bytes: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13245        max_total_material_bytes: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13246        max_evidence_bytes: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13247        dependencies: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13248        feedback_roots: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13249        publication_grants: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13250        inference_grants: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13251        training_grants: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13252        initial_sources: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13253        source_mapping: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13254        snapshot: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13255        replay_selection: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13256        replay_operation: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13257        restore_invocation: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13258        pack_policy: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13259        finish_invocation: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13260        refresh_snapshot: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13261        resolve_checkpoint: Option<&Bound<'_, PyAny>>,
13262        max_checkpoint_bytes: Option<&Bound<'_, PyAny>>,
13263        max_total_checkpoint_bytes: Option<&Bound<'_, PyAny>>,
13264        retain_policy: bool,
13265    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyAny>> {
13266        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
13267        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
13268        let mut import = ColdImportGuard::begin(&session, None)?;
13269        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
13270        let [material_limit, total_material_limit, evidence_limit] = read_task_replay_limits(
13271            max_material_bytes,
13272            max_total_material_bytes,
13273            max_evidence_bytes,
13274            &mut budget,
13275        )?;
13276        let values = [
13277            task_ref,
13278            task_scope,
13279            live_authorities,
13280            replay_rows,
13281            dependencies,
13282            feedback_roots,
13283            publication_grants,
13284            inference_grants,
13285            training_grants,
13286            task_priority_levels,
13287        ]
13288        .into_iter()
13289        .enumerate()
13290        .map(|(index, value)| {
13291            if index == 3 {
13292                read_replay_rows(
13293                    value,
13294                    &mut budget,
13295                    material_limit,
13296                    total_material_limit,
13297                    evidence_limit,
13298                )
13299            } else {
13300                ColdValue::read(value, &mut budget, 0)
13301            }
13302        })
13303        .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
13304        let mut authority = TaskAuthority::parse(&values)?;
13305        let training_views = authority
13306            .replay
13307            .iter()
13308            .map(ReplayRow::training_view_row)
13309            .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
13310        let training_objective_value = ColdValue::read(training_objective, &mut budget, 0)?;
13311        let training_domain_value = ColdValue::read(training_domain, &mut budget, 0)?;
13312        let training_objective = read_training_objective(&training_objective_value)?;
13313        if training_views.is_empty() != training_objective.is_none() {
13314            return Err(invalid(
13315                "training objective must exist exactly when replay rows exist",
13316            ));
13317        }
13318        let initial_sources = ColdValue::read(initial_sources, &mut budget, 0)?;
13319        let source_mapping = ColdValue::read(source_mapping, &mut budget, 0)?;
13320        authority.bind_initial_sources(&initial_sources, &source_mapping)?;
13321        let mut snapshot = AuthoritySnapshot::parse(&ColdValue::read(snapshot, &mut budget, 0)?)?;
13322        authority.check_snapshot(&snapshot)?;
13323        let evaluation = read_task_evaluation_values(
13324            statement_records,
13325            allowed_support_records,
13326            task_program_source,
13327            task_query_ordinals,
13328            task_scoring,
13329            admissible_truth_masks,
13330            actor_eligible,
13331            &mut budget,
13332        )?;
13333        if let Some(source) = &session.editable_observer_source {
13334            if evaluation[2].text()? != source {
13335                return Err(invalid("task observer source differs from its admission"));
13336            }
13337        }
13338        let spec = task_evaluation_spec(
13339            &evaluation,
13340            authority.priority_levels.clone(),
13341            session.editable_program.clone(),
13342            &training_domain_value,
13343        )?;
13344        let checkpoint_referents = resolve_replay_checkpoint_referents(
13345            py,
13346            &authority,
13347            &mut snapshot,
13348            resolve_checkpoint,
13349            refresh_snapshot,
13350            max_checkpoint_bytes,
13351            max_total_checkpoint_bytes,
13352        )?;
13353        let replay_selection = ColdValue::read(replay_selection, &mut budget, 0)?;
13354        let (selection, selected_material) =
13355            decode_selected_replay(&authority.replay, &replay_selection)?;
13356        let observations = session
13357            .owner()?
13358            .task_observation_roots(
13359                &spec,
13360                selected_material.as_ref().map(|binding| &binding.material),
13361            )
13362            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
13363        authority.bind_native_reads(&observations, &spec.allowed_support_records)?;
13364        let goal_witness = authority.goal_witness(&observations);
13365        let operation = ColdValue::read(replay_operation, &mut budget, 0)?;
13366        let (phase, transition) = if let Some(material) = &selected_material {
13367            let operation = operation.text()?.to_owned();
13368            authority.check_use(&operation, &snapshot, true)?;
13369            for callback in [restore_invocation, finish_invocation, refresh_snapshot] {
13370                if !callback.is_callable() {
13371                    return Err(invalid("selected replay requires trusted restore, cleanup and current-authority callbacks"));
13372                }
13373            }
13374            let kind = material.material.transition_kind();
13375            if retain_policy && kind != SemanticTransitionKind::Proposal {
13376                return Err(invalid("retained replay requires an original Proposal"));
13377            }
13378            if kind == SemanticTransitionKind::Proposal {
13379                if !pack_policy.is_callable() {
13380                    return Err(invalid(
13381                        "proposal replay requires its real Runtime policy packer",
13382                    ));
13383                }
13384                #[cfg(not(feature = "semantic-policy"))]
13385                return Err(invalid("proposal replay requires a semantic-policy build"));
13386            } else if !pack_policy.is_none() {
13387                return Err(invalid("no-draw replay must not supply a policy packer"));
13388            }
13389            import.original_decisions = Some(Arc::clone(&material.original_decisions));
13390            (
13391                TaskUsePhase::Importing {
13392                    operation,
13393                    reads: false,
13394                },
13395                Some(kind),
13396            )
13397        } else {
13398            if retain_policy {
13399                return Err(invalid(
13400                    "retained replay requires a selected original Proposal",
13401                ));
13402            }
13403            if operation != ColdValue::None
13404                || [restore_invocation, pack_policy, finish_invocation]
13405                    .iter()
13406                    .any(|callback| !callback.is_none())
13407                || (checkpoint_referents.is_empty() && !refresh_snapshot.is_none())
13408            {
13409                return Err(invalid(
13410                    "fresh import requires no replay operation or callbacks",
13411                ));
13412            }
13413            (TaskUsePhase::Imported, None)
13414        };
13415        let (identity, task_epoch) = {
13416            let mut owner = session.owner()?;
13417            owner.bind_task_evaluation(spec).map_err(xlog_err)?;
13418            owner
13419                .bind_task_goal_witness(goal_witness)
13420                .map_err(xlog_err)?;
13421            if !checkpoint_referents.is_empty() {
13422                let native_task = TaskCheckpointBinding::from_owner(&owner)?;
13423                if checkpoint_referents
13424                    .iter()
13425                    .any(|referent| !referent.task.same_task_content(native_task))
13426                {
13427                    return Err(invalid(
13428                        "actor checkpoint differs from the current native task content or scoring law",
13429                    ));
13430                }
13431            }
13432            if let Some(objective) = training_objective {
13433                owner
13434                    .bind_training_view_arena(training_views, objective)
13435                    .map_err(xlog_err)?;
13436            }
13437            if let Some(material) = &selected_material {
13438                owner
13439                    .restore_replay_material(&material.material)
13440                    .map_err(xlog_err)?;
13441            }
13442            (
13443                *owner
13444                    .task_evaluation_identity()
13445                    .ok_or_else(|| invalid("native import lost its task binding"))?
13446                    .as_bytes(),
13447                owner.task_evaluation_epoch(),
13448            )
13449        };
13450        let task_use = Py::new(
13451            py,
13452            PySemanticTransitionTaskUse {
13453                session: self.session.clone_ref(py),
13454                controller: Arc::clone(&self.identity),
13455                issuance: import.issuance.clone(),
13456                importing: Arc::clone(&session.importing),
13457                task_identity: identity,
13458                task_epoch,
13459                authority,
13460                checkpoint: TaskCheckpointSeed {
13461                    authority: values,
13462                    evaluation,
13463                    training_objective: training_objective_value,
13464                    training_domain: training_domain_value,
13465                    initial_sources,
13466                    source_mapping,
13467                    replay_selection,
13468                },
13469                state: Mutex::new(TaskUseState { phase, snapshot }),
13470                delivery: Mutex::new(None),
13471            },
13472        )?;
13473        let mut retained = None;
13474        if let (Some(ordinal), Some(material), Some(kind)) =
13475            (selection, selected_material, transition)
13476        {
13477            let replay = self.replay_import(
13478                py,
13479                &task_use,
13480                ordinal,
13481                material,
13482                kind,
13483                restore_invocation,
13484                pack_policy,
13485                finish_invocation,
13486                refresh_snapshot,
13487                &import,
13488                retain_policy,
13489            );
13490            match replay {
13491                Ok(member) => retained = member,
13492                Err(error) => {
13493                    if let Ok(mut state) = task_use.borrow(py).state() {
13494                        state.phase = TaskUsePhase::Refused;
13495                    }
13496                    return Err(error);
13497                }
13498            }
13499        }
13500        if let Some(member) = retained {
13501            let result = (task_use, member).into_pyobject(py)?.unbind().into_any();
13502            import.committed = true;
13503            import.deferred = true;
13504            return Ok(result);
13505        }
13506        import.committed = true;
13507        Ok(task_use.into_any())
13508    }
13509
13510    /// Admit a larger training arena from this exact selected publication.
13511    /// The source remains the sole execution owner while a fresh cold Session
13512    /// reconstructs unchanged native material and the trusted model factory
13513    /// verifies its own complete state. No candidate operation is public until
13514    /// the source issuance is revoked and the candidate phase is opened.
13515    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, parent, consumer_streams, snapshot, snapshot_model_state, restore_model, replay_rows, training_objective, training_domain, dependencies, publication_grants, inference_grants, training_grants, capacities, memory_bytes, max_material_bytes, max_total_material_bytes, max_evidence_bytes, refresh_snapshot))]
13516    #[expect(
13517        clippy::too_many_arguments,
13518        reason = "cold arena admission binds complete authority and model custody"
13519    )]
13520    fn admit_training_arena(
13521        &self,
13522        py: Python<'_>,
13523        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
13524        parent: &PySemanticPublishedParent,
13525        consumer_streams: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13526        snapshot: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13527        snapshot_model_state: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13528        restore_model: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13529        replay_rows: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13530        training_objective: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13531        training_domain: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13532        dependencies: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13533        publication_grants: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13534        inference_grants: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13535        training_grants: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13536        capacities: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13537        memory_bytes: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13538        max_material_bytes: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13539        max_total_material_bytes: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13540        max_evidence_bytes: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13541        refresh_snapshot: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
13542    ) -> PyResult<Py<PySemanticTransitionRestoredCheckpoint>> {
13543        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
13544        self.require_issued(task_use)?;
13545        parent.require_task(py, task_use)?;
13546        if !snapshot_model_state.is_callable()
13547            || !restore_model.is_callable()
13548            || !refresh_snapshot.is_callable()
13549        {
13550            return Err(invalid(
13551                "cold arena admission requires trusted model and authority callbacks",
13552            ));
13553        }
13554        let selected_seed = task_use.checkpoint.clone();
13555        let selected_phase = checkpoint_task_phase(&*task_use.state()?)?;
13556        if !matches!(&selected_phase, CheckpointTaskPhase::Segment(operation) if operation == "inference")
13557        {
13558            return Err(invalid(
13559                "training arena admission requires a selected published inference segment",
13560            ));
13561        }
13562        let (source_capacities, admission_limits, device_ordinal, source_memory_bytes) = {
13563            let source = self.session.borrow(py);
13564            (
13565                source.capacities,
13566                source.admission_limits,
13567                source.device_ordinal,
13568                source.memory_bytes,
13569            )
13570        };
13571        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
13572        let [material_limit, total_material_limit, evidence_limit] = read_task_replay_limits(
13573            max_material_bytes,
13574            max_total_material_bytes,
13575            max_evidence_bytes,
13576            &mut budget,
13577        )?;
13578        let candidate_domain = ColdValue::read(training_domain, &mut budget, 0)?;
13579        if candidate_domain == ColdValue::None || candidate_domain != selected_seed.training_domain
13580        {
13581            return Err(invalid(
13582                "arena admission changed or omitted the original pre-action training domain",
13583            ));
13584        }
13585        let mut authority_values = selected_seed.authority.clone();
13586        for (index, value) in [
13587            (4, dependencies),
13588            (6, publication_grants),
13589            (7, inference_grants),
13590            (8, training_grants),
13591        ] {
13592            authority_values[index] = ColdValue::read(value, &mut budget, 0)?;
13593        }
13594        authority_values[3] = read_replay_rows(
13595            replay_rows,
13596            &mut budget,
13597            material_limit,
13598            total_material_limit,
13599            evidence_limit,
13600        )?;
13601        require_retained_arena_authority(&selected_seed.authority, &authority_values)?;
13602        let mut authority = TaskAuthority::parse(&authority_values)?;
13603        authority.bind_initial_sources(
13604            &selected_seed.initial_sources,
13605            &selected_seed.source_mapping,
13606        )?;
13607        let training_views = authority
13608            .replay
13609            .iter()
13610            .map(ReplayRow::training_view_row)
13611            .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
13612        let objective_value = ColdValue::read(training_objective, &mut budget, 0)?;
13613        let objective = read_training_objective(&objective_value)?.ok_or_else(|| {
13614            invalid("cold arena admission requires a complete training objective")
13615        })?;
13616        if training_views.is_empty() {
13617            return Err(invalid(
13618                "cold arena admission requires retained training rows",
13619            ));
13620        }
13621        let capacity_values = ColdValue::read(capacities, &mut budget, 0)?;
13622        let capacity_values = capacity_values.sequence()?;
13623        if capacity_values.len() != 4 {
13624            return Err(invalid(
13625                "cold arena capacities require four exact native bounds",
13626            ));
13627        }
13628        let mut candidate_capacities = [0u32; 4];
13629        for (index, value) in capacity_values.iter().enumerate() {
13630            candidate_capacities[index] = u32::try_from(value.unsigned()?)
13631                .map_err(|_| invalid("cold arena capacity exceeds native domain"))?;
13632        }
13633        let candidate_capacities = (
13634            candidate_capacities[0],
13635            candidate_capacities[1],
13636            candidate_capacities[2],
13637            candidate_capacities[3],
13638        );
13639        for (old, new) in [
13640            (source_capacities.0, candidate_capacities.0),
13641            (source_capacities.1, candidate_capacities.1),
13642            (source_capacities.2, candidate_capacities.2),
13643            (source_capacities.3, candidate_capacities.3),
13644        ] {
13645            if new < old {
13646                return Err(invalid(
13647                    "cold arena admission cannot shrink native capacity",
13648                ));
13649            }
13650        }
13651        let candidate_memory_bytes = ColdValue::read(memory_bytes, &mut budget, 0)?.unsigned()?;
13652        if candidate_memory_bytes < source_memory_bytes {
13653            return Err(invalid(
13654                "cold arena admission cannot shrink native memory budget",
13655            ));
13656        }
13657        let initial_snapshot =
13658            AuthoritySnapshot::parse(&ColdValue::read(snapshot, &mut budget, 0)?)?;
13659        initial_snapshot.newer_than(&task_use.state()?.snapshot)?;
13660        let check_use =
13661            |authority: &TaskAuthority, snapshot: &AuthoritySnapshot| match &selected_phase {
13662                CheckpointTaskPhase::Imported | CheckpointTaskPhase::InitialPrefillBound => {
13663                    authority.check_snapshot(snapshot).map(drop)
13664                }
13665                CheckpointTaskPhase::Segment(operation) => {
13666                    authority.check_use(operation, snapshot, false)
13667                }
13668            };
13669        check_use(&task_use.authority, &initial_snapshot)?;
13670        check_use(&authority, &initial_snapshot)?;
13671        task_use
13672            .authority
13673            .check_use("training", &initial_snapshot, false)?;
13674        authority.check_use("training", &initial_snapshot, false)?;
13675        {
13676            let source = self.session.borrow(py);
13677            let mut owner = source.owner()?;
13678            task_use.require_current(&owner)?;
13679            owner
13680                .current_recompute_state_material(&*parent.lease()?)
13681                .map_err(xlog_err)?;
13682        }
13683        task_use.state()?.begin_arena_preparation()?;
13684
13685        let mut source_checkpoint: Option<Vec<u8>> = None;
13686        let mut candidate_session: Option<Py<PySemanticTransitionSession>> = None;
13687        let verify_source = |checkpoint: &[u8]| -> PyResult<AuthoritySnapshot> {
13688            let refreshed = refresh_snapshot.call0()?;
13689            let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
13690            let current = AuthoritySnapshot::parse(&ColdValue::read(&refreshed, &mut budget, 0)?)?;
13691            current.newer_than(&initial_snapshot)?;
13692            check_use(&task_use.authority, &current)?;
13693            let manifest = SemanticCheckpointManifest::decode(checkpoint)?;
13694            {
13695                let source = self.session.borrow(py);
13696                let mut owner = source.owner()?;
13697                task_use.require_current(&owner)?;
13698                let lease = parent.lease()?;
13699                if owner
13700                    .current_recompute_state_material(&lease)
13701                    .map_err(xlog_err)?
13702                    != manifest.native
13703                {
13704                    return Err(invalid(
13705                        "selected native state changed during cold arena preparation",
13706                    ));
13707                }
13708            }
13709            let model = snapshot_model_state.call0()?;
13710            if !model.is_exact_instance_of::<PyBytes>()
13711                || model.cast::<PyBytes>()?.as_bytes() != manifest.model
13712            {
13713                return Err(invalid(
13714                    "selected model state changed during cold arena preparation",
13715                ));
13716            }
13717            {
13718                let source = self.session.borrow(py);
13719                let mut owner = source.owner()?;
13720                task_use.require_current(&owner)?;
13721                if owner
13722                    .published_state_material(&*parent.lease()?)
13723                    .map_err(xlog_err)?
13724                    != manifest.native
13725                {
13726                    return Err(invalid(
13727                        "selected native state changed during model verification",
13728                    ));
13729                }
13730            }
13731            Ok(current)
13732        };
13733
13734        let result = (|| -> PyResult<Py<PySemanticTransitionRestoredCheckpoint>> {
13735            let checkpoint = self.save_checkpoint(
13736                py,
13737                task_use,
13738                parent,
13739                consumer_streams,
13740                snapshot,
13741                snapshot_model_state,
13742            )?;
13743            let checkpoint = checkpoint.bind(py).as_bytes().to_vec();
13744            source_checkpoint = Some(checkpoint.clone());
13745            let manifest = SemanticCheckpointManifest::decode(&checkpoint)?;
13746            let (_, saved_snapshot, phase, saved_binding) =
13747                TaskCheckpointSeed::decode(&manifest.task)?;
13748            if saved_snapshot.canonical != initial_snapshot.canonical {
13749                return Err(invalid(
13750                    "cold arena checkpoint changed its source authority snapshot",
13751                ));
13752            }
13753            if phase != selected_phase {
13754                return Err(invalid("cold arena source phase changed during checkpoint"));
13755            }
13756            let _historical_initial_prefill =
13757                SemanticTransitionSession::verify_checkpoint_initial_prefill_source(
13758                    &manifest.initial_prefill,
13759                    &manifest.native,
13760                    Identity256::from_bytes(saved_binding.identity),
13761                    saved_binding.epoch,
13762                    saved_binding.content_identity(),
13763                    phase == CheckpointTaskPhase::InitialPrefillBound,
13764                )
13765                .map_err(xlog_err)?;
13766            let admission = SemanticTransitionSession::state_material_admission(&manifest.native)
13767                .map_err(xlog_err)?;
13768            let editable_source = cold_task::editable_source_from_admission(&admission)?;
13769            if let Some(source) = &editable_source {
13770                if selected_seed
13771                    .evaluation
13772                    .get(2)
13773                    .ok_or_else(|| invalid("cold arena task evaluation is incomplete"))?
13774                    .text()?
13775                    != source.observer_source
13776                {
13777                    return Err(invalid(
13778                        "cold arena observer differs from original admission",
13779                    ));
13780                }
13781            }
13782            let spec = task_evaluation_spec(
13783                &selected_seed.evaluation,
13784                task_use.authority.priority_levels.clone(),
13785                editable_source.map(|source| source.program),
13786                &selected_seed.training_domain,
13787            )?;
13788            let (_, selected_material) =
13789                decode_selected_replay(&authority.replay, &selected_seed.replay_selection)?;
13790            let successor = Py::new(
13791                py,
13792                PySemanticTransitionSession::from_admission(
13793                    admission,
13794                    candidate_capacities,
13795                    admission_limits,
13796                    device_ordinal,
13797                    candidate_memory_bytes,
13798                )?,
13799            )?;
13800            candidate_session = Some(successor.clone_ref(py));
13801            let native_binding = {
13802                let session = successor.borrow(py);
13803                let mut owner = session.owner()?;
13804                let observations = owner
13805                    .task_observation_roots(
13806                        &spec,
13807                        selected_material.as_ref().map(|binding| &binding.material),
13808                    )
13809                    .map_err(xlog_err)?;
13810                let mut original_authority = TaskAuthority::parse(&selected_seed.authority)?;
13811                original_authority.bind_initial_sources(
13812                    &selected_seed.initial_sources,
13813                    &selected_seed.source_mapping,
13814                )?;
13815                original_authority
13816                    .bind_native_reads(&observations, &spec.allowed_support_records)?;
13817                authority.bind_native_reads(&observations, &spec.allowed_support_records)?;
13818                let original_goal_witness = original_authority.goal_witness(&observations);
13819                let goal_witness = authority.goal_witness(&observations);
13820                owner.bind_task_evaluation(spec).map_err(xlog_err)?;
13821                owner
13822                    .bind_task_goal_witness(original_goal_witness)
13823                    .map_err(xlog_err)?;
13824                owner
13825                    .restore_state_material(&manifest.native)
13826                    .map_err(xlog_err)?;
13827                owner
13828                    .rebind_restored_training_arena(
13829                        &manifest.native,
13830                        goal_witness,
13831                        training_views,
13832                        objective,
13833                    )
13834                    .map_err(xlog_err)?;
13835                let binding = TaskCheckpointBinding::from_owner(&owner)?;
13836                if !saved_binding.same_cold_arena_content(binding) {
13837                    return Err(invalid("cold arena changed selected native task content"));
13838                }
13839                binding
13840            };
13841            let controller_identity = Arc::new(());
13842            let controller = Py::new(
13843                py,
13844                PySemanticTransitionController {
13845                    session: successor.clone_ref(py),
13846                    identity: Arc::clone(&controller_identity),
13847                },
13848            )?;
13849            let issuance = TaskIssuance::issue(Arc::clone(&successor.borrow(py).issuance))?;
13850            let original_phase = match &phase {
13851                CheckpointTaskPhase::Imported => TaskUsePhase::Imported,
13852                CheckpointTaskPhase::InitialPrefillBound => TaskUsePhase::InitialPrefillBound,
13853                CheckpointTaskPhase::Segment(operation) => TaskUsePhase::Segment(operation.clone()),
13854            };
13855            let candidate_task = Py::new(
13856                py,
13857                PySemanticTransitionTaskUse {
13858                    session: successor.clone_ref(py),
13859                    controller: controller_identity,
13860                    issuance,
13861                    importing: Arc::clone(&successor.borrow(py).importing),
13862                    task_identity: native_binding.identity,
13863                    task_epoch: native_binding.epoch,
13864                    authority,
13865                    checkpoint: TaskCheckpointSeed {
13866                        authority: authority_values,
13867                        evaluation: selected_seed.evaluation,
13868                        training_objective: objective_value,
13869                        training_domain: selected_seed.training_domain,
13870                        initial_sources: selected_seed.initial_sources,
13871                        source_mapping: selected_seed.source_mapping,
13872                        replay_selection: selected_seed.replay_selection,
13873                    },
13874                    state: Mutex::new(TaskUseState {
13875                        phase: TaskUsePhase::ArenaPreparing(Box::new(original_phase)),
13876                        snapshot: initial_snapshot.clone(),
13877                    }),
13878                    delivery: Mutex::new(None),
13879                },
13880            )?;
13881            let candidate_parent = {
13882                let issued = candidate_task.borrow(py);
13883                let session = successor.borrow(py);
13884                let mut owner = session.owner()?;
13885                issued.require_current(&owner)?;
13886                let lease = owner.acquire().map_err(xlog_err)?;
13887                Py::new(
13888                    py,
13889                    PySemanticPublishedParent {
13890                        session: successor.clone_ref(py),
13891                        task_use: candidate_task.clone_ref(py),
13892                        inner: Mutex::new(lease),
13893                        continuation_producers: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
13894                    },
13895                )?
13896            };
13897            let admitted_native = {
13898                let acquired = candidate_parent.borrow(py);
13899                let material = successor
13900                    .borrow(py)
13901                    .owner()?
13902                    .published_state_material(&*acquired.lease()?)
13903                    .map_err(xlog_err)?;
13904                material
13905            };
13906            let model = restore_model
13907                .call1((
13908                    controller.clone_ref(py),
13909                    candidate_task.clone_ref(py),
13910                    candidate_parent.clone_ref(py),
13911                    PyBytes::new(py, &manifest.model),
13912                ))?
13913                .unbind();
13914            {
13915                let issued = candidate_task.borrow(py);
13916                let acquired = candidate_parent.borrow(py);
13917                acquired.require_task(py, &issued)?;
13918                let session = successor.borrow(py);
13919                let mut owner = session.owner()?;
13920                issued.require_current(&owner)?;
13921                if checkpoint_task_phase(&*issued.state()?)? != phase {
13922                    return Err(invalid(
13923                        "cold arena candidate phase changed during model restore",
13924                    ));
13925                }
13926                if owner
13927                    .published_state_material(&*acquired.lease()?)
13928                    .map_err(xlog_err)?
13929                    != admitted_native
13930                {
13931                    return Err(invalid(
13932                        "cold arena candidate native state changed during model restore",
13933                    ));
13934                }
13935            }
13936            let latest = verify_source(&checkpoint)?;
13937            check_use(&candidate_task.borrow(py).authority, &latest)?;
13938            task_use.authority.check_use("training", &latest, false)?;
13939            candidate_task
13940                .borrow(py)
13941                .authority
13942                .check_use("training", &latest, false)?;
13943            {
13944                let issued = candidate_task.borrow(py);
13945                let mut state = issued.state()?;
13946                if !matches!(state.phase, TaskUsePhase::ArenaPreparing(_)) {
13947                    return Err(invalid("cold arena candidate escaped preparation"));
13948                }
13949                state.snapshot = latest;
13950            }
13951            let admitted = Py::new(
13952                py,
13953                PySemanticTransitionRestoredCheckpoint {
13954                    session: successor,
13955                    controller,
13956                    task_use: candidate_task.clone_ref(py),
13957                    parent: candidate_parent,
13958                    model,
13959                },
13960            )?;
13961            {
13962                let source = self.session.borrow(py);
13963                let issued = candidate_task.borrow(py);
13964                let mut source_state = task_use.state()?;
13965                let mut candidate_state = issued.state()?;
13966                if !matches!(source_state.phase, TaskUsePhase::ArenaPreparing(_))
13967                    || !matches!(candidate_state.phase, TaskUsePhase::ArenaPreparing(_))
13968                {
13969                    return Err(invalid("cold arena handoff lost its original preparation"));
13970                }
13971                let activated_phase = match &candidate_state.phase {
13972                    TaskUsePhase::ArenaPreparing(original) => *original.clone(),
13973                    _ => unreachable!("checked candidate preparation"),
13974                };
13975                TaskIssuance::issue(Arc::clone(&source.issuance))?;
13976                source_state.phase = TaskUsePhase::Refused;
13977                candidate_state.phase = activated_phase;
13978            }
13979            Ok(admitted)
13980        })();
13981        if result.is_err() {
13982            if let Some(successor) = candidate_session {
13983                if let Ok(mut owner) = successor.borrow(py).owner() {
13984                    owner.abort();
13985                }
13986            }
13987            let safe = match source_checkpoint.as_deref() {
13988                Some(checkpoint) => verify_source(checkpoint).ok(),
13989                None => (|| -> PyResult<AuthoritySnapshot> {
13990                    let refreshed = refresh_snapshot.call0()?;
13991                    let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
13992                    let current =
13993                        AuthoritySnapshot::parse(&ColdValue::read(&refreshed, &mut budget, 0)?)?;
13994                    current.newer_than(&initial_snapshot)?;
13995                    check_use(&task_use.authority, &current)?;
13996                    task_use.authority.check_use("training", &current, false)?;
13997                    let source = self.session.borrow(py);
13998                    let owner = source.owner()?;
13999                    task_use.require_current(&owner)?;
14000                    Ok(current)
14001                })()
14002                .ok(),
14003            };
14004            if let Ok(mut state) = task_use.state() {
14005                if let Some(snapshot) = safe {
14006                    state.snapshot = snapshot;
14007                    let _ = state.finish_arena_preparation();
14008                } else {
14009                    state.phase = TaskUsePhase::Refused;
14010                }
14011            }
14012        }
14013        result
14014    }
14015
14016    /// Seal the exact selected publication, task capsule and model state into one
14017    /// self-contained checkpoint blob. The serializer runs exactly once without
14018    /// a native or task-state mutex held. Native ownership and authority are
14019    /// revalidated afterwards; a failure returns no candidate checkpoint.
14020    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, parent, consumer_streams, snapshot, snapshot_model_state))]
14021    fn save_checkpoint(
14022        &self,
14023        py: Python<'_>,
14024        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
14025        parent: &PySemanticPublishedParent,
14026        consumer_streams: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14027        snapshot: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14028        snapshot_model_state: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14029    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyBytes>> {
14030        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
14031        self.require_read_issued(task_use)?;
14032        if !matches!(task_use.state()?.phase, TaskUsePhase::ArenaPreparing(_)) {
14033            task_use.state()?.require_public_use()?;
14034        }
14035        parent.require_task(py, task_use)?;
14036        if !snapshot_model_state.is_callable() {
14037            return Err(invalid(
14038                "checkpoint save requires one trusted model-state serializer",
14039            ));
14040        }
14041        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
14042        let streams = ColdValue::read(consumer_streams, &mut budget, 0)?;
14043        let streams = streams
14044            .sequence()?
14045            .iter()
14046            .map(ColdValue::unsigned)
14047            .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
14048        if streams.is_empty()
14049            || streams
14050                .iter()
14051                .any(|&stream| stream == 0 || stream == 2 || stream > i64::MAX as u64)
14052        {
14053            return Err(invalid(
14054                "checkpoint save requires exact supported consumer streams",
14055            ));
14056        }
14057        let snapshot = AuthoritySnapshot::parse(&ColdValue::read(snapshot, &mut budget, 0)?)?;
14058        let (identity, task_binding, prior_snapshot, phase, config) = {
14059            let session = self.session.borrow(py);
14060            if session.importing.load(Ordering::Acquire)
14061                || session.recording.load(Ordering::Acquire)
14062                || session.retiring.load(Ordering::Acquire)
14063            {
14064                return Err(invalid(
14065                    "checkpoint save cannot overlap recording, import or retirement",
14066                ));
14067            }
14068            let mut owner = session.owner()?;
14069            task_use.require_current(&owner)?;
14070            let state = task_use.state()?;
14071            snapshot.newer_than(&state.snapshot)?;
14072            let phase = checkpoint_task_phase(&state)?;
14073            match &phase {
14074                CheckpointTaskPhase::Imported | CheckpointTaskPhase::InitialPrefillBound => {
14075                    task_use.authority.check_snapshot(&snapshot)?;
14076                }
14077                CheckpointTaskPhase::Segment(operation) => {
14078                    task_use.authority.check_use(operation, &snapshot, false)?;
14079                }
14080            }
14081            let prior_snapshot = state.snapshot.canonical.clone();
14082            drop(state);
14083            let lease = parent.lease()?;
14084            owner
14085                .quiesce_published_reader(&lease, &streams)
14086                .map_err(xlog_err)?;
14087            let identity = owner.published_identity(&lease).map_err(xlog_err)?;
14088            let task_binding = TaskCheckpointBinding::from_owner(&owner)?;
14089            (
14090                identity,
14091                task_binding,
14092                prior_snapshot,
14093                phase,
14094                SemanticCheckpointSessionConfig {
14095                    capacities: session.capacities,
14096                    admission_limits: session.admission_limits,
14097                    memory_bytes: session.memory_bytes,
14098                },
14099            )
14100        };
14101        let model = snapshot_model_state.call0().and_then(|model| {
14102            if !model.is_exact_instance_of::<PyBytes>() {
14103                return Err(invalid(
14104                    "checkpoint model-state serializer must return exact builtin bytes",
14105                ));
14106            }
14107            Ok(model.cast::<PyBytes>()?.as_bytes().to_vec())
14108        });
14109        let materials = {
14110            let session = self.session.borrow(py);
14111            let mut owner = session.owner()?;
14112            task_use.require_current(&owner)?;
14113            let state = task_use.state()?;
14114            if state.snapshot.canonical != prior_snapshot
14115                || checkpoint_task_phase(&state)? != phase
14116                || task_use.task_identity != task_binding.identity
14117                || task_use.task_epoch != task_binding.epoch
14118                || TaskCheckpointBinding::from_owner(&owner)? != task_binding
14119            {
14120                return Err(invalid(
14121                    "checkpoint task binding changed during model serialization",
14122                ));
14123            }
14124            drop(state);
14125            let lease = parent.lease()?;
14126            if owner.published_identity(&lease).map_err(xlog_err)? != identity {
14127                return Err(invalid(
14128                    "checkpoint publication changed during model serialization",
14129                ));
14130            }
14131            if model.is_err() {
14132                None
14133            } else {
14134                let native = owner.published_state_material(&lease).map_err(xlog_err)?;
14135                let (initial_prefill, present) = owner
14136                    .checkpoint_initial_prefill_material(&lease)
14137                    .map_err(xlog_err)?;
14138                if (phase == CheckpointTaskPhase::InitialPrefillBound) != present
14139                    && !matches!(phase, CheckpointTaskPhase::Segment(_))
14140                {
14141                    return Err(invalid(
14142                        "checkpoint initial prefill differs from its task phase",
14143                    ));
14144                }
14145                Some((native, initial_prefill))
14146            }
14147        };
14148        let model = model?;
14149        let (native, initial_prefill) =
14150            materials.expect("successful model serialization exports native state");
14151        let task = task_use
14152            .checkpoint
14153            .encode(&snapshot, &phase, &task_binding)?;
14154        let session = config.encode()?;
14155        let checkpoint = SemanticCheckpointManifest {
14156            native,
14157            model,
14158            task,
14159            session,
14160            initial_prefill,
14161        }
14162        .encode()?;
14163        Ok(PyBytes::new(py, &checkpoint).unbind())
14164    }
14165
14166    /// Decode native output intents from a complete checkpoint. This read-only
14167    /// projection is not proof of durable commit or delivery authority.
14168    fn checkpoint_output_intents(
14169        &self,
14170        py: Python<'_>,
14171        checkpoint: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14172    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
14173        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
14174        if !checkpoint.is_exact_instance_of::<PyBytes>() {
14175            return Err(invalid(
14176                "checkpoint intent projection requires exact builtin bytes",
14177            ));
14178        }
14179        let manifest =
14180            SemanticCheckpointManifest::decode(checkpoint.cast::<PyBytes>()?.as_bytes())?;
14181        let intents = xlog_cuda::output_intents_from_publication_material(&manifest.native)
14182            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
14183        let rows = intents
14184            .iter()
14185            .map(|intent| {
14186                (
14187                    PyBytes::new(py, intent.stable_identity.as_bytes()),
14188                    PyBytes::new(py, &intent.effect),
14189                    PyBytes::new(py, &intent.payload),
14190                )
14191            })
14192            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
14193        Ok(PyTuple::new(py, rows)?.unbind())
14194    }
14195
14196    /// Return only intents without a verified durable acknowledgement. Both
14197    /// sealed native queues and the trusted receiver key are checked after
14198    /// restoration; this projection itself does not perform delivery.
14199    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, checkpoint))]
14200    fn checkpoint_pending_output_intents(
14201        &self,
14202        py: Python<'_>,
14203        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
14204        checkpoint: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14205    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
14206        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
14207        self.require_issued(task_use)?;
14208        if !checkpoint.is_exact_instance_of::<PyBytes>() {
14209            return Err(invalid(
14210                "pending intent projection requires exact checkpoint bytes",
14211            ));
14212        }
14213        let binding = task_use.delivery_binding()?;
14214        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
14215        let owner = session.owner()?;
14216        task_use.require_current(&owner)?;
14217        let current_binding = TaskCheckpointBinding::from_owner(&owner)?;
14218        drop(owner);
14219        let manifest =
14220            SemanticCheckpointManifest::decode(checkpoint.cast::<PyBytes>()?.as_bytes())?;
14221        let (seed, _, _, saved_binding) = TaskCheckpointSeed::decode(&manifest.task)?;
14222        if !saved_binding.same_task_content(current_binding)
14223            || seed.authority != task_use.checkpoint.authority
14224        {
14225            return Err(invalid(
14226                "checkpoint pending intents belong to another task or live envelope",
14227            ));
14228        }
14229        let intents = xlog_cuda::pending_output_intents_from_publication_material(
14230            &manifest.native,
14231            binding.recipient_id,
14232            &binding.verification_key,
14233            &binding.expected_effect,
14234        )
14235        .map_err(xlog_err)?;
14236        let rows = intents
14237            .iter()
14238            .map(|intent| {
14239                (
14240                    PyBytes::new(py, intent.stable_identity.as_bytes()),
14241                    PyBytes::new(py, &intent.effect),
14242                    PyBytes::new(py, &intent.payload),
14243                )
14244            })
14245            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
14246        Ok(PyTuple::new(py, rows)?.unbind())
14247    }
14248
14249    /// Export one genuinely held transition into the existing replay carrier.
14250    /// Returns (predecessor_identity, successor_identity, predecessor_material,
14251    /// provenance_material, publication_evidence). Identities have the same four
14252    /// fields as parent.identity(). Each material is exact native bytes; the
14253    /// caller binds them to the canonical ExecutionMaterials references and
14254    /// keeps publication_evidence outside the episode's own hashed closure.
14255    /// The successor's full snapshot is deliberately not an episode material.
14256    ///
14257    /// Both original readers must remain held. A fresh trusted snapshot must
14258    /// authorize the same admitted operation across the full dependency closure.
14259    /// Export does not refresh execution authority, publish, or grant restore
14260    /// permission. This cold operation intentionally copies complete bytes.
14261    /// The Runtime must stop further writers during export and have registered
14262    /// every consumer stream through the real native reader operations. Export
14263    /// completes their submitted work and guards every live P/S range, including
14264    /// tensors, before copying. Both later reader releases must include legacy
14265    /// stream 1, used by this controller's complete-content guards, in addition
14266    /// to the Runtime's original consumer streams. Aliases may remain retained.
14267    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, predecessor, successor, snapshot))]
14268    fn export_replay_materials(
14269        &self,
14270        py: Python<'_>,
14271        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
14272        predecessor: &PySemanticPublishedParent,
14273        successor: &PySemanticPublishedParent,
14274        snapshot: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14275    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
14276        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
14277        self.require_issued(task_use)?;
14278        predecessor.require_task(py, task_use)?;
14279        successor.require_task(py, task_use)?;
14280        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
14281        let snapshot = AuthoritySnapshot::parse(&ColdValue::read(snapshot, &mut budget, 0)?)?;
14282        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
14283        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
14284        task_use.require_current(&owner)?;
14285        let state = task_use.state()?;
14286        let TaskUsePhase::Segment(operation) = &state.phase else {
14287            return Err(invalid(
14288                "replay export requires its admitted original operation",
14289            ));
14290        };
14291        snapshot.newer_than(&state.snapshot)?;
14292        task_use.authority.check_use(operation, &snapshot, false)?;
14293        if std::ptr::eq(predecessor, successor) {
14294            return Err(invalid(
14295                "replay export requires distinct predecessor and successor readers",
14296            ));
14297        }
14298        let predecessor = predecessor.lease()?;
14299        let successor = successor.lease()?;
14300        let predecessor_identity = owner.published_identity(&predecessor).map_err(xlog_err)?;
14301        let successor_identity = owner.published_identity(&successor).map_err(xlog_err)?;
14302        let evidence = owner
14303            .published_replay_evidence(&predecessor, &successor)
14304            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
14305        let provenance = owner
14306            .published_replay_provenance(&predecessor, &successor)
14307            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
14308        let material = owner
14309            .published_state_material(&predecessor)
14310            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
14311        let identity = |value: xlog_cuda::SemanticPublishedIdentity| {
14312            (
14313                PyBytes::new(py, value.instance.as_bytes()),
14314                value.word,
14315                PyBytes::new(py, value.logical_digest.as_bytes()),
14316                PyBytes::new(py, value.state_digest.as_bytes()),
14317            )
14318        };
14319        Ok((
14320            identity(predecessor_identity),
14321            identity(successor_identity),
14322            PyBytes::new(py, &material),
14323            PyBytes::new(py, &provenance),
14324            PyBytes::new(py, &evidence),
14325        )
14326            .into_pyobject(py)?
14327            .unbind())
14328    }
14329
14330    /// Revalidate exact rights before each encoder or model forward and native transition.
14331    /// ``operation`` is explicitly ``inference`` or ``training``. A newer trusted
14332    /// snapshot must cover the unchanged preregistered worst-case segment end.
14333    /// The native fuel/terminal admission reads this exact acquired parent
14334    /// before encoder or model execution; this check does not itself spend fuel or publish.
14335    /// Later transitions use the same original operation and a fresh snapshot.
14336    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, parent, transition, operation, snapshot))]
14337    fn before_segment(
14338        &self,
14339        py: Python<'_>,
14340        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
14341        parent: &PySemanticPublishedParent,
14342        transition: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14343        operation: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14344        snapshot: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14345    ) -> PyResult<()> {
14346        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
14347        self.require_issued(task_use)?;
14348        parent.require_task(py, task_use)?;
14349        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
14350        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
14351        task_use.require_current(&owner)?;
14352        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
14353        let kind = transition_kind(&ColdValue::read(transition, &mut budget, 0)?)?;
14354        let operation = ColdValue::read(operation, &mut budget, 0)?
14355            .text()?
14356            .to_owned();
14357        let snapshot = AuthoritySnapshot::parse(&ColdValue::read(snapshot, &mut budget, 0)?)?;
14358        task_use.require_learning_operation(&owner, &operation)?;
14359        let mut state = task_use.state()?;
14360        state.admit_segment(&task_use.authority, operation, snapshot)?;
14361        if let Err(error) = owner.admit_transition(&*parent.lease()?, kind) {
14362            state.phase = TaskUsePhase::Refused;
14363            return Err(xlog_err(error));
14364        }
14365        Ok(())
14366    }
14367
14368    /// Acquire exactly one sealed native bank. Cold import, layout/schema
14369    /// access and a pending transition are not substitutes for this operation.
14370    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use))]
14371    fn acquire(
14372        &self,
14373        py: Python<'_>,
14374        task_use: Py<PySemanticTransitionTaskUse>,
14375    ) -> PyResult<PySemanticPublishedParent> {
14376        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
14377        let issued = task_use.borrow(py);
14378        self.require_issued(&issued)?;
14379        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
14380        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
14381        issued.require_current(&owner)?;
14382        let lease = owner.acquire().map_err(xlog_err)?;
14383        drop(issued);
14384        Ok(PySemanticPublishedParent {
14385            session: self.session.clone_ref(py),
14386            task_use,
14387            inner: Mutex::new(lease),
14388            continuation_producers: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
14389        })
14390    }
14391
14392    /// Capture the current bytes of real original tensors for this same parent.
14393    /// ``tensors`` uses the original typed layout/interval/producer rows accepted
14394    /// by bind_parent, including I64=7, Bool8=8 and F64=9. Original Python producers and
14395    /// their autograd objects remain retained independently of mutable input rows.
14396    /// Role 0 is the private transient namespace, never a publication role.
14397    /// Its index is the operand's ordinal in the complete supplied roster,
14398    /// including repeated operands; it is not derived from values or storage.
14399    /// Nonpositional operands use logical_axis=u64::MAX and interval (0, 0).
14400    /// Verification requires the same complete roster and original storage.
14401    ///
14402    /// The trusted controller must call immediately after its real forward or
14403    /// transform and before public hooks, then bind the private witness to that
14404    /// original execution. Capture proves later content stability; it does not
14405    /// establish derivation, provenance or permission to import/replay a model.
14406    /// The issuing Runtime must retain this complete witness and every issued
14407    /// policy invocation, original producer, callback and saved autograd payload
14408    /// through native cotangents and the original Python backward. One guaranteed
14409    /// creating-thread cleanup must release that custody after backward finishes.
14410    /// External aliases require an explicit owner kept alive through their last
14411    /// use. Worker access does not make arbitrary Python finalizers thread-safe;
14412    /// neither a native alias alone nor a future deferred-release drain suffices.
14413    /// The witness retains the step, so final release refuses until it is destroyed.
14414    /// Bank-only retirement does not destroy its original baseline or producers.
14415    /// Producer and consumer streams join through the Session without a host
14416    /// payload/digest/status copy or synchronization. Verification and every
14417    /// dependent forward/backward/result/publication must preserve that ordering.
14418    /// Capture and verification require legacy default stream 1 or an explicit
14419    /// consumer stream; per-thread default stream 2 is rejected before handoff.
14420    /// Capture requires CUDA stream-ordered allocation support; native refuses
14421    /// a context that would require a synchronizing allocation fallback.
14422    /// Native feedback outputs already carry their producer's original seal.
14423    /// Capturing those aliases verifies that seal and requires their original
14424    /// type, shape, interval and roster coordinate; it never reseals changed bytes.
14425    /// Issue an opaque native receipt for one exact model-forward logits
14426    /// occurrence while the producer's prepared bank capture is active.
14427    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, step, bank, role, logits, logits_layout, consumer_stream))]
14428    #[expect(
14429        clippy::too_many_arguments,
14430        reason = "the forward receipt binds task authority, producer bank, role, logits geometry and stream"
14431    )]
14432    fn record_model_forward(
14433        &self,
14434        py: Python<'_>,
14435        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
14436        step: &PySemanticPreparedStep,
14437        bank: usize,
14438        role: &str,
14439        logits: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14440        logits_layout: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14441        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14442    ) -> PyResult<PySemanticModelForwardWitness> {
14443        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
14444        self.require_read_issued(task_use)?;
14445        let role = match role {
14446            "baseline" => 0,
14447            "candidate" => 1,
14448            _ => return Err(invalid("model forward role must be baseline or candidate")),
14449        };
14450        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
14451        let stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(consumer_stream, &mut budget)?;
14452        let mut layout = parse_tensor_layout(&ColdValue::read(logits_layout, &mut budget, 0)?)?;
14453        let parent = ContentStepRef::Prepared(step);
14454        let expected = {
14455            let session = self.session.borrow(py);
14456            let owner = session.owner()?;
14457            let state = self.continuation_state(py, task_use, parent, &owner, None)?;
14458            step.require_recording_stream(&owner, stream)?;
14459            self.continuation_binding(&state, parent, false)?
14460        };
14461        let check = || -> PyResult<()> {
14462            let session = self.session.borrow(py);
14463            let owner = session.owner()?;
14464            let state = self.continuation_state(py, task_use, parent, &owner, None)?;
14465            step.require_recording_stream(&owner, stream)?;
14466            if self.continuation_binding(&state, parent, false)? != expected {
14467                return Err(invalid(
14468                    "prepared model-forward authority changed during producer handoff",
14469                ));
14470            }
14471            Ok(())
14472        };
14473        let device = self.session.borrow(py).device_ordinal;
14474        validate_producer_device_guarded(logits, device, &check)?;
14475        layout.role = 0;
14476        layout.index = role as u64;
14477        let tensor = SemanticTensorInput {
14478            tensor: crate::dlpack_from_py_for_stream_guarded(
14479                logits,
14480                i64::try_from(stream)
14481                    .map_err(|_| invalid("consumer stream exceeds DLPack address space"))?,
14482                &check,
14483            )?,
14484            layout,
14485            logical_begin: 0,
14486            logical_end: 0,
14487            native_allocation: None,
14488        };
14489        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
14490        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
14491        let state = self.continuation_state(py, task_use, parent, &owner, None)?;
14492        step.require_recording_stream(&owner, stream)?;
14493        if self.continuation_binding(&state, parent, false)? != expected {
14494            return Err(invalid(
14495                "prepared model-forward authority changed before native receipt recording",
14496            ));
14497        }
14498        let inner = owner
14499            .record_prepared_model_forward(&step.inner, bank, role, tensor, stream)
14500            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
14501        drop(state);
14502        Ok(PySemanticModelForwardWitness {
14503            inner,
14504            _logits: logits.clone().unbind(),
14505            _session: self.session.clone_ref(py),
14506        })
14507    }
14508
14509    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, parent, tensors, consumer_stream))]
14510    fn capture_tensor_content(
14511        &self,
14512        py: Python<'_>,
14513        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
14514        parent: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14515        tensors: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14516        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14517    ) -> PyResult<PySemanticTensorContentWitness> {
14518        self.bind_tensor_content(
14519            py,
14520            task_use,
14521            ContentStepOwner::from_python(parent)?,
14522            tensors,
14523            consumer_stream,
14524            TensorContentBinding::Capture,
14525        )
14526    }

14528    /// Bind all actual model tensors to the original native model baseline.
14529    /// ``tensors`` has the existing typed layout/interval/producer rows, covering
14530    /// exactly roles 18/19/20 present in the acquired parent. Optional adapters
14531    /// must be present exactly when the original roster contains them. Native
14532    /// checks the admitted generation and sealed model contract (role 44).
14533    /// Expected content comes from the original device publication seals, never
14534    /// from a new capture of current model bytes. Initial producer addresses and
14535    /// valid physical strides may differ; type, shape and logical interval may
14536    /// not. Later witness.verify requires these same live storage/layout owners.
14537    /// A prepared parent requires ``bank`` so each recorded branch seals the
14538    /// resident model storage that its producer actually reads. Published parents
14539    /// reject ``bank``. Call before model reads and verify after callbacks and
14540    /// before late backward. This does not certify Python identity, hooks,
14541    /// configuration or numerical derivation; those remain the model owner's
14542    /// checks. Successful return is stream-ordered enqueue, not GPU acceptance.
14543    /// Retain the complete witness through creator-thread cleanup, as for
14544    /// capture_tensor_content; no first-reader lifetime is used as a baseline.
14545    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, parent, tensors, consumer_stream, bank=None))]
14546    fn bind_model_content(
14547        &self,
14548        py: Python<'_>,
14549        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
14550        parent: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14551        tensors: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14552        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14553        bank: Option<usize>,
14554    ) -> PyResult<PySemanticTensorContentWitness> {
14555        self.bind_tensor_content(
14556            py,
14557            task_use,
14558            ContentStepOwner::from_python(parent)?,
14559            tensors,
14560            consumer_stream,
14561            TensorContentBinding::Model(bank),
14562        )
14563    }
14564
14565    /// Retain the actual original-forward outputs for this acquired parent.
14566    /// ``tensors`` uses the typed tensor layout from cold parent import. The
14567    /// six base service arguments are contiguous CUDA DLPack producers: text_rows
14568    /// U64[32,2], text_row_count U64[1], selected_text Bool8[32], active_rows
14569    /// U64[A,4], active_row_count U64[1], and numerical_admissibility Bool8[1].
14570    /// Selection is indexed by original source slot. Active rows contain
14571    /// (physical_row, source_slot, logical_position, kind), with FILLED=1,
14572    /// MASK=2 and FEEDBACK=3; invalid feedback slots leave physical gaps.
14573    /// The original transient ``producer_witness`` captures model tensors in
14574    /// their original order followed by these services at role 0 indices
14575    /// N through N+5. A model with a sealed physical-parameter roster must
14576    /// also supply FP64[N_physical,2,3] numerical_blocks for Proposal/replay,
14577    /// at index N+6. Acquired replay supplies its verified schema digest and
14578    /// model identity; a prepared branch instead supplies the same bank's
14579    /// ``model_content_witness`` and no host identities. Native retains its
14580    /// private acquired model-contract snapshot and reads it on each replay. Both
14581    /// actor-reference and full-objective rows contain B, ordinary and U;
14582    /// Update has no pre-draw block tensor. Model-content witnesses cannot
14583    /// substitute for this capture.
14584    /// ``consumer_stream`` is explicit (or legacy stream 1); 0 and 2 are refused.
14585    /// Native validation checks the acquired source, prefix, services and
14586    /// generations before pending ranges enter the sole publication CAS. A
14587    /// prepared parent requires ``bank`` and retains a distinct continuation for
14588    /// each recorded branch; published parents reject it.
14589    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, parent, text_rows, text_row_count, selected_text, active_rows, active_row_count, numerical_admissibility, tensors, producer_witness, consumer_stream, bank=None, numerical_blocks=None, model_schema_digest=None, model_identity=None, model_content_witness=None))]
14590    #[expect(
14591        clippy::too_many_arguments,
14592        reason = "continuation binding retains each typed producer and its witness"
14593    )]
14594    fn bind_continuation(
14595        &self,
14596        py: Python<'_>,
14597        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
14598        parent: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14599        text_rows: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14600        text_row_count: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14601        selected_text: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14602        active_rows: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14603        active_row_count: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14604        numerical_admissibility: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14605        tensors: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14606        producer_witness: &PySemanticTensorContentWitness,
14607        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14608        bank: Option<usize>,
14609        numerical_blocks: Option<&Bound<'_, PyAny>>,
14610        model_schema_digest: Option<&Bound<'_, PyAny>>,
14611        model_identity: Option<&Bound<'_, PyAny>>,
14612        model_content_witness: Option<&PySemanticTensorContentWitness>,
14613    ) -> PyResult<()> {
14614        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
14615        self.require_read_issued(task_use)?;
14616        match ContentStepOwner::from_python(parent)? {
14617            ContentStepOwner::Published(parent) => {
14618                if bank.is_some() {
14619                    return Err(invalid(
14620                        "published continuation does not accept a prepared bank",
14621                    ));
14622                }
14623                self.require_issued(task_use)?;
14624                self.bind_continuation_in_execution(
14625                    py,
14626                    task_use,
14627                    ContentStepRef::Published(&parent.borrow(py)),
14628                    text_rows,
14629                    text_row_count,
14630                    selected_text,
14631                    active_rows,
14632                    active_row_count,
14633                    numerical_admissibility,
14634                    tensors,
14635                    producer_witness,
14636                    consumer_stream,
14637                    None,
14638                    None,
14639                    numerical_blocks,
14640                    model_schema_digest,
14641                    model_identity,
14642                    model_content_witness,
14643                )
14644            }
14645            ContentStepOwner::Prepared(step) => {
14646                let bank =
14647                    bank.ok_or_else(|| invalid("prepared continuation requires bank zero or one"))?;
14648                self.bind_continuation_in_execution(
14649                    py,
14650                    task_use,
14651                    ContentStepRef::Prepared(&step.borrow(py)),
14652                    text_rows,
14653                    text_row_count,
14654                    selected_text,
14655                    active_rows,
14656                    active_row_count,
14657                    numerical_admissibility,
14658                    tensors,
14659                    producer_witness,
14660                    consumer_stream,
14661                    Some(bank),
14662                    None,
14663                    numerical_blocks,
14664                    model_schema_digest,
14665                    model_identity,
14666                    model_content_witness,
14667                )
14668            }
14669        }
14670    }
14671
14672    /// Bind the complete original model backing produced by this recorded
14673    /// update. The transient witness covers allocations, typed model views,
14674    /// Bool8[1] numerical admissibility. ``baseline_forward`` and
14675    /// ``candidate_forward`` are opaque witnesses issued only by
14676    /// ``record_model_forward`` at the two actual producer sites. They retain
14677    /// contiguous F16, BF16 or F32 ``[rows, capacity, vocabulary]`` logits and
14678    /// native receipts that join the exact work occurrence, generation, model
14679    /// seal and logits digest; this final handoff cannot assign roles by argument
14680    /// position or substitute new tensors.
14681    /// XLOG computes every canary measurement, resource tally and refusal on device.
14682    /// ``bank`` identifies the recorded branch that owns these original outputs.
14683    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, step, bank, tensors, model_allocations, model_storages, model_views, numerical_admissibility, slab_backing, slab_bytes, baseline_forward, candidate_forward, allocation_witness, consumer_stream))]
14684    #[expect(
14685        clippy::too_many_arguments,
14686        reason = "prepared update binding retains model geometry and numerical admissibility"
14687    )]
14688    fn bind_prepared_update_output(
14689        &self,
14690        py: Python<'_>,
14691        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
14692        step: &PySemanticPreparedStep,
14693        bank: usize,
14694        tensors: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14695        model_allocations: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
