14696        model_storages: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14697        model_views: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14698        numerical_admissibility: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14699        slab_backing: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14700        slab_bytes: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14701        baseline_forward: &PySemanticModelForwardWitness,
14702        candidate_forward: &PySemanticModelForwardWitness,
14703        allocation_witness: &PySemanticTensorContentWitness,
14704        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14705    ) -> PyResult<()> {
14706        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
14707        self.require_read_issued(task_use)?;
14708        if bank > 1 {
14709            return Err(invalid("prepared model update bank must be zero or one"));
14710        }
14711        let parent = ContentStepRef::Prepared(step);
14712        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
14713        let stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(consumer_stream, &mut budget)?;
14714        let slab_bytes = ColdValue::read(slab_bytes, &mut budget, 0)?.unsigned()?;
14715        if slab_bytes == 0 || slab_bytes > i64::MAX as u64 {
14716            return Err(invalid(
14717                "model update slab has no supported exact byte extent",
14718            ));
14719        }
14720        let storages = parse_model_storages(model_storages, &mut budget)?;
14721        let views = parse_model_views(model_views, &mut budget)?;
14722        let expected = {
14723            let session = self.session.borrow(py);
14724            let owner = session.owner()?;
14725            let state = self.continuation_state(py, task_use, parent, &owner, None)?;
14726            step.require_recording_stream(&owner, stream)?;
14727            self.require_continuation_witness(py, parent, allocation_witness)?;
14728            if owner
14729                .prepared_transition_kind(&step.inner)
14730                .map_err(xlog_err)?
14731                != SemanticTransitionKind::Update
14732            {
14733                return Err(invalid(
14734                    "model update output belongs only to a prepared update",
14735                ));
14736            }
14737            self.continuation_binding(&state, parent, false)?
14738        };
14739        let check = || -> PyResult<()> {
14740            let session = self.session.borrow(py);
14741            let owner = session.owner()?;
14742            let state = self.continuation_state(py, task_use, parent, &owner, None)?;
14743            step.require_recording_stream(&owner, stream)?;
14744            self.require_continuation_witness(py, parent, allocation_witness)?;
14745            if self.continuation_binding(&state, parent, false)? != expected {
14746                return Err(invalid(
14747                    "prepared update authority changed during producer handoff",
14748                ));
14749            }
14750            Ok(())
14751        };
14752        let device = self.session.borrow(py).device_ordinal;
14753        let ParsedTensorInputs {
14754            handoff: allocation_handoff,
14755            producers: allocation_producers,
14756        } = parse_tensor_inputs_guarded(model_allocations, &mut budget, device, stream, &check)?;
14757        let mut producer_owners = TensorHandoff(vec![
14758            allocation_witness._inputs.clone_ref(py),
14759            model_allocations.clone().unbind(),
14760            tensors.clone().unbind(),
14761        ]);
14762        producer_owners.0.extend(
14763            allocation_witness
14764                ._producers
14765                .iter()
14766                .map(|producer| producer.clone_ref(py)),
14767        );
14768        producer_owners.0.extend(allocation_producers);
14769        let ParsedTensorInputs {
14770            handoff: tensor_handoff,
14771            producers: tensor_producers,
14772        } = parse_tensor_inputs_guarded(tensors, &mut budget, device, stream, &check)?;
14773        producer_owners.0.extend(tensor_producers);
14774        validate_producer_device_guarded(numerical_admissibility, device, &check)?;
14775        producer_owners
14776            .0
14777            .push(numerical_admissibility.clone().unbind());
14778        let allocation_index = u64::try_from(allocation_handoff.0.len())
14779            .map_err(|_| invalid("model update allocation roster is too large"))?;
14780        let numerical_admissibility = SemanticTensorInput {
14781            tensor: crate::dlpack_from_py_for_stream_guarded(
14782                numerical_admissibility,
14783                i64::try_from(stream)
14784                    .map_err(|_| invalid("consumer stream exceeds DLPack address space"))?,
14785                &check,
14786            )?,
14787            layout: SemanticTensorLayout {
14788                role: 0,
14789                index: allocation_index,
14790                element_bytes: 1,
14791                scalar_type: 8,
14792                rank: 1,
14793                logical_axis: u64::MAX,
14794                dimensions: [1, 0, 0, 0],
14795                strides_bytes: [1, 0, 0, 0],
14796            },
14797            logical_begin: 0,
14798            logical_end: 0,
14799            native_allocation: None,
14800        };
14801        validate_producer_device_guarded(slab_backing, device, &check)?;
14802        producer_owners.0.push(slab_backing.clone().unbind());
14803        let slab_backing = SemanticTensorInput {
14804            tensor: crate::dlpack_from_py_for_stream_guarded(
14805                slab_backing,
14806                i64::try_from(stream)
14807                    .map_err(|_| invalid("consumer stream exceeds DLPack address space"))?,
14808                &check,
14809            )?,
14810            layout: SemanticTensorLayout {
14811                role: 0,
14812                index: 0,
14813                element_bytes: 1,
14814                scalar_type: 1,
14815                rank: 1,
14816                logical_axis: u64::MAX,
14817                dimensions: [slab_bytes, 0, 0, 0],
14818                strides_bytes: [1, 0, 0, 0],
14819            },
14820            logical_begin: 0,
14821            logical_end: 0,
14822            native_allocation: None,
14823        };
14824        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
14825        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
14826        let state = self.continuation_state(py, task_use, parent, &owner, None)?;
14827        self.require_continuation_witness(py, parent, allocation_witness)?;
14828        if self.continuation_binding(&state, parent, false)? != expected {
14829            return Err(invalid(
14830                "prepared update authority changed during model output handoff",
14831            ));
14832        }
14833        owner
14834            .bind_prepared_update_output(
14835                &step.inner,
14836                bank,
14837                SemanticModelMemory {
14838                    allocations: allocation_handoff.into_native(),
14839                    storages,
14840                    views,
14841                },
14842                tensor_handoff.into_native(),
14843                numerical_admissibility,
14844                slab_backing,
14845                &baseline_forward.inner,
14846                &candidate_forward.inner,
14847                &allocation_witness.inner,
14848                stream,
14849            )
14850            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
14851        drop(state);
14852        drop(owner);
14853        drop(session);
14854        step.continuation_producers
14855            .lock()
14856            .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared update producer ownership mutex is poisoned"))?[bank]
14857            .append(&mut producer_owners.0);
14858        Ok(())
14859    }
14860
14861    /// Bind the original policy producers while this genuine step is recording.
14862    /// The combined transient witness covers text logits, product support,
14863    /// parameters, model-issued baselines, parameter/baseline errors, and
14864    /// parameter/text/baseline domains in that exact order. Numerical arrays
14865    /// are original CUDA FP64 views: pointwise E[...,2]=(O,U) and preliminary
14866    /// D[...,4]=(M,O,U,I). I is independently derived on the ideal formula.
14867    /// This records no host publication or RNG identity and returns no invocation;
14868    /// only actual completed execution can expose the original result and its
14869    /// retained late-backward tape. ``bank`` identifies the recorded branch whose
14870    /// original numerical producers remain owned until native result selection.
14871    /// Policy producers may bind before the original continuation. The native
14872    /// branch joins both bindings before any transition can execute.
14873    #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
14874    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, step, bank, binding, model_output, text_logits, product_support, parameters, component_baselines, parameter_errors, baseline_errors, parameter_domains, text_domains, baseline_domains, producer_witness, consumer_stream))]
14875    #[expect(
14876        clippy::too_many_arguments,
14877        reason = "parent binding retains complete publication and model ownership"
14878    )]
14879    fn bind_prepared_policy(
14880        &self,
14881        py: Python<'_>,
14882        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
14883        step: &PySemanticPreparedStep,
14884        bank: usize,
14885        binding: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14886        model_output: Py<PyAny>,
14887        text_logits: Py<PyAny>,
14888        product_support: Py<PyAny>,
14889        parameters: Py<PyAny>,
14890        component_baselines: Py<PyAny>,
14891        parameter_errors: Py<PyAny>,
14892        baseline_errors: Py<PyAny>,
14893        parameter_domains: Py<PyAny>,
14894        text_domains: Py<PyAny>,
14895        baseline_domains: Py<PyAny>,
14896        producer_witness: &PySemanticTensorContentWitness,
14897        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
14898    ) -> PyResult<()> {
14899        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
14900        if bank > 1 {
14901            return Err(invalid("prepared policy bank must be zero or one"));
14902        }
14903        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
14904        let stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(consumer_stream, &mut budget)?;
14905        let fields = object_sequence(binding, &mut budget)?;
14906        if fields.len() != 2 {
14907            return Err(invalid(
14908                "policy binding requires generation and exact digest bytes",
14909            ));
14910        }
14911        let binding = xlog_cuda::SemanticCatalogueBinding {
14912            generation: ColdValue::read(&fields[0], &mut budget, 0)?.unsigned()?,
14913            digest: identity_bytes(&fields[1])?,
14914        };
14915        let parent = ContentStepRef::Prepared(step);
14916        let expected = {
14917            let session = self.session.borrow(py);
14918            let owner = session.owner()?;
14919            let state = self.continuation_state(py, task_use, parent, &owner, None)?;
14920            step.require_recording_stream(&owner, stream)?;
14921            self.require_continuation_witness(py, parent, producer_witness)?;
14922            if binding != owner.binding() {
14923                return Err(invalid("policy packing belongs to another native binding"));
14924            }
14925            if step
14926                .policy_inputs
14927                .lock()
14928                .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared policy producer owner is poisoned"))?[bank]
14929                .is_some()
14930            {
14931                return Err(invalid("prepared policy producers were already bound"));
14932            }
14933            self.continuation_binding(&state, parent, false)?
14934        };
14935        let inputs = [
14936            text_logits,
14937            product_support,
14938            parameters,
14939            component_baselines,
14940            parameter_errors,
14941            baseline_errors,
14942            parameter_domains,
14943            text_domains,
14944            baseline_domains,
14945        ];
14946        let device = self.session.borrow(py).device_ordinal;
14947        let mut handoff = TensorHandoff(Vec::with_capacity(inputs.len()));
14948        let producer_stream = i64::try_from(stream)
14949            .map_err(|_| invalid("consumer stream exceeds the DLPack signed stream range"))?;
14950        let check = || {
14951            let session = self.session.borrow(py);
14952            let owner = session.owner()?;
14953            let state = self.continuation_state(py, task_use, parent, &owner, None)?;
14954            step.require_recording_stream(&owner, stream)?;
14955            self.require_continuation_witness(py, parent, producer_witness)?;
14956            if self.continuation_binding(&state, parent, false)? != expected {
14957                return Err(invalid(
14958                    "prepared policy authority changed during producer handoff",
14959                ));
14960            }
14961            Ok(())
14962        };
14963        for input in &inputs {
14964            validate_producer_device_guarded(input.bind(py), device, &check)?;
14965            handoff.0.push(crate::dlpack_from_py_for_stream_guarded(
14966                input.bind(py),
14967                producer_stream,
14968                &check,
14969            )?);
14970        }
14971        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
14972        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
14973        let state = self.continuation_state(py, task_use, parent, &owner, None)?;
14974        self.require_continuation_witness(py, parent, producer_witness)?;
14975        if self.continuation_binding(&state, parent, false)? != expected {
14976            return Err(invalid(
14977                "prepared policy authority changed during producer handoff",
14978            ));
14979        }
14980        let [text, support, parameters, component_baselines, parameter_errors,
14981            baseline_errors, parameter_domains, text_domains, baseline_domains]: [_; 9] = handoff
14982            .into_native()
14983            .try_into()
14984            .unwrap_or_else(|_| unreachable!("exact policy producer roster"));
14985        owner
14986            .bind_prepared_policy(
14987                &step.inner,
14988                bank,
14989                binding,
14990                text,
14991                support,
14992                parameters,
14993                component_baselines,
14994                [
14995                    parameter_errors,
14996                    baseline_errors,
14997                    parameter_domains,
14998                    text_domains,
14999                    baseline_domains,
15000                ],
15001                &producer_witness.inner,
15002                stream,
15003            )
15004            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
15005        drop(state);
15006        drop(owner);
15007        drop(session);
15008        let mut retained = step
15009            .policy_inputs
15010            .lock()
15011            .map_err(|_| invalid("prepared policy producer owner is poisoned"))?;
15012        if retained[bank].is_some() {
15013            return Err(invalid("prepared policy producers were already bound"));
15014        }
15015        retained[bank] = Some(PreparedPolicyInputs {
15016            model_output,
15017            inputs,
15018            invocation_issued: false,
15019        });
15020        Ok(())
15021    }
15022
15023    /// Snapshot one original full-MASK policy, execute all draws and the sole device
15024    /// publication, and retain its late tape. ``binding`` is the exact pair
15025    /// returned with the packing layout. The original contiguous CUDA inputs
15026    /// are F32[32,V], Bool8[support_cells], FP32[P], FP32[1,136], followed by
15027    /// FP64 envelopes [P,2], [1,136,2] and domains [P,4], [32,V,4], [1,136,4]
15028    /// in (M,O,U,I) order. Pointwise E differs from preliminary D.O/U.
15029    /// Their common witness uses that exact order on ``consumer_stream``.
15030    /// ``model_output`` is the caller-authenticated original output, retained
15031    /// without invoking a getter; rows/selected bits come only from the already
15032    /// admitted continuation. Acquire of the result remains explicit.
15033    #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
15034    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, parent, binding, model_output, text_logits, product_support, parameters, component_baselines, parameter_errors, baseline_errors, parameter_domains, text_domains, baseline_domains, producer_witness, consumer_stream))]
15035    #[expect(
15036        clippy::too_many_arguments,
15037        reason = "replay import carries independent material and lifecycle callbacks"
15038    )]
15039    fn execute_policy(
15040        &self,
15041        py: Python<'_>,
15042        task_use: Py<PySemanticTransitionTaskUse>,
15043        parent: Py<PySemanticPublishedParent>,
15044        binding: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15045        model_output: Py<PyAny>,
15046        text_logits: Py<PyAny>,
15047        product_support: Py<PyAny>,
15048        parameters: Py<PyAny>,
15049        component_baselines: Py<PyAny>,
15050        parameter_errors: Py<PyAny>,
15051        baseline_errors: Py<PyAny>,
15052        parameter_domains: Py<PyAny>,
15053        text_domains: Py<PyAny>,
15054        baseline_domains: Py<PyAny>,
15055        producer_witness: &PySemanticTensorContentWitness,
15056        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15057    ) -> PyResult<PySemanticPolicyInvocation> {
15058        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
15059        self.require_issued(&task_use.borrow(py))?;
15060        self.execute_policy_in_execution(
15061            py,
15062            task_use,
15063            parent,
15064            binding,
15065            model_output,
15066            text_logits,
15067            product_support,
15068            parameters,
15069            component_baselines,
15070            parameter_errors,
15071            baseline_errors,
15072            parameter_domains,
15073            text_domains,
15074            baseline_domains,
15075            producer_witness,
15076            consumer_stream,
15077            None,
15078            || Ok(()),
15079        )
15080    }
15081
15082    /// Publish the already admitted recompute/drain continuation without any
15083    /// policy draw. A proposal cannot use this entry: native preflight requires
15084    /// the actual bound policy. Returns the observed next proposal counter;
15085    /// acquire the new parent with the separate native Acquire operation.
15086    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, parent))]
15087    fn execute_continuation(
15088        &self,
15089        py: Python<'_>,
15090        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
15091        parent: &PySemanticPublishedParent,
15092    ) -> PyResult<u64> {
15093        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
15094        self.require_issued(task_use)?;
15095        self.execute_continuation_in_execution(py, task_use, parent, None)
15096    }
15097
15098    /// Materialize the initial native parent before any model continuation.
15099    /// This cold operation does not consume ``before_segment`` and returns only
15100    /// the device-validated ``(instance, word, logical_digest, state_digest)``;
15101    /// a model must separately acquire the resulting parent lease.
15102    ///
15103    /// ``source`` contains exactly 32 original ring rows and ``prefix`` the
15104    /// existing committed source, each ``(token, logical_position, kind,
15105    /// provenance, valid, committed, recomputed, provenance_record)``. Flags are
15106    /// exact bools, kinds are PAD=0/FILLED=1/MASK=2 and provenance is
15107    /// NONE=0/SOURCE=1/GENERATED=2. This fresh initializer accepts only observed
15108    /// SOURCE for FILLED; GENERATED needs actual published history restoration.
15109    /// Initial provenance_record values are zero; the controller derives actual
15110    /// ledger indices from the task's source_mapping. Neither sequence is sorted
15111    /// or repacked, and supplied FILLED tokens must equal their mapped payload.
15112    ///
15113    /// ``metadata`` is an exact dict with every key required: recovered_instance
15114    /// (None for this fresh initializer; recovery must preserve actual history), ring_head, provenance_capacity_records, prefix_capacity,
15115    /// feedback_capacity, max_position, pad_token, terminal_tokens,
15116    /// final_intent_payload_bytes, intent_effect (actual application bytes),
15117    /// intent_entry_capacity, intent_payload_capacity_bytes,
15118    /// acknowledgement_payload_capacity_bytes, model_generation, policy_generation,
15119    /// model_numerical_mode (complete, restorable producer-owned cold metadata),
15120    /// model_contract_layout (S_begin, S_bytes, S_digest_offset, generation_offset,
15121    /// N_offset, identity_offset), six u64 byte coordinates in record 44,
15122    /// neural_generation, cache_generation, training_cursor, training_rng
15123    /// (four u64 words), fuel, rng (model u32, stream u64, family u8, proposal u32),
15124    /// topology_identity and table_identity (bytes32), role_counts (55 u64s),
15125    /// active_layouts, authority_decisions_capacity_bytes. Active layouts are
15126    /// reserved shapes, not fabricated forward
15127    /// outputs; their initial content is uncomputed and cannot be acquired as a
15128    /// valid tensor. Decision capacity must fit the complete current and planned
15129    /// future snapshots; no implicit growth occurs. Authority generation comes
15130    /// from this native task use. Provenance capacity is in records and must fit
15131    /// the mapped initial records plus 32 possible appended generated tokens.
15132    ///
15133    /// ``records`` rows are ``(role, index, capacity_bytes, actual_bytes)``;
15134    /// generated native records are not caller inputs. In particular, role 3
15135    /// (PrefixIdentity) is derived from the actual PrefixSource by fresh native
15136    /// initialization; caller bytes are rejected, even for an empty prefix.
15137    /// RuntimeContract (role 43) is also native-generated: it joins the actual
15138    /// cold contract, capacities and layouts with the complete model contribution.
15139    /// Its own capacity is computed by the native producer, not supplied here.
15140    /// Checkpoint/replay restoration retains and validates the original bytes.
15141    /// Complete dependency and
15142    /// authority records are inserted from this controller's retained import.
15143    /// ``tensors`` rows are ``(layout, logical_begin, logical_end, producer)``.
15144    /// A layout is ``(role, index, element_bytes, scalar_type, rank, logical_axis,
15145    /// dimensions[4], strides_bytes[4])``. Scalar codes are U8=1/U32=2/U64=3/
15146    /// F16=4/BF16=5/F32=6/I64=7/Bool8=8/F64=9. The original DLPack dtype and layout must agree;
15147    /// no numerical conversion or detached replacement leaf is performed.
15148    /// ``model_allocations`` uses the same tensor-input rows with complete U8
15149    /// backing vectors, role zero and index equal to allocation ordinal.
15150    /// ``model_storages`` rows are ``(allocation, byte_offset, span_bytes)``;
15151    /// their ordinal is the producer storage identity. ``model_views`` rows are
15152    /// ``(role, index, storage, byte_offset)`` in role/index order. View offsets
15153    /// are relative to that storage, independently of tensor version identity.
15154    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, metadata, source, prefix, records, tensors, model_allocations, model_storages, model_views, prefill_receipt=None))]
15155    #[expect(
15156        clippy::too_many_arguments,
15157        reason = "execution continuation retains each typed producer and callback guard"
15158    )]
15159    fn bind_parent(
15160        &self,
15161        py: Python<'_>,
15162        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
15163        metadata: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15164        source: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15165        prefix: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15166        records: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15167        tensors: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15168        model_allocations: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15169        model_storages: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15170        model_views: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15171        prefill_receipt: Option<&PySemanticInitialPrefillReceipt>,
15172    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
15173        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
15174        self.require_read_issued(task_use)?;
15175        {
15176            let session = self.session.borrow(py);
15177            task_use.require_current(&*session.owner()?)?;
15178            if !matches!(
15179                task_use.state()?.phase,
15180                TaskUsePhase::Imported | TaskUsePhase::InitialPrefillReady { .. }
15181            ) {
15182                return Err(invalid(
15183                    "initial parent must be bound before segment admission",
15184                ));
15185            }
15186        }
15187        let mut parent = parse_parent(metadata, source, prefix, records, task_use)?;
15188        let prefill_scope = if parent.prefix.is_empty() {
15189            if prefill_receipt.is_some() {
15190                return Err(invalid(
15191                    "empty initial prefix cannot consume a prefill receipt",
15192                ));
15193            }
15194            None
15195        } else {
15196            let receipt = prefill_receipt.ok_or_else(|| {
15197                invalid("nonempty initial prefix requires its completed prefill receipt")
15198            })?;
15199            let stage = receipt.stage.borrow(py);
15200            if stage.session.as_ptr() != self.session.as_ptr()
15201                || !stage
15202                    .task_use
15203                    .borrow(py)
15204                    .issuance
15205                    .same_as(&task_use.issuance)
15206                || receipt.consumed.load(Ordering::Acquire)
15207            {
15208                return Err(invalid(
15209                    "initial prefill receipt belongs to another or consumed task",
15210                ));
15211            }
15212            task_use
15213                .state()?
15214                .require_initial_prefill_ready(&stage.scope)?;
15215            Some(Arc::clone(&stage.scope))
15216        };
15217        let device = self.session.borrow(py).device_ordinal;
15218        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
15219        parent.model_memory.storages = parse_model_storages(model_storages, &mut budget)?;
15220        parent.model_memory.views = parse_model_views(model_views, &mut budget)?;
15221        let ParsedTensorInputs {
15222            handoff: tensors,
15223            producers: _producers,
15224        } = parse_tensor_inputs(tensors, &mut budget, device)?;
15225        let ParsedTensorInputs {
15226            handoff: allocations,
15227            producers: _allocation_producers,
15228        } = parse_tensor_inputs(model_allocations, &mut budget, device)?;
15229        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
15230        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
15231        task_use.require_current(&owner)?;
15232        let state = task_use.state()?;
15233        if !matches!(
15234            (&state.phase, parent.prefix.is_empty()),
15235            (TaskUsePhase::Imported, true) | (TaskUsePhase::InitialPrefillReady { .. }, false)
15236        ) {
15237            return Err(invalid("task phase changed during parent producer handoff"));
15238        }
15239        drop(state);
15240        parent.tensors = tensors.into_native();
15241        parent.model_memory.allocations = allocations.into_native();
15242        if let Some(receipt) = prefill_receipt {
15243            receipt
15244                .consumed
15245                .compare_exchange(false, true, Ordering::AcqRel, Ordering::Acquire)
15246                .map_err(|_| invalid("initial prefill receipt was already consumed"))?;
15247        }
15248        let identity = match owner.bind_parent(parent) {
15249            Ok(identity) => identity,
15250            Err(error) => {
15251                if prefill_scope.is_some() {
15252                    owner.abort();
15253                    task_use.state()?.phase = TaskUsePhase::Refused;
15254                }
15255                return Err(xlog_err(error));
15256            }
15257        };
15258        if let Some(scope) = prefill_scope {
15259            task_use.state()?.commit_initial_prefill(&scope)?;
15260        }
15261        Ok((
15262            PyBytes::new(py, identity.instance.as_bytes()),
15263            identity.word,
15264            PyBytes::new(py, identity.logical_digest.as_bytes()),
15265            PyBytes::new(py, identity.state_digest.as_bytes()),
15266        )
15267            .into_pyobject(py)?
15268            .unbind())
15269    }
15270
15271    /// Revalidate after the segment, before any externally visible activation.
15272    /// Fresh independent rights and this actual acquired FINAL bank's native
15273    /// terminal intent are both required. This check does not deliver an effect.
15274    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, parent, snapshot))]
15275    fn before_external_activation(
15276        &self,
15277        py: Python<'_>,
15278        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
15279        parent: &PySemanticPublishedParent,
15280        snapshot: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15281    ) -> PyResult<()> {
15282        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
15283        self.require_issued(task_use)?;
15284        parent.require_task(py, task_use)?;
15285        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
15286        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
15287        task_use.require_current(&owner)?;
15288        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
15289        let snapshot = AuthoritySnapshot::parse(&ColdValue::read(snapshot, &mut budget, 0)?)?;
15290        task_use
15291            .state()?
15292            .revalidate_activation(&task_use.authority, snapshot)?;
15293        owner
15294            .admit_external_activation(&*parent.lease()?)
15295            .map_err(xlog_err)
15296    }
15297
15298    /// Bind one local receiver to this TaskUse before delivery. Only the
15299    /// privileged application may source these exact bytes from its retained
15300    /// live grant; the task document and checkpoint never carry the secret.
15301    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, recipient_id, verification_key, expected_effect))]
15302    fn bind_delivery_receiver(
15303        &self,
15304        py: Python<'_>,
15305        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
15306        recipient_id: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15307        verification_key: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15308        expected_effect: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15309    ) -> PyResult<()> {
15310        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
15311        self.require_issued(task_use)?;
15312        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
15313        let owner = session.owner()?;
15314        task_use.require_current(&owner)?;
15315        drop(owner);
15316        let recipient_id = identity_bytes(recipient_id)?;
15317        if recipient_id == Identity256::default()
15318            || !verification_key.is_exact_instance_of::<PyBytes>()
15319            || !expected_effect.is_exact_instance_of::<PyBytes>()
15320        {
15321            return Err(invalid(
15322                "trusted receiver requires exact nonzero identity, key and effect bytes",
15323            ));
15324        }
15325        let verification_key: [u8; 32] = verification_key
15326            .cast::<PyBytes>()?
15327            .as_bytes()
15328            .try_into()
15329            .map_err(|_| invalid("delivery verification key must contain exactly 32 bytes"))?;
15330        let expected_effect = expected_effect.cast::<PyBytes>()?.as_bytes().to_vec();
15331        if verification_key.iter().all(|&byte| byte == 0) || expected_effect.is_empty() {
15332            return Err(invalid("trusted receiver key and effect must be nonempty"));
15333        }
15334        let mut binding = task_use
15335            .delivery
15336            .lock()
15337            .map_err(|_| PyRuntimeError::new_err("delivery receiver binding mutex is poisoned"))?;
15338        if binding.is_some() {
15339            return Err(invalid(
15340                "task use already has its one delivery receiver binding",
15341            ));
15342        }
15343        *binding = Some(DeliveryReceiverBinding {
15344            recipient_id,
15345            verification_key,
15346            expected_effect,
15347        });
15348        Ok(())
15349    }
15350
15351    /// Commit one durable receiver acknowledgement after FINAL. The key and
15352    /// recipient come from the trusted local grant, never from task content.
15353    /// A byte-identical retry returns the existing publication identity.
15354    #[pyo3(signature = (task_use, *, parent, snapshot, receipt))]
15355    fn acknowledge_delivery(
15356        &self,
15357        py: Python<'_>,
15358        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
15359        parent: &PySemanticPublishedParent,
15360        snapshot: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15361        receipt: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15362    ) -> PyResult<Py<PyTuple>> {
15363        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
15364        self.require_issued(task_use)?;
15365        parent.require_task(py, task_use)?;
15366        if !receipt.is_exact_instance_of::<PyBytes>() {
15367            return Err(invalid(
15368                "delivery acknowledgement requires exact receipt bytes",
15369            ));
15370        }
15371        let binding = task_use.delivery_binding()?;
15372        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
15373        let snapshot = AuthoritySnapshot::parse(&ColdValue::read(snapshot, &mut budget, 0)?)?;
15374        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
15375        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
15376        task_use.require_current(&owner)?;
15377        task_use
15378            .state()?
15379            .revalidate_activation(&task_use.authority, snapshot)?;
15380        let identity = owner
15381            .acknowledge_delivery(
15382                &*parent.lease()?,
15383                receipt.cast::<PyBytes>()?.as_bytes(),
15384                binding.recipient_id,
15385                &binding.verification_key,
15386                &binding.expected_effect,
15387            )
15388            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
15389        Ok((
15390            PyBytes::new(py, identity.instance.as_bytes()),
15391            identity.word,
15392            PyBytes::new(py, identity.logical_digest.as_bytes()),
15393            PyBytes::new(py, identity.state_digest.as_bytes()),
15394        )
15395            .into_pyobject(py)?
15396            .unbind())
15397    }
15398}
15399
15400impl PySemanticTransitionController {
15401    fn bind_tensor_content(
15402        &self,
15403        py: Python<'_>,
15404        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
15405        parent: ContentStepOwner,
15406        tensors: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15407        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15408        binding_kind: TensorContentBinding,
15409    ) -> PyResult<PySemanticTensorContentWitness> {
15410        self.session.borrow(py).require_creator()?;
15411        self.require_read_issued(task_use)?;
15412        match &parent {
15413            ContentStepOwner::Published(acquired) => {
15414                acquired.borrow(py).require_task(py, task_use)?
15415            }
15416            ContentStepOwner::Prepared(step) => step.borrow(py).require_task(py, task_use)?,
15417        }
15418        let binding = {
15419            let session = self.session.borrow(py);
15420            let owner = session.owner()?;
15421            parent.binding(py, &owner, false)?
15422        };
15423        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
15424        let stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(consumer_stream, &mut budget)?;
15425        let inputs = tensors.clone().unbind();
15426        let device = self.session.borrow(py).device_ordinal;
15427        let check = || -> PyResult<()> {
15428            let session = self.session.borrow(py);
15429            let owner = session.owner()?;
15430            if parent.binding(py, &owner, false)? != binding {
15431                return Err(invalid(
15432                    "original content scope changed during producer callback",
15433                ));
15434            }
15435            parent.check_producer_stream(py, &owner, stream)
15436        };
15437        check()?;
15438        let ParsedTensorInputs { handoff, producers } =
15439            parse_tensor_inputs_guarded(tensors, &mut budget, device, stream, &check)?;
15440        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
15441        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
15442        task_use.require_identity(&owner)?;
15443        let state = task_use.state()?;
15444        let inner = match &parent {
15445            ContentStepOwner::Published(acquired) => {
15446                let acquired = acquired.borrow(py);
15447                let (operation, snapshot) = state.content_handoff_binding()?;
15448                if (Some(operation), snapshot) != binding {
15449                    return Err(invalid(
15450                        "tensor content authority changed during producer handoff",
15451                    ));
15452                }
15453                let lease = acquired.lease()?;
15454                owner.published_identity(&lease).map_err(xlog_err)?;
15455                match binding_kind {
15456                    TensorContentBinding::Capture => {
15457                        owner.capture_tensor_content(&lease, handoff.into_native(), stream)
15458                    }
15459                    TensorContentBinding::Model(None) => {
15460                        owner.bind_model_content(&lease, handoff.into_native(), stream)
15461                    }
15462                    TensorContentBinding::Model(Some(_)) => {
15463                        return Err(invalid(
15464                            "published model content does not accept a prepared bank",
15465                        ));
15466                    }
15467                }
15468            }
15469            ContentStepOwner::Prepared(step) => {
15470                let step = step.borrow(py);
15471                if state.prepared_content_binding(&step.scope)? != binding {
15472                    return Err(invalid(
15473                        "tensor content authority changed during producer handoff",
15474                    ));
15475                }
15476                match binding_kind {
15477                    TensorContentBinding::Model(Some(bank)) => owner.bind_prepared_model_content(
15478                        &step.inner,
15479                        bank,
15480                        handoff.into_native(),
15481                        stream,
15482                    ),
15483                    TensorContentBinding::Model(None) => {
15484                        return Err(invalid("prepared model content requires bank zero or one"));
15485                    }
15486                    TensorContentBinding::Capture => owner.capture_prepared_tensor_content(
15487                        &step.inner,
15488                        handoff.into_native(),
15489                        stream,
15490                    ),
15491                }
15492            }
15493        }
15494        .map_err(xlog_err)?;
15495        drop(state);
15496        drop(owner);
15497        Ok(PySemanticTensorContentWitness {
15498            inner,
15499            _inputs: inputs,
15500            _producers: producers,
15501            parent,
15502            session: self.session.clone_ref(py),
15503        })
15504    }
15505
15506    fn require_issued(&self, task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse) -> PyResult<()> {
15507        self.require_read_issued(task_use)?;
15508        task_use.state()?.require_public_use()
15509    }
15510
15511    fn require_read_issued(&self, task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse) -> PyResult<()> {
15512        task_use.issuance.require_current()?;
15513        if !Arc::ptr_eq(&self.identity, &task_use.controller) {
15514            return Err(invalid("task use belongs to another controller"));
15515        }
15516        Ok(())
15517    }
15518
15519    fn check_recording(
15520        &self,
15521        py: Python<'_>,
15522        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
15523        scope: &Arc<()>,
15524        snapshot: &[u8],
15525    ) -> PyResult<()> {
15526        self.require_read_issued(task_use)?;
15527        if self.session.as_ptr() != task_use.session.as_ptr() {
15528            return Err(invalid("recording belongs to another Session"));
15529        }
15530        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
15531        let owner = session.owner()?;
15532        task_use.require_identity(&owner)?;
15533        let state = task_use.state()?;
15534        if !session.recording.load(Ordering::Acquire)
15535            || !matches!(&state.phase, TaskUsePhase::Recording { scope: current, .. }
15536                if Arc::ptr_eq(scope, current))
15537            || state.snapshot.canonical != snapshot
15538        {
15539            return Err(invalid(
15540                "original recording scope or authority changed during callback",
15541            ));
15542        }
15543        Ok(())
15544    }
15545}
15546
15547impl PySemanticTransitionController {
15548    // Pure phase projection; the caller derives `importing` only after
15549    // validating the private guard. This grants no native execution by itself.
15550    fn execution_binding(state: &TaskUseState, importing: bool) -> PyResult<(String, Vec<u8>)> {
15551        let operation = match (&state.phase, importing) {
15552            (TaskUsePhase::Segment(operation), false)
15553            | (
15554                TaskUsePhase::Importing {
15555                    operation,
15556                    reads: false,
15557                },
15558                true,
15559            ) => operation,
15560            _ => {
15561                return Err(invalid(
15562                    "controller execution requires its admitted phase with import reads closed",
15563                ))
15564            }
15565        };
15566        Ok((operation.clone(), state.snapshot.canonical.clone()))
15567    }
15568
15569    fn execution_state<'a>(
15570        &self,
15571        py: Python<'_>,
15572        task_use: &'a PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
15573        parent: &PySemanticPublishedParent,
15574        owner: &SemanticTransitionSession,
15575        import: Option<&ColdImportGuard<'_>>,
15576    ) -> PyResult<MutexGuard<'a, TaskUseState>> {
15577        self.require_read_issued(task_use)?;
15578        parent.require_task(py, task_use)?;
15579        if self.session.as_ptr() != task_use.session.as_ptr()
15580            || self.session.as_ptr() != parent.session.as_ptr()
15581        {
15582            return Err(invalid(
15583                "controller execution owners belong to another native Session",
15584            ));
15585        }
15586        task_use.require_identity(owner)?;
15587        if let Some(guard) = import {
15588            let session = self.session.borrow(py);
15589            if !std::ptr::eq(&*session, guard.session)
15590                || guard.committed
15591                || !guard.issuance.same_as(&task_use.issuance)
15592                || !session.importing.load(Ordering::Acquire)
15593            {
15594                return Err(invalid(
15595                    "controller execution requires this Session's active uncommitted import guard",
15596                ));
15597            }
15598        }
15599        let state = task_use.state()?;
15600        Self::execution_binding(&state, import.is_some())?;
15601        Ok(state)
15602    }
15603
15604    #[expect(
15605        clippy::too_many_arguments,
15606        reason = "replay import carries independent material and lifecycle callbacks"
15607    )]
15608    fn replay_import(
15609        &self,
15610        py: Python<'_>,
15611        task_use: &Py<PySemanticTransitionTaskUse>,
15612        ordinal: usize,
15613        material: NativeReplayBinding,
15614        kind: SemanticTransitionKind,
15615        restore_invocation: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15616        _pack_policy: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15617        finish_invocation: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15618        refresh_snapshot: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15619        import: &ColdImportGuard<'_>,
15620        retain_policy: bool,
15621    ) -> PyResult<Option<Py<PySemanticRetainedReplayMember>>> {
15622        #[cfg(not(feature = "semantic-policy"))]
15623        let _ = retain_policy;
15624        #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
15625        let original_decisions = Arc::clone(&material.original_decisions);
15626        let material = Arc::new(material.material);
15627        let issued = task_use.borrow(py);
15628        let lease = {
15629            let mut owner = import.session.owner()?;
15630            issued.require_identity(&owner)?;
15631            let lease = owner.acquire().map_err(xlog_err)?;
15632            owner.admit_transition(&lease, kind).map_err(xlog_err)?;
15633            lease
15634        };
15635        let parent = Py::new(
15636            py,
15637            PySemanticPublishedParent {
15638                session: self.session.clone_ref(py),
15639                task_use: task_use.clone_ref(py),
15640                inner: Mutex::new(lease),
15641                continuation_producers: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
15642            },
15643        )?;
15644        let acquired = parent.borrow(py);
15645        let expected = {
15646            let owner = import.session.owner()?;
15647            let state = self.execution_state(py, &issued, &acquired, &owner, Some(import))?;
15648            Self::execution_binding(&state, true)?
15649        };
15650        // All temporary original outputs and policy invocation owners leave this
15651        // block before the Runtime is asked to retire its remaining aliases.
15652        let replay_result = (|| -> PyResult<Option<Py<PySemanticRetainedReplayMember>>> {
15653            let row = issued.authority.replay[ordinal].python_view(py)?;
15654            let transition = match kind {
15655                SemanticTransitionKind::Proposal => "proposal",
15656                SemanticTransitionKind::Recompute => "recompute",
15657                SemanticTransitionKind::Update => "update",
15658                SemanticTransitionKind::Drain => "drain",
15659            };
15660            let restored = {
15661                let _reads = ImportReadScope::enter(&issued)?;
15662                restore_invocation.call1((
15663                    task_use.clone_ref(py),
15664                    parent.clone_ref(py),
15665                    row,
15666                    transition,
15667                ))?
15668            };
15669            self.check_import_callback(py, &issued, &acquired, import, &expected)?;
15670            let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
15671            let restored = object_sequence(&restored, &mut budget)?;
15672            if restored.len() != 3 || !restored[1].is_callable() {
15673                return Err(invalid(
15674                    "original invocation restore must return its output, final continuation callable and consumer stream",
15675                ));
15676            }
15677            // Retain the original output even without the policy feature.
15678            let _original_output = restored[0].clone().unbind();
15679            // Freeze the original stream before policy handoffs. The delayed
15680            // continuation supplies its final witness but cannot replace this
15681            // stream or an earlier continuation accepted by native code.
15682            let consumer_stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(&restored[2], &mut budget)?
15683                .into_pyobject(py)?
15684                .into_any();
15685            let bind_continuation = |mut budget: usize| {
15686                let continuation = {
15687                    let _reads = ImportReadScope::enter(&issued)?;
15688                    restored[1].call1((
15689                        task_use.clone_ref(py),
15690                        parent.clone_ref(py),
15691                        _original_output.clone_ref(py),
15692                    ))?
15693                };
15694                self.check_import_callback(py, &issued, &acquired, import, &expected)?;
15695                let arguments = object_sequence(&continuation, &mut budget)?;
15696                let (blocks, schema, identity, tensors_index, witness_index) = if kind
15697                    == SemanticTransitionKind::Proposal
15698                {
15699                    if arguments.len() != 11 {
15700                        return Err(invalid("final proposal continuation requires seven CUDA services, sealed model identities, tensors and its captured producer witness"));
15701                    }
15702                    (
15703                        Some(&arguments[6]),
15704                        Some(&arguments[7]),
15705                        Some(&arguments[8]),
15706                        9,
15707                        10,
15708                    )
15709                } else {
15710                    if arguments.len() != 8 {
15711                        return Err(invalid("final non-drawing continuation requires six CUDA services, tensors and its captured producer witness"));
15712                    }
15713                    (None, None, None, 6, 7)
15714                };
15715                let producer_witness = arguments[witness_index]
15716                    .extract::<PyRef<'_, PySemanticTensorContentWitness>>()?;
15717                self.bind_continuation_in_execution(
15718                    py,
15719                    &issued,
15720                    ContentStepRef::Published(&acquired),
15721                    &arguments[0],
15722                    &arguments[1],
15723                    &arguments[2],
15724                    &arguments[3],
15725                    &arguments[4],
15726                    &arguments[5],
15727                    &arguments[tensors_index],
15728                    &producer_witness,
15729                    &consumer_stream,
15730                    None,
15731                    Some(import),
15732                    blocks,
15733                    schema,
15734                    identity,
15735                    None,
15736                )
15737            };
15738            if kind == SemanticTransitionKind::Proposal {
15739                #[cfg(feature = "semantic-policy")]
15740                {
15741                    let policy = {
15742                        let _reads = ImportReadScope::enter(&issued)?;
15743                        _pack_policy.call1((
15744                            task_use.clone_ref(py),
15745                            parent.clone_ref(py),
15746                            _original_output.clone_ref(py),
15747                        ))?
15748                    };
15749                    self.check_import_callback(py, &issued, &acquired, import, &expected)?;
15750                    let policy = object_sequence(&policy, &mut budget)?;
15751                    if policy.len() != 11 {
15752                        return Err(invalid("Runtime replay policy requires binding, text, parameters, product support, baselines, five original numerical views and their common witness"));
15753                    }
15754                    let policy_witness =
15755                        policy[10].extract::<PyRef<'_, PySemanticTensorContentWitness>>()?;
15756                    let invocation = self.execute_policy_in_execution(
15757                        py,
15758                        task_use.clone_ref(py),
15759                        parent.clone_ref(py),
15760                        &policy[0],
15761                        _original_output.clone_ref(py),
15762                        policy[1].clone().unbind(),
15763                        policy[3].clone().unbind(),
15764                        policy[2].clone().unbind(),
15765                        policy[4].clone().unbind(),
15766                        policy[5].clone().unbind(),
15767                        policy[6].clone().unbind(),
15768                        policy[7].clone().unbind(),
15769                        policy[8].clone().unbind(),
15770                        policy[9].clone().unbind(),
15771                        &policy_witness,
15772                        &consumer_stream,
15773                        Some(import),
15774                        || bind_continuation(budget),
15775                    )?;
15776                    // Keep the complete original invocation in existing failure
15777                    // custody until native final use succeeds. Import replay
15778                    // verifies history; it neither runs a backward nor opens
15779                    // the public policy final-use API during Importing.
15780                    let comparison = invocation
15781                        .outcome
15782                        .as_published()
15783                        .map_err(xlog_err)
15784                        .and_then(|_| {
15785                            self.verify_import_successor(py, &issued, &acquired, &material, import)
15786                        });
15787                    if retain_policy {
15788                        comparison?;
15789                        let invocation = Py::new(py, invocation)?;
15790                        return Py::new(
15791                            py,
15792                            PySemanticRetainedReplayMember {
15793                                session: self.session.clone_ref(py),
15794                                task_use: task_use.clone_ref(py),
15795                                parent: parent.clone_ref(py),
15796                                controller_identity: Arc::clone(&self.identity),
15797                                replay_ordinal: ordinal as u64,
15798                                replay_row: issued.authority.replay[ordinal].training_view_row()?,
15799                                invocation,
15800                                original_decisions,
15801                                material: Arc::clone(&material),
15802                                expected: expected.clone(),
15803                                finish_invocation: finish_invocation.clone().unbind(),
15804                                refresh_snapshot: refresh_snapshot.clone().unbind(),
15805                                group_use: Mutex::new(RetainedGroupUse {
15806                                    update: None,
15807                                    target: None,
15808                                    completion: None,
15809                                    banks: [false; 2],
15810                                    gradient_banks: [false; 2],
15811                                    deliveries: std::array::from_fn(|_| None),
15812                                }),
15813                                completed: AtomicBool::new(false),
15814                            },
15815                        )
15816                        .map(Some);
15817                    }
15818                    let retained = TensorHandoff(vec![invocation]);
15819                    let invocation = &retained.0[0];
15820                    let completion = (|| -> PyResult<()> {
15821                        let mut owner = import.session.owner()?;
15822                        let state =
15823                            self.execution_state(py, &issued, &acquired, &owner, Some(import))?;
15824                        if Self::execution_binding(&state, true)? != expected {
15825                            return Err(invalid(
15826                                "policy import authority changed before final use",
15827                            ));
15828                        }
15829                        invocation.start_final_use()?;
15830                        // Policy handoff and predecessor/successor comparison
15831                        // use this controller-owned legacy stream. Native final
15832                        // use also checks the original continuation's stream.
15833                        owner
15834                            .finish_policy_invocation(&*acquired.lease()?, invocation.rng, 1)
15835                            .map_err(xlog_err)
15836                    })();
15837                    if completion.is_ok() {
15838                        drop(retained.into_native());
15839                    }
15840                    // Finalization is attempted once even for a refusal or a
15841                    // failed comparison. Uncertain completion retains invocation,
15842                    // tape and reader; reader release will not retry that use.
15843                    finish_with_cleanup(py, comparison, completion)?;
15844                }
15845                #[cfg(not(feature = "semantic-policy"))]
15846                return Err(invalid("proposal replay requires a semantic-policy build"));
15847            } else {
15848                bind_continuation(budget)?;
15849                self.execute_continuation_in_execution(py, &issued, &acquired, Some(import))?;
15850                self.verify_import_successor(py, &issued, &acquired, &material, import)?;
15851            }
15852            Ok(None)
15853        })();
15854        if replay_result.as_ref().is_ok_and(Option::is_some) {
15855            return replay_result;
15856        }
15857        self.finalize_replay_import(
15858            py,
15859            task_use,
15860            &parent,
15861            &issued,
15862            &acquired,
15863            &material,
15864            finish_invocation,
15865            refresh_snapshot,
15866            import,
15867            &expected,
15868            replay_result.map(|_| ()),
15869        )?;
15870        Ok(None)
15871    }
15872
15873    #[expect(
15874        clippy::too_many_arguments,
15875        reason = "one canonical replay completion retains original callbacks and native owners"
15876    )]
15877    fn finalize_replay_import(
15878        &self,
15879        py: Python<'_>,
15880        task_use: &Py<PySemanticTransitionTaskUse>,
15881        parent: &Py<PySemanticPublishedParent>,
15882        issued: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
15883        acquired: &PySemanticPublishedParent,
15884        material: &xlog_cuda::SemanticReplayMaterial,
15885        finish_invocation: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15886        refresh_snapshot: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
15887        import: &ColdImportGuard<'_>,
15888        expected: &(String, Vec<u8>),
15889        replay_result: PyResult<()>,
15890    ) -> PyResult<()> {
15891        // Cleanup runs exactly once even if restore, packing, execution or the
15892        // first comparison failed. Its sole permission is retiring the original
15893        // Runtime's temporary owners; an aborted native owner still rejects reads.
15894        let cleanup_result = (|| -> PyResult<Vec<u64>> {
15895            let streams = {
15896                let _reads = ImportReadScope::enter(issued)?;
15897                finish_invocation.call1((task_use.clone_ref(py), parent.clone_ref(py)))?
15898            };
15899            let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
15900            let mut streams = ColdValue::read(&streams, &mut budget, 0)?
15901                .sequence()?
15902                .iter()
15903                .map(ColdValue::unsigned)
15904                .collect::<PyResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
15905            // Complete-state verification uses this actual controller-owned
15906            // legacy stream in addition to the Runtime's exact consumer roster.
15907            if !streams.contains(&1) {
15908                streams.push(1);
15909            }
15910            Ok(streams)
15911        })();
15912        let streams = match (replay_result, cleanup_result) {
15913            (Err(error), cleanup) => {
15914                let release = cleanup
15915                    .and_then(|streams| Self::release_import_reader(acquired, import, &streams));
15916                return finish_with_cleanup(py, Err(error), release);
15917            }
15918            (Ok(()), Err(error)) => return Err(error),
15919            (Ok(()), Ok(streams)) => streams,
15920        };
15921        let mut release_allowed = true;
15922        let final_result = (|| -> PyResult<AuthoritySnapshot> {
15923            self.check_import_callback(py, issued, acquired, import, expected)?;
15924            // Current authority refresh is not a model callback and opens no
15925            // unfinished import reads. Historical role39 never supplies rights.
15926            let snapshot = refresh_snapshot.call0()?;
15927            let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
15928            let snapshot = AuthoritySnapshot::parse(&ColdValue::read(&snapshot, &mut budget, 0)?)?;
15929            {
15930                let mut owner = import.session.owner()?;
15931                let state = self.execution_state(py, issued, acquired, &owner, Some(import))?;
15932                if Self::execution_binding(&state, true)? != *expected {
15933                    return Err(invalid(
15934                        "current authority changed outside the importer's refresh",
15935                    ));
15936                }
15937                snapshot.newer_than(&state.snapshot)?;
15938                issued.authority.check_use(&expected.0, &snapshot, false)?;
15939                // Join all callback writes to P/S shared storage and retire
15940                // aliases, but retain P's reader for final full comparison.
15941                // An uncertain completion is quarantined, never retried here.
15942                release_allowed = false;
15943                owner
15944                    .quiesce_published_reader(&*acquired.lease()?, &streams)
15945                    .map_err(xlog_err)?;
15946                release_allowed = true;
15947            }
15948            self.verify_import_successor(py, issued, acquired, material, import)?;
15949            Ok(snapshot)
15950        })();
15951        let release = if release_allowed {
15952            Self::release_import_reader(acquired, import, &streams)
15953        } else {
15954            Ok(())
15955        };
15956        let snapshot = finish_with_cleanup(py, final_result, release)?;
15957        let owner = import.session.owner()?;
15958        let mut state = self.execution_state(py, issued, acquired, &owner, Some(import))?;
15959        state.finish_import(&issued.authority, snapshot)?;
15960        Ok(())
15961    }
15962
15963    fn release_import_reader(
15964        parent: &PySemanticPublishedParent,
15965        import: &ColdImportGuard<'_>,
15966        streams: &[u64],
15967    ) -> PyResult<()> {
15968        let mut owner = import.session.owner()?;
15969        if owner.is_poisoned() {
15970            return Err(invalid(
15971                "failed native completion retains the import reader in quarantine",
15972            ));
15973        }
15974        owner
15975            .release(&mut *parent.lease()?, streams)
15976            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
15977        drop(owner);
15978        parent.release_continuation_producers();
15979        Ok(())
15980    }
15981
15982    fn check_import_callback(
15983        &self,
15984        py: Python<'_>,
15985        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
15986        parent: &PySemanticPublishedParent,
15987        import: &ColdImportGuard<'_>,
15988        expected: &(String, Vec<u8>),
15989    ) -> PyResult<()> {
15990        let owner = import.session.owner()?;
15991        let state = self.execution_state(py, task_use, parent, &owner, Some(import))?;
15992        if Self::execution_binding(&state, true)? != *expected {
15993            return Err(invalid(
15994                "import callback changed the task's original current authority",
15995            ));
15996        }
15997        owner
15998            .published_identity(&*parent.lease()?)
15999            .map_err(xlog_err)?;
16000        Ok(())
16001    }
16002
16003    fn verify_import_successor(
16004        &self,
16005        py: Python<'_>,
16006        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
16007        predecessor: &PySemanticPublishedParent,
16008        material: &xlog_cuda::SemanticReplayMaterial,
16009        import: &ColdImportGuard<'_>,
16010    ) -> PyResult<()> {
16011        let mut owner = import.session.owner()?;
16012        let _state = self.execution_state(py, task_use, predecessor, &owner, Some(import))?;
16013        let mut successor = owner.acquire().map_err(xlog_err)?;
16014        let comparison = predecessor.lease().and_then(|lease| {
16015            owner
16016                .verify_replay_publication(material, &lease, &successor)
16017                .map_err(xlog_err)
16018        });
16019        // This private successor was never exported to Python; native full
16020        // content verification registered the controller's legacy stream 1.
16021        // Retire its actual native reader even on comparison failure; preserve
16022        // both errors if cleanup also fails and let import abort own it.
16023        let release = owner.release(&mut successor, &[1]).map_err(xlog_err);
16024        // Normalizing an exception may execute Python; release native locks first.
16025        drop(_state);
16026        drop(owner);
16027        finish_with_cleanup(py, comparison, release)
16028    }
16029
16030    #[expect(
16031        clippy::too_many_arguments,
16032        reason = "execution continuation retains each typed producer and callback guard"
16033    )]
16034    fn bind_continuation_in_execution(
16035        &self,
16036        py: Python<'_>,
16037        task_use: &PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
16038        parent: ContentStepRef<'_>,
16039        text_rows: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
16040        text_row_count: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
16041        selected_text: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
16042        active_rows: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
16043        active_row_count: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
16044        numerical_admissibility: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
16045        tensors: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
16046        producer_witness: &PySemanticTensorContentWitness,
16047        consumer_stream: &Bound<'_, PyAny>,
16048        prepared_bank: Option<usize>,
16049        import: Option<&ColdImportGuard<'_>>,
16050        numerical_blocks: Option<&Bound<'_, PyAny>>,
16051        model_schema_digest: Option<&Bound<'_, PyAny>>,
16052        model_identity: Option<&Bound<'_, PyAny>>,
16053        model_content_witness: Option<&PySemanticTensorContentWitness>,
16054    ) -> PyResult<()> {
16055        match parent {
16056            ContentStepRef::Published(_) if prepared_bank.is_some() => {
16057                return Err(invalid(
16058                    "published continuation does not accept a prepared bank",
16059                ));
16060            }
16061            ContentStepRef::Prepared(_) if prepared_bank.is_none_or(|bank| bank > 1) => {
16062                return Err(invalid("prepared continuation requires bank zero or one"));
16063            }
16064            _ => {}
16065        }
16066        if model_content_witness.is_some() && matches!(parent, ContentStepRef::Published(_)) {
16067            return Err(invalid("acquired continuation requires its verified host model identities, not a prepared model-content witness"));
16068        }
16069        if matches!(parent, ContentStepRef::Prepared(_))
16070            && (model_schema_digest.is_some()
16071                || model_identity.is_some()
16072                || numerical_blocks.is_some() != model_content_witness.is_some())
16073        {
16074            return Err(invalid("prepared numerical blocks require their same-bank model-content witness and no host model identities"));
16075        }
16076        let expected = {
16077            let session = self.session.borrow(py);
16078            let owner = session.owner()?;
16079            let state = self.continuation_state(py, task_use, parent, &owner, import)?;
16080            self.require_continuation_witness(py, parent, producer_witness)?;
16081            if let Some(model_witness) = model_content_witness {
16082                self.require_continuation_witness(py, parent, model_witness)?;
16083            }
16084            self.continuation_binding(&state, parent, import.is_some())?
16085        };
16086        let mut budget = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
16087        let consumer_stream = parse_witness_consumer_stream(consumer_stream, &mut budget)?;
16088        if let ContentStepRef::Prepared(step) = parent {
16089            let session = self.session.borrow(py);
16090            let owner = session.owner()?;
16091            step.require_recording_stream(&owner, consumer_stream)?;
16092        }
16093        let check = || -> PyResult<()> {
16094            let session = self.session.borrow(py);
16095            let owner = session.owner()?;
16096            let state = self.continuation_state(py, task_use, parent, &owner, import)?;
16097            if self.continuation_binding(&state, parent, import.is_some())? != expected {
16098                return Err(invalid(
16099                    "original continuation scope changed during producer callback",
16100                ));
16101            }
16102            Ok(())
16103        };
16104        let model_schema_digest = model_schema_digest.map(identity_bytes).transpose()?;
16105        let model_identity = model_identity.map(identity_bytes).transpose()?;
16106        let mut services = vec![
16107            text_rows,
16108            text_row_count,
16109            selected_text,
16110            active_rows,
16111            active_row_count,
16112            numerical_admissibility,
16113        ];
16114        services.extend(numerical_blocks);
16115        // Retain the original Python producers independently of mutable input
16116        // rows. Native code retains the captured witness without a Python cycle.
16117        // Any failed callback leaves these original autograd owners quarantined.
16118        let mut producer_owners = TensorHandoff(vec![producer_witness._inputs.clone_ref(py)]);
16119        producer_owners.0.extend(
16120            producer_witness
16121                ._producers
16122                .iter()
16123                .map(|value| value.clone_ref(py)),
16124        );
16125        if let Some(model_witness) = model_content_witness {
16126            producer_owners.0.push(model_witness._inputs.clone_ref(py));
16127            producer_owners.0.extend(
16128                model_witness
16129                    ._producers
16130                    .iter()
16131                    .map(|value| value.clone_ref(py)),
16132            );
16133        }
16134        producer_owners
16135            .0
16136            .extend(services.iter().map(|value| (*value).clone().unbind()));
16137        let device = self.session.borrow(py).device_ordinal;
16138        for producer in &services {
16139            validate_continuation_producer_guarded(producer, device, &check)?;
16140        }
16141        let ParsedTensorInputs {
16142            handoff: tensors,
16143            producers,
16144        } = parse_tensor_inputs_guarded(tensors, &mut budget, device, consumer_stream, &check)?;
16145        producer_owners.0.extend(producers);
16146        let mut service_handoff = TensorHandoff(Vec::with_capacity(services.len()));
16147        for producer in &services {
16148            service_handoff
16149                .0
16150                .push(crate::dlpack_from_py_for_stream_guarded(
16151                    producer,
16152                    i64::try_from(consumer_stream)
16153                        .map_err(|_| invalid("consumer stream exceeds DLPack address space"))?,
16154                    &check,
16155                )?);
16156        }
16157        let session = self.session.borrow(py);
16158        let mut owner = session.owner()?;
16159        let state = self.continuation_state(py, task_use, parent, &owner, import)?;
16160        self.require_continuation_witness(py, parent, producer_witness)?;
16161        if let Some(model_witness) = model_content_witness {
16162            self.require_continuation_witness(py, parent, model_witness)?;
16163        }
16164        if self.continuation_binding(&state, parent, import.is_some())? != expected {
16165            return Err(invalid(
16166                "task phase changed during continuation producer handoff",
16167            ));
16168        }
16169        let authority_decisions = match import {
16170            Some(guard) => guard
16171                .original_decisions
16172                .as_ref()
16173                .ok_or_else(|| {
16174                    invalid("cold replay continuation lacks original native authority decisions")
16175                })?
16176                .as_ref()
16177                .to_vec(),
16178            None => state.snapshot.canonical.clone(),
16179        };
16180        let mut service_tensors = service_handoff.into_native();
16181        let numerical_blocks = if services.len() == 7 {
16182            service_tensors.pop()
16183        } else {
16184            None
16185        };
16186        let [text_rows, text_row_count, selected_text, active_rows,
16187            active_row_count, numerical_admissibility]: [_; 6] = service_tensors
16188                .try_into()
16189                .unwrap_or_else(|_| unreachable!("exact continuation service producer roster"));
16190        let input = SemanticContinuationInput {
16191            text_rows,
16192            text_row_count,
16193            selected_text,
16194            active_rows,
16195            active_row_count,
16196            numerical_admissibility,
16197            numerical_blocks,
16198            model_schema_digest,
16199            model_identity,
16200            tensors: tensors.into_native(),
16201            authority_decisions,
16202        };
16203        let result = match parent {
16204            ContentStepRef::Published(parent) => owner.bind_continuation(
16205                &*parent.lease()?,
16206                input,
16207                &producer_witness.inner,
16208                consumer_stream,
16209            ),
16210            ContentStepRef::Prepared(step) => owner.bind_prepared_continuation(
16211                &step.inner,
16212                prepared_bank.expect("validated prepared bank"),
16213                input,
16214                &producer_witness.inner,
16215                model_content_witness.map(|witness| &witness.inner),
16216                consumer_stream,
16217            ),
16218        }
16219        .map_err(xlog_err);
16220        drop(state);
16221        drop(owner);
16222        drop(session);
16223        result?;
16224        match parent {
16225            ContentStepRef::Published(parent) => parent
16226                .continuation_producers
16227                .lock()
16228                .map_err(|_| {
16229                    PyRuntimeError::new_err("continuation producer ownership mutex is poisoned")
16230                })?
16231                .append(&mut producer_owners.0),
16232            ContentStepRef::Prepared(step) => step.continuation_producers.lock().map_err(|_| {
16233                PyRuntimeError::new_err("continuation producer ownership mutex is poisoned")
16234            })?[prepared_bank.expect("validated prepared bank")]
16235            .append(&mut producer_owners.0),
16236        }
16237        Ok(())
16238    }
16239
16240    fn require_continuation_witness(
16241        &self,
16242        py: Python<'_>,
16243        parent: ContentStepRef<'_>,
16244        witness: &PySemanticTensorContentWitness,
16245    ) -> PyResult<()> {
16246        if witness.session.as_ptr() != self.session.as_ptr()
16247            || !match (parent, &witness.parent) {
16248                (ContentStepRef::Published(parent), ContentStepOwner::Published(issued)) => {
16249                    std::ptr::eq(&*issued.borrow(py), parent)
16250                }
16251                (ContentStepRef::Prepared(step), ContentStepOwner::Prepared(issued)) => {
16252                    std::ptr::eq(&*issued.borrow(py), step)
16253                }
16254                _ => false,
16255            }
16256        {
16257            return Err(invalid(
16258                "continuation producer witness belongs to another Session or published parent",
16259            ));
16260        }
16261        Ok(())
16262    }
16263
16264    fn continuation_state<'a>(
16265        &self,
16266        py: Python<'_>,
16267        task_use: &'a PySemanticTransitionTaskUse,
16268        parent: ContentStepRef<'_>,
16269        owner: &SemanticTransitionSession,
16270        import: Option<&ColdImportGuard<'_>>,
16271    ) -> PyResult<MutexGuard<'a, TaskUseState>> {
16272        match parent {
16273            ContentStepRef::Published(parent) => {
16274                self.execution_state(py, task_use, parent, owner, import)
16275            }
16276            ContentStepRef::Prepared(step) => {
16277                if import.is_some() {
16278                    return Err(invalid("prepared recording cannot replace replay import"));
16279                }
16280                self.require_read_issued(task_use)?;
16281                step.require_task(py, task_use)?;
16282                task_use.require_identity(owner)?;
16283                owner.prepared_stream(&step.inner).map_err(xlog_err)?;
16284                let state = task_use.state()?;
16285                if !matches!(&state.phase, TaskUsePhase::Recording { scope, .. }
16286                    if Arc::ptr_eq(scope, &step.scope))
16287                {
16288                    return Err(invalid(
16289                        "continuation requires this step's original recording",
16290                    ));
16291                }
16292                Ok(state)
16293            }
16294        }
16295    }
16296
16297    fn continuation_binding(
16298        &self,
16299        state: &TaskUseState,
16300        parent: ContentStepRef<'_>,
16301        importing: bool,
16302    ) -> PyResult<(Option<String>, Vec<u8>)> {
16303        match parent {
16304            ContentStepRef::Published(_) => Self::execution_binding(state, importing)
16305                .map(|(operation, snapshot)| (Some(operation), snapshot)),
16306            ContentStepRef::Prepared(step) => state.prepared_content_binding(&step.scope),
16307        }
16308    }
